family_scale1__Z_00243_2.desc: A symmetrical double-ended header-style housing in this family: a central finned block is flanked by equal short runouts, terminated by projecting mounting ears rather than edge flanges. The bottom is closed, the outer walls carry molded retention ridges and a keying rib, the slot row is interrupted by a single wider polarization gap, and only a few tooling holes break the otherwise plain feet.

family_scale1__Z_00774_2.desc: Compact scalloped-edge paring blade with a short drop-point body, a double row of coarse scallops along the cutting edge, a choil and sharpening notch at the heel, and a narrow hidden tang having two pin holes, one rectangular locking slot, and a jimped thumb rib on the spine.

family_scale1__Z_00015_1.part_family: miniature drilled hollow rectangular profile (slender micro-tube rail)
family_scale1__Z_00015_1.desc: An elongated open C-channel micro-profile of the same scale family, formed from a thin rectangular section with one long side removed so the bore is accessible as a slot. It uses a single evenly spaced row of through-holes along the web, two counterbored mounting holes at one end only, and a beveled cut at the opposite end instead of a stepped relief.

family_scale1__Z_00534_2.desc: A rectangular perimeter frame plate with a central octagonal window, built from a grid of crisscross diagonal struts. The crossing ribs form a dense pattern of small diamond and triangular cutouts between the inner window and the outer border, with four larger corner pads left solid. Folds along the outer border create a shallow down-turned skirt for stiffness, and every rib edge is lightly beveled.

family_pilot__Z_00061_0.desc: A one-piece shallow rectangular open frame (four-sided ring) with a large centered rectangular window. A constant ornate molding cross-section of many fine ribs, steps and grooves runs continuously around all four sides and meets in square corners. The outer edge carries a scalloped ogee contour while the inner edge is a clean reveal; small integral rectangular tabs sit at the lower inner edge and two small fillets ease the top inner corners.

family_pilot__Z_00086_2.desc: Wider pentagonal gusset blank with an arced crown, using a four-hole corner bolt pattern around a central keyed bore; it mixes in two countersunk fasteners and one radial slot, and adds a small integral locating tab on one edge while remaining a single flat pierced plate.

family_pilot__Z_00035_0.part_family: extruded sliding guide track / trim profile strip
family_pilot__Z_00035_0.desc: Long, slender solid extrusion of uniform cross-section: a flat thin base carries two parallel concave rounded grooves running the full length, separated by a narrow central rib and bordered by low raised outer rails. Both ends are plain square cuts with no holes, slots, or bosses; the whole part is one continuous prismatic profile intended as a twin-channel sliding or glazing run.

family_scale1__Z_00342_0.part_family: bent sheet-metal angle bracket with machined mounting lugs
family_scale1__Z_00342_0.desc: L-shaped formed bracket with a flat horizontal flange joined by four equal inside bend radii to a taller vertical web. The web carries two rounded end lugs, each pierced by one large through bore flanked by small through holes, plus a central raised boss with a counterbored through hole and three small holes equally spaced on a bolt circle; additional pairs of small through holes and a wide concave arch cut into the lower free edge complete the part, and the flange has two small through holes near the lugs.

family_scale1__Z_00122_2.part_family: bent sheet-metal spring strip with serrated edge
family_scale1__Z_00122_2.desc: Double-bent strip forming a shallow U: a flat central web rises into two opposed vertical legs of unequal height. One leg carries a single large semicircular bite plus a stamped dimple boss, the other leg is plain with one elongated slot, and the web is pierced by a staggered line of round holes instead of an edge scallop row.

family_scale1__Z_00455_2.desc: A compact folded-sheet bracket of the same family: an L-section plate with one short edge bent down as a mounting leg and the opposite corner notched out. The flat face has a grid of blind dimple embossments for standoff, one large rectangular aperture, two D-shaped connector cutouts, and a curled ground ear pierced with a single hole on the leg; exposed edges are hemmed rather than left sharp.

family_scale1__Z_00369_0.desc: A thin planar three-lobed carrier plate with one central through bore and three equal through bores spaced evenly on a common bolt circle. Each bore is wrapped by a raised concentric collar, the three outer collars tie back to the central hub through short curved webs, and the outside edge is a closed scalloped loop of six equal arcs with fully filleted blends; the section is a slim constant plate with one shallow face step.

family_scale1__Z_00643_1.desc: A low-profile variant uses a flat rectangular mounting plate carrying a single raised finned pedestal at its center. The pedestal has one large round through bore for a cylindrical module, four corner tapped holes in the plate, and fins cut only on two opposite faces by one uniform set of open slots while the remaining faces stay smooth and hold a pair of press-fit threaded inserts.

family_pilot__Z_00058_1.part_family: flat-bar lever with transverse round handle
family_pilot__Z_00058_1.desc: A crank-style variant bends the flat rectangular arm into a shallow L and puts a round grip bar through the short leg so the projections are unequal. It adds one side gusset at the bend, a slotted mounting eye at the free end, a locating cross hole, and light edge breaks on the exposed grip.

family_scale1__Z_00071_2.desc: Flat constant-thickness connector plate built as an elongated central bar with a round through bore at midspan and two opposed arms that neck down to slimmer rounded end lugs. Each lug is pierced by a single obround through slot, a shallow raised rim runs along the bar edges on one face, and all exterior corners, neck transitions and slot ends are rounded with matching small fillets.

family_scale1__Z_00514_1.desc: Narrow single-rail extrusion offcut with one open T-slot on each side and a central bored spine; one end is prepared for an end connector with a counterbored hole, while a sidewall has a short milled access notch and local boss for a clamp screw.

family_scale1__Z_00196_0.desc: A single uniform-thickness flat plate in a symmetric trident layout, with one large central through bore, paired upper circular bosses linked by a narrow bridge around an angular lightening window, and two lower side arms ending in rounded mounting ears. Twelve small through holes repeat around the hub and tabs, several holes are reinforced by annular pads, and all outer corners use small rounded fillets.

family_scale1__Z_00207_0.part_family: flat toothed rotary ring (sprocket / reluctor wheel)
family_scale1__Z_00207_0.desc: One thin, constant-thickness metal plate formed as an annular web between a plain inner bore and a continuous outer rim; the rim carries a single row of identical evenly spaced external teeth with rounded tooth tips and a repeating chamfer at alternating tooth roots. At the centre a small raised hub contains a through bore plus three tiny equally spaced through-holes on a concentric bolt circle; the whole toothed rim, web and hub are a single monolithic piece with no welds or fasteners.

family_scale1__Z_00783_0.desc: A rectangular open-cell core block built from thin formed foil ribbons bonded node-to-node into a regular array of hexagonal prismatic cells, with the straight cell passages running continuously between two opposite open faces; the two end faces show the hexagon pattern while the four side faces read only as parallel ribbon walls and bond lines, and the part is a cleanly trimmed core with no skins, holes, bosses, louvers, or edge fillets.

family_scale1__Z_00343_1.part_family: thin slotted grille panel with mounting bosses
family_scale1__Z_00343_1.desc: A narrow rectangular vent cover of the same family, built as a thin perimeter flange carrying one row of elongated horizontal slots rather than a multi-row grid. Only the four corners have bosses, formed as counterbored standoffs, and the back face is stiffened by a few straight cross-ribs instead of blind pockets.

family_scale1__Z_00548_1.part_family: long helical gear pinion with through bore
family_scale1__Z_00548_1.desc: A straight-cut spur gear with many fine teeth formed on a thin outer rim, the rim joined to an offset hub boss by a flat web pierced with several circular lightening holes. The bore is stepped, takes a single rectangular keyway and a radial set-screw hole in the boss, has filleted tooth roots, and the hub face is recessed for mating clearance.

family_scale1__Z_00521_0.part_family: shallow molded plastic electronics chassis tray
family_scale1__Z_00521_0.desc: A low rectangular base deck carries upstanding perimeter walls and internal ribs of mixed heights, all molded as one thin-walled shell, partitioning the tray into open bays; two raised rectangular blocks are densely patterned with many small through-holes in repeated rows, three larger round through-holes act as mounts, and several rectangular windows plus slots pierce the deck and walls with small edge fillets throughout.

family_scale1__Z_00451_0.desc: A thin, constant-thickness, narrow flat strip curved in plan into a shallow open banana/hook profile. One end is a small lug pierced by a single round through-hole for mounting, blending through a long large-radius sweep into an opposite free end terminated by a full round bulb-shaped pad. There are no out-of-plane bends, ribs, bosses, or slots; edges are clean sheared contours with filleted transitions.

family_scale1__Z_00531_1.desc: A solid press-fit dowel of the same locating-pin family, made with three equally spaced full-length grooves swaged into the shank to raise three narrow ribs for interference. It adds a short pilot chamfer at the insertion end and a flat shoulder head at the opposite end, keeping the rest of the surface plain with no slot, threads, or through-holes.

family_pilot__Z_00070_1.desc: A flat rectangular thin-walled plate with a raised peripheral flange and an X-shaped pair of ribs crossing between opposite corners into a central raised boss. Two rows of mounting holes run along the long edges, one end has an elongated adjustment slot, and the open bays between ribs are lightened with shallow pockets.

family_scale1__Z_00416_1.desc: A heavier member of the same family is bent from a wider blank into an L-shaped wall bracket with two perpendicular legs; a folded triangular stiffening rib bridges the inside corner, the base leg carries a row of three mounting holes while the upright leg has a single elongated slot, and both outer edges are hemmed for stiffness.

family_scale1__Z_00093_2.desc: A circular speaker-style cover: a narrow round rim contains concentric ring ribs tied together by radial spokes, producing curved trapezoidal openings that grow toward the outside. It adds a solid central logo pad, three hidden snap hooks on the back edge, and a shallow domed profile rather than lying perfectly flat.

family_scale1__Z_00328_1.part_family: slender ribbed-shell flat-blade hand tool (precision spudger/trimmer)
family_scale1__Z_00328_1.desc: A same-family one-piece probe but with a circular, gently tapered thin-wall tube closed by a hemispherical back cap and necking to a long conical needle point at the front; it carries one cross-drilled hole near the tip and one short axial vent slot mid-length, is stiffened inside by three equally spaced longitudinal webs rather than six, and has a knurled grip patch rolled near the rear.

family_scale1__Z_00134_1.desc: Round variant of the same family: a flat circular ring bezel with a centered lens opening, a smooth inner sealing land and the roller-bead track moved to the outer perimeter only. Beads alternate between two sizes on short separating webs, and the flat ring adds a few molded locating ears with clearance holes for fasteners so it can be clocked and screwed to a housing.

family_scale1__Z_00802_2.desc: Internal spline ring hub with a plain cylindrical outer surface and straight axial internal splines in the bore for a sliding shaft connection. Several radial oil holes pierce the rim into the spline roots, one face carries an annular lightening groove, and a single narrow locking-pin slot is cut across the spline track.

family_scale1__Z_00330_1.desc: Flat profiled carrier plate with an asymmetric three-lobed silhouette: one long spine joins a large teardrop panel to two smaller oval pads. The spine carries four round clearance holes and one slotted hole, while the largest panel uses scalloped lightening cutouts and a single shallow embossed rib with filleted borders.

family_scale1__Z_00681_0.desc: One-piece slender flat metal strip with a constant thin rectangular section and straight parallel edges. A fine regular tooth or rib pattern runs along the strip, while one end is machined into a compact cross-like nose with a single central through bore, eight small chamfers, four blend radii and several sharp micro corners; the opposite end is plain.

family_scale1__Z_00816_2.part_family: slender thin-wall tubular probe / needle shaft
family_scale1__Z_00816_2.desc: Another variant open at both ends, carrying two diametrically opposed cross-holes near one end for a retaining pin, a single external circumferential groove around mid-length, and a gently swaged short nozzle at the far end. The shell remains smooth and constant elsewhere with no internal ribs or external thread.

family_scale1__Z_00598_0.part_family: toothed/serrated flanged ring on a cylindrical hub with through bore
family_scale1__Z_00598_0.desc: A stepped axisymmetric metal part: a thick annular flange whose outer rim carries dense radial serrations/gear-like teeth all the way around is joined concentrically on one face to a smaller plain cylindrical hub that projects axially, forming a top-hat section. A single central through bore passes through both flange and hub; the hub wall is smooth and straight, the tooth roots meet the flange with sharp corners, and the hidden core of the bore is shown dashed.

family_scale1__Z_00236_1.desc: A same-family carrier disc with a central hub and keyed round bore, surrounded by six hexagonal cells that are blind pockets rather than through-holes; radial ribs tie the hub to the pocket walls and to a continuous solid outer rim, the cell mouths and periphery are lightly rounded, and the mounting face is left flat with a recessed pilot boss.

family_scale1__Z_00053_0.desc: Thin constant-thickness flat link plate whose two tapered arms meet at a central round boss carrying a through pivot bore, the arms set at a slight included angle in plan and ending in rounded tips. The web is skeletonized by through-cut lightening features—capsule-slot clusters near each tip and an angular window beside the boss—leaving a continuous peripheral rib with short struts; outer corners are generously radiused and most cut edges take a small chamfer.

family_scale1__Z_00416_0.desc: A thin constant-thickness metal strap is brake-formed from a flat pattern into a free-standing angular bracket whose base leg, upright leg and inclined brace leg all radiate from one tightly radiused folded corner. One round clearance hole passes through the bend zone, the strap ends carry small punched notches, and the edges are sheared with no ribs, bosses or welded joints.

family_scale1__Z_00662_2.part_family: thin cruciform spider plate with hex end openings
family_scale1__Z_00662_2.desc: Six-arm indexing plate: a ring-shaped hub with a keyed central through hole feeds six radial arms whose ends alternate between hexagonal recesses, forked slots, and small circular pin holes. Use scalloped outer edges, generous root fillets, and several raised locating bosses around the hub without forming a closed enclosure.

family_scale1__Z_00276_0.desc: Thin-walled molded latch with a vertical mounting ear at one end, a boxed twin-window hinge body in the middle, and a slender arm ending in a ribbed cylindrical nose. The ear has a through bore and elongated relief, the body uses open rectangular pockets around a flexure hinge, and the nose carries a through hole, small grip ribs, and rounded fillets.

family_scale1__Z_00502_0.part_family: thin flat annular ring with knurled inner bore
family_scale1__Z_00502_0.desc: A closed, flat, thin annular washer-like ring with one large central through-hole. A narrow smooth outer rim borders a wider textured inner band whose bore edge carries a dense continuous knurl running all the way around; the cross-section is a thin rectangular strip with small edge lips and a clean open center, no other holes or slots.

family_scale1__Z_00086_0.desc: One-piece constant-thickness machined spider: a central ring boss with a clean through bore carries six equally spaced curved arms that hook claw-like to one side, opening crescent windows between neighbours. The outer contour is a multi-flat profile, the pattern is six-fold rotationally symmetric about the bore, and every lobe tip, window edge and rim edge is chamfered rather than filleted.

family_pilot__Z_00109_1.desc: Same family as a smoother hexagonal spacer sleeve: three alternate flats are plain and three each contain one full-length keyway around the same coaxial hex bore. A circumferential retaining groove, chamfered lead-in, and four mid-height radial threaded holes replace the long pocket column.

family_scale1__Z_00324_2.desc: An internal ring-gear variant with the teeth formed around the inside of a deep annular shell and a smooth outer piloting band. One end is a flat mounting flange with a bolt circle of countersunk through holes, while the hub is split by a radial clamp slit drawn tight by a tangential cap screw.

family_scale1__Z_00648_1.desc: A larger rectangular bulkhead plate with two vertical columns of circular connector openings and one broad rectangular window between them. Countersunk holes sit near the corners, a shallow peripheral groove accepts a gasket,紧紧 and the rear face carries several raised standoff pads for board mounting.

family_scale1__Z_00272_1.part_family: stamped spring clip with slotted collar
family_scale1__Z_00272_1.desc: A related part uses a shorter split sleeve with a single axial seam and only two opposed cantilever leaves; its flat mounting leg has an oblong hole, stamped stiffening ribs and a folded ear instead of the long web and pierced lug.

family_scale1__Z_00690_0.desc: Trihedral corner connector: a compact machined corner block ties together three mutually perpendicular extruded arms (two horizontal at a right angle plus one vertical leg). One outer face of the block is a square mounting pad with four through-bolts on a circular bolt pattern for an end plate or foot, each arm carries a row of evenly spaced cross-drilled through holes in a few sizes, and small equal-height raised pads and short gusset fillets stiffen the joints.

family_scale1__Z_00313_2.part_family: thin flat molded comb strip with edge scallops (wire/lead organizer clip)
family_scale1__Z_00313_2.desc: An L-shaped planar comb: a short leg carrying two countersunk mounting holes and small cylindrical standoff bosses, joined at a right angle to a long leg that alternates round scallop notches with rectangular keyhole slots along its working edge, reinforced on its back face by three transverse ribs, and closed at the far end by a full-width thickened rim.

family_scale1__Z_00710_1.desc: A square filter-retaining variant uses a uniform grid of same-size square cells inside a thicker flanged rim. Four corner mounting holes and short standoff pads break the otherwise regular rib pattern, with a center cross-bar for extra stiffness.

family_scale1__Z_00614_2.desc: Square low-profile adapter frame with a thicker stepped outer rim, eight round standoff bosses in two concentric rows, and triangular gussets filling every corner. The center is fully open; one side has a wide cable cutout and elongated adjustment slots, while the remaining sides carry patterned clearance holes and molded-in threaded inserts.

family_pilot__Z_00083_0.part_family: pigeonhole shelving frame of thin panels
family_pilot__Z_00083_0.desc: Open-front multi-bay cubby frame assembled from thin sheet panels: two stepped outer side panels and intermediate vertical dividers are joined at right angles to several evenly spaced horizontal shelves, forming an uneven grid of compartments. The thin walls are stiffened by folded edge flanges, the uprights project slightly past the top shelf, and the panels carry small fastener and tab slots with no closed back or door.

family_scale1__Z_00063_0.desc: One-piece molded bracket joining a low rectangular cradle body to a tall rear upright web. The cradle is capped by an arched half-round channel open through the front, while the upright carries a large central through-bore ringed by small internal locking teeth and concentric circular ribs; outer corners are softly filleted, the upright rim and cradle edges are chamfered, and the bore has a shallow face counterbore.

family_pilot__Z_00031_1.part_family: ribbed molded control tray with thumbwheel
family_pilot__Z_00031_1.desc: A related non-copy part is a narrow open slider made from two side rails joined by cross webs, with the serrated wheel set between mid-length axle bosses. It swaps the continuous rim for elongated end slots, snap hooks and alternating short ribs underneath.

family_pilot__Z_00030_2.part_family: thin-strip open frame bracket with upright leg
family_pilot__Z_00030_2.desc: A three-sided U-shaped frame of thin uniform strip leaves the fourth side open, with a single central flat post standing normal to the frame between the two free ends. The post has a row of small clearance holes plus one elongated slot, a shallow rib runs along the inside of the frame rails for stiffness, and all bends are formed with a generous inside radius rather than sharp corners.

family_scale1__Z_00217_0.desc: A thin flat plate formed as a quatrefoil web with four short raised cylindrical collars spaced a quarter-turn apart around a central through hole. Each collar is a hollow boss with its own through bore, the collar bases blend into the web with small fillets, and the entire outer rim carries a continuous band of fine, uniform semicircular scallops that give the four lobes a serrated, gear-like edge.

family_scale1__Z_00681_2.desc: Double-tab rack-strip variant: a smooth narrow spine joins two wider end tabs, each tab carrying one round hole and two lightening slots. Opposed tooth rows sit on the tabs rather than the spine, with chamfered tooth tips and generous fillets at every spine-to-tab transition.

family_scale1__Z_00375_1.desc: Similar slotted rotor disc but with a thicker raised hub and a splined or keywayed centre bore instead of a plain hole. Fewer, wider radial arms connect to a continuous scalloped outer ring, the spoke roots are reinforced with curved gussets, the rim has blind counterbores rather than through notches, and only selected edges are filleted while the slot sides remain as-cut.

family_scale1__Z_00309_1.part_family: machined round hub flange with lightening pockets
family_scale1__Z_00309_1.desc: A lighter adapter plate of the same family built as an open spoke wheel: six radial ribs connect the rim straight to the hub with no separate boss ring, leaving six through fan-shaped windows that break toward the scalloped OD. It uses one plain pilot bore, four tapped holes on the bolt circle, two dowel holes, a stepped rear register recess, and uniform chamfers around every edge instead of a rear counterbore.

family_scale1__Z_00825_1.part_family: flat multi-arm linkage plate with truss lightening
family_scale1__Z_00825_1.desc: Flat cross-shaped linkage plate with four short arms radiating from a thickened central hub. The hub has one main pivot bore surrounded by a small bolt circle, while each arm is a slim web relieved by round lightening holes; opposite arms end in clevis eyes and the other two end in slotted mounting tabs, all in one uniform sheet thickness.

family_scale1__Z_00121_2.desc: A compact L-shaped bulkhead joins a punched connector face to a perpendicular mounting base with one bend and a generous inside radius. The face mixes a few large round power-connector holes, a cluster of small signal-connector holes, and one rectangular cutout, while the base has two obround fixing slots, threaded-insert bosses, and a half-sheared cable-tie lance.

family_scale1__Z_00146_2.desc: Compact two-port adapter frame in the same family: two adjacent rectangular pass-throughs are separated by a center web, with six insert-ready circular bosses around the ports and a hinged top latch. Vent slots cross the rear wall, diagonal ribs tie the side walls to the base, and one breakaway mounting tab provides an alternate install option.

family_scale1__Z_00423_2.part_family: right-angle flat-strap crank link with a bored eye hub
family_scale1__Z_00423_2.desc: Three-way junction in the same plate-link family: a central cylindrical boss carrying one transverse bore, with three radiused-end tangs leaving it (two opposite in line and one perpendicular). Each tang ends in a semicircular tip, the perpendicular tang has a smaller secondary cross-hole near its free end, and triangular gusset ribs on both faces reinforce the boss-to-tang transitions.

family_scale1__Z_00549_2.desc: An eight-lobe daisy plate: the outer edge is a scalloped ring of rounded, non-forking petals with narrow radial slots between neighbours that stop short of the hub, and there is no outer rim. The central area combines a counterbored through bore with a small bolt circle of clearance holes on one pitch, while shallow pressed beads run a short distance out along each petal root for stiffness so the part remains essentially flat.

family_scale1__Z_00499_1.desc: Same family, but an oval escutcheon frame with a circular central opening. It has a continuous rounded outer lip, a flat rear mounting flange with several evenly spaced through-holes, and a radial rib pattern on the back face rather than edge ribs.

family_scale1__Z_00192_1.desc: A low-profile rotary cap of the same family with a blind internal boss for an insert and a shallow domed crown; the grip band uses dense fine knurl ribs interrupted by a few wide thumb flats, plus one molded index pip on the rim.

family_scale1__Z_00475_0.part_family: stepped compound spur gear (coaxial cluster gear)
family_scale1__Z_00475_0.desc: One-piece stepped cluster gear: a large external spur ring and a smaller coaxial pinion are rigidly tied together by a reduced-diameter cylindrical hub, giving a spool-like side section. Both rims carry cut involute teeth; the large ring has a central through bore with an internal toothed recess and four repeated radial blend features, while the pinion presents a short locating boss.

family_scale1__Z_00696_2.desc: Two-row offset well carrier on a closed thin floor: two parallel banks of square pockets share a central spine wall, one bank deeper than the other, with a round locating boss in alternating pockets. The perimeter is a thin shell with corner mounting ears, vertical guide ribs inside the taller bank, a latch lever formed on one side wall, and drainage slots through the shared spine.

family_scale1__Z_00244_2.part_family: machined cheese-plate mounting plate with four corner bosses
family_scale1__Z_00244_2.desc: A narrow rail-style plate runs a full-length edge slot and a central rectangular lightening window, with cross-drilled clevis lugs clustered at both ends. In place of a square-hole array it carries a sparse line of obround slots and paired tapped holes, with triangular gussets beneath the end lugs and one raised index-pin boss.

family_scale1__Z_00422_2.part_family: solid rectangular-section straight bars and spacer blocks
family_scale1__Z_00422_2.desc: A same-family short rectangular spacer block of constant cross-section featuring two longitudinal holes on one broad face, a centered longitudinal slot on the opposite face, and small corner fillets; the end faces remain plain and there are no external ribs.

family_scale1__Z_00427_2.desc: A short elbow-shaped track corner with a flat base flange and an upstanding curved web; the web carries two long arc slots separated by a rib, the flange has a slotted mounting hole at each end, and small triangular gussets stiffen the ends where the web meets the flange.

family_scale1__Z_00607_0.desc: A rigid flat base plate carries a network of thin vertical wall panels standing at right angles, dividing the rectangular footprint into several connected rooms and a corridor. Door openings interrupt the partitions with swing clearance shown in plan, while small square recesses sit at two wall junctions and tiny through-holes pierce the base; the walls share one uniform height above the slab, giving a single-piece scale model of a floor plan.

family_scale1__Z_00328_2.part_family: slender ribbed-shell flat-blade hand tool (precision spudger/trimmer)
family_scale1__Z_00328_2.desc: A symmetrical double-ended member of the same family: two opposing ribbed oval shells meet at a thicker central collar formed as a raised boss band, each end terminating in a bevelled working edge (one a wide straight chisel, the other a narrower angled pick), with a through-slot in the collar for a tether and only two internal longitudinal ribs per shell, all shell-to-rib and shell-to-collar junctions filleted.

family_scale1__Z_00683_2.part_family: thin-walled rectangular connector housing with side boss
family_scale1__Z_00683_2.desc: A low-profile clamshell-half variant with an oval rounded-rectangle bezel, a continuous peripheral mounting groove, four corner screw bosses, and two oblong cable slots along one side. A side cylindrical spud provides a central ported opening flanked by alignment pins, and the underside uses a lattice of thin ribs in place of through windows.

family_scale1__Z_00333_1.desc: A six-bay countertop organizer of the same family uses five straight (non-leaning) thin divider plates joined by three wire tie rails, with a back-stop rail closing the rear. Instead of arches, each bay has a shallow rectangular lower notch, and every divider ends in a flanged foot intended to fasten down to a sheet base tray.

family_scale1__Z_00061_1.desc: A similar thin spacer ring but made as a split spring ring: one radial kerf passes through the wall so the annulus can expand over a shaft, and four through-holes are evenly spaced on the face for screws. The bore and outer edge are chamfered, a narrow raised annular locating rib runs near the outside of one face, and the rim is otherwise round without flats.

family_scale1__Z_00813_1.desc: A stiffer single-sided rack bar with square-cut gear teeth across the top face and a plain flat underside; both ends are square-cut and each carries a pair of countersunk mounting holes, two narrow longitudinal ribs run beneath the tooth line for stiffness, and a lone elongated through-slot near mid-length provides clamp adjustment.

family_scale1__Z_00247_0.desc: Single rounded-rectangular enclosure shell with four generously filleted outer corners and small chamfers along the vertical edges. Its flat top deck is populated in one row by three hexagonal insert bosses and two counterbored through-holes, then by a small rectangular window, a large capsule-shaped pocket and a smaller capsule pocket; the long sidewall has a centered rectangular notch at its lower edge plus a tiny side tab, the short ends carry a central locating slot, and the inner faces are stiffened by many close-spaced vertical ribs.

family_scale1__Z_00103_0.part_family: flat sunburst rotor plate with central bore
family_scale1__Z_00103_0.desc: A single constant-thickness flat plate whose perimeter is cut into a radial sunburst: numerous sharp triangular teeth ring a round central web, while four longer pointed spikes project past the tooth ring at even quarter spacing. The web carries a smooth central through bore with a low annular raised ring on one face, and the tooth flanks and spike edges are broken by a repeated set of small chamfers. In edge view the rim reads as a regular segmented band of the repeated tooth silhouettes.

family_scale1__Z_00810_0.desc: One continuous thin strip is formed into an open semicircular half-band with a rectangular cross-section and constant wall. The inner and outer faces are smooth concentric cylindrical shells joined by square-cut end faces; it has an open through throat and no punched holes, slots, ribs, bosses, or separate fillet features beyond the bend radius.

family_scale1__Z_00813_0.desc: A slender flat blade whose upper edge carries one continuous row of many small rounded rack teeth while the lower edge stays smooth; the toothed run begins just behind a short stepped-down tang at one end and terminates at the other in an enlarged rounded eye lug whose outer radius is concentric with a transverse pin through-hole, with a tiny rectangular boss standing on the blade beside the lug. The body is uniform thin stock, and the eye is formed as a solid rounded pad blended smoothly into the strip.

family_scale1__Z_00606_0.desc: Thin circular base plate carries a central through-hole and an equally spaced ring of identical upright blades around its periphery. Each blade is a narrow formed fin with a bent outer tab/notch, rising from the top face and leaving the inner area open.

family_scale1__Z_00642_2.desc: Deeper two-by-two compartment tray with larger square pockets, a thicker stepped outer flange, and internal fillets at every rib-to-floor junction. Two opposite sidewalls carry snap-fit latch tabs, the base has a central blind boss ringed by small vent holes, and the rib edges are plain without notches.

family_scale1__Z_00247_2.desc: Taller two-bay enclosure shell split by a central transverse wall, each bay carrying its own capsule pocket and a pair of hexagonal threaded inserts. It swaps the top counterbores for molded cable-entry slots on both short ends, adds two external mounting ears with plain holes at the corners, a rectangular knock-out panel on one long side, and an egg-crate rib pattern on the floor rather than dense vertical wall ribs.

family_scale1__Z_00726_0.desc: A flat constant-thickness rectangular plate carries a dense aligned matrix of circular through-holes in five rows, with the first row using a larger hole size and the remaining rows using a smaller size. The long edges are stepped with rectangular notches and small latch-style tabs, the hole mouths are eased, and the edge views show a thin wall with intermittent short backing ribs or standoffs rather than a deep shell.

family_scale1__Z_00561_2.desc: A mostly rectangular constant-thickness plate with three small mounting eyes spaced along one short edge and a matching pierced tab at the opposite corner. The field has one large D-shaped cutout, a straight row of small round holes, and one open perimeter bay with stepped sides; corners are rounded and every feature passes through the sheet.

family_scale1__Z_00410_0.desc: Uniform-thickness flat metal link with two rounded end lugs, each carrying a single large pivot bore of differing size, joined by a narrowing web; a large hooked through cutout nested between the lugs is bounded partly by an internal cylindrical arc, and five small through fastener holes are spread along the web and lugs with all outer transitions filleted and no ribs, bosses, or bends.

family_scale1__Z_00202_1.desc: An elongated sibling uses two parallel edge rails bridged by spaced rungs and diagonal truss webs, with one center row of standoff bosses for components. One end carries a large clearance cutout and slotted mounting ears; the other end switches to solid pads with countersunk holes and molded-in alignment pins.

family_scale1__Z_00563_1.part_family: slender precision-punched metal mounting strip / perforated rail
family_scale1__Z_00563_1.desc: A similar perforated strip but wider and thicker, with two staggered rows of round holes down the web plus a few larger countersunk mounting holes clustered near both ends, and elongated clearance slots replacing the end bolt-circle pad.

family_pilot__Z_00081_0.desc: A one-piece open rectangular tray: a flat base plate edged by a low doubled perimeter lip carries thin upright partition walls that are edge-joined to the base and meet each other at right angles. The walls come in a tall set and a low sill set, forming several unequal rectangular bays; one bay is closed by a fine mesh vent panel and another frames a small recessed pocket. Small standoff bosses sit on the base between walls, a single short chimney-like post rises near a rear edge, narrow clearance slots cut the wall feet, and every interior wall-to-base junction is softly filleted.

family_scale1__Z_00645_2.part_family: thin toothed annular indexing ring (encoder/timing disc)
family_scale1__Z_00645_2.desc: A thin encoder disc with a smooth continuous outer edge and many fine internal radial timing slots just inside the rim rather than external teeth. Six circular lightening cutouts form a spoked web between the slotted band and a keyed central bore, and several countersunk flat-head screw holes are evenly spaced around the web; the disc is a uniform-thickness stamping with no bosses.

family_scale1__Z_00679_1.desc: A pressed flat four-arm spider in an X layout with a notably larger central pad and a central keyed bore; the broad arms are ribbed on one face by shallow pressed stiffening beads and join the pad through large fillets, while their tips are open forked slots rather than closed rings. Two opposite arms carry raised threaded bosses and the other two carry plain clearance holes, and the panel uses a few wide lightening windows instead of dense perforations.

family_pilot__Z_00096_1.part_family: slender rectangular hollow-section tube (straight RHS post/spacer)
family_pilot__Z_00096_1.desc: A same-family square hollow-section post with the same constant thin wall, sharp corners, and open square-cut ends, but with one through-hole across opposite faces near each end and a single elongated slot centered on one side face. Keep the core unobstructed and the ends plain.

family_scale1__Z_00414_2.part_family: thin stamped sheet-metal plate / flat shim bracket with stepped outline
family_scale1__Z_00414_2.desc: A flat sheet-metal locator plate shaped as a wide U: two parallel fingers extend from a common spine, separated by a deep rectangular slot open at one end. The spine carries two countersunk holes and a small central boss-like dimple, while each finger tip has a single round hole; all features lie in one plane with uniform sheet thickness.

family_scale1__Z_00190_2.part_family: radially slotted thin rotor disc with central drive hub
family_scale1__Z_00190_2.desc: A shallow dished (conical) variant with no separate boss: the center has a hexagonal through-hole stiffened by a short raised reinforcing ring, and the sloped outer band mixes long radial slits with shorter edge notches in an alternating pattern. A few sparse radial ribs on the back face stiffen the dish, and three countersunk mounting holes sit on the inner flat ring.

family_scale1__Z_00123_2.desc: A lightened pulley/sheave variant with a machined V-groove around the outer circumference and eight tapered triangular lightening slots around a central bearing bore. Thin radial ribs on one face tie the hub to the grooved rim, and a single stamped index mark sits beside one slot; all slot roots and groove shoulders are filleted.

family_scale1__Z_00642_0.desc: Thin-walled square tray with a low perimeter rim and an internal three-by-three rib grid forming nine equal open pockets on a common base. The outer wall and rib tops are castellated with repeated rectangular slots, the base carries two through holes along the centreline, and thin uniform walls connect rim, ribs and floor with small corner/root fillets.

family_scale1__Z_00017_0.desc: A tall monolithic molded canister with a regular hexagonal shell, softly rounded vertices and flat end faces. One end carries a cluster of deep axial cylindrical sockets in two sizes grouped around a central hole, plus a smaller bore and a raised concentric ring boss, with a short stepped tab standing at the middle; all six side faces are patterned with shallow horizontal rounded-end flutes stacked in vertical columns, and the top rim is chamfered.

family_scale1__Z_00275_1.part_family: thin-walled vented square sleeve enclosure with chamfered corners
family_scale1__Z_00275_1.desc: A taller rectangular louvered riser of the same thin-panel family but closed at the bottom by an integral floor and finished at the top with an outward mounting flange pierced with several bolt holes. Two adjacent faces use a wide grid of obround ventilation slots while the other two are solid with vertical strengthening ribs and a pair of internal snap bosses.

family_scale1__Z_00412_1.part_family: curved spring slat of thin strip
family_scale1__Z_00412_1.desc: A laminated leaf spring built from two bonded curved strips stacked in thickness. The leaf tapers in width from midspan toward each end, terminating in a rounded eye with a single mounting hole per end, with generous fillets blending the eyes into the spring body.

family_scale1__Z_00652_2.desc: A wide U-channel mounting rail with a flat base and two sidewalls. Each sidewall carries an alternating pattern of lanced formed-over tabs and circular pierced holes, the base has a small cluster of dimpled locating bosses, and the closed ends have corner notches and a return lip for fastening.

family_pilot__Z_00094_0.desc: An elongated thin flat metal strip with a smoothly rounded nose at one end, a gently tapered upper edge along its length, and a short angled-down mounting tab at the far end; a single round through-hole pierces the strip near the tab, and the part is a constant thin wall with a large fillet at the nose.

family_scale1__Z_00306_2.part_family: straight-fluted hollow dowel pin (grooved press-fit retaining pin)
family_scale1__Z_00306_2.desc: A hollow slotted spring pin formed as a rolled cylindrical shell of uniform wall thickness with one continuous longitudinal gap that lets it compress radially during installation. Both ends carry generous lead-in chamfers, the outer surface is smooth rather than fluted, and the cross-section closes to a full circle when seated in the hole.

family_scale1__Z_00350_1.part_family: elongated toothed rail with integral clips
family_scale1__Z_00350_1.desc: A straight flat gear-rack bar of uniform rectangular section with evenly pitched teeth along one full long edge and a smooth datum face on the opposite edge. A line of counterbored through-holes runs mid-width between two internal stiffening ribs, and each end carries a machined locating notch rather than a clip ear.

family_scale1__Z_00098_0.desc: A thin flat plate with fivefold rotational symmetry: a small central hub is carried by five radial slotted arms to five round outer eyelet lugs. The hub has one through bore, each lug has a matching through hole on a common bolt circle, and each arm is a comb of narrow parallel through-slots bounded by filleted webs; outer lobes have local flats and all sheet edges are rounded.

family_scale1__Z_00562_0.desc: A flat, shallow rectangular frame built from a constant-thickness outer border (two continuous rails and two end stiles) with several evenly spaced vertical mullions spanning between the rails, forming a single row of tall narrow through-openings. All members share the same thin wall and shallow depth, are integral with no separate infill panel, and have a flush rear face with only small internal corner fillets and no bosses or mounting features.

family_scale1__Z_00494_0.desc: Single thin constant-thickness plate cut as a star wheel: a compact central hub carries one center through bore and five small through holes evenly spaced on a bolt circle, with narrow rectangular blades radiating integrally from the hub. Each blade is a flat strap with abrupt in-plane elbow bends, open square-cut tips, sharp outer corners, and little or no filleting, forming an evenly spaced multi-blade rotor pattern.

family_scale1__Z_00750_0.desc: One-piece synchronous pulley: a thin outer rim carries many evenly spaced radial belt teeth around its full circumference and is tied through a recessed solid web to a concentric central through-bore. A short cylindrical hub projects from one face of the web and is cross-drilled with a single radial through-hole for a pin or set screw; tooth roots and the bore are plain, with small edge breaks rather than generous fillets.

family_scale1__Z_00767_2.desc: A symmetrical dual-cheek linkage bracket uses two parallel side plates joined by cross-ribs and boxed spacers between end eyes, leaving a central rectangular window. The end bores are flanged for press-in bushings, one cheek adds a keyway slot, and the outer faces carry patterned dowel holes and counterbored fasteners instead of an open X-web.

family_scale1__Z_00584_2.part_family: thin stamped annular retainer ring with perimeter tabs and notches
family_scale1__Z_00584_2.desc: A C-shaped split thrust washer/retainer whose ring is not fully closed; the two ends overlap through a tongue-and-slot joint for radial compliance. The outside diameter carries fine evenly spaced grip serrations, three short tangs are stamped and bent axially to locate against a housing, and one face has two countersunk mounting holes while the opposite face carries an embossed circular rib for spring preload.

family_scale1__Z_00263_0.desc: One continuous punched and formed metal blank shaped as an open three-sided rectangular frame: a straight cross bar carries two parallel legs so the inner edges leave one large window that breaks out through the open side. The cross bar inner edge has stepped notches and a short comb of tiny rectangular lances, low coined domes stand slightly proud of the sheet at intervals, and the leg ends and one narrow side tab carry small through-holes arranged as a four-hole group and a separate three-hole group, with a chamfered lead on one tab.

family_scale1__Z_00517_0.desc: A thin constant-wall circular disc formed by an outer annular rim with a recessed inner shoulder. Four radial webs connect the rim to a small central boss, leaving four open quadrant windows with rounded outer edges.

family_pilot__Z_00035_2.part_family: extruded sliding guide track / trim profile strip
family_pilot__Z_00035_2.desc: Snap-on capping variant: a shorter flexible extrusion with a convex top carrying three shallow decorative grooves and an underside formed as a spring barb that clips over a panel edge; no fasteners are used, the outer nose is generously radiused, and the profile is supplied in coils for cut-to-length trim work.

family_pilot__Z_00040_1.desc: A nearly closed circular retaining clip bent from the same class of strip, interrupted by a small radial gap; two opposed ears project outward near the gap, each pierced with a single round hole, with a short offset tang for tool handling and smooth coined transitions at every bend.

family_scale1__Z_00421_1.part_family: thin flat multi-eyelet plate (spinner-style bossed flange)
family_scale1__Z_00421_1.desc: Elongated thin plate of the same constant thickness formed as five annular eyelets in a straight line, each joined to the next by a narrow pinched waist so it reads like a flat link bar. Only the two end eyelets get counterbored through holes for seated fasteners, the three middle eyelets carry plain drilled holes, and each connecting waist is lightened by an obround through slot; edges are plain broken with no raised ribs.

family_scale1__Z_00349_1.desc: A shorter arc-sector segment of the same family but with the tooth row on the convex outer edge rather than the concave edge. It uses fewer, deeper teeth, has a raised boss with two through mounting holes near mid-arc, triangular stiffening ribs on the back face between boss and flange, and both ends closed by integrally molded stop blocks.

family_scale1__Z_00434_0.desc: Constant-thickness flat plate with three equal through bores set in a rounded tri-lobe outline; the lobes are blended by tangent fillets and separated by curved organic relief slots that leave narrow ligaments to the outer edge.

family_scale1__Z_00511_2.part_family: open-front thin-panel shelving cabinet with divider slots
family_scale1__Z_00511_2.desc: Shallow wall-mount organizer built the same way from thin sheet: an open-front box with a partial-height back and a single fixed shelf, plus a few wide vertical bins formed by removable divider plates rather than many narrow fins. The back panel carries a regular pattern of keyhole mounting slots and two large rectangular access cutouts, and the outer corners are reinforced with small welded gusset tabs instead of plain folded seams.

family_pilot__Z_00110_2.part_family: slender precision steel pins and small shafts
family_pilot__Z_00110_2.desc: A hollow tubular spring pin rolled from thin strip into a long cylinder with one longitudinal slot running its full length so the wall can flex inside a bore. Both ends are tapered with a lead-in chamfer and three raised detents are pressed at stations along the wall to grip the housing, with no cross-holes, threads or external grooves.

family_scale1__Z_00499_2.desc: Rectangular picture-frame bezel with a two-tier stepped inner aperture sized for a glass panel and backing. The outer profile is straight with bevelled corners instead of scrolled sides, the rear carries an integral hanging boss plus two keyhole slots, and widely spaced gussets tie the outer lip to the inner window.

family_scale1__Z_00177_1.part_family: spoked wheel with treaded outer band
family_scale1__Z_00177_1.desc: Five straight tapered spokes connect a smooth continuous outer ring to a compact center hub, with a hexagonal axle socket instead of a star recess. The contact band is mostly slick with shallow circumferential grooves, and small vent slots are placed between the spoke roots near the rim.

family_scale1__Z_00037_0.desc: An elongated straight rack built as an integral T-section: a thin full-length base flange carries a narrower central web, and the top of the web is machined with a dense uniform run of identical transverse teeth. From above the tooth crests form a continuous mirrored chevron (herringbone/double-helical) pattern about the centerline, while the side view reads as regular vertical slots; the ends are plain square cuts with no holes, bosses, or added fillets.

family_scale1__Z_00262_0.part_family: thin machined carrier plate with clustered ring bosses
family_scale1__Z_00262_0.desc: A flat, uniform-thickness machined plate whose footprint is a rounded triangular cluster of raised annular bosses with large through-bores. The bosses are tied together by narrow triangular webs that leave open windows between rings, three smaller through-holes are equally spaced on a common bolt circle at the cluster center, and the outer lobes are closed with six matching generous radii.

family_scale1__Z_00282_1.part_family: hubbed radially slotted circular cutter disc
family_scale1__Z_00282_1.desc: Flat rotary cutter plate with a thicker reinforced inner ring and a plain round bore plus a single keyway; alternating long and short radial slots break the outer rim into uneven cutting teeth, and two small countersunk drive holes sit on the bolt circle.

family_scale1__Z_00588_0.desc: A straight one-piece annular sleeve open through its axis, with a smooth cylindrical outer wall and plain flat end faces. The bore carries an internal ring-gear set of forty-six coarse teeth with generous root fillets together with ninety-two fine axial serrations over the central length, bounded by short smooth bands at both ends; four small axial through holes are equally spaced on a bolt circle through the annular wall.

family_scale1__Z_00173_2.desc: Flat multi-bay version: a straight rectangular plate rather than leaning towers, with two pairs of round bores on a vertical face and a central reinforcing rib down the back. Retention is by molded side snap-latches instead of bent foot hooks, with plain cylindrical bosses, no hex flats, and one split cable-entry slot.

family_scale1__Z_00273_1.part_family: stamped and bent strip-metal hook / flat spring latch
family_scale1__Z_00273_1.desc: A shorter double-ended flat spring strip of the same rectangular section: one tip is rolled into a fully closed eye curl while the opposite tip is flattened and pierced with two round mounting holes separated by a central longitudinal slot. A single pressed stiffening bead runs down the middle of the shank, the edges are coined smooth, and there is no side tab.

family_scale1__Z_00226_1.part_family: rectangular open-grid frame with connector bosses
family_scale1__Z_00226_1.desc: Same-family carrier frame using a single row of tall rectangular bays instead of a square grid, with unevenly spaced vertical mullions and one solid end wall. Only the two lower corners carry threaded connector bosses, while the opposite long edge has a molded snap rail and a thin perimeter lip for gasket seating.

family_scale1__Z_00536_1.part_family: slender solid rectangular strip (flat precision bar)
family_scale1__Z_00536_1.desc: A similar slender flat strip arranged as a clamping strap: same uniform rectangular section but with two clearance through-holes, one near each square-cut end, matching back-face counterbores, and a single long edge broken by a light chamfer while the opposite edge stays sharp.

family_scale1__Z_00664_0.part_family: trussed open frame of thin punched rails
family_scale1__Z_00664_0.desc: Open rectangular equipment frame assembled from thin punched sheet-metal rails rather than a closed shell. Twin tall slotted uprights rise from a long multi-bay base; the base ties longitudinal edge rails to repeated cross members and diagonal X-braces, forming a row of open cells with folded flanges, small edge tabs and dense patterns of round mounting holes.

family_scale1__Z_00586_1.desc: Same family but six-fold: a constant-thickness flat drive plate with six equal concave drive scallops around the rim and six plain round mounting lugs between them. It has a central bore with a single keyway, two concentric rings of round lightening holes (different diameters per ring), three short radial pin slots opening toward the scallops, and three low circular boss pads clustered around the bore on one face only.

family_pilot__Z_00040_2.desc: An S-curved formed bracket with a straight mounting leg carrying two obround slots, folding through one stiffening radius into an opposing hook leg; a shallow embossed rib runs along the bend apex, the hook tip is chamfered, and a small locating dimple is coined near the folded junction.

family_scale1__Z_00012_2.part_family: slender flat-bar link strip with cross holes
family_scale1__Z_00012_2.desc: A narrow flat-bar connector with mixed end features: a round pivot hole at one end and a short longitudinal slot at the other, with a shallow milled relief pocket on one broad face between them. The body remains a single solid strip with rounded end corners and no added ribs.

family_pilot__Z_00069_1.part_family: ribbed plastic enclosure half with molded honeycomb grille
family_pilot__Z_00069_1.desc: Deep molded plastic cover half of similar clamshell type, with a snap-latch perimeter rim and a large central recessed panel. Venting is provided by a regular grid of round holes rather than hex cells, flanked by two clusters of cylindrical screw bosses; the inner face is stiffened by a crossing rib lattice and the outer corners are generously filleted for molding.

family_scale1__Z_00335_2.desc: A Z-profile sheet-metal retention clip with two opposed mounting flanges joined by a narrow web. One flange has a keyhole slot and the other a pair of round holes; the web is stiffened by lanced ribs, with clipped notches and a few dimpled standoffs instead of continuous spring fingers.

family_scale1__Z_00167_1.desc: Two-piece clamshell hood of the same family: mating halves meet on a central seam with a short body, three wide vent slots on each side wall rather than on the face, an integrated finger latch on one flank, and two metal jackscrew inserts by the mating face. Cable exits through a top opening with molded strain-relief ribs, and there is no rear extension or drilled corner boss.

family_scale1__Z_00162_1.desc: Molded display bezel with a portrait rectangular opening shifted toward one end, a continuous raised sealing rib around the window, six perimeter snap hooks and two locating pins. Two corner bosses use threaded inserts while the other corners are plain clearance holes.

family_pilot__Z_00035_1.part_family: extruded sliding guide track / trim profile strip
family_pilot__Z_00035_1.desc: Single-channel variant: an extruded runner strip whose top face has one deep U-shaped groove centered between broad flat mounting shoulders; the web is drilled with a regularly spaced row of countersunk holes, and the ends are miter-cut so lengths can be joined into a rectangular frame.

family_pilot__Z_00038_0.desc: A bent sheet-metal bracket of uniform thickness folded along straight bend lines into an open angular channel of intersecting flat flanges. One long edge carries a single deep V-shaped notch near an end, while the opposite end is cut on a taper down to a pointed tip. All walls are planar with sharp outside corners, small inside bend radii, and no holes, slots, ribs, or bosses.

family_scale1__Z_00394_1.desc: Two-feature pivot lug: a flat blade carries a hollow sleeve at one end and a thicker solid mounting pad at the other, with paired triangular gussets flanking the blade; the pad has two clearance holes and one keyway slot, and the blade-to-sleeve junction is blended with a small fillet radius.

family_scale1__Z_00104_1.desc: A four-arm cross plate in the same family, built around a thicker central ring with a keyed through bore. Four round raised bosses stand equally spaced on the ring, each with a single tapped hole, and the narrow webs between bosses are opened with lightening pockets; one arm also carries a radial set-screw into the hub.

family_scale1__Z_00546_2.desc: A compact square-section manifold rail: a short prismatic block with two longitudinal through-bores crossed by several transverse drilled galleries that intersect them, the gallery mouths spot-faced on one face only. One end is counterbored and threaded for a fitting while the opposite end is plain, an integral side flange carries two bolt holes, and all exterior edges are chamfered rather than radiused.

family_scale1__Z_00088_0.desc: Thin constant-thickness bracket plate with a rectangular base and a single diagonal top edge forming a right-triangular outline. One face carries six rectangular blind lightening pockets in a stepped triangular array (rows of three, two and one) separated by integral ribs inside a perimeter wall; pocket roots and outer corners are filleted, all exposed and pocket edges have a small uniform chamfer, and three through fastener holes sit near the corners.

family_scale1__Z_00490_0.part_family: inverted-U support frame of thin flat bar
family_scale1__Z_00490_0.desc: One-piece goalpost arch bent from uniform thin rectangular strip: two long legs splay outward from a straight top rail through small square corner blocks. The rail carries one short centered underside notch plus several shallow rectangular edge notches along its length; the legs are plain flat strips ending in square-cut feet, with no through-holes and only small chamfers at the corner bosses.

family_scale1__Z_00301_2.desc: Low single-pedestal variant using a shallow C-section wall: an open rectangular frame with a regular diamond grid of cutouts rather than organic cells, topped by a curved saddle that cradles an extruded seat beam and backed by three internal gusset ribs. A wide flat foot with elongated mounting slots and a drain notch replaces the toothed rail, and all outer corners are generously filleted; a pair of threaded inserts on the saddle accepts a swivel seat pan.

family_scale1__Z_00188_2.desc: Wide molded timing idler with twin peripheral tooth bands separated by a shallow circumferential groove. The open web has three kidney-shaped cutouts and internal radial ribs, while the stepped central bore provides a bearing seat, retaining-ring groove, and a smooth lead-in chamfer.

family_scale1__Z_00795_0.desc: One-piece annular collar with a central round through bore and a stepped inner wall. The outer rim is a continuous castellated band of sixteen integral rectangular lugs separated by small rounded root notches; the lugs carry the same axial thickness as the ring, with shallow face steps and softened edges.

family_scale1__Z_00397_0.desc: A shallow, constant-thickness half-cylindrical shell with a C-shaped arc cross-section, open along both long edges and bounded by square-cut end faces. A single narrow, shallow longitudinal groove runs along the crown of the concave surface, stopping short of the ends, and each end face carries a small curved notch or lip where the groove meets the rim. No holes, ribs, or bosses are present; the part reads as a simple curved channel cover.

family_scale1__Z_00187_2.part_family: flat radial multi-spoke spider hub plate
family_scale1__Z_00187_2.desc: An eight-tooth index star wheel built as a flat ring hub with short rectangular radial lugs. The inner hub carries a bolt circle of countersunk through holes plus three dowel-pin bores, every other lug root has a through clearance slot, the outer edge is scalloped between teeth, and one lug is shorter with a timing notch to define rotational position.

family_scale1__Z_00660_0.desc: This strip is a straight, symmetric thin-walled shell with a hollow rectangular center spine tying two identical terminal heads. Each head is a compact multi-row block of small rectangular contact cavities and internal septa, wrapped by paired snap beams with barbed catches, short lead-in ramps, and radiused junctions; the features are molded slots and latches rather than bored holes.

family_scale1__Z_00651_2.desc: A compact double-row variant with features split into two staggered longitudinal lines of equal closed-bottom rectangular wells rather than a center channel. One end has a transverse polarizing keyslot, the mid-section has a single large through clearance opening, and the underside carries a few low raised locating pads.

family_scale1__Z_00579_0.desc: Straight seamless thin-wall tube of constant hollow rounded-square cross-section: four flat outer faces run the full length and meet at four equal external corner rounds, while the matching square bore uses four smaller internal fillets so the wall stays uniform. Both ends are open and cut square to the axis, with no holes, slots, ribs, bosses, seams or end fittings.

family_scale1__Z_00715_1.desc: Heavy rectangular framing extrusion with twin round anchor bores in line down its length, surrounded by four closed rectangular cells tied together by diagonal ribs. Three T-slots span the top face, one slot runs down each side, the bottom face is flat, and thick outer walls end in chamfered corners; both cut ends are machined square.

family_scale1__Z_00458_1.desc: A four-arm relative in the same flat star-plate family, using broader blunt-ended spokes around a raised annular hub boss. The central bore is keywayed, four small clearance holes sit on a bolt circle in the boss, and short radial slots open into the concave gaps between adjacent arms.

family_scale1__Z_00708_2.desc: A deeper rectangular shielding cover formed as a shallow pan with side walls and a perforated top face. It swaps the regular round-hole grid for staggered slots or hex vents, adds underside reinforcing ribs, several integral grounding spring fingers along one wall, and a raised boss near one corner.

family_scale1__Z_00472_2.part_family: webbed radial spider hub with end eyes
family_scale1__Z_00472_2.desc: Six-spoke stamped-look variant with spokes every 60 degrees around a large-bored thin annular center; a ring of small mounting holes circles the hub, each short spoke ends in a slotted tang fitted with a pressed bushing sleeve, alternating spokes carry a single stiffening rib on one side only, the outer rim has two dowel holes, and fillets are minimal compared with the ribbed reference part.

family_scale1__Z_00647_1.desc: A shorter clip-point blank with plain unengraved faces, one large lanyard hole at the pommel instead of twin pins, a long shallow fuller groove, a ground swedge near the tip, a finger choil plus a single bent integral guard, scalloped filework along the spine, and a narrow rat-tail tang rather than a full flat one.

family_scale1__Z_00012_1.part_family: slender flat-bar link strip with cross holes
family_scale1__Z_00012_1.desc: A flat rectangular strap link with three pin holes on the wide centerline: one near each end and one at mid-length. The long edges carry a small chamfer, and the middle hole is set in a slightly raised circular boss while the bar stays otherwise prismatic.

family_scale1__Z_00732_0.desc: A thin flat rectangular frame molded in plastic, defined by a large central window with generous internal corner fillets. A row of small raised through-hole bosses runs across one edge, with additional through-holes near the opposite corners, short edge notches between bosses, a narrow side slot and small polarizing tab, plus an embossed triangular orientation mark inside the opening and stiffening ribs on the back face.

family_pilot__Z_00110_1.part_family: slender precision steel pins and small shafts
family_pilot__Z_00110_1.desc: A stepped latching shaft built from several concentric diameters: a long ground body, a thinner pilot nose, and a rear reduced neck ending in a short external thread for a nut. It adds one annular circlip groove partway along the body, two milled wrench flats just behind the body, and one cross-hole through the nose for a retaining clip, with small fillets at the shoulders and chamfers on all exposed edges.

family_scale1__Z_00183_0.desc: Monolithic flat rectangular bezel ring with a large centered rectangular through-window. One face carries a shallow stepped rabbet around the window, forming a raised outer rim and an inner seating ledge with concentric edge lines; the section is uniformly thin with small edge breaks and no holes, ribs, or bosses.

family_scale1__Z_00803_2.desc: An internal-toothed ring member of the same family: a thin annulus carries inward-facing teeth, three broad crescent cutouts, and a bolt circle of counterbored mounting holes. The center is a large clear opening, with generous rounds at the cutout ends and tooth roots.

family_scale1__Z_00557_2.desc: A thicker stepped connector block from the same plate family, with two parallel through bores crossing a transverse drilled passage. One face carries a hex socket recess and a counterbored port, the opposite face has a sealing groove, and two small mounting ears with clearance holes replace the lozenge outline.

family_pilot__Z_00091_0.part_family: openwork flat cut-plate star wheel / sheet-metal flange
family_pilot__Z_00091_0.desc: A single flat constant-gauge plate cut as a sixfold openwork star: six tapered spokes radiate from a small central hub and end in blunt squared lobes, all lying in one plane with no bends, ribs, or drawn features. The hub carries one round through-bore with a narrow keyway notch, and each gap between neighbouring spokes is cleared by a curved teardrop slot whose ends terminate in identical round fillets.

family_scale1__Z_00597_2.part_family: thin injection-molded plastic ring grille with spokes
family_scale1__Z_00597_2.desc: A racetrack-shaped molded support grille: two straight side rails join semicircular end rings, bridged by a ladder of even transverse ribs over a central longitudinal spine. Four corner posts have counterbored mounting holes, alternating rib heights form a shallow dish, and a continuous perimeter lip snaps into a housing with a couple of cable notches in selected ribs.

family_scale1__Z_00149_2.desc: A zigzag sheet-metal retainer of the same thin stock, bent into a shallow channel along its spine so it is not purely flat. The web carries a regular pattern of obround pierced slots with narrow embossed ribs between them, flared mounting feet at each end hold two clearance holes apiece, and one side is scalloped into finger grips while the opposite side stays straight and smooth.

family_scale1__Z_00720_1.desc: Rectangular slotted extrusion, wider than it is tall, with T-slots only on the two broad faces and the two narrow faces left flat and closed; an off-centre main bore is flanked by two screw bosses, the long edges are chamfered, and one end is cut square while the other is mitered for a frame corner.

family_scale1__Z_00372_0.desc: Low-profile closed rectangular ring forming a large central through-window, with a flat underside and a stepped top that creates one continuous shallow rabbet between an outer rim and an inner raised lip for seating a panel. Four small through-holes sit on corner pads just inside the rounded outer corners, the outer vertical edges carry a uniform small fillet, and the walls are thin and constant with no added ribs.

family_scale1__Z_00729_1.desc: A straight, unbowed flat-strip retainer of the same thin constant-width stock, terminated at each end by a fully rolled closed eyelet instead of open hooks. A row of several evenly spaced pierced adjustment slots runs down the mid-length, short stamped transverse stiffening ribs sit just inboard of each eyelet, and the longitudinal edges are lightly hemmed for safety.

family_scale1__Z_00683_1.part_family: thin-walled rectangular connector housing with side boss
family_scale1__Z_00683_1.desc: A compact square member of the same housing family with a single centered rectangular window rather than paired slots, six counterbored face holes spaced around the perimeter, and the round connector boss shifted to a corner. The boss uses a plain central bore with three flange holes, and the interior is stiffened by one diagonal rib instead of transverse webs.

family_scale1__Z_00373_0.desc: A hollow injection-moulded rectangular brick: thin peripheral walls form an open-bottom box closed by a flat top deck that carries four short cylindrical studs in a two-by-two grid. Directly beneath each stud is a coaxial stepped socket—small blind bore opening into a larger counterbore/tube—so a mating brick can plug in; internal tube walls and ribs tie the four sockets to the side walls, the lower rim has a shallow peripheral relief, and nearly every edge shares the same small round.

family_scale1__Z_00190_0.part_family: radially slotted thin rotor disc with central drive hub
family_scale1__Z_00190_0.desc: A thin flat circular disc with a raised cylindrical boss at its center, blended into the disc face with a large fillet. The boss carries a centered square through-hole for a shaft drive, and the outer annular band of the disc is patterned with many evenly spaced, slightly angled radial slots running from an inner solid ring out to the rim; the disc inner face and rim are otherwise plain.

family_scale1__Z_00581_0.desc: Constant-thickness cloverleaf plate with three filleted arms radiating from a central ring and merging through concave webs into a smooth outer rim. The ring has a centered circular through-hole, and each arm carries a pad with a cross-shaped recessed/through key feature; edge views show small stepped rims and repeated pad details around the lobes.

family_scale1__Z_00527_0.desc: Thin uniform sheet press-brake bent into a shallow flanged tray: a broad flat deck is integral with upturned edge walls on several sides and one taller end wall, all from a single blank. The deck carries a dense regular grid of identical small through-holes plus a small separate cluster of different through-holes, while the flanges repeat the same holes in straight rows, with simple bent corner intersections and no ribs, bosses, or added hardware.

family_scale1__Z_00406_0.part_family: thin slatted rectangular grille / vent cover panel
family_scale1__Z_00406_0.desc: Flat rectangular molded grille with a continuous low perimeter rim and several closely spaced integral ribs running the long direction, forming narrow through-slots between them; the ribs tie into solid end rails, the wall section is uniformly thin, and the short ends carry small solid seating tabs.

family_pilot__Z_00119_1.desc: A surface-mount spring contact: a flat anchor pad pierced by two round holes merges through a shallow S-bend into a resilient cantilever beam that terminates in a raised hemispherical contact dimple instead of an eye. A central embossed rib stiffens the beam, and the free edge is forked into twin contact tines.

family_scale1__Z_00757_0.part_family: stamped and formed sheet-metal yoke bracket
family_scale1__Z_00757_0.desc: A constant-thickness flat metal plate shaped as a compact three-arm yoke: a central head/web splits into a left leg, a right leg and a side arm, all blended with generous fillets. The head carries two closed cutouts (a large rounded-rectangular window and a smaller D-shaped grip loop), plus an embossed rectangular boss near the fork; the three free ends have small rectangular through-slots/lanced catch features, and all inner and outer corners are radiused.

family_scale1__Z_00784_0.part_family: thin-wall instrument tube / hypodermic-style metal cannula
family_scale1__Z_00784_0.desc: A straight, slender, thin-wall metal tube of uniform small circular cross-section running end to end, forming a hollow shell with a continuous axial through bore; near one end a pair of small cross-holes is drilled through the wall perpendicular to the axis, both ends are clean square-cut, and the outer surface is otherwise smooth and featureless with no ribs, flanges, or threads.

family_scale1__Z_00668_0.desc: Thin circular molded cover with a continuous outer rim and a shallow stepped edge. Straight ribs cross in an open diamond lattice and tie into the rim; three small through holes plus a separate clearance hole are set among filleted rib junctions and small local bosses.

family_scale1__Z_00326_0.desc: Straight constant-cross-section extruded standoff/rail with fourfold symmetry: a small central boss holds one axial through-hole, four radial webs tie the boss to four perimeter rails, and the bays between rails form full-length longitudinal grooves. The single body has square-cut ends, four rounded outer corners and eight small chamfered edges; aside from the central hole it is uninterrupted along its length.

family_scale1__Z_00812_0.desc: A flat constant-thickness metal strap: a closed rounded eye (annular loop) at one end flows through an offset zigzag neck into a slender trussed web pierced by alternating rounded-oblong and triangular lightening slots. The opposite end narrows into a laminated tongue of several stacked leaves pierced by one small through-hole, with many small edge fillets and a few larger blend radii around the eye.

family_scale1__Z_00423_0.part_family: right-angle flat-strap crank link with a bored eye hub
family_scale1__Z_00423_0.desc: Constant-thickness plate formed as an L: a short cylindrical eye hub with a single transverse through-bore sits at the corner, and two flat tangs leave it at a right angle with small tangent fillets into the hub. The long tang is a parallel-sided strap ending in a semicircular tip; the short tang is a narrower rectangular strap ending square. Thin uniform wall, no ribs, slots, or extra bosses beyond the single bored eye.

family_scale1__Z_00732_1.desc: A deeper clamshell-style connector bezel half with the same rectangular window concept but a continuous mating lip around its perimeter and screw bosses only at the four corners. It uses an internal rib lattice for stiffness, a keyed asymmetric cutout on one side edge, and molded snap-latch hooks along two opposite flanks instead of exposed through-hole pads.

family_scale1__Z_00071_0.desc: Constant-thickness flat plate with a round central hub pierced by a single through bore; three identical arms radiate from the hub at equal spacing and broaden into rounded end pads. Each pad carries a centered blind regular-hexagon socket in one face, the outer contour uses short straight flats joined by generous rounds, and every vertical edge and pocket corner is broken with the same small fillet while the faces stay parallel.

family_scale1__Z_00085_0.desc: A shallow rectangular open-top tray machined as one thin-walled pocket: a flat base is bounded by low perimeter walls with small internal fillets and a few larger external corner radii. Three full-length ribs stand on the base and divide the cavity into four narrow lanes; the ribs and end walls carry repeating rounded-end through slots, mixed columns of small through holes, and one larger through mounting hole.

family_scale1__Z_00310_2.desc: A symmetric top-hat/omega style rail with a raised central crown and two flat side flanges sharing one bent blank; the flanges hold many small fixing holes on a tight pitch, the crown has one row of larger oblong clip slots, one end adds a stamped locking lance and an embossed ID pip, and several positions are left as knockout dimples rather than punched through.

family_scale1__Z_00363_2.desc: A stepped double-shell bushing with a long smooth bore and a shorter enlarged collar; the collar uses two circumferential rows of large hexagonal pockets while the barrel uses sparse slotted perforations. An internal annular boss, an external keyseat, and blended fillets at the step provide mounting and alignment features.

family_scale1__Z_00712_2.desc: A ribbed idler-rotor variant with a narrow outer running band flanked by two thin side flanges, connected directly to a thick central flange by many straight in-plane radial ribs forming an open lattice. The centre uses a multi-spline bore, a circumferential bolt circle of small lightening holes sits between hub and band, one face is recessed while the other is flat, and a small integral balance boss projects from the rib side.

family_scale1__Z_00083_0.part_family: open slotted divider tray of thin panels
family_scale1__Z_00083_0.desc: Open-top rectangular rack assembled from thin sheet panels: low outer side walls and a base frame joined at the corners by bent tabs, with a row of evenly spaced vertical divider plates spanning front-to-back to form parallel part slots. The dividers and top rail carry small edge radii and rounded slot mouths; the base and divider feet are patterned with triangular lightening cutouts, and the rear rail has a pair of through holes plus a small hexagonal across-flats boss feature.

family_scale1__Z_00104_2.desc: A five-lobe star plate of essentially constant thickness with a central splined bore and no raised pads. Five tapered spokes run to a scalloped outer rim, and flush countersunk holes are set on a bolt circle in the webbing between the spokes, with the perimeter lightly chamfered.
