family_scale1__Z_00303_1.desc: A wider flat vent cover of the same perforated-plate family: a rectangular panel with square corners and a continuous solid border, a central band of hexagonal through cells framed by an embossed stiffening rib, four countersunk screw holes at the corners, and one larger circular port breaking the pattern near one edge.

family_scale1__Z_00368_2.desc: A short symmetric finned sleeve has a radial mounting flange at mid-length drilled with a bolt circle, and both ends neck down to smooth locating diameters. One side is closed by an integral domed cap so the central cavity is blind, with a lone keyway in the bore and widely spaced heavy ribs instead of a dense fine fin pattern.

family_scale1__Z_00240_2.part_family: flat multi-pocket bearing cage / retainer ring
family_scale1__Z_00240_2.desc: A thicker stepped member of the same family with two concentric pocket rows: an inner row of small round holes and an outer row of elongated pill-shaped pockets. The central bore carries a single keyway, the outer rim is an integral toothed gear edge, fasteners are countersunk blind holes rather than through, and one face has an annular lubrication groove with a small radial feed hole.

family_scale1__Z_00617_2.desc: A compact power-resistor-style finned housing formed as a thin rectangular tube with stacked fins on one broad face only and a flat mounting flange on the opposite face. Removable end plates close the tube and carry a mixed pattern of countersunk holes, one central clearance slot, a grounding stud and two press-fit standoffs. Fin edges use only a few large scallops with no tiny fillet field, and one end plate is extended into a bent bracket for panel mounting.

family_pilot__Z_00062_1.desc: A folded sheet sign made as a shallow rectangular backer pan with a perimeter return and a row of blocky raised serif letters across the face. Instead of open channel characters it mixes embossed solid bosses for some strokes with pierced negative cutouts for others, with punched mounting holes grouped near both ends and a hemmed stiffening edge along the top.

family_scale1__Z_00271_2.desc: Closed yoke-style stamped plate with an oval four-hole flange and two short edge slots entering from opposite sides to create a serpentine center ligament. It uses countersunk mounting holes, a coined reinforcement ring around one hole, small perimeter fillets, and one shallow bent lip for clearance.

family_scale1__Z_00147_1.desc: A flat corrugated spring ribbon pressed from a single sheet with several identical wave cycles; punched slots between alternating crests create a comb-like flexure pattern, and each end extends into a wider mounting tang carrying a pair of through holes.

family_scale1__Z_00024_1.desc: Same family but arranged as a straight horizontal strip: four raised-boss through-holes in a row, linked by a single diagonal cross-brace between each adjacent pair and closed by a slim outer rail. It adds slotted mounting eyes at both strip ends and one central lightening slot, keeping one flat face with chamfered edges throughout.

family_scale1__Z_00258_0.desc: A thin uniform-thickness planar strip: one end closes into a rounded rectangular eye/loop for anchoring, a narrow waist opens into two long parallel rails separated by a central slot, and the far end fans into a one-sided comb of even-pitch cantilever tines with tiny chamfered tips. All transitions are radiused, the section is constant sheet with no bosses, and the only openings are the eye slot and the slots between tines.

family_scale1__Z_00554_1.part_family: pigeonhole storage cabinet of thin panels
family_scale1__Z_00554_1.desc: Low, wide wall-mount pigeonhole shelf of the same thin-panel type: a shallow open case with a back panel carrying keyhole mounting slots, mixing a few full-width document slots across the top with a dense bank of narrow vertical-divider cubbies below. Two dividers drop into notched slots so they are removable, shelf fronts are turned into small label flanges, and each side panel has a pressed stiffening emboss.

family_scale1__Z_00347_1.desc: A flat rectangular sheet-metal grille with two horizontal banks of punched louvers separated by a solid center rib; the perimeter is hemmed for stiffness. Four corner holes and a pair of side keyhole slots provide mounting, and pressed stiffening beads run between the louver columns.

family_scale1__Z_00073_2.desc: Four-arm flower knob/backplate with a domed center boss, blind bore and cross drive slot; two opposite broad petals are larger than the other pair and carry raised hexagonal studs instead of sockets. The scalloped perimeter is rounded, the underside has a concentric stiffening ring with short perimeter ribs, and two opposite petals integrate countersunk mounting ears.

family_scale1__Z_00797_0.desc: One continuous C-shaped band bent from constant rectangular-section strip, open on one side with two square free ends and small end chamfers. The inner and outer edges are concentric smooth arcs; the face is plain and there are no holes, slots, ribs, bosses, or patterned teeth.

family_pilot__Z_00070_2.desc: A thin annular disc with a continuous outer ring joined by four evenly spaced radial spokes to a central hub. The sectors between spokes are mostly open, each spoke blends into the ring with a small fillet, the hub has a keyed through bore, and separate pads around the rim each take one countersunk fastener hole.

family_scale1__Z_00023_0.desc: An elongated flat strap joins a rounded eye at one end to a taller cylindrical barrel boss at the other, acting as a pivot link. The central web is pierced by repeated narrow oblong slots arranged in groups, and short transverse webs carry several small round through-holes for fasteners; edges are straight with generous end radii and the barrel stands proud of the strap as a thick ring.

family_scale1__Z_00544_1.desc: A similar open-frame bezel plate with an off-center rectangular window; pocketed cells populate only two opposite rails in staggered rows, while the remaining rails are mostly solid and include several through mounting holes, short connector slots, and four small corner bosses.

family_scale1__Z_00580_1.desc: A laser-cut constant-thickness linkage plate laid out as a five-point star, where a solid central pentagonal hub carries five slim radial arms. Each arm is split lengthwise by one obround slot and ends in a clevis eye, while the hub holds a single large central bore surrounded by a symmetric ring of small through holes; short curved gusset webs tie neighboring arms together and every re-entrant corner is filleted.

family_scale1__Z_00702_0.part_family: T-slot aluminum extrusion profile, cut to length
family_scale1__Z_00702_0.desc: A short straight cut of a symmetric multi-slot aluminum framing extrusion. The cross-section carries several longitudinal T-slots across the top and side faces, an internal lattice of thin webs dividing hollow chambers, and multiple continuous through-bores of two sizes running the full length. Slot mouths, rib tips and cavity corners are rounded with small fillets, and both ends are plain square saw cuts.

family_scale1__Z_00242_0.desc: A shallow circular grille plate with a rounded outer edge and a raised concentric rim, molded as one piece with a short rear skirt. The front face splits into an upper field of many small rectangular window apertures in staggered rows and a lower field of long horizontal louver slots separated by thin ribs, with a small uniform fillet on the outside corner.

family_pilot__Z_00046_1.part_family: thin triangular spacer plate with raised circular pad
family_pilot__Z_00046_1.desc: Same-family triangular plate but pierced rather than padded: a central round through-hole with a back-side counterbore replaces the solid boss, and three counterbored mounting holes sit one near each apex. A slim perimeter rib on the underside links the three hole bosses and stiffens the panel.

family_scale1__Z_00383_0.desc: Uniform-thickness flat plate shaped as an inverted wishbone: a circular eye lug at the apex is pierced by one transverse through bore, and its round outside blends tangentially into two straight, slightly tapered legs that diverge down to small flat mounting feet. A large concave semicircular arch is cut upward into the lower edge between the legs to clear a mating shaft, leaving a centre ligament; transitions are small profile fillets, with no ribs, slots, added bosses, or secondary holes.

family_scale1__Z_00576_1.desc: A compact rectangular sensor-node board of the same laminate type, but with no edge-contact finger: castellated half-holes line both short edges, a single central through-hole header field and one corner-pair of mounting holes serve fixation, and the top face mixes small surface-mount bodies with a coin-cell clip and a chip antenna at one corner. The underside is essentially bare except for a few test pads.

family_scale1__Z_00461_2.desc: Cylindrical honeycomb insert built as a short hollow tube whose wall is a double-thickness lattice of large hexagonal cells; a flanged rim with a chamfered lead-in sits at one end and a smooth solid collar band wraps the opposite end for retention.

family_scale1__Z_00393_0.desc: One thin-walled shell whose profile is a shallow concentric-arc strip (well short of a half-round): a convex outer cylinder and a concave inner cylinder of near-constant radial thickness, closed at the two arc ends by short radial cheek faces so the front view reads as a crescent with upturned tips. That crescent is carried straight across a single axial width that is split by one internal shoulder into a full-depth end pad and a slightly relieved adjacent band, giving one visible step and one hidden inner edge; there are no holes, slots, ribs or bosses, only small edge breaks.

family_scale1__Z_00628_1.desc: A same-thickness flat cover plate framed by a solid perimeter border, with one centered rectangular sight window in the upper half and a dense grid of small round vent holes covering the lower half; the bottom rail has two keyhole mounting slots, one side edge has a half-round cable notch, corners are radiused, and there are no internal ribs or bosses.

family_scale1__Z_00539_1.part_family: flat profile-cut sheet blank (thin silhouette plate)
family_scale1__Z_00539_1.desc: A decorative flat cut-out blank of uniform sheet thickness with a symmetrical six-point star/gear outline around a solid centre, one central clearance hole for a fastener, and smoothly filleted roots between adjacent pointed lobes. It is a purely planar waterjet/laser-cut plate with no bends, slots or secondary bosses.

family_pilot__Z_00034_0.desc: Uniform-thickness cloverleaf plate made from four equal round lobes in a two-by-two cluster; the paired lobes are tangent while the left and right groups are tied by narrow waisted webs. It has one small across-flats through feature at a central pad, an open rectangular edge relief on the opposite side, generous perimeter blend radii, and no raised ribs beyond the plate thickness.

family_scale1__Z_00545_2.part_family: machined mounting plate with integral upright bosses
family_scale1__Z_00545_2.desc: Round flanged member of the same family with a central large bore, six low radial bosses on one bolt circle and three taller equally spaced posts topped by flat pads. Elongated lightening slots sit between the posts, small through holes are laid out on two concentric circular patterns, and thin ribs tie each post back to the outer flange with radiused intersections.

family_scale1__Z_00322_0.desc: A straight extrusion of constant complex cross-section: two parallel hollow round coolant tubes run the full length and are joined by a thin central web that carries a dense longitudinal fin grid; the end face packs several clustered through-ports of differing diameters, small across-flats on selected bores, one off-center clearance hole, and opposed angled longitudinal runs that chamfer the flanks; the tube mouths have short entry chamfers and the finned web stops short of the plain end tubes.

family_scale1__Z_00605_1.desc: Closed-deck faceted kayak: the same folded thin-panel chine construction, but skinned over by a continuous deck that leaves a single oval cockpit cut-out with a raised coaming flange. Two watertight transverse bulkheads plus a bow crash frame divide the interior, the stern carries an integral skeg slot, and the bottom runs with more rocker and one soft chine radius instead of exposed ring frames.

family_scale1__Z_00450_2.part_family: thin flat closed frame ring (delta bezel/spacer)
family_scale1__Z_00450_2.desc: Closed scalene triangular frame ring with deliberately unequal wall widths: the longest wall is wider and carries elongated slots plus small lightening holes, one vertex has two raised boss pads for standoff, and a narrow formed bead around the inner window edge adds stiffness while the part remains a single thin flat loop.

family_scale1__Z_00034_1.desc: A same-family tweezer built as two straight spring straps joined at the rear by a folded bridge instead of a crossing pivot; it has flat serrated gripping pads rather than needle points, a row of circular lightening holes along each handle, a single oblong adjustment slot, and generous fillets at the fold with no crossing geometry.

family_scale1__Z_00638_0.part_family: finned hollow extrusion with gabled profile
family_scale1__Z_00638_0.desc: A single straight thin-walled extrusion cut square at both ends, formed as a closed five-sided shell: two vertical side walls and a flat base rising to two sloped roof faces that meet at a small flattened ridge. The outside carries dense uniform longitudinal fins running the full length over the roof and side faces, while the inside is one smooth continuous gable-shaped cavity; only minor stepped foot details at the base and the blunted ridge break the sharp edges. There are no holes, bosses, slots, or separately joined panels.

family_scale1__Z_00291_0.desc: Flat triangular sheet-metal web with one short edge folded perpendicular into a narrow upstanding mounting flange whose top lip is rolled into a small curled barrel; the bend root carries a small rounded fillet. Four through-holes pierce the web, three grouped in a tight cluster just off the bend line and a single hole farther toward the tapered nose, with the free end drawn out to a pointed tip.

family_scale1__Z_00347_0.desc: A long thin sheet-metal panel with a sloping top edge; the flat web is cut by many parallel vertical slots with one edge lanced and bent inward to form a dense row of louver fins. Short folded end flanges close the panel, exposed edges carry small chamfers, and a few small bent tabs along the lower edge act as mounting feet.

family_scale1__Z_00584_0.part_family: thin stamped annular retainer ring with perimeter tabs and notches
family_scale1__Z_00584_0.desc: A one-piece flat annular plate of uniform thin section with a large central bore; the outer rim carries eight evenly spaced castellated lugs separated by rounded notches, and the inner rim has matching scalloped cutouts so the ring edge reads as alternating tabs and reliefs. Around the mid-thickness a regular row of small stamped rectangular windows/slots appears in edge view, and all notch roots and tab corners are broken with small fillets rather than sharp corners.

family_scale1__Z_00401_0.desc: Rotationally symmetric top-hat spacer: a straight thin-walled hollow barrel is joined coaxially at its lower end to a thin flat circular base flange, leaving an annular seat around the barrel. A single central through-bore runs the full height, the shell section is uniform, and there are no ribs, slots or secondary holes; the only transition is a small circumferential fillet where the barrel meets the flange.

family_scale1__Z_00388_2.desc: Another variant is a shallow U-channel clip with one end tab folded back to make a closed corner and the opposite end left open. It uses hemmed outer edges, two lanced stiffening ribs across the web, and an oblong slot in the base flange for adjustment.

family_scale1__Z_00181_0.desc: A metal double timing pulley with two coaxial externally toothed rims joined by a narrower cylindrical central web, giving a spool-like section. It has a full central through bore, three axial through holes evenly spaced on a bolt circle between the bore and the teeth, and rounded fillets where the web meets each toothed rim.

family_scale1__Z_00145_0.desc: A constant-thickness flat plate with a central round through bore for a bearing; three identical arms leave the hub at equal angles and each ends in an integral hexagonal ring boss forming an outer weight pocket. Narrow webs tie the rings and bore together, with filleted arm roots, small relief notches beside the hub, and rounded outer corners throughout.

family_scale1__Z_00439_1.desc: A right-angle folded sheet bracket with two broad flanges sharing one bend line; one flange has a row of three round mounting holes and the other has one elongated slot, with the outer corners lightly radiused.

family_scale1__Z_00247_1.desc: Low-profile member of the same shell family laid out as a shallow base with a continuous peripheral lip for a snap-on lid and four corner screw bosses instead of chamfered edges. The deck uses one off-center large capsule opening, two round connector counterbores on one side and a row of three rectangular connector cutouts along the opposite long edge; stiffening comes from a few transverse floor ribs plus two internal standoff pillars, and the outer wall is smooth with no side notches.

family_scale1__Z_00529_1.desc: A stepped solid pinion shaft carrying two external spur-gear bands of different face width, separated by a turned relief groove. It adds a keyed through bore, circumferential retaining-ring grooves on the journals, and a small radial lubrication hole into the bore.

family_scale1__Z_00709_1.part_family: profiled flat metal linkage/clevis plate bracket
family_scale1__Z_00709_1.desc: A boomerang-shaped flat plate of even thickness serves as a bellcrank, with a pivot bore at the elbow and a pin bore near each arm tip. One arm carries a slotted adjustment hole and a small integral stop tab, while shallow lightening pockets are milled into one face between the three bores. All bores are normal to the plate, the perimeter is chamfered, and the arm roots blend with generous fillets rather than added ribs.

family_scale1__Z_00678_1.desc: A shorter flat perforated strip of the same rail family with one centered row of larger through-holes and a staggered partial second row. Both ends carry counterbored fixing holes, one long edge has a shallow relief notch, and the corners are chamfered rather than square.

family_scale1__Z_00457_2.part_family: molded thin-wall keypad faceplate with display window
family_scale1__Z_00457_2.desc: A rugged handheld-terminal bezel with a thickened perimeter bumper, reinforced corner ribs, and one large touchscreen window occupying most of the face. A compact column of oblong function-key openings runs along one side while a separate three-by-four block of square numeric key slots sits opposite; the underside carries multiple locating bosses, metal-threaded inserts, a molded gasket groove, and cutouts for a connector and lanyard.

family_scale1__Z_00676_2.part_family: long drilled-perforated flat bar / multi-hole mounting strip
family_scale1__Z_00676_2.desc: A compact connector block from the same drilled-strip family: a short, thick rectangular bar with three staggered rows of small through-holes on its top face, two cross-holes drilled through the side faces at right angles to the top rows, and small chamfers on all external edges. Ends are counterbored for mounting screws, mixing hole rows, cross-drilling, and edge breaks in one part.

family_scale1__Z_00395_1.desc: A hinged split clamp collar in the same open-ring family: the rectangular-section band is closed on one side of the gap by an integral thin flexure hinge and on the other side by a pair of facing pinch ears, each ear carrying one bolt clearance hole. The outer wall has three evenly spaced axial ribs, the bore has one radial set-screw boss opposite the hinge, and all external edges are lightly chamfered.

family_scale1__Z_00309_2.part_family: machined round hub flange with lightening pockets
family_scale1__Z_00309_2.desc: A heavier dished coupling hub in the same family with no through lightening windows: a solid bowl web rises from the outer rim into a tall central barrel boss that is keyed and cross-drilled for a shaft pin. The flange face carries eight blind tapped holes and a counterbored pilot from the opposite side, with three backside radial stiffening ribs, filleted boss-to-web transitions, and an O-ring groove in the rear register.

family_pilot__Z_00047_1.desc: A formed sheet-metal variant uses a shallow channel back web with left and right side flanges and six shorter ribs spot-welded across the inner face. The end ribs are notched for cable ties, the middle ribs carry a row of round clearance holes, and exposed edges are closed with small hems.

family_scale1__Z_00775_0.desc: A single thin constant-gauge plate cut to a sixfold dendritic snowflake silhouette: six radial primary arms grow from a small hub and each carries two opposed pairs of lateral twigs, with every outer tip and inner crotch finished by equal small fillets. The hub has a large central through aperture plus a small across-flats hex detail, and the part is entirely through-cut with no bosses, ribs, bends or formed features.

family_pilot__Z_00049_2.part_family: flat paddle link plate with a bolted circular eye flange
family_pilot__Z_00049_2.desc: Wider gusseted mounting paddle of the same family: a thick-rimmed circular head with a central bore combines through-bolts on one circle with a few raised threaded bosses and countersunk dowels on the same face. The head transitions into an offset plate arm containing an oblong adjustment slot and stamped stiffening beads, with a notched, chamfered free end instead of a plain flat tip.

family_scale1__Z_00780_2.desc: Flat-strap scroll clip with a straight mounting tongue pierced by two round holes, a generous radius into a half-volute pressure arm, and a short reverse-curl contact pad; an embossed longitudinal bead stiffens the tongue and stamped dimples replace through-slots.

family_scale1__Z_00016_1.part_family: folded perforated sheet-metal guard / vent fascia panel
family_scale1__Z_00016_1.desc: Single almost-flat guard panel of the same family: a rectangular plate with rounded corners and one long closed slot, perforated by a regular hexagonal honeycomb field instead of an organic pattern, with a row of countersunk mounting holes along one edge and a short stiffening return flange formed on the opposite edge.

family_scale1__Z_00429_1.part_family: slender thin-gauge metal reed/probe with formed end(s)
family_scale1__Z_00429_1.desc: A flat spring reed of the same family rather than a tube: a long uniform thin strip with a gentle offset, one end rolled into a single closed eye for a pin and the opposite end pierced with two small round holes bridged by a short central slot. A narrow pressed stiffening bead runs over only part of the length, edges are deburred, and all corners carry small radii.

family_scale1__Z_00105_1.part_family: machined round flanged housing and end-cap adapters
family_scale1__Z_00105_1.desc: A similar circular adapter housing but with a taller thin-walled cup, a flat gasket face, and a blind central bore instead of a through outlet. It uses six counterbored flange holes, an external retaining-ring groove, two opposed wrench flats, and one radial side port.

family_scale1__Z_00155_2.part_family: flat spider carrier plate with bossed holes
family_scale1__Z_00155_2.desc: A two-pad connecting plate in the same family: two unequal closed ring bosses are joined by a straight narrow waist with no central hole, the larger boss polygonal with a blind threaded stud on its back face and the smaller boss given an obround adjustment slot. The perimeter is finished with a handful of generous corner radii, one face is recessed to seat a retaining ring, and a short reinforcing rib runs along the waist on the reverse side only.

family_scale1__Z_00211_2.desc: A symmetrical Y-shaped flat plate with three arms meeting at a central junction, each arm ending in a circular through bore and an open fork slot. Give the junction a polygonal through cutout with a raised annular boss, place weight-reduction pockets in each arm, and finish external transitions with small fillets and evenly spaced rim notches.

family_pilot__Z_00076_1.desc: A similar family part as a single formed C-channel mounting strip rather than an open ladder: one long web with a down-turned flange and an offset return lip, pierced by a linear pattern of elongated mounting slots and two larger end holes. It has plain sheared ends, no internal cross walls, and broader bend radii along the folded edge.

family_scale1__Z_00724_2.desc: A low-profile vented retaining ring is made from two concentric hoops bridged by four S-shaped arms, with a scalloped inner edge and smooth blended transitions. Three keyway slots provide anti-rotation, while blind threaded inserts are on the back face instead of simple through holes.

family_scale1__Z_00545_1.part_family: machined mounting plate with integral upright bosses
family_scale1__Z_00545_1.desc: L-shaped variant of the same bracket family: a horizontal base leg with three obround pass-through slots transitions into a single taller upright leg at one end, stiffened by two small gusset ribs at the corner. The base carries two five-hole circular bolt patterns and low mounting pads, while the upright ends in a clevis pair with cross holes instead of perimeter towers.

family_pilot__Z_00010_2.part_family: ribbed injection-molded carrier plate with through-boss array
family_pilot__Z_00010_2.desc: An angled member of the family: a single row of three large through-collars plus scattered small holes is set into a vertical ribbed web, which is joined by a broad gusset fillet to a flat horizontal mounting flange. The flange carries obround adjustment slots and countersunk screw holes, the rib field is a coarse cross-hatch instead of a tight waffle, and the free top edge of the web is molded as a toothed connector profile.

family_scale1__Z_00532_1.desc: A perforated mounting channel of the same long constant U section, with equal-height flanges and a single centered row of round holes along the web plus an oblong slot near each end for adjustment; a shallow stamped longitudinal stiffening bead runs on the outside face of the web opposite the opening, the ends remain square-cut, and the bend corners are kept small.

family_scale1__Z_00264_1.desc: Compact member of the same family built as a short stout rail with one central raised block pierced by a single large counterbored aperture flanked by two small reamed pin holes. Slotted end feet replace round mounting holes, shallow lightening pockets open the underside, and the top carries only a sparse set of tapped holes rather than a dense micro-groove row.

family_scale1__Z_00062_2.desc: A round six-lobe variant with six equal through bores evenly spaced on a ring around a central counterbored bore; every web between adjacent outer rings is opened by a small round lightening hole, three flats are milled on the outside for wrenching, and one lobe carries a radial keyway slot instead of a crown notch.

family_scale1__Z_00579_1.desc: A stepped thin-wall rounded-square tube of the same hollow construction but formed with a short swaged reduction near one end so the tip becomes a smaller rounded-square nose; the opposite end is closed by an integral pressed cap. Two opposed cross-drilled pin holes sit just behind the cap and the open nose has a chamfered lead-in, with otherwise plain unribbed walls.

family_scale1__Z_00393_2.desc: A short curved wear-guide shoe spanning about a quarter arc with a noticeably thicker radial wall for stiffness. It has two countersunk mounting holes through the shell, several cast ribs on the convex back, splayed (non-radial) end faces, and a tongue on one end with a matching groove on the other so multiple shoes lock into a continuous track.

family_scale1__Z_00152_0.desc: A thin, flat rectangular distribution plate with stepped end tabs, small edge chamfers and many rounded corner fillets. The top face carries eight small through-ports in a two-by-four array alongside three larger central through-ports, the small ports sitting in raised round bosses with internal hex wrenching flats; matching cylindrical side fittings with axial bores are joined to the two end tabs as inlet and outlet stubs.

family_scale1__Z_00591_0.desc: A single long, slender thin-wall rectangular tube, closed at both end faces, forming one straight hollow body with no separate joints. Its faces carry dense, evenly pitched small through-holes: one narrow face has a single inline row, while the adjacent wider face has two parallel rows of the same holes (a doubled count) sharing the same pitch and similar end margins; the holes pierce the wall toward the bore. There are no ribs, bosses, slots or fillets—just crisp-edged extruded profile with a regular drilled-hole matrix.

family_scale1__Z_00583_1.desc: A single-loop variant uses one broad teethed strap entering an offset oval buckle, with the ratchet teeth split into two staggered rows. The tail ends in a rounded pull tab with molded grip dimples, while the head contains one hinged pawl, a single insertion slot and external stiffening ribs.

family_pilot__Z_00005_1.desc: A three-spoke member of the same flat-plate family: a uniform-thickness triangular spider whose round hub has a through-bore with a keyway plus two small dowel holes. Three slim arms leave the hub at equal angles, each split by a long lightening slot and ending in a circular counterbored bearing pocket with a raised boss on one face, while the free edges are chamfered rather than fully rounded.

family_scale1__Z_00621_2.part_family: vented extruded electronics enclosure with front I/O panel
family_scale1__Z_00621_2.desc: A wider low-profile clamshell enclosure half with a matching cover, joined along the sidewalls by screws into integral bosses. The base holds several PCB standoffs and a raised alignment ridge, the side walls are perforated by long cooling louvers, and the front edge mixes several rectangular USB-style cutouts, one notched network-port opening with tab relief and one small round jack hole; the cover adds a shallow embossed logo pad, a light-pipe window and generously filleted corners.

family_pilot__Z_00036_0.desc: A thin straight rail is built as one tall narrow wall with a continuous top flange and a lower serrated edge, forming a shallow longitudinal channel. Along the channel are repeated short ribs and twenty-eight small round-nosed teeth grouped between transverse tabs; both ends carry latch feet, one end has a single through-hole, and the teeth and feet are softly filleted.

family_scale1__Z_00237_0.part_family: T-slot structural aluminum extrusion cut length
family_scale1__Z_00237_0.desc: Straight saw-cut length of symmetrical square T-slot aluminum framing extrusion with a constant cross-section. Each of the four outer faces carries one centered longitudinal T-groove with a narrow slot between retaining lips, and diagonal internal ribs form an X-shaped web tying the side walls to a central tubular boss. The boss holds a full-length through bore for a fastener, the rib ends around the boss are chamfered in a repeated pattern, and the outside corners are lightly radiused.

family_scale1__Z_00817_0.part_family: thin flat profiled sheet-metal plate with through-cut slots and holes
family_scale1__Z_00817_0.desc: A single flat sheet body of uniform thickness with a rounded-rectangle outer perimeter: one side is opened by a large concave circular mouth that breaks through the edge, with a smaller adjacent detent notch, while the opposite corners carry generous blend radii. The interior is pierced by one large contoured closed opening with inward curved waists, plus a separate obround slot and a single round through-hole near one end. All internal and external corners are filleted; there are no ribs, bosses, or bends, only profiled through-cuts in a flat web.

family_scale1__Z_00185_0.desc: A flat square thin metal plate forms a lightweight mounting panel with a continuous rounded-corner outer rim and four corner through-holes on a common bolt circle. The interior is opened into a symmetric lattice: long rounded-end slots near the top and bottom, plus mirrored diagonal webs that create trapezoidal and triangular pockets. Narrow ribs tie the rim together, with filleted pocket corners and cleanly broken hole edges.

family_scale1__Z_00699_1.desc: A compact connector-spacer extrusion segment with a square hollow core and one continuous T-slot on each outer face. It uses two opposed longitudinal bores, thicker corner bosses, rounded outer corners, one milled flat, and several cross-drilled fixing holes.

family_scale1__Z_00435_2.part_family: slender round shaft with an attached flat flag/paddle blade
family_scale1__Z_00435_2.desc: A crank-style variant in which the round rod is bent into an L, with a long handle leg and a short offset working leg; a single trapezoidal vane is welded to the short leg, stiffened by a folded edge rib and punched with two mounting slots. The handle leg ends in a plain straight tip, while the working leg has a flattened clinch where the vane attaches.

family_scale1__Z_00734_0.desc: Constant-thickness flat plate profiled as one irregular lever: a long slightly tapered straight arm rising from a lower offset foot, with a narrow curved waist between them. One round through-hole sits in the lower body next to an in-plane J-shaped catch notch, and the bottom edge ends in a small curled toe with a root fillet; the remaining corners are broken with several small edge rounds. No bosses or ribs; the thickness stays uniform.

family_scale1__Z_00135_0.desc: Thin uniform-thickness plate with an elongated rounded-oblong outline and four large outer corner radii. Along the centerline are two hexagonal pockets, one toward each end, with a larger round through bore at mid-length set in a ring-like boss; the face layout is mirrored about the bore. All edges are broken by repeated small chamfers, with additional angled chamfers ringing each hex pocket and the central bore.

family_pilot__Z_00047_2.desc: A molded thin-wall cover panel has a perimeter lip and an asymmetric rib set: two tall vertical pads plus several short horizontal ribs in a staggered pattern. Four corner bosses take fasteners, one rib is interrupted by an oblong hand slot, and the ribs blend into the skin with generous fillets.

family_scale1__Z_00181_1.desc: A single-width timing pulley with one externally toothed rim carried on a dished web and an offset hub on one side. The bore is keyed, the web is opened by several lightening pockets, and the outer rim has integral belt-retaining flanges on both edges.

family_scale1__Z_00771_2.desc: Another member of the family is a square molded dial bezel whose frame is a deep closed rib and whose centre is an open through-window for a separate insert rather than a blind recessed field. It has three locating pins around the window, a central boss tied to the frame by an X-shaped pair of reinforcement ribs on the reverse, and several snap-fit tabs on the outer edge for clipping into a housing.

family_scale1__Z_00751_2.desc: A cranked stamped variant with one round eye and through bore at the low end; the same-thickness arm leaves the eye, jogs sideways through a single angled offset, then straightens into a wider rounded paddle carrying one cross-pin hole near the tip and a pair of shallow embossed stiffening ribs along its face.

family_scale1__Z_00283_0.desc: Low-profile folded sheet-metal standoff with two thin rounded-end mounting plates joined by two parallel formed strap arms; each plate carries three through holes, and the arms use radiused bends, small corner fillets and chamfered edges with no ribs or bosses.

family_scale1__Z_00704_1.part_family: extruded linear rail with a pocketed end block
family_scale1__Z_00704_1.desc: A shorter member of the same family uses a similar hollow multi-void profile but replaces the discrete holes with a continuous T-slot along one face and a single keyway on the opposite web. Both ends are closed by separate right-angle bracket plates, the side wall carries one row of countersunk holes and a dowel pair, and one end is opened by a large rectangular notch instead of a caged pocket block.

family_scale1__Z_00091_1.part_family: thin equipment baseplate with low raised bosses and rails
family_scale1__Z_00091_1.desc: A relative swaps the long channel for an L-shaped arrangement: a low perimeter lip runs along two adjacent edges of a thin rectangular plate, a grid of cylindrical standoff bosses mixing through and blind bores fills the interior, and two short parallel guide rails sit between the boss rows. Corner ears carry countersunk mounting holes, and shallow triangular gussets tie the taller bosses back to the plate.

family_scale1__Z_00807_1.desc: Compact symmetrical member of the same family with short flat end tabs and a central solid lens plate. Each tab carries one round mounting hole, the plate has four radial ribs and a single raised boss on one face, and the perimeter is continuously rounded.

family_scale1__Z_00402_2.part_family: curved solid guide-rail segment (arcuate rectangular block)
family_scale1__Z_00402_2.desc: A longer near-quarter-ring runner in the same family with a stepped section that adds an integral raised boss on the outer cylindrical face and a continuous longitudinal groove on the inner cylindrical face. One end is a plain radial face while the opposite end has a rectangular locating notch plus a cross-drilled pin hole, and the top face is left flat without mounting holes.

family_scale1__Z_00482_1.desc: A slender extruded guide rail of open hat-shaped cross-section: one wide longitudinal T-slot on the working face flanked by two lands with generous edge radii, and a solid back web that thickens under the slot root. Each end carries a pair of drilled mounting holes instead of a central bore, one end is square-cut and the other is mitered, and the groove edges are left sharp without end chamfers.

family_scale1__Z_00254_0.part_family: flat multi-cell hub plate with central bore and polygonal through-cells
family_scale1__Z_00254_0.desc: A constant-thickness flat plate built as a fused cluster of rings: a central cylindrical ring with a through round bore is tangent-joined by short shared webs at four compass points to four identical closed hexagonal ring lobes, giving one round center opening plus four hexagonal through-cells with open diagonal gaps between lobes. All cell walls equal the plate height and pass fully through, and the front and back faces are flat and parallel. Every internal and external vertical edge carries a small uniform round-over, producing a fully filleted perimeter with no ribs, threads, slots, or separate bosses.

family_scale1__Z_00408_0.desc: Straight elongated solid profile of thin constant cross-section. A flat rectangular web carries several close parallel longitudinal ribs on one face and a single centred V-groove running the full length on the opposite face; both ends are plain square cuts with no holes, slots, bosses or added fillets.

family_scale1__Z_00745_1.desc: A sibling mounting strap is a flat bar bent into a shallow in-plane U with two unequal legs and a closed base; one leg carries three round holes in a row, the other has a single oblong slot, and all outer corners are radiused.

family_scale1__Z_00565_2.desc: Narrow single-slot mounting rail with thin walls: the top face is formed as one open T-slot with cover-strip seats on the lips, the two side faces are plain, and the bottom face carries two shallow longitudinal grooves plus a pair of small clearance bores. Internal longitudinal ribs stiffen the shell between the slot floor and the lower wall, and all sealed corners use generous fillets for a light enclosure edge.

family_scale1__Z_00662_1.part_family: thin cruciform spider plate with hex end openings
family_scale1__Z_00662_1.desc: Three-arm version for the same family: a triangular spider plate with a blind central boss bore, three arms of varied reach, and end pads mixing two hexagonal sockets with one slotted mounting ear. Add lightening slots along the arms and shallow ribs on one face while keeping the part predominantly a flat plate.

family_scale1__Z_00726_1.desc: A similar molded perforated plate, but more square, with a uniform field of equal small through-holes, a plain perimeter flange, four corner mounting bosses, and two elongated fixing slots. The back side uses a shallow rib lattice for stiffness instead of edge-only standoffs.

family_scale1__Z_00221_0.desc: A thin uniform-thickness plate cut as a six-pointed star: a central round hub with a through bore is ringed by six open, roughly pentagonal frame segments, and each radial arm terminates in an outward-pointing triangular spike. Arms and frames are perforated by many small round-ended through-slots, interior corners carry small fillets, and the angular spacing between adjacent arms alternates between two values around the hub.

family_scale1__Z_00813_2.desc: A compact double-ended serration leaf stamped with coarse triangular teeth on both long edges; each end finishes in a semicircular locating notch instead of a through-hole, a central elongated slot allows sliding adjustment, and three small molded pads on the back face act as stand-off bosses.

family_scale1__Z_00629_1.desc: Wider stiffened variant of the same grid family: a long perimeter frame with a four-by-six set of rectangular cells, using full-depth primary ribs one way and half-depth secondary ribs the other so the intersections step. Two short end flanges add slotted mounting holes and a pair of underside locating bosses, and one corner cell is closed off by an embossed identification pad.

family_scale1__Z_00175_2.desc: Low-profile rectangular bezel grille with fully rounded corners and only a coarse grid of large openings made by a few orthogonal ribs inside a solid perimeter frame. The back has snap-fit cantilever tabs and two alignment pins for tool-less mounting, rib intersections are blended with small fillets, and one cell is blanked off solid.

family_scale1__Z_00766_2.part_family: splined coupling collar with radial torque lugs
family_scale1__Z_00766_2.desc: A stepped splined hub variant: a short cylindrical boss with an external involute spline on its outer diameter at one end and a smaller splined through-bore, backed by a castellated flange of four wide lugs. A bolt circle of evenly spaced through-holes pierces the flange between the lugs, and a radial grease cross-hole enters the boss wall.

family_scale1__Z_00136_0.part_family: one-piece miniature dagger with integral guard and grip
family_scale1__Z_00136_0.desc: A rigid one-piece miniature dagger: a thin flat blade reads as a pointed double-edged profile in the main view and as a narrow rectangle in the edge view, with a shallow center ridge or hidden edge running toward the tip. The blade flows into a compact rounded rectangular crossguard with a small central recess, then into a short rounded-end grip; small fillets blend the guard and grip transitions.

family_scale1__Z_00547_0.desc: A single constant-thickness plate whose outline merges a circular annular eye with a centered through-bore, an A-shaped open web of two inclined struts tied at the base, and a short straight rectangular tang at the far end. The eye carries a shallow concentric face recess around the bore, all material is one wall thick, and every cut edge is square with no formed bends.

family_scale1__Z_00549_0.desc: Constant-thickness flat plate cut to a snowflake outline: a small central round hub carries many evenly spaced radial arms that each fork into short branch fingers, and every external corner at the roots, forks and tips is broken by the same small fillet radius. The hub has a coaxial through bore with a larger counterbore from one face; there are no ribs, bosses or formed features beyond the flat sheet.

family_pilot__Z_00084_1.desc: A related carrier is one thin plate with a continuous raised perimeter lip and a large central lightening window. Obround connector slots are grouped at one end only, while the opposite edge becomes a comb of evenly spaced fingers; small bosses and filleted gussets stiffen the window corners.

family_pilot__Z_00014_2.desc: A sixteen-sided thin bezel ring with a scalloped inner boundary, alternating recessed outer panels, and two opposed locating flats. Short ribs rise between selected facets and carry blind threaded bosses, while a continuous top lip and countersunk corner pockets lighten the band.

family_scale1__Z_00334_1.desc: A compact Z-shaped support is bent from one flat strip into two parallel mounting feet linked by an offset web; each foot carries a pair of countersunk screw holes, while the web has two stamped stiffening ribs and a central cable clearance cutout.

family_scale1__Z_00811_0.desc: One solid prismatic flat strip of constant thickness and width; the plan is a plain rectangle with square long edges and small chamfers on the two short end faces. It is a single uninterrupted blank with no holes, slots, ribs, bosses or bends, only broken edges and a longitudinal centerline axis.

family_scale1__Z_00358_1.desc: Low-profile board-mount header from the same family: a closed-bottom rectangular insulator with one central ribbed septum and a single row of contact cavities along each long side, the cavities square pass-throughs staggered relative to the opposite row. Add chamfered mating-face lead-ins, four corner standoffs, end screw ears, one off-centre polarising key, and short latch ramps on both end walls.

family_scale1__Z_00419_1.desc: A thin-walled square tube is bent through two opposing arcs into a shallow S with a short straight tangent between the curves, and a flat mounting lug is welded to each end. Each lug is pierced with two bolt holes, and a narrow drain slot is cut through the lower wall of the middle straight.

family_scale1__Z_00405_1.part_family: thin slotted contact plate with integral tang
family_scale1__Z_00405_1.desc: Same family but a centered-tang variant: the narrow tab leaves the short edge on the plate centerline with a generous radius at the root. The pad uses two staggered rows of small holes, a few short transverse slots rather than lengthwise ones, and a single elongated mounting slot near the free end in place of the rib cluster.

family_scale1__Z_00482_2.desc: A stepped profiled shaft that is splined only over its middle: several continuous axial ribs on a lobed core transition at both ends to plain cylindrical journals. One journal is cross-drilled for a pin and has a small radial set-screw flat, while the opposite journal carries a short external thread with a relief groove; all longitudinal ribs fade out before the bearing seats.

family_scale1__Z_00747_1.desc: Compact open-ended square spacer tube with equal sides and a constant thin wall, rounded outside corners and a plain bore. Two opposed cross-pin holes pierce the wide faces near each end, and both rims are lightly chamfered for insertion.

family_scale1__Z_00417_1.part_family: thin flat faceplate with an in-line row of raised rectangular bosses
family_scale1__Z_00417_1.desc: A similar thin rectangular escutcheon carrying two wide raised pads flanking one narrower central pad, all set on the panel centreline. The perimeter is lightly chamfered and a plain mounting hole is provided near each short end, while the back remains flat and featureless.

family_scale1__Z_00393_1.desc: A true half-round plain-bearing shell: a semi-cylindrical thin shell with two flat parting faces, one oil feed hole through the crown, an internal annular distribution groove, and a small locating tang pressed out of one parting edge. Wall thickness is constant, the axial edges are chamfered, and the bore carries a thin running lining on a stiff backing.

family_scale1__Z_00400_2.desc: A stamped flat-strip pawl rolled into a full closed eye at one end and tapered into a single beak-like hook tooth at the other. The narrow mid-arm carries one longitudinal stiffening rib and two small locating notches along the same edge, with smooth bend radii and no other holes or patterns.

family_scale1__Z_00776_1.desc: A low-count handwheel member of the same family uses a solid outer grip ring and three broad slightly swept spokes into a flanged hub; the bore is keyed and has a side set-screw boss, while shallow scallops on the rim inner edge and triangular gussets at the spoke roots provide grip and stiffness.

family_scale1__Z_00125_0.desc: A single thin square plate with a flat underside, an integral raised perimeter rim, and four rounded outside corners. The top face is a monolithic five-by-five rib lattice joined to the base sheet, forming equal blind square pockets with small chamfers on the rib/pocket edges and no through-holes or bosses.

family_scale1__Z_00161_2.part_family: formed flat-steel connecting link with pierced eye ends
family_scale1__Z_00161_2.desc: A double-offset toggle-style flat link with both pierced ears kicked to the same side of the shank in a shallow Z-crank. A pressed longitudinal rib stiffens the web, each ear is coined into a raised boss around a single hole, and the far ear is drawn out into an obround take-up slot; edges are finished with small chamfers rather than rounds.

family_scale1__Z_00716_2.desc: A hollow rectangular extruded strut with thin outer walls and an internal cross-web that divides the bore into four cells. One face is finned like a heatsink, the opposite faces carry a single keyway groove and one offset round through-bore, and short fastener slots are pierced through one wall at intervals; corners are generously rounded and the ends are milled flat.

family_scale1__Z_00281_2.part_family: flat rectangular open-grid tube frame panel
family_scale1__Z_00281_2.desc: A heavier related grille framed as a closed tube perimeter filled by a dense checkerboard of near-square cells and a central spine rib. Four low corner boss pads carry clearance holes, short triangular gusset ribs brace the spandrels, and the outer corners use small chamfers rather than rounds.

family_scale1__Z_00744_2.part_family: slender molded flat tongue blade (insertion/pry strip)
family_scale1__Z_00744_2.desc: Flat stamped spring-metal member of the same insertion-tongue family: a constant-thickness blank with a sharp V-point leading end, rolled safety radii on the long edges, and one embossed longitudinal stiffening bead running between two round mounting holes at the rear. The rear terminates in a single right-angle bent lug that carries an elongated adjustment slot, one long edge is cut with fine serrations while the opposite edge stays smooth, and the point corners are left sharp rather than faceted.

family_scale1__Z_00298_1.part_family: slotted multi-bay divider rack of thin upright panels
family_scale1__Z_00298_1.desc: A two-tier organizer variant uses an L-shaped base with only a few tall partitions creating two wide channels; the dividers are solid (no window slots) but each is braced by triangular gusset ribs at the base, the base carries circular mounting bosses and a closed front retaining lip, and a separate end stop closes one channel.

family_scale1__Z_00270_1.part_family: flat plate gang of fused toothed wheels
family_scale1__Z_00270_1.desc: A straight strip-like plate of even thickness carrying five identical external-tooth wheels in one tangent row, fused root-to-root by short narrow necks. Each wheel hub is drilled through in line, lightening slots are cut through the web between neighbouring hubs, and the two end wheels each take a radial timing notch. One long edge of the strip is left as a straight mounting datum with two plain fixing holes, while all tooth crests and hole edges receive a small edge round.

family_scale1__Z_00770_2.part_family: tapered flat sheet-metal spring strip (wedge clip)
family_scale1__Z_00770_2.desc: A short tapered latch leaf whose thickness ramps from a thick mounting pad to a rounded feather edge, the thin tip turned down opposite the pad. Two elongated punched slots sit side by side in the pad for adjustment fasteners, a small embossed dimple acts as the detent on the leaf, and the pad corners are filleted with the long edges deburred.

family_scale1__Z_00178_2.desc: A compact pinion-style spur gear uses a narrow toothed rim with a single offset hub and a keyed through bore secured by two radial set-screw holes spaced around the boss. An annular relief groove is cut into the back face beside the hub to save weight, and the gear is finished with a generous fillet at the hub-to-rim transition.

family_scale1__Z_00635_0.part_family: slender multi-slot extruded aluminium profile rail
family_scale1__Z_00635_0.desc: One long straight extrusion cut to length, with a small constant multi-lobed cross-section, external longitudinal grooves on several faces and an internal web. Two small bores run continuously through the part, the profile corners carry four tiny fillets, and the cut ends are broken by numerous small chamfers; there are no cross holes, bosses or attached brackets.

family_scale1__Z_00196_1.desc: A rectangular constant-thickness carrier plate with four raised corner standoff bosses, a wide central window, two elongated cable slots, and two parallel rows of clearance holes. The perimeter is mildly chamfered and uses a few triangular lightening pockets instead of arms.

family_scale1__Z_00746_2.part_family: curved flat linkage arm with bolted end pads
family_scale1__Z_00746_2.desc: A nearly straight, slightly cambered flat arm having three pads along its length: two end pads and a central boss. Each pad holds a counterbored through hole, the end pads add only three-hole triangular patterns, and the central boss adds a keyway slot and a pair of threaded blind holes; one side edge is scalloped for weight reduction while a thin raised rib runs along the opposite edge for stiffness.

family_scale1__Z_00510_2.part_family: slender knurled precision probe / scriber pins
family_scale1__Z_00510_2.desc: A cranked contact needle that is knurled only on a short rear grip band and otherwise smooth, with the shank bent into a shallow Z so the tip offsets from the mount. The working end splits into a short twin-prong fork, each prong finishing in its own micro-radius point, and the rear terminates in a single pivot eyelet rather than cross-drilled holes.

family_scale1__Z_00614_0.desc: Low, thin-walled square open frame molded as a single plate-like ring: four narrow side rails meet at raised corner posts and leave a large central window. A single diagonal rib bridges the interior between two rails, with short inner wall segments forming small slots. Each corner post carries a through mounting hole with a shallow counterbore, and one edge adds two small auxiliary through holes.

family_scale1__Z_00123_0.desc: A thin constant-thickness annular wheel with a central through bore and six regular hexagonal through windows ringing the hub, leaving six radial webs between bore and rim. The outer edge is scalloped into alternating lobes and concave rounded notches, every window corner and rim transition is generously filleted, and the rim carries a rounded raised edge with a small locating tab.

family_scale1__Z_00412_0.part_family: curved spring slat of thin strip
family_scale1__Z_00412_0.desc: A single thin rectangular strip of uniform width and constant thickness, gently bowed along its length into a shallow arc so midspan rises above the square-cut ends. No holes, slots, or bosses; model as a clean swept solid of a rectangular cross-section along an arced centerline with lightly broken edges.

family_scale1__Z_00547_1.desc: A flat plate rocker link with a large ring boss at one end and a smaller pin eye at the other, joined by one straight tapered spine and one curved lower strut that leave an elongated lightening window between them. The large boss is counterbored on one face for a bearing, both bores are plain through-holes, and the plate thickness is uniform throughout.

family_scale1__Z_00335_1.desc: A compact stamped grounding comb with a straight mounting edge and an offset raised tongue, carrying a single large pierced hole, two adjustment slots and a dense edge of short curled spring fingers. Small coined radii and clipped corners define the finger roots while the opposite edge remains flat for fastening.

family_pilot__Z_00085_2.part_family: flat multi-lobe spider plate with through-bored ring bosses
family_pilot__Z_00085_2.desc: Same family but an asymmetric two-boss link: one large counterbored annular boss for a press-fit insert and one smaller boss with an obround adjustment slot, joined by a single arched arm with a broad gusseted fillet. There is no central hub hole; instead a blind pocket is recessed in the arm, one face carries a peripheral flange, and the opposite face has a field of shallow grip dimples with a few cross ribs.

family_scale1__Z_00622_2.part_family: thin-walled trihedral box corner with a concave three-way cove (inside cube corner)
family_scale1__Z_00622_2.desc: Open-topped sheet-metal corner tray folded from one blank into a right-angle pocket of three square gusset plates, with the inner triple junction relieved by a shallow convex spherical dimple instead of a scoop. One panel is perforated by a regular grid of small slots, the seams use tab-and-slot with spot welds rather than hems, and a rolled wire edge stiffens only the top rim while the remaining edges are left plain.

family_scale1__Z_00331_1.part_family: thin open-center rectangular plastic bezel frame
family_scale1__Z_00331_1.desc: Molded rectangular cover bezel with a proportionally larger window and a generous radius on the outside corners only. In place of the seating pocket it carries a continuous raised tongue around the opening that mates with a groove, several evenly spaced snap clips on the outer wall, and two mounting ears with clearance holes at the midpoints of the long sides.

family_scale1__Z_00306_0.part_family: straight-fluted hollow dowel pin (grooved press-fit retaining pin)
family_scale1__Z_00306_0.desc: A very slender solid cylindrical pin of constant round cross-section, its full length cut with a dense pattern of straight longitudinal flutes - a few wide grooves among many medium and fine serrations forming a splined, knurled outer surface. A small axial through-hole runs centered end to end, the lands between flutes form sharp longitudinal ridges, and both ends are square with light edge breaks.

family_scale1__Z_00288_2.desc: Double-ended stud-sleeve variant: external thread on both end zones separated by a narrower unthreaded waisted middle formed as an external hex for a wrench. A straight tapped through bore runs end to end with no counterbore, both faces are chamfered, and one radial cross-hole pierces the hex waist for a locking pin or wire.

family_scale1__Z_00005_2.desc: An extended multi-span variant with four low raised pads along a continuous thin spine; each pad holds a plain non-knurled hole with a metal threaded insert and a snap leg pair underneath. Triangular gusset ribs fill every sloped transition, the shell is slightly thicker with no top cutout, and opposed side latch tabs at mid-length replace one set of end feet.

family_pilot__Z_00045_1.desc: Closed rounded-rectangular sealing frame punched from the same thin plate stock, with a matching inner cutout and a broad constant-width land. Four countersunk through-holes sit at the corner blends, one long side has a small semicircular keying notch, and the inner edge carries a shallow relief groove on one face.

family_pilot__Z_00052_1.desc: A same-family spring leaf uses a constant-gauge arched shell but adds two round mounting holes near one end, one central longitudinal slot, and a short hooked tab bent from the opposite tip. The cross-section stays a simple open curve with smooth tangent transitions into the tab.

family_pilot__Z_00028_1.desc: A Z-shaped formed sheet bracket using two opposed bends to offset a low mounting foot from a raised fixing tab; the foot carries two round holes plus a central obround slot, the tab has a single clearance hole, the free edge is stiffened by a short hem, and each bend corner is relieved with a small circular notch.

family_scale1__Z_00091_0.part_family: thin equipment baseplate with low raised bosses and rails
family_scale1__Z_00091_0.desc: A flat rectangular base panel is a thin shell with nearly all detail on one face: a dense corner cluster packs together several small rectangular frames, short partition walls and a tiny pedestal, with small locating holes confined to that cluster, while two straight rails step out beside a broad open rectangular channel running toward the far edge and a separate notched pad sits nearby. Every upstand is a low rib or boss of only a couple of heights, square-edged with small base fillets, and the opposite face remains flat.

family_scale1__Z_00777_0.desc: One-piece dished synchronous pulley with a continuous toothed outer rim, a five-spoke web, and a small central hub region. Curved spokes form alternating lightening pockets with filleted roots, while five through-holes are equally spaced on a bolt circle and the rim carries a repeating tooth pattern.

family_pilot__Z_00044_0.desc: A constant-thickness flat plate cut to a tall stylised profile: a short top cross tab with rounded corners runs into a straight left leg, while the lower right side flares diagonally outward into a pointed foot. One closed interior slot follows the same gesture - rounded at the top, pinched through the middle, then sweeping out toward the foot - leaving a fairly even ligament; every inner and outer corner is filleted and there are no tapped holes, bosses, or formed bends, only the pierced contour.

family_scale1__Z_00745_2.desc: Another version is a serpentine flat spring bracket with four gentle reverse curves, two widened landing pads, and a central stiffening emboss; it uses two adjustment slots, small relief notches at the inner curves, and one locating dimple rather than through holes.

family_pilot__Z_00096_2.part_family: slender rectangular hollow-section tube (straight RHS post/spacer)
family_pilot__Z_00096_2.desc: A closed rectangular-tube standoff in the same family: the slender hollow rectangular core is capped by a flat plate at one end and carries a rectangular mounting flange with four corner holes at the other, with two shallow longitudinal ribs on one outer wall; use small fillets only where the cap and flange meet the tube.

family_pilot__Z_00028_0.desc: A thin constant-width flat metal strip of uniform rectangular cross-section, folded once through a single generous inside radius into a J/L profile with one long straight leg and one short straight tangential leg; the bend is a smooth fillet with no holes, slots, ribs, bosses, hems, or patterns, only faint bend-line witness marks on the flat pattern.

family_scale1__Z_00186_1.desc: Mid-band variant with the straight axial spline teeth centered between two plain bearing journals instead of at one end. Its bore is stepped (a shallow counterbore from the front and a smaller through hole) with one feather keyway, and one smooth journal carries a radial tapped hole for a locking set screw; the tooth ends are left square and blend into the shoulders with small fillets rather than chamfers.

family_scale1__Z_00257_0.part_family: open-top machined enclosure with holed mounting deck
family_scale1__Z_00257_0.desc: Open-topped five-sided machined housing: a thick rectangular base deck is integrally joined to perimeter side walls forming a shallow cavity, with taller ribbed wall/post sections toward one end and a small rectangular opening in one side wall. The deck carries two opposing columns of three raised circular mounting bosses with counterbored through holes, surrounded by a dense pattern of smaller through holes, tapped holes and deep blind holes; the outside rim has rounded corners, many edge fillets, small radiused notches and a perimeter chamfer, with internal ribs tying the deck to the walls.

family_scale1__Z_00822_0.part_family: ribbed injection-molded plastic circular grille / spoked rotor disc
family_scale1__Z_00822_0.desc: A thin flat thermoplastic disc with a rounded outer rim, a central drive hub with a through bore and star-shaped drive recess, and radial spokes tying hub to rim. Between the spokes are open tapered trapezoidal windows plus small molded details (tiny diamond holes, narrow triangular slots and shallow recessed sector panels); the front is a drafted shallow-relief shell with a recessed border ring and generous fillets, while the back is stiffened by a radial/circumferential grid of thin ribs and small edge chamfers and side latch tabs.

family_scale1__Z_00217_2.desc: A flatter six-petal variant of the family built as an annular diaphragm with no raised bosses: six mounting eyelets (plain through holes) on slender radial arms surround an oversized central opening, short curved relief slots sit at each arm root, and the outer edge mixes fine indexing notches on two opposite petals with a plain smooth contour elsewhere.

family_scale1__Z_00219_0.desc: A flat, round machined flange plate of essentially uniform thickness with a chamfered outer rim and a stepped annular recess profile shown in a magnified rim detail. The web carries a central through bore set in a hexagonal recess and two concentric bolt patterns clocked apart from each other: four large plain through-holes equally spaced on an inner bolt circle and four smaller countersunk through-holes equally spaced on an outer bolt circle. The countersunk fasteners sit angularly between the large holes, forming an alternating ring around the hub.

family_scale1__Z_00518_2.part_family: thin-walled molded plastic bezel / instrument tray
family_scale1__Z_00518_2.desc: Symmetrical square clamshell cover in thin molded plastic with an outer snap-fit flange and intermittent latch tabs; the face is laid out with four circular cup recesses in a two-by-two array around a central raised rectangular platform, backed by gusseted corner bosses and short radial ribs rather than through slots.

family_scale1__Z_00368_0.desc: A single solid-of-revolution fitting with a large finned barrel body densely wrapped in uniform circumferential ribs, blending through a tapered shoulder into a short reduced neck. A coaxial stepped through-bore runs end to end, opening from a small bore into larger counterbored seats at the big face, while the neck tip is closed out by several consecutive chamfered and angled faces with small blends at the jumps.

family_scale1__Z_00108_0.desc: A one-piece shallow rectangular shell with thin uniform walls, rounded outer corners and a flat floor that is open on the opposite face. Four identical long parallel through-slots cross the floor between narrow integral webs, interior edges are lightly filleted, and one larger through-hole plus several small through-holes pierce the walls and floor for fastening. Short peripheral ribs and small bosses stiffen the rim and the slotted face.

family_scale1__Z_00476_0.part_family: arcuate molded grille/bezel segment with windows
family_scale1__Z_00476_0.desc: Thin-walled annular-sector strip of uniform thickness and constant radial width, molded as one curved shell. A row of evenly spaced rectangular through-windows runs along the arc; each window is edged by a slightly raised rectangular rim on the convex face and separated from the next by narrow transverse ribs, while the inner-radius edge carries a stepped ledge with a repeating series of small rectangular slots. Both segment ends are plain square cuts, all frame corners are filleted, and small gussets reinforce the window frames on the concave side.

family_scale1__Z_00755_0.part_family: thin annular retaining/mounting ring with an integral clip tab
family_scale1__Z_00755_0.desc: A thin flat annular plate with a large concentric through opening and a narrow rim; the rim carries an equally spaced bolt-circle pattern of small through holes set into shallow outward lobes, so the outer edge reads as gently scalloped with rounded fillets between the lobes and short radial relief notches along the inner edge. From one inner-edge station a short clip flag rises out of the plane of the ring; it has a widened head bounded by two external radii, one tiny through hole, and small slots where it blends back into the annulus.

family_scale1__Z_00602_2.desc: A broader flat snowflake coaster-style plate with six thick arms, fully enclosed pierced holes clustered near the centre, and an integral top loop for suspension. Unlike the through-cut outline part, its faces carry shallow embossed vein lines on one side only, with rounded branch ends and small edge chamfers all around.

family_scale1__Z_00774_1.desc: Full-tang utility blade of the same flat cutlery family but with a plain unserrated curved edge and clip point; the exposed handle tang carries three rivet holes and an oblong lanyard slot, an integral front finger guard, and a slightly hooked rear pommel.

family_scale1__Z_00804_0.desc: Closed-loop elastomeric timing belt laid out as an obround racetrack: two semicircular radiused ends joined by straight tangent runs, with a constant rectangular cross-section all around. Dense, evenly spaced transverse teeth are molded integrally across the full belt width on the inner face and wrap continuously around the curved ends, while the outer back is a smooth tensile band with embedded longitudinal cords; each tooth has small root fillets and there are no holes or bosses.

family_scale1__Z_00043_1.part_family: machined flat connecting link with end eyes
family_scale1__Z_00043_1.desc: A flat three-hole triangular linkage plate with one large pivot lug at the apex and two smaller lug ears at the base, tied together by broad tapered side rails. The open center is lightened by a contoured pocket, each bore is counterbored from one face and chamfered on the other, and a short rib bridges the webs between the base ears.

family_pilot__Z_00029_1.part_family: bent flat metal strip hook / clip
family_pilot__Z_00029_1.desc: A closed rectangular bail formed from the same kind of flat strip, with four gentle corner radii and two outward mounting feet along one side. Each foot carries a single clearance hole, and the long straight span is relieved by a central lightening slot and two stamped locating dimples.

family_scale1__Z_00021_2.part_family: finned rectangular heatsink block on a hollow twin-cell base
family_scale1__Z_00021_2.desc: Finned clamshell enclosure half: a thin-walled cover with an external top field of straight fins at two different pitches, an internal perimeter lip containing a continuous gasket groove, and one longitudinal internal stiffening rib. Four cylindrical standoff bosses inside locate a board, two end lugs provide clearance holes, and a rounded rectangular cable cutout breaks one side wall.

family_scale1__Z_00010_2.part_family: ribbed thin rectangular bezel panel with recessed windows
family_scale1__Z_00010_2.desc: Another same-family part is a square stiffened panel that uses a lattice of thin ribs on a common skin to create a three-by-three array of recessed pads. Its back face carries short standoff pillars at the outer corners, a central circular boss with a through hole, small scallops where the ribs meet, and generous rounded outer corners instead of discrete corner reliefs.

family_scale1__Z_00748_1.desc: A similar bracket family member built as a stiffened mounting gusset: two flat-bar legs are welded at a right angle and tied by a solid triangular plate instead of an open frame. The plate carries a short row of clearance holes along one leg, a single elongated adjustment slot near the apex, and a small reinforcing boss welded at the inside of the corner.

family_scale1__Z_00163_1.desc: A stamped annular reluctor ring with an open center, the same constant plate thickness, and a rim of twenty-four rectangular outward notches. The web includes four through mounting slots, two small keyway notches at the bore, and several round lightening holes; tooth edges are chamfered rather than scalloped.

family_scale1__Z_00145_1.desc: A constant-thickness four-arm plate arranged as a symmetric cross about a central bearing bore; each arm terminates in a circular counterbored pocket for a press-fit weight rather than a hex ring. Wider tapered spokes carry a lightening slot near the hub, the rim between lobes is scalloped, and all exposed edges receive a uniform small fillet.

family_scale1__Z_00449_1.desc: Different full-round gable louver built as a circular outer ring with a raised center hub, six radial ribs and several concentric louver rings that form annular airflow slots. A continuous rear flange has spaced screw bosses and snap tabs, with an insect screen retained behind the grille.

family_scale1__Z_00811_2.desc: A same-family flat bar formed into an L by one right-angle bend with a small fillet relieving the inner corner; the short leg carries two counterbored mounting holes while the long leg is a plain slightly tapered tongue ending in a rounded tip, all made from uniform sheet thickness.

family_scale1__Z_00249_2.desc: Low-profile H-style quadcopter chassis plate with an elongated central body for the battery, four cantilevered motor pads arranged as two front and two rear, and each pad formed as a plain round boss with a center bore ringed by small fastener holes; the arms carry multiple lightening cutouts and the outer perimeter is chamfered rather than ringed.

family_scale1__Z_00796_1.desc: External shaft-style circlip: an open spring ring of uniform flat rectangular section whose two free ends curl outward into opposed grip ears, each ear pierced with one round tool hole. A small radial locating nib sits on the outer edge opposite the gap, and all working edges are deburred with a consistent chamfer.

family_scale1__Z_00483_1.part_family: ribbed plastic enclosure half / molded electronics chassis tray
family_scale1__Z_00483_1.desc: A similar molded tray-style enclosure half, but arranged around one centered rectangular PCB pocket with four equal-height insert bosses at the pocket corners and a continuous rim tongue for a snap-on lid. Ventilation is moved to a row of slots in one side wall rather than floor windows, and only two diagonal external mounting ears are used, each backed by a single gusset rib.

family_pilot__Z_00106_0.part_family: flat circular lugged flange cover with annular seal groove
family_pilot__Z_00106_0.desc: A thin flat round plate forming a sealing end cover: a single annular shell bounded by an outer rim with four equally spaced radial ear lugs, each pierced by one small through fastener hole on a common bolt circle. Inboard of a concentric recessed ring groove, two large through ports sit symmetrically left and right of the centerline, with a shallow central disc recess; all edges and lug roots are generously filleted.

family_scale1__Z_00259_1.desc: A square perforated fixture plate with a staggered triangular array of through holes, alternate rows offset by half a pitch. Four corner holes are counterbored for cap screws, the centre has one larger locating bore, and the back face is relieved with shallow rectangular pockets between hole lands to cut mass.

family_scale1__Z_00310_0.desc: A long slender carrier formed from one thin sheet into a constant shallow channel section with two side legs, short edge returns and rounded inside corners. The flanges carry dense longitudinal rows of small through holes, including a repeated two-by-ten pattern plus extra holes, while the web is pierced by a pair of cross-shaped openings and a few short radiused slots, all repeating on a regular pitch along the length.

family_scale1__Z_00179_2.desc: Comb-style routing strip folded as a repeated row of identical upright loops standing from a continuous flat spine with several plain clearance holes and no countersinks. Small formed gussets separate adjacent loops, the spine edges are chamfered, and both ends finish as short outward return flanges instead of open tabs.

family_pilot__Z_00021_0.desc: A cylindrical metal shaft carrying a longitudinal stack of identical three-lobed cam plates clamped face-to-face between two plain end journals. Each cam plate has a central hexagonal through-bore coaxial with the shaft, three rounded lobes spaced equally around the bore, small rectangular notches on the lobe faces, and short relief grooves or runouts between adjacent lobes. One shaft end is a short square drive boss and the other is a reduced spigot with an internal bore shown in section.

family_scale1__Z_00796_2.desc: Internal spiral retaining ring: two overlapping flat-strip coils of thin rectangular section stacked into a near-closed ring with a single narrow radial gap between the coil tips. The inner edge carries an evenly spaced pattern of shallow semicircular notches while the outer edge stays smooth and concentric; there are no through holes and the end faces are square-cut and slightly lapped in plan.

family_scale1__Z_00516_2.desc: A squat open-frame spacer of the same family built from two deep perforated cheek plates held apart by pressed cross-ties and stamped corner gussets rather than a closed shell; the cheeks mix rows of plain small holes with countersunk holes and large teardrop lightening cutouts, the top rails add elongated alignment slots, and separate bolt-on feet with formed embosses provide the mounting interface.

family_scale1__Z_00527_2.desc: A pan-shaped perforated cover with four shallow downturned skirt flanges and a slightly crowned deck. The ventilation field is a staggered array that leaves a blank central pad for a label or boss, the corners use countersunk holes instead of the plain grid holes, and the outer rim is hemmed for stiffness with two small underside standoffs.

family_pilot__Z_00117_0.desc: A one-piece thin flat plate forms a round medallion pad with a single tangential strap handle leaving the perimeter; the strap is pinched at the root and broadens toward a blunt free end. The section is a plain parallel sheet with small blend fillets at the neck and a shallow blind coined or recessed patch on one face of the round pad; no through-holes, slots, ribs or bosses are used.

family_scale1__Z_00283_1.desc: Single-piece folded sheet-metal L-bracket with a tall mounting flange and a shorter support flange at a right angle; the mounting flange has a vertical column of round holes, while the support flange uses two oblong slots, one stamped stiffening rib and a hemmed outer edge.

family_scale1__Z_00557_1.desc: A rectangular adapter plate of similar machined-plate construction, but with a single row of four threaded round bores interrupted by a central obround slot. It has two opposing hex nut pockets, small corner clearance holes, chamfered outer edges, and a shallow counterbore around one end bore rather than any raised bosses.

family_scale1__Z_00081_0.part_family: flat spoked handwheel ring with scalloped rim
