family_scale1__Z_00081_0.desc: A thin flat annular wheel built from a central cylindrical hub with a plain through bore, joined by eight evenly spaced radial spokes to a continuous outer rim, leaving petal-shaped lightening windows between the spokes. The rim edge is formed into rounded lobes and carries a regular ring of small semicircular scallops all around, the faces are flat and parallel with uniform wall thickness, and small fillets blend the spoke roots into hub and rim.

family_scale1__Z_00609_1.desc: Wider rectangular connector bulkhead plate with three large rounded cutouts side by side, a single row of countersunk through-holes along the top edge, and a keyhole mounting slot at two opposite corners. A raised circular boss ring surrounds only the middle cutout on the rear face, the remaining cutouts are plain, and the outer border is chamfered rather than rebated.

family_scale1__Z_00654_0.part_family: flat machined annular spacer ring with a pointed star outer edge
family_scale1__Z_00654_0.desc: A single thin monolithic plate forming a wide flat ring with one large central circular through-bore. The outer boundary is one continuous cut profile of alternating radial points and V-shaped reentrant notches, like a square overlaid on a rotated square, giving an eight-point star outline; three different edge chamfer sizes are applied to the corner tips, each repeated on a set of four corners. Thickness is constant across the whole part, all faces are vertical through-cuts with sharp corner relief, and there are small rectangular edge notches on two opposed outer tabs; there are no bosses, ribs, bends, welds, or secondary formed features.

family_pilot__Z_00065_1.desc: A one-piece curved releasable tie strap has ratchet serrations only on the inner face, an enlarged locking head at one end, and a smooth tapered tail at the other. Short stiffening ribs blend the head into the band, the head contains a release-latch window, and the band itself is free of mounting holes.

family_scale1__Z_00167_2.desc: Shallow open-backed blanking cover for the same family: a flat mounting flange with four corner holes surrounds a deep molded bank of vertical louvers, with a recessed inner ledge to retain a filter pad. Snap-fit spring clips run along the side edges instead of a cable neck, and a small raised logo boss sits on the outer grille frame.

family_scale1__Z_00102_1.desc: Alternate same-family part: a flat rosette medallion made from a constant-thickness blank, with twelve smooth convex petals tied to a narrow inner ring around a countersunk center hole. Each petal has a single teardrop window near its tip, roots are reinforced by short integrated gussets, and the scalloped outer rim is fully rounded rather than sharply pointed.

family_scale1__Z_00486_1.desc: Same kind of milled flat plate, but laid out as a grid rather than a radial star: a rounded rectangular rim carrying four large rectangular through-windows in a two-by-two pattern joined by a cross web, with raised corner bosses that take counterbored mounting holes and a row of lightening holes along each web. All pocket corners are filleted and the underside remains a single flat sealing face.

family_scale1__Z_00632_2.desc: Hollow ribbed standoff extrusion: a closed four-sided tube with external longitudinal ribs on every face and internal webs dividing it into several cells around a single central clear bore. The ribs are denser on two opposite sides, the open ends are chamfered, and all outer corners and rib roots use small blend radii.

family_scale1__Z_00385_2.desc: A bent single-lever variant: one tall through-bored boss, stepped with a larger counterbore on the back face for a press-in bushing and two radial set-screw holes spaced apart, carries one flat arm that leaves the boss radially then takes a single in-plane dogleg before ending in a two-prong clevis with an aligned pin hole. Two triangular gusset ribs tie the underside of the arm to the boss, and the straight arm section is pierced by one long oval slot; edges are chamfered rather than filleted into a neck.

family_scale1__Z_00773_1.desc: A wider constant-thickness grille of the same lattice family, using more longitudinal ribs than cross ribs and node pads mainly at the perimeter; round mounting holes appear in selected corner pads, long capsule-shaped lightening slots open the outer bays, and small fillets ease the rib-to-pad transitions.

family_scale1__Z_00312_1.desc: Thin flat star-shaped mounting plate with six evenly spaced arms radiating from a central ring. The ring carries a large central through bore encircled by tapped holes, while each arm terminates in an elongated adjustment slot and is lightened by a triangular cutout near its root.

family_scale1__Z_00070_0.desc: Low-profile rectangular sheet-metal pan with an open top and a shallow recessed floor forming one large interior pocket. Thin uniform walls are folded up on all sides with small corner radii; short flanged ears and angled gusset tabs project outward for mounting. Features include countersunk and plain through holes on the flanges, a large circular through hole with smaller adjacent holes at one end, rectangular connector cutouts and narrow slots along the side walls, plus small bent stiffening ribs.

family_scale1__Z_00425_2.part_family: bent flat-bar metal strap / crank link
family_scale1__Z_00425_2.desc: A right-angle bent flat bar acting as a simple L-bracket, with a single crease instead of two and legs of noticeably unequal length. The longer leg has one slotted mounting hole elongated along its axis, the shorter leg has one round hole, and both outer corners are rounded rather than square-cut.

family_scale1__Z_00101_0.desc: A thin, flat, flower-shaped plate bounded by six equal convex lobes linked by small concave fillets. It is pierced by six plain through-holes — one central hole plus five identical holes evenly pitched on a concentric bolt circle — with each outer hole centred in its own lobe. The body is a solid uniform web (no ribs, gussets, slots, or threads), the top and bottom faces are flat and parallel, and every outer edge is broken with a uniform small round.

family_scale1__Z_00078_1.desc: A shallow, gently crowned circular grille panel in the same family, built from a radial-and-concentric rib lattice that opens into wedge-shaped cells and is bound by a plain rolled rim. On the back are several equally spaced mounting bosses with counterbored holes, and the outer edge finishes in a continuous fillet rather than corner chamfers.

family_scale1__Z_00736_1.part_family: bent flat-strip metal bracket / leaf strap
family_scale1__Z_00736_1.desc: Same family: a uniform flat spring strip with two opposite-set bends (a Z/crank profile) that offset the working leg from the mounting leg. It replaces the single round tip hole with one obround slot at the working end, has two round holes in a line on the mounting leg, and uses chamfered tips with slightly larger bend radii; still no ribs or fasteners.

family_scale1__Z_00043_0.part_family: machined flat connecting link with end eyes
family_scale1__Z_00043_0.desc: A thin flat link formed as two unequal ring lugs joined by a narrow straight web of lower thickness. Each lug has a central through bore with matching angled entry chamfers on both faces, the lug rims stand proud of the web as raised pads, and the exposed outline and web edges carry a small uniform chamfer.

family_scale1__Z_00124_1.desc: Flat uniform-thickness three-armed link plate with a compact central triangular hub and three radiused straps fanning out to rounded clevis lugs, each lug taking a single through pin bore. The hub is opened by one large central triangular cutout plus small filleted corner pockets, two arms add an elongated adjustment slot, and every inside corner is filleted with otherwise smooth flat faces.

family_scale1__Z_00095_1.desc: A deeper clamshell variant from the same family: two opposed banks of stamped louvers straddle a central pressed stiffening rib on the front wall, the wraparound side flanges carry keyhole slots and raised threaded standoff bosses, and the rear wall replaces the connector port with a large circular fan opening ringed by tapped holes plus several circular knockouts.

family_scale1__Z_00068_2.desc: A handwheel-style variant with a raised central D-bore hub, two main grip spokes and intermediate thinner spokes running to a solid outer rim that has evenly spaced radial timing slots. Stiffening is provided by concentric annular ribs on one face plus several counterbored mounting holes on a bolt circle, with no axial rib skirt and no separate base flange.

family_scale1__Z_00653_0.desc: A flat square backing plate carries an integral orthogonal egg-crate of thin vertical walls that cross to form an 8x8 array of identical square pockets; the walls are fused to the base and to each other with small fillets at the junctions, and their top edges are stepped to different heights across the grid so the working face reads as a terraced relief while the opposite face remains a flat mounting skin. No through-holes, slots or bosses are present; the part is one continuous ribbed shell.

family_scale1__Z_00778_1.desc: A split sealing ring of the same annular family: a thin ring with a single circumferential gap whose ends overlap in a scarf joint so the ring can be expanded onto a shaft. The outer cylindrical surface carries several shallow rectangular circumferential grooves, while both flat faces remain smooth with a small chamfer on the inner edge.

family_scale1__Z_00040_2.desc: Wider flat carrier plate with two parallel rails linked by a diagonal lattice, a central circular boss, four corner through holes, and two oblong adjustment slots. Outer corners are rounded and the lattice intersections are filleted for stiffness.

family_scale1__Z_00578_2.desc: An elongated profile emblem in a three-peak serpentine outline where the raised bead runs only along the upper edge and stops short of the end tabs. A debossed groove follows the lower contour, one leg carries a row of small circular rivet holes, and the backside is braced by longitudinal ribs; the feature mix combines large outer corner fillets with a few sharp internal re-entrant corners.

family_scale1__Z_00153_2.part_family: ribbed molded enclosure cover with hinge lug
family_scale1__Z_00153_2.desc: A deeper clamshell-style half using twin hinge barrels along one side and no outer latch boss. Inside the recessed cavity, a small grid of standoff bosses anchors a board, radial gusset ribs tie the bosses to all four walls, and the rim is relieved by one wide cable notch rather than a perimeter slot pattern.

family_scale1__Z_00562_1.desc: A square return-air grille with a slightly wider perimeter flange and a two-way lattice of horizontal and vertical bars creating many small square cells instead of one row of slots. The rear has a shallow recessed seat for a filter screen and the flange carries a few countersunk mounting holes near the corners.

family_scale1__Z_00095_0.desc: A shallow bent sheet-metal enclosure cover: a flat rectangular front wall carries one vertical bank of six horizontal louvered vents and four corner mounting holes inside a hemmed perimeter, while one folded return wall holds a connector port flanked by two small jack-screw holes and one larger through hole, with dense clusters of small chamfered perforations along the adjacent edge.

family_scale1__Z_00723_2.desc: Shorter, wider twin-rail chassis insert with a central spine and mirrored ladder bays on each side. The feature mix combines round boss towers, metal-insert mounting holes, elongated cable slots, and diagonal corner gussets, with a hinged latching tab at one end, a flanged mounting foot at the other, and rib height increasing toward a reinforced mid-span.

family_scale1__Z_00203_0.desc: One-piece pivot bracket: a cylindrical hinge barrel with a through pin bore blends into a flat tapered leaf that carries a round eye and an adjacent oblong slot along its centreline, then splits into a forked pair of angled mounting lugs tied by cross-webs so the rear reads as a channel. Each lug tip is a small pad populated with threaded-insert bosses, the silhouette is generously filleted, and a thin lug edge shows evenly stepped internal lands.

family_scale1__Z_00664_1.part_family: trussed open frame of thin punched rails
family_scale1__Z_00664_1.desc: Low four-post open rack in the same punched-rail family: paired uprights are tied by rectangular top and bottom side rails with removable shelf angles between them. Each post carries a main column of square cage-nut openings plus a short column of round holes, with corner gusset plates, folded rail edges and no diagonal bracing.

family_scale1__Z_00702_1.part_family: T-slot aluminum extrusion profile, cut to length
family_scale1__Z_00702_1.desc: A slim square single-channel extrusion with one T-slot on each of the four outer faces and a single large central bore flanked by four corner screw bosses for end tapping. The walls are thin and uniform, internal diagonal webs stiffen the corners, and all slot edges are lightly radiused.

family_scale1__Z_00117_0.desc: A thin, uniform-thickness square plate with generously rounded corners and a formed edge lip rolled along its perimeter. Six petal-shaped through openings are arranged radially about the center, separated by six spoke ribs that merge into a small central hub ring with a single through bore; the spokes and hub tie into a continuous outer rim. Four countersunk-style mounting holes sit near the corners on a common bolt circle, and the corner rim carries small blend radii throughout.

family_scale1__Z_00017_1.desc: A squat member of the same canister family with the same faceted shell and rounded corners, but its end face has a single large central blind well ringed by smaller satellite pilot holes on one bolt circle rather than a mixed cluster. The grip texture is reworked as axial flutes interrupted by one mid-height circumferential band, and the top is closed by a wide low hexagonal flange with an integral latch on one flank instead of a center tab.

family_scale1__Z_00081_2.part_family: flat spoked handwheel ring with scalloped rim
family_scale1__Z_00081_2.desc: A dished handwheel variant with a crowned web and three curved spokes that flow into an offset side hub carrying a blind bore and a radial set-screw boss. Its grip edge is knurled with fine axial ridges rather than scalloped, and the front face includes a pattern of small counterbored mounting holes around the hub.

family_scale1__Z_00513_1.part_family: thin punched sheet-metal vent grille panel
family_scale1__Z_00513_1.desc: A round thin sheet-metal fan guard uses an outer annular mounting ring with three integral ears, each pierced by a short radial slot for fastening. The vent field is a single continuous spiral slot from a solid center hub to the rim, with two concentric stiffening beads rolled into the sheet and a shallow drawn lip around the perimeter.

family_scale1__Z_00409_0.part_family: cut length of thin-wall square hollow tube
family_scale1__Z_00409_0.desc: A straight, plain cut-off piece of thin-walled square hollow section. The constant square profile forms four flat outer faces around a continuous central bore that is open at both square-cut ends, with no holes, slots, ribs, bosses, or added features and only the natural wall edge visible at each end.

family_scale1__Z_00089_1.desc: Molded socket plate of the same family but with three pocket banks arranged around a central raised alignment island rather than a split pair; it drops the open center channel, adds four corner mounting holes and two guide-pin bosses, and moves the polarizing notch to the long side with shallow latch reliefs.

family_scale1__Z_00101_2.desc: An elongated obround flange plate carrying two staggered rows of four through-holes each, with a long slotted mounting hole at each rounded end for bolt adjustment. The solid web between the hole rows is lightened by two milled rectangular pockets, the perimeter is one smooth continuous curve without lobes, and the edge is bevelled rather than filleted.

family_scale1__Z_00497_0.desc: A single continuous extruded rail: a flat longitudinal base integrally joins several parallel upstanding webs that run the full profile length, splitting it into multiple side-by-side sliding channels of mixed height, with one side rising into a taller double-walled guide channel and the others staying low. The web tips carry small hooked lips, every base and channel corner is broken by numerous small fillets, and a set of four through-holes pierces the base for fasteners.

family_scale1__Z_00822_1.part_family: ribbed injection-molded plastic circular grille / spoked rotor disc
family_scale1__Z_00822_1.desc: A closed-face molded axial impeller of the same family: a splined central hub carries several backward-curved blades out to a continuous outer shroud ring, with a solid back plate instead of open windows. The rear of the back plate is stiffened by radial gusset ribs and a circumferential rib ring, and a few small balance holes and a single keyway are provided in the hub.

family_scale1__Z_00543_1.desc: Closed two-piece ventilated housing of the same family: a base shell and a snap-on lid form a six-sided box whose long sidewalls carry two banks of horizontal louvers separated by a central reinforcing rib; inside are four corner PCB standoffs with screw bosses, one end is opened with a large rectangular connector cutout plus a row of small cable holes, and the lid corners use generous fillets and snap latches rather than an open comb.

family_scale1__Z_00661_0.part_family: long bent sheet-metal angle rail with punched square slots
family_scale1__Z_00661_0.desc: A slender L-angle rail folded from constant-thickness sheet metal: a wide punched web is joined along one long edge to a narrower plain flange at a right angle. The web carries two parallel longitudinal columns of small square through-slots on an even pitch, repeated in groups along most of the length, with square-cut ends and only the bend radius at the fold.

family_scale1__Z_00419_0.desc: A single hollow rectangular section is swept along a smooth quarter-arc to form a right-angle elbow of constant cross-section. It is one continuous tube with square-cut open ends; the inner and outer bend faces are smooth concentric curves and there are no holes, slots, ribs or bosses.

family_scale1__Z_00552_2.desc: A longer variant split by thin internal ribs into three identical bays along its length, each bay holding one oblong slot beside a vertical column of small round apertures. One long edge carries a polarizing notch and a partial-height rib instead of a top boss, and both ends use flexible cantilever snap latches with rounded lead-ins rather than rigid mounting tabs.

family_scale1__Z_00790_0.desc: One-piece annular gear ring with a thick cylindrical rim carrying continuous helical external teeth around the full circumference. A coaxial hexagonal through-bore has rounded corners, the flat end faces are plain, and the tooth roots are filleted; there is no separate hub, web, boss, or split joint.

family_scale1__Z_00005_1.desc: A shorter clip of the same family built as a closed rectangular tube rather than an open channel, with a single central molded thumb wheel over one fixing hole and smooth snap feet at both ends. A solid top deck replaces the long window, three stiffening ribs run across the sloped shoulders, and one end carries a side-entry slot instead of a through-hole.

family_scale1__Z_00583_2.desc: A releasable double-header version joins two compact buckles back-to-back on a flexible center web and feeds four smooth-backed toothed strap ends, two from each buckle. Each head adds a thumb-release lever, side guide rails, enclosed pawl cavities and rounded anti-snag tip guards instead of sharp points.

family_scale1__Z_00278_2.desc: A longer multi-point variant with three connection features: a large bore at each rounded end plus a third bore offset toward one edge near mid-length, so the lightening pattern changes from alternating triangular truss cutouts at the ends to short rectangular slots wrapping around the middle boss region. One edge rail also carries a row of small circular tooling holes, and several through-slots break up the web without disturbing the constant-thickness shell; all intersections are filleted and there are no ribs standing off the face.

family_scale1__Z_00366_2.part_family: profiled flat sheet-metal hand lever bracket
family_scale1__Z_00366_2.desc: A narrow flat cam-lever blank with an enlarged circular pivot eye at one end and a forked clevis tip at the other, connected by a gently tapered spine. Three small tooling holes run in a row along the spine, the long edges carry shallow scalloped relief notches, and there is no closed finger slot.

family_scale1__Z_00567_2.desc: A same-family cover with only two rows of wide horizontal slots and gently rounded bar intersections. Snap-fit tabs on the side edges replace the upward posts, and shallow reinforcing ribs on the rear face bridge between the vertical stiles to stiffen the open grid.

family_scale1__Z_00322_1.desc: A low-profile cold-plate extrusion with one wide flat base plate, a single row of large oval coolant galleries inside, and a pin-fin field on the opposite face; side mounting flanges extend beyond the finned zone and carry counterbored through-holes, while one end has an integral transverse dam so the galleries exit only at the far end.

family_pilot__Z_00084_2.desc: Another variant is an open ladder frame with two side rails joined by several cross ties and clear bays between them. Some ties carry paired raised locating bosses and round tooling holes, one rail has a fine row of slots, and the other rail is plain with scalloped clearance notches.

family_scale1__Z_00311_1.desc: A five-arm version uses uneven spoke lengths around a keyed central bore; two spokes end in forked clevis ears and three end in plain pads with counterbored holes. One face has radial stiffening ribs and the opposite face is flat, with perimeter pilot notches rather than oriented edge slots.

family_scale1__Z_00712_0.desc: A flat circular wheel built as an outer rim ring, a smaller concentric inner ring and a central hub, all tied together by evenly spaced radial spokes in a single constant-thickness web. The rim carries a repeating circumferential pattern of trapezoidal windows separated by short solid blocks, the central bore has one narrow axial keyway slot, and the inner cylindrical seat is slightly smaller than the outer diameter with lightly radiused edges.

family_scale1__Z_00232_0.desc: A single thin flat sheet cut into one connected branching web of thick rounded struts that wander in stepped, roughly hexagonal turns. The struts enclose several irregular through-openings and island holes, and every inside and outside corner carries the same small fillet; there are no bends, bosses, ribs, or fasteners, just a uniform-thickness openwork plate.

family_scale1__Z_00098_2.desc: A six-spoke annular variant: use a closed inner ring rather than a solid hub, with six radial ribs to a circular outer flange interrupted by six lug pads. Alternate long and short through-slots between spokes, add one perimeter index notch and two datum tabs, and include two larger tooling holes opposite each other.

family_scale1__Z_00327_0.desc: Single constant-thickness arcuate bracket plate: a broad annular-sector web bounded by a convex outer edge and a concave inner cutout, with short straight end faces. Two round through-holes sit near the ends; the lower corner transitions are filleted, and there are no ribs, bosses, slots, or formed flanges.

family_pilot__Z_00070_0.desc: A flat D-shaped thin panel with a straight lower edge closed by a continuous rounded outer rim. Three ribs radiate from a central circular boss to the rim and side edges in a Y-spoke layout, and small triangular gusset webs brace the two lower corners, while the face carries rim clearance holes, a larger central bore flanked by two round reliefs, and countersunk holes along the bottom edge.

family_pilot__Z_00104_0.desc: One elongated thin metal strip: a broad cross-hatched grip end carries two through holes, then the strip necks down and splits lengthwise into two parallel edge rails. The rails converge and roll into a small rounded J-hook tip with a transverse end groove; all edges use generous fillets and the wall stays uniformly thin.

family_scale1__Z_00326_2.desc: Compact twin-bore slotted profile: two parallel axial through-holes sit in separate round bosses joined by a thin spine, with opposing side grooves and one closed flat face for labeling or seating. Several short cross-slots interrupt one flange for clamp hardware, the ends are tapped rather than plain, and the exterior uses fillets predominantly instead of chamfers.

family_scale1__Z_00471_1.part_family: bent sheet-metal channel bracket with end mounting flanges
family_scale1__Z_00471_1.desc: A straight-length member of the same thin-gauge formed channel family, kept essentially in one plane with one shallow offset bend near midspan to clear an obstruction. Wider gusseted ears at both ends use elongated slots instead of round holes, the web is stiffened by two pressed longitudinal ribs and a regular pattern of pierced round holes, and only two opposed spring retainer tabs are lanced from a single flange.

family_scale1__Z_00235_1.desc: Shallow sheet-metal chassis tray of the same family with a separate flat lid; its two side walls are vented by staggered banks of short horizontal louvers rather than full-height slots, the rear edge has one row of connector clearance holes, and the base uses four raised standoff pads plus a single large central cutout instead of dense perforations.

family_scale1__Z_00304_2.desc: A boxed chevron column variant: rectangular top and bottom mounting plates, each with a pair of holes and hemmed outer edges, are tied together by two parallel zigzag folded webs. Short stiffening dimples run along each bend line and a few punched tabs mate the two webs into a closed louvered section.

family_scale1__Z_00198_0.desc: Machined bracket formed as a thin horizontal base plate joined to an upright rear web and a short end wall, with filleted gusset ribs tying the web to the base. The vertical web carries a row of eight clearance through-holes, the perpendicular side flange carries two rows of three and five through-holes, and the base has several raised rectangular pads with holes plus a perimeter set of small bosses; external edges are broadly chamfered.

family_pilot__Z_00074_0.desc: A flat uniform-thickness circular metal disc whose round rim is interrupted by a small rectangular top lug, opposed side flats, and several semicircular scallops around the edge. The face is densely populated by equal-diameter through holes laid out as concentric equally spaced bolt-circle rings combined with parallel straight rows, with no bosses, ribs, or formed shell—just the perforated web and machined perimeter features.

family_scale1__Z_00457_0.part_family: molded thin-wall keypad faceplate with display window
family_scale1__Z_00457_0.desc: A thin rectangular molded faceplate bounded by a continuous raised perimeter rim with rounded outer corners and a stepped underside edge. The upper field is opened by one large rectangular display window, while the lower field carries a regular four-by-four array of small square through-slots for individual keys, separated by narrow webs and finished with filleted internal corners; small evenly spaced edge features along the sides serve for location or snap engagement.

family_scale1__Z_00603_1.desc: Three-sided open channel from the same thin-wall family: two slotted side rails are joined by one plain end rail so the far end stays open, with the slotting gathered into wider louvered bays instead of an even comb. The outside face has a continuous shallow flange, a small set of round mounting holes in the end rail, and triangular corner gussets for stiffness.

family_scale1__Z_00345_0.desc: One-piece open-topped thin-wall cylinder whose side shell is a uniform lattice: several circumferential hoop bands tie many vertical ribs into rows of rectangular through-slots around the full circumference, with a thicker chamfered lip at the open rim. The closed end is an integral radial grill of spokes and concentric rings forming sector vents about a central hub; the hub carries a small round through-hole with an across-flats drive detail, and all rib, band, and wall-to-end junctions are filleted.

family_pilot__Z_00079_1.desc: A six-arm star extrusion with a hollow polygonal core and alternating fin styles: three arms are smooth clamping webs with T-slots, while the other three carry dense cooling ribs. The ends are faced, one end is counterbored, and the axial holes are reduced to two opposed pairs.

family_scale1__Z_00692_1.desc: Single-plane Warren truss rail: two parallel chords are joined by vertical posts and alternating diagonals across six bays, with pressed gusset plates at the nodes. One end carries a slotted splice plate for field bolting, while the opposite end has a narrow locating tongue and two welded stub lugs.

family_scale1__Z_00647_2.desc: A broad leaf-shaped camp-blade blank with a curved belly and blunt rounded tip, a full flat tang pierced by three handle-pin holes plus a central lanyard slot and several lightening slots, stamped repeating feather texture on both faces, jimping on the spine and thumb ramp, no guard, and a small gut-hook cutout near the heel.

family_scale1__Z_00753_2.desc: Same family with attachment features instead of plain cut ends: a short closed rectangular tube spacer with a small formed/welded mounting lug at mid-length and a longitudinal row of punched slots on one wide face for an adjustable clip; uniform thin wall, open ends, and no internal ribs.

family_scale1__Z_00787_0.part_family: thin arced slotted link plate with pin eyes
family_scale1__Z_00787_0.desc: Constant-thickness flat plate swept in plan into a shallow single-radius arc sector. A long narrow through-slot concentric with the arc splits the band into outer and inner rails joined only at the two ends. Three round through-holes sit in integral circular eyelet lugs projecting from the inner concave edge, with concave scallops between lugs, a smooth outer convex edge, and small edge fillets throughout.

family_pilot__Z_00105_2.part_family: bowed thin-gauge sheet-metal spring strip with serrated edges and lug teeth
family_pilot__Z_00105_2.desc: Another variant: a short arcing latching pawl of the same thin sheet, one long edge cut with fine ratchet serrations and the opposite edge left clean. The wider body end holds one round pivot hole and a small stamped boss, while the working end tapers into a rounded hook tip with a single reinforcing gusset fold.

family_scale1__Z_00174_2.part_family: thin-wall frame of channel-profile rails (sign/display frame)
family_scale1__Z_00174_2.desc: Closed rectangular bezel frame without any post: four mitred channel-profile sides forming a flat picture-frame ring, with gusset ribs at the inner corners, a row of evenly spaced rectangular slots along one side for clip attachment, and small locating bosses on the rear face.

family_scale1__Z_00295_1.desc: A matching enclosure half biased toward cable entry: a low rectangular tray with one taller rear wall, side latch hooks and a front finger recess. Its floor uses a grid of thin ribs instead of partitions, has several raised board studs, blind threaded inserts in the corners, and a large obround connector cutout on the rear wall.

family_scale1__Z_00058_0.part_family: molded plastic fir-tree wire-harness routing clips
family_scale1__Z_00058_0.desc: Flat, uniform-wall injection-molded clip shaped as a vertical fork. A straight rectangular shank carries many opposed fir-tree barbs on all faces and ends in a chamfered insertion tip; above a short neck the body splits through two inclined struts into a symmetric Y of two tall parallel rectangular posts whose inner faces form an open cradle. Sharp edges are broadly broken with small chamfers, walls are thin and drafted, and there are no holes, threads, bosses or metal inserts.

family_scale1__Z_00209_2.desc: A shallow U-shaped variant made from thin sheet: a flat perforated base joined to two short bent-up side walls, with the base holding a symmetric field of small ventilation holes and two elongated slots, while each side wall carries only a couple of round mounting holes and a notched cable cutout. The exposed rim is hemmed for stiffness instead of chamfered, giving a formed-panel look rather than an all-machined one.

family_scale1__Z_00324_1.desc: A one-piece helical gear with a thicker toothed rim and a long integral sleeve hub centered in the blank; the bore is round with a single longitudinal keyway and two radial set screws at right angles. Four circular lightening pockets are cut through the web between hub and rim, and the hub faces and bore mouths are chamfered.

family_scale1__Z_00298_2.part_family: slotted multi-bay divider rack of thin upright panels
family_scale1__Z_00298_2.desc: A compact single-row sorter variant packs many closely spaced thin fins on a narrow base strip, with alternating fin heights and scalloped top edges instead of pierced windows. A thin central web links the fin tips for stiffness, the base feet have countersunk mounting holes, and the fin leading edges are bull-nose rounded rather than chamfered.

family_scale1__Z_00042_1.part_family: thin flat radial spider hub plate
family_scale1__Z_00042_1.desc: A similar spider plate but laid out as a four-arm cross with identical pads at right angles. The central hub uses a keyed through bore with a counterbored face on one side only, each arm ends in a round pad with a single tapped through hole, and small triangular gusset ribs tie the pads back to the hub on the underside.

family_pilot__Z_00008_0.desc: A flat, one-piece eggcrate grille: a solid peripheral border with clipped/chamfered corners frames a dense orthogonal lattice of thin intersecting walls that form square through-cells, with small fillets/gussets at the wall junctions. The border carries the mounting features—several countersunk screw holes, a few larger counterbored holes, and a handful of short slots near the edges—while the cell field stays open and uniform in wall height.

family_pilot__Z_00004_2.part_family: flat multirotor frame plate (X-arm drone plate)
family_pilot__Z_00004_2.desc: Radial hub plate for a hexacopter: a hexagonal central boss with six short spokes evenly spaced around it, each spoke drilled with a pair of through holes plus a keyhole slot to capture quick-release arm clamps. The hub area adds shallow recessed pockets for speed controllers and counterbored holes for flush-head fasteners, giving a busier central feature set than the X plate.

family_scale1__Z_00357_2.part_family: split band clamp with tightening lug
family_scale1__Z_00357_2.desc: A cast split shaft-collar clamp with a thick annular body cut by one radial slot; two opposed in-line bosses on one side take a single clamp screw, the outer diameter has set-screw flats and a small relief at the slot root, the bore includes an internal keyway and a shallow oil groove, and an integral L-shaped foot with two slotted mounting holes extends tangentially from the ring.

family_pilot__Z_00100_1.desc: A similar flat mounting plate but wider and with a reinforced straight top edge instead of a hook ear. It uses two separated horizontal rows of small through-holes near the top, an elongated vertical slot in the center rather than a rounded window, a slotted adjustable tab at the bottom, and a single raised boss around one central hole, with triangular gusset ribs only at the two lower corners.

family_scale1__Z_00577_1.desc: Compact H-frame variant with two short side rails linked by three cross bridges and a closed central panel; four corner screw towers and two midspan studs sit on triangular gussets, with oblong cable slots in the bridges and snap hooks on both outer rails.

family_scale1__Z_00122_0.part_family: bent sheet-metal spring strip with serrated edge
family_scale1__Z_00122_0.desc: Thin flat strip of constant rectangular section folded into a shallow L: a long horizontal leg joined by a small rounded inside fillet to a short upturned end tab. The top edge of the long leg carries one uniform row of semicircular scalloped notches, the upturned tab finishes in a small hooked fork with a rounded mouth, and a tiny pierced feature sits low on the vertical leg.

family_scale1__Z_00079_0.desc: A flat rectangular molded base panel carries a raised drafted perimeter rim and several thin internal partition ribs that split the top face into open compartments. Near one end sit two side-by-side obround raised pads, while the opposite area has a stepped U-shaped channel and a small notched pocket; all walls join the base with fillets, the outer edges are lightly chamfered, and a few tiny pin holes dot the floor.

family_scale1__Z_00280_0.desc: Thin square molded cover panel with a shallow perimeter rim and rounded corners, built as one flat shell with an integral circular central boss pierced by a large through opening. The opening is bridged by an orthogonal waffle lattice of ribs, several small square through slots are grouped in sets around the boss as secondary vents, and four equally spaced corner through holes on a common bolt circle take the fasteners.

family_scale1__Z_00415_2.desc: A spring-strap variant with the rolled eye at one end only, an arched preloaded bend in the flat leg, a single elongated slot near the eye, and shallow stamped ribs across the free end for stiffness.

family_scale1__Z_00637_0.part_family: flat sheet four-arm X-frame plate bracket
family_scale1__Z_00637_0.desc: A constant-thickness flat plate cut to an X plan-form: a small central square hub with four equal diagonal arms, each arm ending in a rounded ear that carries a through-hole and a short open slot forming a clevis-like tip. The faces are plain with no ribs or bosses; edges have only a few small notches and holes, and all outer corners are broken or rounded.

family_pilot__Z_00017_1.desc: A symmetric four-arm X-layout quad plate cut from one laminate sheet, with a rectangular central battery deck captured between two stacked ring hubs and a slotted top plate. Each arm carries two long lightening cutouts and widens into a round motor pad with four mounting holes; the perimeter is scalloped between arm roots and a row of countersunk holes runs down each arm, with no camera or antenna tabs.

family_scale1__Z_00607_1.desc: A similar interior-layout model of an open-plan studio: one large L-shaped living zone wrapped by exterior walls, a single enclosed bathroom pod, and one curved partition wall. Window slots are cut along two outer walls, thin rib-like columns stiffen the long spans, and the whole layout sits on a recessed perimeter base flange.

family_scale1__Z_00445_2.desc: Inline bar variant: an elongated constant-thickness plate with large annular hubs at both ends and a smaller central pilot bore, all joined by a narrowed straight spine. The spine is pierced by two long lightening slots and two countersunk mounting holes, with generous fillets where the spine meets each hub and a fully rounded outer perimeter.

family_scale1__Z_00030_1.desc: Low-profile comb-style variant with a wider base flange, three mounting holes and two opposed banks of short rounded fingers closing a central channel. It mixes alternating tooth lengths, an underside relief window and root fillets rather than tall side rails.

family_scale1__Z_00363_1.desc: An open lattice spacer ring with a single mid-height honeycomb band and no inner liner; alternating hexagonal and diamond openings wrap the barrel and are split by three axial stiffening ribs. One end carries a locating flange with four clearance holes, while the opposite end has two bayonet notches and a lead-in chamfer.

family_scale1__Z_00357_1.part_family: split band clamp with tightening lug
family_scale1__Z_00357_1.desc: A hinged two-strap hose clamp built from rolled channel-section strip: one semicircular half ends in a rolled hinge barrel, the other half carries a flared saddle with pressed ribs and closes over a swinging T-bolt and trunnion, with edge hems, an inner sealing liner groove, and an oversize adjustment slot rather than pinched ears.

family_scale1__Z_00492_1.desc: A comparable rotating carrier disk but with eight peripheral through bores on the bolt circle and a plain central arbor hole, using recessed counterbores rather than raised collars. Solid pie-shaped webs separate the bores, broken only by a few short radial lightening slots, and the edge is finished with a narrow rolled flange for stiffness.

family_scale1__Z_00458_0.desc: A constant-thickness flat plate cut to a six-petal star outline: six identical rounded lobes radiate evenly from a compact central hub, with smooth concave necks where each petal joins the hub. A single cylindrical bore passes straight through the hub, and all outer and inner edges are simple through-cut vertical faces with generous fillets and no ribs, slots, pockets, or added bosses.

family_scale1__Z_00605_0.desc: Long double-ended open hull folded from thin flat panels along several longitudinal chines, forming a faceted shell with a gentle bottom rocker, upswept raked ends and a nearly flat mid-body. Transverse frames, short vertical webs and longitudinal stringers surround an open central cockpit; one interior web carries a small round hole, the mid-body lower corners are softly radiused, and hidden lines indicate recessed floor and end stiffeners.

family_scale1__Z_00249_0.desc: Thin single-plate quadcopter frame: a central circular hub with a through bore feeds four slim radial arms in a cruciform layout, and each arm ends in a raised faceted motor-mount ring with its own through hole; opposing rings use slightly different bore sizes. Hub, arms and rings are one continuous web with filleted internal corners throughout, and the motor rings stand a little proud of the arm plate.

family_scale1__Z_00373_1.desc: A single-row member of the same family: an elongated open-bottom shell whose deck carries one straight run of three cylindrical studs, with three matching stepped receiving sockets on the same centreline underneath. A continuous longitudinal spine rib and short transverse ties connect the sockets to the side walls, one end wall is pierced by two small vent slots, and all edges use the uniform small radius.

family_scale1__Z_00625_2.desc: A narrow toothed timing drum runs on a horizontal axle captured between two flat cheek plates over a rectangular base plate. The rim is a shallow grooved, gear-toothed shell patterned with axial slots and a cross-pin through the hub, and triangular gusset ribs brace the cheek plates down to the bolted feet.

family_scale1__Z_00591_1.desc: A shorter relative built as an open three-sided channel rather than a closed tube: a flat perforated web between two plain side flanges. The web carries two staggered rows of small through-holes kept clear of the bend radii, with one elongated clamping slot at each end and small chamfers on the outer corners instead of fillets.

family_scale1__Z_00748_2.desc: A lighter triangular brace in the same family made from bent sheet-metal channel rather than welded bar. The three sides are folded with edge flanges for stiffness, joined by rivets at each vertex, and punched with evenly spaced lightening holes along the long side plus two counterbored mounting holes on the base leg.

family_scale1__Z_00097_1.desc: Heavier circular port plate of the same family but with a smooth non-scalloped outside diameter and a raised central boss on one face. Four large through-bores are evenly spaced around a blind pilot bore that carries a keyway, while a separate inboard ring is threaded rather than plain, and the large bores are counterbored from the back face with the front face left flat. Small radial slots break the rim for indexing and only the counterbore mouths are chamfered.

family_scale1__Z_00284_2.desc: A low stepped organizer tray with a wide primary well beside a staggered bank of eight short slots instead of parallel long pockets. The opposite sidewall has two elongated access openings plus several small drain holes, internal ribs tie back to a central boss, and all exposed edges are softly filleted.

family_scale1__Z_00731_2.desc: A fourteen-vane paddle wheel built from folded sheet-metal blades welded to a short sleeve; alternating long and short vanes are twisted for pitch, and the sleeve includes clamping bosses with lightening slots between weld lands.

family_scale1__Z_00213_2.part_family: tri-lobed hand spinner body with recessed bearing pockets
family_scale1__Z_00213_2.desc: Elongated two-lobe bar spinner: a waisted central web joins two circular bearing seats at opposite ends, with a counterbored finger bearing hole in the middle. The end pockets are deep raised-rim cups for press-in bearings, the web is opened by two symmetric kidney slots, and a thin peripheral rib stiffens the otherwise flat plate.

family_scale1__Z_00170_1.desc: A four-arm variant of the same hub family for a small blower: a taller cylindrical center boss with a keyed bore replaces the flat ring, four curved tapered spokes blend into a continuous scalloped outer rim instead of separate tip blocks, and teardrop lightening windows open the face between spokes while blind standoff bosses on the back carry the fasteners.

family_scale1__Z_00089_0.desc: Thin flat rectangular base plate with a low continuous perimeter rim, carrying two dense rectangular banks of many identical narrow blind pockets separated by fine ribs; a single wide recessed channel splits the banks lengthwise, one short end has a stepped polarizing/key recess with a small tongue and a tiny square pocket, and the outer corners use eight small equal rounds, with a regular fine-pitch groove pattern along one edge.

family_scale1__Z_00101_1.desc: A compact three-lobed plate of similar style: three through-holes sit at the lobe centres in a triangular array around a single larger central bore, but the rim between lobes is drawn as straight tangent flats, giving a rounded-triangle outline rather than scallops. A short raised annular boss rings the central bore on one face as a seating surface, and the outer edges are chamfered instead of rounded.

family_scale1__Z_00119_0.desc: Low-profile rectangular grille made as a continuous perimeter rim with one central vertical rib forming two louver bays. Fourteen long horizontal through-slots with rounded ends and many small edge radii fill the bays; four corner through-holes sit in reinforced pads, with tiny locating holes and rounded outer corners.

family_scale1__Z_00059_0.part_family: thin circular honeycomb grille/vent cover plate
family_scale1__Z_00059_0.desc: Thin flat circular cover with a narrow plain outer rim and stepped concentric raised rings on the front face. The middle band carries a regular honeycomb field of hexagonal through-cells around a small central hub with a through hole, and the rear is a shallow flat plate with a small central boss and a chamfered edge.

family_scale1__Z_00119_1.desc: Single-bay member of the same grille family with one uninterrupted field of horizontal louvers inside a thin rounded frame. It replaces the corner-boss pattern with two diagonal mounting holes, adds rear midspan standoffs, and uses a pair of snap tabs instead of tiny locating holes.

family_pilot__Z_00010_0.part_family: ribbed injection-molded carrier plate with through-boss array
family_pilot__Z_00010_0.desc: Flat rectangular thermoplastic panel whose working face is a regular grid of large cylindrical through-bosses (four by three). The boss rims are tied together by a raised diagonal waffle rib lattice, smaller through-holes sit at chosen lattice nodes and around the perimeter, and two sizes of obround slot break the field; the back face is mostly flat, outer corners are generously rounded, edge intersections carry small fillets, one long edge is molded as a thin fine-pitch contact/comb strip, and a short edge has a stepped scalloped relief.

family_scale1__Z_00340_2.desc: A short fan-shaped plate left flat rather than bowed, opening at the inner edge with a wide V-notch and three elongated adjustment slots that mirror the outer arc. One countersunk hole and a pressed stiffening bead cross the middle of the span, one radial edge is scalloped for grip, and every exposed outer corner is rounded.

family_scale1__Z_00121_1.desc: A wider, shorter faceplate is bent on both side edges to the same side to make a shallow U-channel, with perforated end tabs instead of folded ears. Its web holds one horizontal row of rectangular multi-pin connector cutouts with paired jack-screw holes, a line of small round indicator holes above them, two keyhole mounting slots, and a pressed longitudinal stiffening bead down the middle.

family_pilot__Z_00074_1.desc: A heavier circular tube-sheet style plate with a large central bore, two concentric rings of small through holes, and a raised hub on one face around the bore. The outer edge uses keyway-like radial slots instead of scallops, there is a shallow O-ring groove on the sealing face, and a few holes are countersunk for flush fasteners.

family_scale1__Z_00778_0.desc: A thin flat washer-like annular ring produced as a pure surface of revolution. Multiple concentric circular grooves and ridges run around both the inner and outer cylindrical edges and step slightly across the flat faces, giving a multi-line profile in section; there are no holes, slots, or ribs, just continuous stepped circumferential grooves with small chamfered corners.

family_scale1__Z_00443_0.part_family: open rectangular bezel frame of thin rails
family_scale1__Z_00443_0.desc: Tall narrow open rectangular bezel made from four thin-walled straight rails joined at the corners into a closed loop of shallow uniform depth. The inner edge carries a continuous narrow rebate for a retained panel, the top rail has a short stepped cap detail, and the remaining faces are smooth with clean mitered corner joints and no holes.

family_scale1__Z_00529_0.desc: One-piece transmission part with a slender tubular stem coaxially joined to a wider straight-spur gear ring at one end. A continuous axial through bore runs through the stem and gear hub, with a short boss at the transition, plain cylindrical walls, edge chamfers, and many evenly spaced external teeth; no keyway, slot, cross-hole, or rib pattern is shown.

family_scale1__Z_00477_0.desc: A constant-thickness flat emblem plate made from one connected cut outline: a five-point star is tied to a horizontal spine bar by several short upright ribs, while a row of tapered fingers hangs below the spine as a fringe. Narrow through-cut slots separate the ribs and fingers, there are no mounting holes, and the outside corners are sharp sheet-cut corners rather than molded fillets.

family_scale1__Z_00405_0.part_family: thin slotted contact plate with integral tang
family_scale1__Z_00405_0.desc: A thin flat rectangular plate of uniform thickness, with a narrow straight tang extending from one end off a stepped shoulder and biased toward one side edge. The wider pad holds a single in-line row of small through-holes plus one larger mounting hole near the far end, several long parallel through-slots crossing the body, and a tight cluster of three close ribs at the far edge; outer corners are essentially sharp.

family_scale1__Z_00128_0.part_family: thin molded spoke-and-ring protective grille (fan/vent guard)
family_scale1__Z_00128_0.desc: Flat circular lattice grille molded as one thin part: several concentric circular ribs are tied together by eight radial spokes into a single open network, with the outer ring forming the rim and rounded/filleted junctions throughout. A small central hub carries a through mounting hole with a shallow countersunk/counterbored seat, and the edge detail shows the ribs are narrow drafted walls tapering to a crisp edge with a tiny locating bead at the rim.

family_scale1__Z_00344_2.desc: A flat acute-triangular plate blank with three small rounded triangular windows arranged toward the corners and no large central opening. One leg carries a line of elongated ventilation slots while the opposite edge is scalloped with semicircular notches, corner holes are set in thickened pads, and every internal and external corner is generously radiused.

family_scale1__Z_00475_1.part_family: stepped compound spur gear (coaxial cluster gear)
family_scale1__Z_00475_1.desc: Three-stage cluster gear with full-width spur wheels of decreasing diameter stacked on a common shaft and separated by thin spacer hubs. The largest wheel web carries lightening pockets, and the central bore is broached for a key rather than left plain.

family_scale1__Z_00774_0.desc: Thin flat steel blade with one long serrated cutting edge and a smooth opposite spine, tapering to a rounded point; at the heel the section necks down through small fillets into a short flat tang pierced by a single through rivet hole, with a small bolster step at the blade-to-tang transition.

family_scale1__Z_00022_0.part_family: flat perforated multi-arm spider mounting plate
family_scale1__Z_00022_0.desc: Constant-thickness machined plate formed as three rounded arms radiating equally from a central hub in one flat web. The hub carries a single large through bore, each arm ends in a semicircular tab with a through-hole, and small through-holes are repeated along each arm on concentric bolt circles; the web is further opened by circular and oval lightening holes, with all outer edges and hole rims softly rounded.

family_pilot__Z_00005_2.desc: A heavier six-spoke spider plate built around a thickened hub with a blind hexagonal socket instead of a through-hole. Alternating long and short arms radiate outward; each long arm forks into an open slotted clevis eye while each short arm ends in a small closed round loop, thin radial gusset ribs tie the arms to the hub on the back face, and a ring of evenly spaced lightening holes surrounds the socket.

family_pilot__Z_00058_2.part_family: flat-bar lever with transverse round handle
family_pilot__Z_00058_2.desc: A forked indexing handle uses two parallel thin rectangular blades bridged by one cross shaft near the ends and by a second spacer boss partway along. One blade has a short slot and several cross holes, while the other stays plain; the shaft carries small end collars and a welded stop ring.

family_scale1__Z_00525_0.part_family: bent and pierced sheet-metal slide rail
family_scale1__Z_00525_0.desc: One long low-profile rail formed from a single flat strip, with a raised central tongue running between two end blocks. The near end turns up into a short pierced ear carrying a vertical row of small round holes and tiny locating pins, while the far end folds down into a retaining foot; the tongue hasangled lead-in chamfers on both sides and a small adjacent ear carries a clustered pattern of bores around a pivot.

family_scale1__Z_00512_2.desc: Shallow lid-style enclosure half with a flat sealing land, a perimeter tongue-and-groove and a waffle-pattern rib grid on the underside rather than straight fins. Four corner screw bosses surround a central raised pad for a light pipe, a separate rectangular shield fence and a gasket groove replace the connector shrouds, and breakaway mounting tabs run along all four sides.

family_scale1__Z_00693_1.desc: Straight single-row cradle strip: a narrow flat spine carries one line of evenly spaced circular through bores, each bore flanked by two downward semi-cylindrical half-shells with small gusset ribs; both ends terminate in chamfered mounting eyelets with lead-in notches rather than a closed loop.

family_scale1__Z_00306_1.part_family: straight-fluted hollow dowel pin (grooved press-fit retaining pin)
family_scale1__Z_00306_1.desc: A solid grooved dowel pin with three equally spaced full-length longitudinal grooves at one-hundred-twenty-degree spacing, separated by rounded raised lands that press into the mating hole. The shank diameter is constant along its length, one end has a long insertion chamfer, the other is lightly chamfered, and there is no internal bore.

family_scale1__Z_00409_1.part_family: cut length of thin-wall square hollow tube
family_scale1__Z_00409_1.desc: A short rectangular hollow-section spacer sleeve with the same thin-wall construction, but with a clearance through-hole drilled across two opposite faces near each end for a pin or bolt. The cut edges are lightly chamfered, and one face carries a small stamped identification patch rather than any formed feature.

family_scale1__Z_00787_1.part_family: thin arced slotted link plate with pin eyes
family_scale1__Z_00787_1.desc: Constant-thickness plate bent into a tighter C-shaped arc rather than a shallow sector. Two parallel curved through-slots divide it into three rails tied at both ends and by one central transverse bridge. Four eyelet lugs carry round through-holes along the outer convex edge, the inner edge is left smooth, both ends are squared with a single locating notch, and only the slot terminations are filleted.

family_scale1__Z_00060_2.desc: Open-rotor radial fan with six straight radial blades molded between a compact central boss and a continuous thin outer tip band, leaving large through slots between blades. The boss has a hex drive recess and two flats for set screws, lightening pockets on its underside, small clip lugs on the band for a guard, and uniform draft with generous radii for molding.

family_scale1__Z_00587_2.part_family: flat perforated vent/grille panel with a clear rectangular window
family_scale1__Z_00587_2.desc: A same-family vented panel that is mostly perforated by a staggered array of small hexagonal through-holes instead of square slots. A single wide rectangular aperture is offset toward one end, bounded by a shallow embossed stiffening bead and several small raised bosses on the back face for standoff mounting; the outer rim is a narrow solid margin with relieved corner fillets.

family_scale1__Z_00000_1.desc: Square grille panel using the same ring-and-tie construction but a denser six-by-six array of smaller apertures and a doubled perimeter rail for stiffness. In place of edge loops it carries four corner mounting eyelets plus short integral standoff feet on the back face so the panel sits proud of the mating surface.

family_scale1__Z_00624_1.part_family: honeycomb-faced circular mounting plate with lugs
family_scale1__Z_00624_1.desc: A round flange plate of the same thin-web type uses three equally spaced mounting ears and a continuous raised outer rim. One face is covered by a regular honeycomb of identical hexagonal pockets across the full diameter, the back face is essentially flat, and a raised central boss with a single bore is tied to the rim by short radial ribs.

family_pilot__Z_00045_0.desc: One-piece planar frame ring of uniform thickness: a closed, constant-width band whose outer and inner edges follow the same irregular rounded polygon with generously blended apexes. The annular-style band is a plain shell with square-cut edges and a fully open center, carrying no holes, slots, ribs, bosses, or counterbores.

family_scale1__Z_00435_0.part_family: slender round shaft with an attached flat flag/paddle blade
family_scale1__Z_00435_0.desc: One long straight round wire shaft of small constant diameter runs almost the full length of the part; near one end a single thin flat rectangular flag plate is edge-joined perpendicular to the shaft axis and held by a short crimped sleeve wrapped around the rod. The flag is a plain unfolded sheet with straight edges and square corners, no holes, slots, ribs or bosses; the far shaft tip is plain and the joint end is rounded closed.

family_scale1__Z_00063_2.desc: A twin-tower molded retainer with two upright plates of unequal height linked by a cross web: the taller plate holds a toothed locking ring for a rotating shaft and the shorter one carries a plain oval slot. The base is a hollow rectangular shell with two parallel arched cradles underneath and a lattice of reinforcing ribs across the back face.

family_scale1__Z_00488_1.desc: A perimeter-flanged ventilation cover in the same perforated-panel family: the flat face carries a staggered triangular-pitch field of small round holes and is wrapped by a short turned-up rim closed at the corners. Two obround mounting slots and one small blanked boss interrupt the perforations toward one end.

family_scale1__Z_00015_2.part_family: miniature drilled hollow rectangular profile (slender micro-tube rail)
family_scale1__Z_00015_2.desc: A closed rounded-rectangular micro-extrusion with two thin internal webs that split the bore into three longitudinal cells. Both ends carry small flanged pads, each drilled with a four-hole pattern, and one outer wall has a continuous keyway-like longitudinal slot with generous fillets where the pads meet the tube.

family_scale1__Z_00807_2.desc: Offset variant where two unequal rectangular tangs meet a twisted open lattice midsection rather than lying in one line. The lattice uses crossed transverse ribs, one tang is lightened by three slots, and molded gussets reinforce both shoulder transitions.

family_scale1__Z_00056_0.desc: Injection-moulded short cylindrical ring with a central through bore and thin, near-uniform walls. A dense ring of internal axial ribs forms spline-like teeth around the bore, the outer wall carries one radial rectangular connector pocket that opens to the side, and a shallow rectangular recess sits on a face; rib roots, port corners and the rim use small rounds and chamfered lead-ins, with one end stepped into a closing shoulder and a small lower lug.

family_scale1__Z_00069_0.desc: A thin flat rectangular panel whose main body carries a regular six-by-eight field of identical through holes. Along the top edge the panel steps up into asymmetric ear/tab sections with a central rectangular notch, three small mounting through holes, chamfered outer corners, and small filleted transitions; selected holes and edges receive small chamfers while the plate thickness stays constant.

family_pilot__Z_00116_1.desc: Same formed-sheet family but arranged as a stiffened L-bracket: a long flat foot with two clearance holes bends up into a vertical back wall that carries three equal-height ears separated by two slots. A shallow stamped bead runs along the inside of the bend for rigidity and the ear tips are rounded.

family_scale1__Z_00768_2.desc: Compact flat index washer with an off-center round drive bore that has a keyway notch, an asymmetric pair of radial ears (a short blunt stop lug on one side and a slender arrow pointer on the other), and a circumferential row of small stamped detent dimples near the rim.

family_scale1__Z_00152_2.desc: A compact panel distribution plate built from a thicker ribbed central spine with thinner side wings. Two staggered rows mix larger counterbored ports with smaller plain through-ports, and the part mounts through slotted corner ears plus a pair of blind dowel bores, omitting any cylindrical end fittings.

family_scale1__Z_00697_2.part_family: flat rectangular multi-opening frame of thin profiles
family_scale1__Z_00697_2.desc: A single-opening picture-frame member is built from the same thin profiles with one mid-height horizontal rail splitting a large central aperture into upper and lower openings. The bottom rail has two small access notches, the top rail carries a row of round mounting holes rather than slots, and short reinforcing ribs bridge the four inner corners.

family_pilot__Z_00080_2.desc: A deeper two-tier caddy of the same family built around a tall central spine with opposing comb dividers that form long channels on both sides. One end wall carries an integral handle cutout, the closed base sits on raised boss pads underneath, stiffening gussets tie the spine to the side walls, and large fillets ease the principal corners.

family_scale1__Z_00412_2.part_family: curved spring slat of thin strip
family_scale1__Z_00412_2.desc: A furniture support slat with a straight rigid center section flanked by upward-cambered flexible zones toward rounded ends. It carries two elongated through-slots for fasteners, a shallow stiffening rib along the underside, and a pair of snap-fit locator bosses near each end.

family_scale1__Z_00420_1.desc: A low rounded-end cover of the same thin-shell type, but split into two obround pockets separated by an integral transverse web. It adds a perimeter sealing groove, four underside mounting bosses, and small corner fillets while keeping the outside free of through openings.

family_scale1__Z_00624_2.part_family: honeycomb-faced circular mounting plate with lugs
family_scale1__Z_00624_2.desc: A heavier circular lid in this family seats with a stepped outer rim and uses six perimeter lugs instead of four. Concentric rings of hexagonal pockets shrink toward the middle of the working face, a few cells are opened into through-holes, and the reverse side carries radial stiffening ribs from the rim to a central hub.

family_scale1__Z_00721_0.part_family: bent sheet-metal ventilated channel / perforated folded enclosure rail
family_scale1__Z_00721_0.desc: A tall, narrow folded sheet-metal channel of thin uniform wall. One broad face carries a single vertical column of nine evenly spaced obround through-slots, while the adjacent narrow front strip carries a vertical row of small round through-holes grouped as seven plus two. Edges are cleanly folded with small corner reliefs and no added bosses or ribs.

family_scale1__Z_00484_0.desc: A thin circular cast plaque whose face carries a low-relief cursive monogram of two intertwined letters. Long ribbon-like strokes sweep across the field and end in spiral volutes, with tiny fillets blending every curl into the flat background and a crisp raised crest running along each stroke; the back is a plain flat mounting face.

family_scale1__Z_00039_2.part_family: ribbed plastic linear guide rail with integral end mounting brackets
family_scale1__Z_00039_2.desc: A twin-rail ladder variant: two short parallel hollow rails tied together by several evenly spaced cross-webs, with gusseted right-angle end feet carrying keyhole slots, ventilation slots molded into the sidewalls, a continuous dovetail groove on one outer face for a sliding carriage, and a few metal-inserted threaded bosses replacing the fine hole pattern.

family_pilot__Z_00056_2.part_family: thin flat slat with obliquely cut ends
family_pilot__Z_00056_2.desc: A similar thin leaf whose thickness is stepped: a short thicker pad at one end blends through a shallow taper into the slender blade, the pad is pierced by a single countersunk hole, a low pressed rib runs lengthwise along the blade centreline, and the far tip is clipped at one oblique angle only.

family_scale1__Z_00437_0.part_family: flat profiled pendant tag with eyelet
family_scale1__Z_00437_0.desc: A single flat profiled plate forms an open zigzag shank that narrows to a sharp point and joins into a thicker annular eye boss at the opposite end. The eye carries one central through bore, and the rest of the part is a constant-thickness pierced blank with clean cut edges, no ribs, and no secondary holes.

family_scale1__Z_00737_2.desc: Elongated grille variant with six narrow slots in one line, alternating two opening widths and separated by short cross ribs. Backside ribs stiffen the midspan, and each end has a small snap-fit boss and a lead-in chamfer for assembly.

family_scale1__Z_00824_0.desc: Thin flat rectangular cover panel with rounded outer corners and a raised perimeter rim; two short hinge ears project from one vertical edge, each pierced by a single small through hole for a pin. The face is split by a mid rail into two stacked rounded-rectangular recessed fields, and each field carries a row of parallel horizontal vent slots.

family_scale1__Z_00318_1.part_family: round injection-moulded plastic snap-in grille/strainer (vent or filter screen)
family_scale1__Z_00318_1.desc: Flat circular ventilation grille of the same snap-in family, but using a radial pattern: a solid central hub with a small through bore, evenly spaced spokes running out to two concentric hoops, and a thickened outer rim. Instead of sprung latch tabs it carries several bayonet lugs behind the rim and one indexing notch, with generous fillets where the spokes meet the hub.

family_scale1__Z_00079_1.desc: A shallow rectangular molded cover whose base plate is stiffened by a crisscross rib lattice and a single central circular pedestal rather than obround pads. The drafted outer wall carries molded hinge lugs on one long side and opposing snap hooks on the other, with one oblong cable slot cut through the rim and small corner bosses for fasteners.

family_scale1__Z_00154_0.part_family: spinner-style multi-arm plate with hex nut-capture bosses
family_scale1__Z_00154_0.desc: Thin flat tri-arm plate: three tapered arms radiate at equal spacing from a central annular hub that carries a single round through-hole, and each arm tip ends in a raised hexagonal boss with a concentric hexagonal through-pocket serving as a captive-nut socket. The part is a constant-thickness plate apart from the upstanding hex bosses, with small chamfers breaking the outer edges and pocket rims.

family_scale1__Z_00709_2.part_family: profiled flat metal linkage/clevis plate bracket
family_scale1__Z_00709_2.desc: A roughly rectangular profiled plate bracket is machined from thicker stock, leaving two thin triangular gusset ribs standing on one face to tie a central bearing-bore land to a forked end. Four corner clearance holes and two dowel holes surround the large bore, while one edge is cut with a single deep tube saddle and the opposite edge splits into two clevis ears each carrying a cross-drilled pin hole. Outer corners are rounded and all functional holes pass clean through the plate thickness.

family_scale1__Z_00243_1.desc: A low, straight-bodied member of the same housing family with a closed top lid and no ramped end: a single side wall carries one row of wide contact apertures, while the opposite wall is solid with molded snap-latch barbs. The base uses four raised corner bosses with counterbored inserts instead of full-length flanges, and the interior has one longitudinal stiffening rib plus polarization keys in the aperture line.

family_scale1__Z_00145_2.desc: An elongated two-lobed bar plate with opposed end masses and a central through bearing seat; each lobe is a closed ring containing an internal hexagonal aperture for a flush insert. Tapered struts join the rings to the hub with a radius and a short relief slot at every root, while one face adds shallow blind recesses around the bore and the opposite face stays flat.

family_scale1__Z_00687_1.desc: A similar flanged rotary ring, but with a smooth outer rim used as a clamp face instead of teeth. The bore is plain through with an internal keyway rather than a counterbore, and it has eight larger through holes on a single bolt circle plus scalloped lightening pockets between them; one face has a raised pilot spigot and an O-ring groove.

family_scale1__Z_00259_2.desc: A narrow elongated carrier plate with two parallel rows of through holes running its length and obround mounting slots at both ends. The leading edge is chamfered rather than radiused, and shallow longitudinal ribs on the underside tie the holed strips together across a thin central web.

family_scale1__Z_00535_1.part_family: four-channel T-slot structural extrusion cut to length
family_scale1__Z_00535_1.desc: A lighter two-slot rail of the same framing family: an extruded rectangular bar with continuous T-slots on two opposite faces and closed smooth walls on the other two. The core has a central threading bore plus two small longitudinal accessory bores, and one closed face is thickened into an integral mounting land with drilled through holes.

family_scale1__Z_00302_1.desc: Sibling variant with three arched upright port plates on a plain rectangular base, creating two adjacent clevis gaps; only the outer plates are populated, each with a ring of spotfaced through holes around a center bore, while the middle plate is a solid web with one alignment bore. Four corner counterbored holes and a central longitudinal slot anchor the base, and short triangular gussets tie each upright to the floor.

family_scale1__Z_00271_0.desc: A single thin flat plate forms a wide two-hole mounting head that necks into an elongated bifurcated fork. A long U-shaped through slot leaves two parallel fingers with chamfered pointed tips; the head has two round through holes, rounded side notches, and filleted shoulder transitions.

family_scale1__Z_00097_0.desc: Thin flat circular machined plate whose outer rim is scalloped into lobes that wrap around a ring of large through-bores. One central large through-bore is ringed by six equal large through-holes on one concentric bolt circle and six smaller through-holes on a smaller concentric bolt circle, leaving narrow radial webs between plus a couple of larger rounded rim notches. Every scallop crest, hole mouth, and web-window corner carries small uniform rounds, and the plate keeps essentially constant thickness.

family_scale1__Z_00391_0.part_family: thin embossed round cover/dial plate with a curved dividing rib and bored bosses
family_scale1__Z_00391_0.desc: A very thin circular disc with a raised concentric outer rim and an S-shaped, yin-yang-like rib embossed on the face, splitting the top into two interlocking comma lobes. Each lobe carries a short cylindrical boss with a central through-bore, the two bosses sitting on opposite lobes and offset from the disc center. Rib roots, boss bases and the rim transition are softly filleted, with no other perforations.

family_scale1__Z_00438_1.desc: A quarter-arc punched strip of the same family has one straight tangent leg ending in a folded mounting ear and a free curved tail at the opposite end. It carries two oblong cable slots along the band, one round locating hole, and a single stiffening lip formed on the outer edge.

family_scale1__Z_00789_0.part_family: lightweight toothed rail with trussed web bracket
family_scale1__Z_00789_0.desc: A long, straight, thin-walled rail whose flat top flange carries a fine gear-rack tooth pattern along one edge, with small fillets at the ends and a large rounded clearance notch at one extremity; a downturned short lip closes the opposite end. From the flange a single open web descends and is braced by diagonal ribs into triangular and four-sided lightening pockets, converging into a small drilled boss at the bottom. Fastening is by a set of four small through-holes along the rail and a separate pair of through-holes low in the web and boss, with filleted internal corners throughout.

family_scale1__Z_00811_1.desc: A flat straight strap of similar thin rectangular section, drilled with a linear pattern of three clearance holes along the center axis plus one transverse obround slot near an end; both ends are rounded, the corners carry small fillets, and the faces stay flat with no ribs or bends.

family_scale1__Z_00176_0.desc: A solid thin plate is profiled as a stylized outer flame with a nested open flame line on the broad face, standing upright from a low stepped rectangular foot. The lower straight tab is captured by the foot and braced by two triangular cheek plates; keep the panel solid rather than shelled, with no through-holes or bosses, small fillets at the foot transitions, smooth broad faces, and a fine regular transverse rib texture confined to the narrow perimeter edge.

family_scale1__Z_00508_0.desc: A shallow rectangular framed grille with side and end rails forming a low channel around a flat slotted web. The web carries two banks of eight elongated through-slots, with thin uniform walls, mostly square edges, small internal corner blends, and one raised transverse feature near an end.

family_scale1__Z_00286_1.desc: Stretch-X flat frame plate of the same laminate type with a solid elongated center web instead of a window, using four flush pressed inserts rather than raised bosses. Front arms are longer than the rear pair, every rounded arm tip carries a triangular cluster of three motor holes, and two parallel battery slots plus several teardrop lightening cutouts pierce the web and inner arms.

family_scale1__Z_00028_1.part_family: thin contoured decorative emblem badge (automotive nameplate)
family_scale1__Z_00028_1.desc: A round medallion badge with a raised polished outer ring, a recessed textured center field, and a low domed cap interrupted by one radial slot. The backside uses a closed perimeter rib, three equally spaced locating bosses, and a ring of radial ribs, with two through bores and a keyed notch for clocking.

family_scale1__Z_00315_2.part_family: vented flat faceplate panel with end mounting tab
family_scale1__Z_00315_2.desc: An L-shaped thin cover of the same family whose long leg has three rounded connector openings in a row and whose short bent return leg is filled with a louvered slot bank; small circular standoff bosses project from the inner face for board mounting, with generous fillet at the bend and plain, unchamfered louver edges.

family_scale1__Z_00120_2.desc: Another variant is a shallow dished carrier ring rather than a lobed star: a continuous outer rim holds three equally spaced arc-shaped blade slots that sweep toward the centre, and three flexure arms project inward to boss pads with counterbored pivot holes. A short keyed timing-tooth sector and a single index notch supply drive and datum, while tiny etched fiducials and one folded locating tab take the place of raised port rims.

family_pilot__Z_00031_0.part_family: ribbed molded control tray with thumbwheel
family_pilot__Z_00031_0.desc: A shallow rectangular tray with a raised perimeter rim transitions into two sloped gussets that support an upright end hub for a transverse serrated wheel. The floor carries several long parallel stiffening ribs and small through holes around a central hub bore; the underside adds short feet, edge chamfers and generous small fillets.

family_scale1__Z_00124_2.desc: Thin straight connecting link of constant plate thickness with two inline round-ended lugs joined by top and bottom chords and a central spine perforated by a row of circular and oval lightening holes. One end lug is drilled with a short pattern of identical through holes for indexed mounting, a narrow raised lip runs around the outer perimeter as a stiffening rib, and all hole edges and chord junctions are filleted.

family_scale1__Z_00433_0.desc: A single thin rectangular sheet is edge-folded at right angles into a shallow peripheral return flange, and two interior transverse rails bridge the long sides to form three equal rectangular through-openings in a row. Each opening carries a recessed stepped seating ledge on one face, with small bend reliefs at the flange corners and no bosses, threads, or fasteners.

family_scale1__Z_00099_0.desc: A thin flat rectangular grille panel framed by a low raised perimeter rim with generously rounded corners.
