The face is pierced by a dense field of parallel obround louvers in two banks—many short slots in rows and a separate group of longer slots—with every louver edge chamfered; one end thickens into a mounting block carrying two through holes plus a small counterbored hole and a projecting cylindrical locating pin, while all outer edges are broken with chamfers.

family_pilot__Z_00095_1.desc: A single-ended slim spanner has one C-jaw at the tip of a long handle that tapers toward the tail, with a shallow stamped reinforcing rib along the shank and an elongated hanging slot instead of a round hole. The tail is squared into a light pry edge and the perimeter is chamfered rather than fully rounded, giving a stiffer feel.

family_pilot__Z_00020_2.desc: An elongated two-pad spacer plate is made from a single flat thickness with a narrow concave waist joining rounded end pads. Each pad carries a stepped through hole, lightening recesses are pocketed into the waist, and the perimeter is fully filleted with no raised ribs.

family_scale1__Z_00219_1.desc: A sealed round bearing end-cap flange built as a thicker circular disc with a protruding cylindrical pilot spigot on the back face that registers into a housing bore and a shallow raised boss around a blind central pocket on the front argumentative face. Rather than mating through-bolt circles, it uses six tapped holes on a single bolt circle plus two dowel holes, carries a continuous O-ring groove in the outer annular land, and is relieved by three kidney-shaped lightening pockets that blend into the spigot with generous fillets.

family_scale1__Z_00629_0.desc: Shallow rectangular lattice panel: a continuous outer perimeter rim is integrally joined to an orthogonal rib network that forms a five-by-four array of identical square through-cells. All ribs share the same thin wall, meet at small filleted/drafted junctions, and the rim carries a short side wall around the edge; there are no holes, bosses, or separate fasteners, just one moulded open grille.

family_scale1__Z_00443_1.part_family: open rectangular bezel frame of thin rails
family_scale1__Z_00443_1.desc: Wider landscape bezel of the same thin-rail build, split by one horizontal mid-rail into two stacked openings and formed as a return-flange section rather than a closed box. Corner blocks carry threaded bosses, while the outer top rail has a row of mounting holes and a pair of elongated cable slots toward one end.

family_pilot__Z_00011_1.desc: Two-bay version: a wider base plate split by a central honeycomb web into adjacent equipment pockets, with a full-height rear wall, a straight top rail instead of an inclined header, and a continuous perimeter rib. Each bay carries a cluster of hexagonal threaded-insert bosses and blind counterbores, the rear wall has a row of circular connector cutouts and a slotted cable pass, and the side walls add molded snap-latch hooks plus ribbed mounting feet.

family_scale1__Z_00627_2.desc: Another variant is a flat surface-mount strip with two staggered rows of short fingers on opposite edges of a common web; elongated mounting slots and raised contact dimples replace round holes, and alternating finger lengths have generous root fillets with smooth tips.

family_scale1__Z_00327_1.desc: A same-family curved bracket plate laid out as a longer arc with three round through-holes along its midline and one elongated slot at an end. A small pierced tab projects from one end for a secondary fastener, while the opposite end remains a plain flat lug.

family_scale1__Z_00456_1.desc: A rectangular framed vent plate with a staggered field of fewer, larger round holes and two plain solid margins left for sealing. Instead of a bolt circle it uses slotted tabs along two opposite edges for fastening, and the back face adds a few straight reinforcing ribs across the screen area with generous fillets at the inner frame corners.

family_scale1__Z_00320_1.part_family: perforated flat mounting strip / drilled bar rail
family_scale1__Z_00320_1.desc: A wider flat mounting rail with a plain rectangular section and two parallel, staggered rows of countersunk through-holes running its full length; each end carries an oblong adjustment slot, and the long edges are chamfered rather than radiused, making a stiff perforated strip for bolting to a frame.

family_scale1__Z_00768_1.desc: Flat indicator flag cut from uniform sheet as an elongated teardrop: a small round hub at one end carrying two mounting holes and one slotted adjustment eye, transitioning into a long tapering needle at the opposite end, with a single short folded stiffening flange along one straight edge.

family_scale1__Z_00488_0.desc: A single flat rectangular plate of uniform thickness with four equal rounded corners and a continuous solid edge margin. Its interior is pierced by a regular rectangular array of small identical through-holes, three hundred total arranged twenty by fifteen, evenly spaced in both directions, with no bends, ribs, bosses, or separate joined bodies.

family_scale1__Z_00112_1.desc: A short through-bored sleeve variant whose serrations form a raised grip band around the mid-length rather than closing an end; the straight bore has one full-length internal keyway and is locked by two radial set-screw holes, both ends are chamfered, and the wall is thicker with fewer, coarser rectangular knurl teeth.

family_scale1__Z_00338_1.desc: Pressed low-profile needle-roller cage: a single annular band with one closed outer rim and an open opposite side, punched with many identical narrow rectangular windows; all crossbars are the same, one face has small coined retaining nibs, and one rim is gently flared so the cage snaps axially into its housing.

family_scale1__Z_00091_2.part_family: thin equipment baseplate with low raised bosses and rails
family_scale1__Z_00091_2.desc: Another version is organized as fields rather than rails: a large central rectangular pocket is ringed by a low wall, one side is covered by rows of identical small square pads separated by crossing ribs, and the opposite side carries two long reinforcing ribs with a few oblong slots between them. Molded locating pegs and a couple of snap hooks rise from the rim while the underside keeps a sparse pattern of shallow stiffening ribs.

family_scale1__Z_00817_2.part_family: thin flat profiled sheet-metal plate with through-cut slots and holes
family_scale1__Z_00817_2.desc: A flat constant-thickness gusset plate bent into an L-shaped outline only in plan view (still one flat sheet): two straight legs meet at a large filleted inner corner, with three round mounting holes patterned along one leg and a single slotted hole on the other leg. A contoured lightening cutout sits at the corner junction, one outer edge carries a concave radius for hose/cable clearance, and all free corners are rounded.

family_scale1__Z_00387_0.desc: Model one seamless, constant-thickness half-round shell: an outer semicylindrical skin and a concentric inner semicylindrical skin are connected only at the two straight springing edges, then extruded straight along the axis. Both ends are open, the underside is open, and there are no holes, slots, ribs, bosses, flanges, or patterned features; keep the longitudinal edges square with only small edge breaks.

family_scale1__Z_00581_1.desc: A four-arm coupler plate of the same flat-lobed family: rounded lobes meet at a compact central hub around a bored pivot hole, with alternating arms using an elongated slot and a counterbored boss. Shallow ribs tie the hub to two opposite lobes, and the outer corners are scalloped rather than cross-keyed.

family_scale1__Z_00191_2.desc: A one-piece decorative insert with two side-by-side rectangular bays: one bay carries a dense diamond lattice, the other a sparse cross grille, all bounded by a common outer rail. It has intermittent stiffening ribs on the back face, alternating round and oblong through holes for fastening, scalloped cutouts along one edge, and filleted internal corners with no separate assembled parts.

family_scale1__Z_00448_1.desc: Machined adapter with an elongated round spigot having only two diametral through-bolts, an internal keyway, and a shallow counterbore at the mouth, flowing through a smooth cone-into-pyramid shell into a short square receiver that carries a single row of tapped holes on two adjacent faces and terminates in an open clevis slot with one transverse pivot bore.

family_scale1__Z_00759_1.part_family: short molded optical light-guide rod (light pipe)
family_scale1__Z_00759_1.desc: An L-shaped light pipe in the same family: a short straight input leg meets a longer output leg at a molded elbow whose inner corner is one wide mirrored chamfer that turns the beam right around. The input face is flat and flush with a small annular locating flange, the far end splits into two rounded output fingers, and the body carries two tiny side lugs with mounting holes plus generous draft.

family_scale1__Z_00679_0.desc: A constant-thickness flat plate cut as a radial six-point star: a compact central hub blends through small fillets into six identical slender arms spaced evenly in angle. Each arm is pierced along its length by a row of small round lightening holes and ends in a closed annular eyelet boss with a through bore, while selected eyelets add local across-flats hex seats. The hub and inner arm zone carry six equally spaced larger bores on a common bolt circle with shallow spotfaces plus smaller through holes; the part is otherwise a flat sheet outline with no raised shell.

family_scale1__Z_00561_1.desc: A flat uniform-thickness rocker link whose tapered arm joins two eye lugs of unequal size, one at each end, both with centered through bores. Along the arm are a few round lightening holes and one long slotted hole, plus small locating notches on the edges; the outline is smoothly filleted with no enclosed stepped window.

family_scale1__Z_00401_1.desc: Taller stepped flanged sleeve of the same family: the barrel has two coaxial diameters, a larger lower register and a reduced upper neck, rising from a wider bolted flange that carries three equally spaced clearance holes. Add an external circlip groove near the open end, a rolled top lip, and blend the barrel-to-flange joint with a generous fillet instead of a sharp corner.

family_scale1__Z_00358_0.desc: Open-topped rectangular insulating shell moulded as a thin base plate with four integral side walls. Two facing interior walls carry matching combs of closely spaced vertical ribs that split the cavity into parallel lanes; the rib crests are notched by two mirrored groups of eight narrow through-slots with semicircular lead-in reliefs between them.

family_scale1__Z_00077_0.desc: One shallow square tray body: a thick rectangular base skirt carries a recessed well framed by a thin continuous perimeter wall, all as one monolithic shell. The well floor is pierced by a regular 5×5 array of circular through holes with a shallow counter-recess around the field, and a diagonal criss-cross lattice of narrow ribs spans the well, tying into the side walls to form open diamond cells directly over the holes. Rib-to-wall, rib-to-floor and rim intersections carry small fillets; there are no separate bosses, the stiffness coming from the rib grid and the base skirt.

family_scale1__Z_00242_2.desc: Another variant uses several concentric annular bands that alternate fine circumferential slots with solid ribs around a slightly domed center, plus a plain solid sector reserved for a label. Its rear face has a perimeter groove for a foam gasket and four hidden screw bosses set inside the rim instead of snap features.

family_scale1__Z_00808_1.desc: A shorter, wider molded carriage of the same family with a single central rectangular aperture but no side pads; instead one rail is drilled with a row of small round through-holes for spring contacts, the opposite rail has an integral cantilever latch and two reinforcing ribs, only one end is opened with a deep thumb scoop, and the other end is closed off by a solid stop flange with a tapered lead-in.

family_scale1__Z_00649_1.part_family: flat serrated ratchet wheel with hex hub
family_scale1__Z_00649_1.desc: A one-directional toothed plate of the same thin-wheel family: a constant-thickness disc with asymmetric hooked perimeter teeth sloped for single-sense pawl engagement, a round central bore with one keyway and a short one-sided hub boss, and six equally spaced circular lightening holes on a bolt circle instead of a slotted spoke web, plus a small set-screw boss on the hub face.

family_scale1__Z_00825_2.part_family: flat multi-arm linkage plate with truss lightening
family_scale1__Z_00825_2.desc: Planar toggle link made as a single straight bar with enlarged round bosses at both ends and one intermediate pivot boss. The web between bosses is opened by a long central slot plus rounded triangular relief pockets; the end bosses carry small cross-pin holes and one has a rectangular key notch, with fully filleted edges and constant plate gauge.

family_scale1__Z_00140_1.desc: Rectangular grille panel with the same rim-and-rib construction but a coarser center field, finer ribs near both short edges, four corner through holes, and two snap lugs on one side for clipping into a bezel.

family_scale1__Z_00341_0.desc: A thin rectangular base skin carries on one face an orthogonal lattice of narrow upstanding ribs whose intersections leave a regular field of identical square through-slots inside a continuous perimeter frame. Selected grid positions are left solid as small pads, groups of slots are gathered into distinct zones around the field, and the outer corners have small rounded detail.

family_scale1__Z_00450_0.part_family: thin flat closed frame ring (delta bezel/spacer)
family_scale1__Z_00450_0.desc: Closed delta-shaped ring cut from one uniform thin sheet: three constant-width straight walls are mitre-joined into a triangular loop around a single large centered triangular through-window. Outer and inner profiles are parallel triangles on one plane, with small corner reliefs at the vertices and plain flat faces free of ribs, bosses, holes, or formed flanges.

family_scale1__Z_00637_2.part_family: flat sheet four-arm X-frame plate bracket
family_scale1__Z_00637_2.desc: A formed sheet cross bracket with a rectangular hub and four arms in a plus layout, two short and two long rather than diagonal. The long arms are bent up as flanges terminating in slotted clevis eyes, the short arms remain flat tabs with obround slots, and shallow embossed ribs run along each arm toward a pattern of press-in inserts at the centre.

family_scale1__Z_00680_2.desc: A hollow finned-tube member extruded as an annular shell with a central axial bore and continuous longitudinal fins wrapped around the full circumference; several evenly spaced radial webs tie an inner liner to the finned outer wall so the annulus is split into multiple parallel axial coolant passages. Fin roots are filleted, crests are rounded, both ends are faced square with a small lead-in chamfer, and one end adds a short unfinned collar for clamping.

family_scale1__Z_00186_2.desc: Double-ended spline hub: both faces are externally toothed with different tooth counts, separated by a narrow smooth relief groove so it can engage at either end. The central bore passes through but uses two opposed keyways plus a circumferential retaining-ring groove near one face; every tooth crest is chamfered and the roots are generously filleted for repeated axial engagement.

family_scale1__Z_00313_0.part_family: thin flat molded comb strip with edge scallops (wire/lead organizer clip)
family_scale1__Z_00313_0.desc: A straight, thin flat strip of uniform plate thickness whose one long edge is plain while the opposite long edge carries a row of evenly spaced semicircular scallop cutouts opening to the edge; at one end the strip steps up into a perpendicular T-shaped tab whose top arm holds a small rounded notch, with rounded tips on the scallop fingers; shown edgewise as a plain thin rectangle.

family_pilot__Z_00023_0.desc: Thin uniform-thickness plate with a three-lobe clover silhouette: a small central through-bored hub joined by three curved waisted arms to three identical outer ring bosses spaced equally around the center. Each outer boss has one large through bore and a scalloped, gear-like rim made of many small equal-radius scallops, with concave outer notches between lobes and softly filleted edges throughout.

family_pilot__Z_00106_2.part_family: flat circular lugged flange cover with annular seal groove
family_pilot__Z_00106_2.desc: A slightly dished round cover plate with an outer curled rim and four cardinal lug tabs joined smoothly to the shell. Instead of twin ports it uses one offset oval aperture, two small raised bosses with counterbored fastener seats on the inner face, and short radial stiffening ribs between the rim and aperture in place of a full annular seal groove.

family_scale1__Z_00455_1.desc: A pressed-metal cover folded into a shallow U-channel with both long edges lipped upward and a bevelled front flange. Instead of standoff pads it uses a single lengthwise embossed rib for stiffness, punched round holes grouped toward one end for a connector row, two staggered rows of oblong vent slots across the middle, and four corner mounting holes; one lip carries a small keyhole slot for hanging.

family_scale1__Z_00411_1.desc: A flat spring-steel band is formed into a C-shaped retaining clip with two parallel arms extending from a single large radiused bight. The longer arm is straight and carries two folded-up pierced mounting ears plus a stamped longitudinal stiffening rib, while the shorter arm terminates in an open rolled hook. The free ends are chamfered, every bend uses a liberal inside radius, and the clip relies on the strip's own spring action rather than separate fasteners at the bight.

family_scale1__Z_00299_1.desc: A similar formed flat-bar bracket with two parallel mounting feet, each pierced by two holes, joined by a raised offset bridge; add shallow embossed stiffening ribs along the bridge and a single locating tab with a slot on one foot.

family_scale1__Z_00437_1.part_family: flat profiled pendant tag with eyelet
family_scale1__Z_00437_1.desc: A flat profiled tag with a rounded rectangular body and a raised eyelet boss set at one corner with one through bore. Opposite the eyelet is a short longitudinal strap slot, the outer corners are filleted, and one face carries a shallow embossed perimeter border instead of a thick ring.

family_pilot__Z_00058_0.part_family: flat-bar lever with transverse round handle
family_pilot__Z_00058_0.desc: A straight solid rectangular lever carries one short cylindrical cross pin through a single transverse hole near an end, forming a T-handle. The pin protrudes on both sides and is fixed with a small collar or local weld at the joint; edges are mostly square, with no shell, ribs, pattern, or generous fillets, only a shallow raised witness along the bar.

family_scale1__Z_00546_0.desc: A slim, straight prismatic metal rail of constant thin-rectangular cross-section, made as a multi-cell extrusion cut to length; internal webs separate four longitudinal through-bores running end to end. The broad faces carry a dense regular grid of small drilled holes repeated along the length, every hole mouth is chamfered with two chamfer classes, and the outer long corners are lightly radiused, with no bosses, ribs or threads.

family_scale1__Z_00349_2.desc: A near-semicircular variant built as two concentric curved rails joined by radial webs, giving an open ladder-like sector instead of a solid strip. Teeth are cut only on the inner rail, the outer rail is plain with three equispaced counterbored mounting holes plus one locating dowel boss, and the tooth pattern alternates long and short teeth with a single central keyway slot.

family_scale1__Z_00745_0.desc: Model it as one constant-thickness flat bar that stays in a single plane: a uniform-width strip makes an open zigzag with a long diagonal middle run and short terminal legs on opposite sides. Give square-cut ends, sharp corner geometry with only small edge breaks, and no holes, slots, ribs, bosses, or repeated patterns.

family_scale1__Z_00344_0.desc: A single uniform thin plate whose outer plan is a rounded-corner triangle, made as one flat sheet rather than an assembly. Two through openings pierce the face: a large central rounded-corner window and a smaller rounded triangular hole offset toward one vertex. A narrow recessed band tracks the outer perimeter, a dense row of identical small perforations runs along one edge and shows on the adjacent edge face, and all outer corners are filleted, with no ribs, bosses, or formed bends.

family_scale1__Z_00507_1.desc: Stepped internal-spline adapter with a larger flanged end carrying six axial clearance holes and a smaller pilot spigot at the opposite end. The bore has spline teeth over only part of its length, plus a snap-ring groove and a straight keyway, with generous fillets blending the flange into the barrel.

family_scale1__Z_00759_0.part_family: short molded optical light-guide rod (light pipe)
family_scale1__Z_00759_0.desc: A slender clear light-guide rod of nearly constant thin rectangular section with rounded long edges and capsule-like end transitions; both ends are closed by groups of polished planar facets set at large obtuse angles to the rod axis so the entering beam is redirected through a steep bend, while a fine contrasting core line runs the full mid-length. There are no holes, slots or bosses—only the monolithic molded body, optically polished bevel faces and small edge fillets with mold draft.

family_scale1__Z_00127_2.desc: A short, deeper channel bracket of the same family used web-down as a mounting face: two countersunk holes sit near mid-length while each flange is pierced by a pair of cross-holes for through-fasteners. One end is closed by a folded tab with one hole, the opposite end is miter-notched, and the bend corners are small fillets rather than sharp creases.

family_scale1__Z_00212_0.desc: Thin-wall molded rectangular pan with a low outer shell, a stepped top lip and an integral orthogonal eggcrate of vertical ribs that splits the interior into a regular five-by-five field of open square wells standing on a shared floor plate. Each well floor is pierced by one centered circular through-hole, giving twenty-five total; rib toes, rib-to-wall junctions and the lip corners use small molded fillets, with the outer shell otherwise smooth.

family_scale1__Z_00526_1.desc: Half-ring curved rack of the same stepped L-section but with the tooth row moved to the convex outer edge; the web carries a regular angular pattern of countersunk mounting holes separated by obround lightening slots. Both radial ends are closed by integral stop lugs and every tooth root is filleted.

family_scale1__Z_00502_1.part_family: thin flat annular ring with knurled inner bore
family_scale1__Z_00502_1.desc: An open split retaining ring of the same thin-ring family with a single radial gap and two small lug ears at the ends, each ear pierced by one round tool hole. One face is chamfered, the outer edge is smooth, and the bore carries three separated knurled pads instead of a continuous texture.

family_scale1__Z_00775_1.desc: A two-dimensional blanked sheet decoration built as a four-point star rather than sixfold: four broad tapered arms at right angles each carry a single pair of short barbs and meet at a center pierced by a square through-hole. Two small round hanging holes sit on opposite arms, all corners are micro-radiused, and the gauge is uniform with a straight unformed edge.

family_pilot__Z_00102_1.desc: An open three-quarter circular clamp band in the same thin-gauge stock uses rounded flared lug ends rather than square tips, and each lug carries one round bolt hole. Instead of a full perforation row, only three elongated clearance slots are grouped near mid-arc, and one shallow continuous emboss rib along the band centerline stiffens the curved shell.

family_pilot__Z_00119_0.desc: A thin flat spring strip of uniform rectangular section runs as a long plain shank, is dogleg-offset in its own plane, then ends in a tightly rolled curled eye whose bore receives a pin. All bends are generously radiused, and the opposite mounting end is slit lengthwise into a few short parallel contact fingers.

family_scale1__Z_00696_1.desc: Straight single-row terminal/module housing: a uniform-height row of identical open-top cavities held between two end walls, each cavity with the same front latch window and rear wire-entry slot. The thin outer shell uses evenly spaced separator ribs, a continuous base rail, a small integral boss in every other cavity, and a mounting ear with a through hole at each end.

family_scale1__Z_00459_1.desc: Asymmetric extruded aluminum track with a single deep T-slot channel on the top face and a broad flat mounting flange along the bottom. The flange carries a row of countersunk through holes plus one slotted adjustment hole, the channel floor is smooth rather than serrated, one end is closed by an integral stop boss, and a transverse reinforcing rib bridges the web near the opposite end.

family_scale1__Z_00478_0.desc: Monolithic constant-thickness star knob with a compact central hub pierced by a clean square through-bore and blended into six evenly spaced radial grip lobes. The lobe roots are heavily filleted into the flat web, the broad faces remain smooth, and the outer lobe crowns carry a fine straight knurl/serrated grip pattern.

family_pilot__Z_00066_2.desc: A flat emblem plate shaped as a block letter "R" with straight vertical and diagonal strokes, one enclosed rounded counter opening, and a small ball-shaped relief boss raised on the face at the junction of the strokes. Thin ribbed fins wrap only the outer curved edge of the bowl, the remaining edges are plain, and the flat back face includes shallow counterbored pockets for rear fasteners.

family_scale1__Z_00369_1.desc: A flat four-arm bearing spider with a square central pad and four identical round seats on a square pattern bolt circle. Straight tapered spokes join the pad to four outer collars, each spoke is pierced by a long lightening slot, and the perimeter is a rounded square rim with small corner fillets and no scalloped edge.

family_scale1__Z_00538_0.part_family: spur gear with integral central hub
family_scale1__Z_00538_0.desc: A solid external spur gear: a thin cylindrical disc carries straight teeth around its entire outer rim and shares its axis with a stepped hub. A taller cylindrical boss projects from one face with a reduced spigot at its free end, while a short collar and smaller stub project from the opposite face; a plain round through bore passes coaxially through the whole stack.

family_scale1__Z_00688_2.part_family: open cubic structural frame node / six-face connector hub
family_scale1__Z_00688_2.desc: A heavier closed-shell hub variant cast as a thin-wall cube with six stiffened faces; two opposite faces carry a large central bore while the other faces use an eight-hole pattern around a raised pilot. A cruciform internal rib set and external mounting feet reinforce the walls, with larger rounds on the feet and smaller edge breaks elsewhere.

family_scale1__Z_00674_0.desc: Flat rectangular molded frame panel with a continuous perimeter wall, one central vertical web, and evenly spaced horizontal webs forming two columns of seven identical rectangular through-slots; outer corners are rounded, all internal web junctions carry small fillets, and the thin constant-thickness walls show a slight raised edge on one face.

family_scale1__Z_00037_1.desc: A spur rack variant made as a solid rectangular bar rather than a T-section, with straight teeth cut across the full top width so the crest lines run perpendicular to the length. A row of evenly spaced counterbored through holes sits on the neutral axis for mounting, all outer edges get a small chamfer, and one end face includes a single locating dowel hole.

family_scale1__Z_00694_0.desc: Flat elongated rectangular carrier plate with a raised perimeter rim and an open lattice of ribs forming regular pockets across one face, backed by a thin skin stiffened with many closely spaced parallel fins. Four round corner eyelets, a pair at each short end, are fused into the rim with small fillets, each pierced by a through hole and a hex across-flats feature, while the rim and boss roots carry several small oblong through-slots.

family_scale1__Z_00198_2.desc: Compact corner variant with one deep vertical web, three unequal triangular gussets, and an enclosed toe on the base; it mixes a four-hole tapped pattern in the web, two large base clearance slots, a keyway, and one raised cylindrical boss, with rounded fillets instead of chamfers on the outer edges.

family_pilot__Z_00038_2.desc: A narrow bent sheet-metal clip formed by three parallel folds into a U-shaped channel with two legs and a closed back. Both legs share a pair of matching circular pin holes, one leg is extended and relieved by a single rectangular slot, and the back is doubled over with a flattened hem seam.

family_scale1__Z_00103_1.part_family: flat sunburst rotor plate with central bore
family_scale1__Z_00103_1.desc: An eight-point indexing star wheel of the same plate family: a uniform-thickness disc with eight identical tapered teeth around a central hub, the teeth asymmetric with one steep driving flank and one shallow return flank for one-way ratcheting. The hub is a raised cylindrical boss thicker than the toothed rim and carries a smooth through bore plus a single keyway and two opposing set-screw flats. Crescent lightening pockets sit in the web between the boss and the tooth roots, and the outer tooth tips are slightly rounded rather than needle-sharp.

family_scale1__Z_00494_2.desc: Another variant: an eight-finger radial spider/fan made as a flat spring plate, using paired narrow spokes that merge into a reinforced ring around a splined boss. It mixes two long slotted blades for flexure with shorter stiff blades, includes several lightening holes, and uses generous root radii rather than sharp intersections.

family_scale1__Z_00719_2.part_family: thin toothed wheel on a spindle
family_scale1__Z_00719_2.desc: A moulded same-family timing wheel has a thicker rim with angled external teeth, an annular recessed front face, and three oval windows through the web. The centre is a hexagonal driving boss with a cross-hole for a retaining pin instead of a plain through shaft.

family_pilot__Z_00107_0.desc: A constant-thickness flat lever plate with one enlarged circular annular eye blended tangentially into a single narrow straight shank; the eye has a central through bore with a threefold equally spaced index pattern at the hub, plain side faces, no ribs, and a smooth filleted transition into the shank.

family_scale1__Z_00671_1.part_family: thin molded faceplate for a handheld keypad device
family_scale1__Z_00671_1.desc: A handset-style front cover of the same family, built as a shallow dished panel rather than a flat plate. It has one large through-cut display opening with a stepped bezel, a horizontal earpiece slot group at the top, and a smaller keypad field of widely spaced oblong key openings plus a central circular navigation cutout; the backside carries short perimeter snap ribs and two locating bosses.

family_pilot__Z_00091_2.part_family: openwork flat cut-plate star wheel / sheet-metal flange
family_pilot__Z_00091_2.desc: Another member of the family: an openwork wheel-blank stamped from one sheet with eight spokes, a shallow dimpled boss drawn around the center, and a hex broach through the hub instead of a keyed round bore. Wide U-shaped radial openings separate the spokes, while a partially continuous scalloped outer band keeps the rim closed between every other tip.

family_scale1__Z_00197_2.desc: A flanged timing sprocket formed as a wide fine-toothed rim with an integral tapered lock boss on one side and a small retaining flange on the other. The web is pocketed rather than fully slotted, the bore is keywayed, and a ring of tapped holes sits on a bolt circle for a locking element instead of plain through-holes.

family_scale1__Z_00060_0.desc: One-piece injection-molded impeller built from a thin circular backplate with a central raised hub and short lower annular skirt. Several slender spokes tie the hub to an inner support ring, while eight evenly spaced forward-curved paddle blades stand on the backplate around the rim; each blade is a thin open shell closed by a rounded outer cap, with a repeated small fillet at every root and edge transition and a clear through bore at the hub.

family_scale1__Z_00420_2.desc: A narrow capsule-shaped escutcheon formed as a raised rim around one through window rather than a blind pocket. The back carries a sparse lattice of stiffening ribs and two locating posts, and the front has a stepped lip with a short row of vent slots toward one end.

family_scale1__Z_00118_1.desc: Different member: a six-point star washer plate from the same flat pierced family, using a round center bore, a closed outer ring, and alternating teardrop lightening slots with small rectangular windows. Two opposite points extend into mounting ears with slotted holes, while all transitions stay filleted and the part remains a single sheet-thickness blank.

family_scale1__Z_00062_1.desc: An inline two-lobe plate of the same family having a large bearing bore at each end and a smaller pilot bore midway between them; the figure-eight rim is tangent to the two outer rings, the connecting web carries one obround lightening slot plus a short row of small drilled holes, and the long edges are relieved by shallow scallops rather than triangular windows.

family_scale1__Z_00747_0.desc: Long straight open-ended sleeve with a constant oblong rectangular cross-section and uniform very thin walls. The outside has four small rounded corners while the inner bore has four sharper rounded corners, forming a continuous through passage; there are no side holes, slots, ribs or bosses along the length.

family_scale1__Z_00436_1.desc: A shorter stamped spring strip with a widened flat mounting pad at one end pierced by two round holes, stepping down to a narrow neck that terminates in a single open C-hook (no closed eye). A shallow pressed stiffening rib runs across the neck just below the hook bend, and the hook tip is chamfered.

family_scale1__Z_00791_0.part_family: coaxial cluster spur gear with integral pinion
family_scale1__Z_00791_0.desc: Monolithic stepped spur-gear cluster: a large toothed gear wheel is sandwiched coaxially between a longer smaller pinion on one face and a short plain cylindrical boss on the other, all sharing one central through bore. Both the large wheel and the pinion carry external teeth around their full circumference; the big gear is a solid flat web with no lightening holes, and the hub transitions are plain turned shoulders with small fillets.

family_scale1__Z_00329_0.part_family: small single-column pedestal stand with splayed foot base
family_scale1__Z_00329_0.desc: Low ribbed pedestal stand: a thin square top plate is carried on one central rectangular post, with a cross of flat ribs beneath the plate and triangular gussets bracing the post up into the top. The post terminates in an X-shaped base of four splayed feet, each a flat rectangular pad tied back to the post by triangular web ribs; exposed edges are chamfered and the part reads as joined thin-wall construction rather than a solid.

family_scale1__Z_00356_0.desc: A thin round base flange carries a stepped, taller central cylindrical hub with a through bore; an outer annular rim is tied back to the hub by a ring of radial web ribs that leave open sector pockets, while three small upright cylindrical bosses stand at uneven angular stations. The face is patterned with several drilled holes on concentric bolt circles, a few rectangular blind pockets, and small rectangular slots around the outer rim; one edge zone is shaped as an across-flats wrenching feature, and all rib roots and step transitions are lightly filleted.

family_scale1__Z_00592_0.desc: A one-piece insulating connector body joins a tall open rectangular shroud to a lower contact base. The shroud is a thin-walled frame with a rounded-arch inner window and two corner fillets, forming a polarizing guide for a mating blade; the base carries a dense regular field of through holes in several diameters plus a uniform-pitch row of vertical contact pins, with small alignment and countersunk features on the mating face and a thin locating tongue stepping into a wider contact block in profile.

family_scale1__Z_00059_2.part_family: thin circular honeycomb grille/vent cover plate
family_scale1__Z_00059_2.desc: Square low-profile speaker cover with gently rounded corners, an embossed center panel pierced by many small round holes between two decorative grooves, and a solid perimeter ledge. The back face carries four threaded stud bosses near the corners and a continuous gasket groove in the rim.

family_scale1__Z_00026_0.part_family: thin molded rectangular electronics cover plate
family_scale1__Z_00026_0.desc: Low-profile rectangular molded plate with a continuous raised perimeter rim and four corner mounting bosses carrying counterbored through holes. The face has a central raised rectangular frame around a stepped square recess, several cylindrical standoffs (some through-bored, some blind), small locating holes, and narrow rectangular latch slots in the side walls; edges are largely flat with numerous fine chamfers and a couple of larger lead-in chamfers.

family_scale1__Z_00214_1.desc: A narrow single-row enclosure tray with one long central channel flanked by two unequal end wells, all enclosed by one continuous thin outer wall rather than a bolted flange. Fastening is by threaded bosses rising from the inside corners, a slotted cable cutout pierces one end wall, a snap ledge runs around the rim, and short ribs bridge the channel for stiffness.

family_scale1__Z_00724_0.desc: A thin flat outer rim is joined to a small central hub by crossing curved spokes, leaving large symmetric windows between the spokes. Twelve evenly spaced through holes sit on the rim bolt circle, with small raised pads at the holes and blended fillets where the spokes meet the hub and rim.

family_scale1__Z_00195_0.desc: A flat injection-moulded wheel in which a stiff outer rim ring is joined to a central hex-bore drive hub by four straight radial spokes arranged as a cross. The rim inner edge is scalloped into repeating large arcs with many small fillets, four small rectangular ears project radially outward, and in section the rim forms a shallow double-flanged channel with thin radial ribbing between hub and rim.

family_scale1__Z_00130_0.desc: One solid rectangular brass bar with flat front and back faces and a narrow uniform thickness; two corners are softly radiused and the other two are chamfered, with small stepped end tabs. A straight column of nine identical hexagonal socket recesses runs along one edge as clamping-screw stations matched by tiny through holes, while the open face carries a mixed field of five oblong slots in a row, two counterbored holes, and a few plain round clearance holes of differing sizes.

family_scale1__Z_00643_2.desc: A long rail-like member of the same family is an extruded rectangular bar with fins across the top face only, produced by many even-depth open slots and broken into segments by a few shallow transverse cuts for crossflow. Underneath runs a continuous keyed channel that slides over a board edge connector, with counterbored holes along the centerline and plain through holes at both squared, chamfered ends; there is no corner flange.

family_scale1__Z_00743_2.desc: A heavier ring-gear insert with a stepped bore: the internal teeth run only part of the axial width and open into a larger counterbore on the back face, while the outer rim is pierced by six equidistant radial oil holes and one axial dowel slot, and a shallow annular groove on the front face forms a seal seat.

family_scale1__Z_00420_0.desc: A monolithic shallow obround trim plate with a continuous outer side wall closed around a blind recessed floor; straight runs blend into semicircular ends, and the inner recess is offset to leave a uniform peripheral rim. The shell has filleted wall-to-floor transitions and no holes, slots, ribs, or bosses.

family_pilot__Z_00007_1.desc: Variant with a taller finned tube using fewer, deeper radial fins and two separate cooling zones interrupted by a plain collar. One end has a rectangular flange with slotted mounts and a side sensor boss; the other end is a short male coupling with an O-ring groove, cross-drilled lock holes, and a smooth internal flow bore.

family_scale1__Z_00643_0.desc: A tall machined metal body of rounded-rectangular cross section sits on a short flanged skirt with generous corner radii. A centered rectangular passage runs through the body, six through-bolt holes ring the cavity near the corners, and small edge fillets finish the hole entries. Dense vertical cooling fins are formed on the side faces by many narrow open slots, with the slots on the broader faces cut deeper than those on the narrower faces so fin height differs around the perimeter.

family_scale1__Z_00248_0.desc: This part is a symmetric stamped-and-bent sheet metal clip formed from a single flat strip. The strip rises from each end through a pair of open U-shaped hooks into a tall central M-shaped spring section topped by two short upright prongs; all transitions are generous bend radii and the strip edges carry small chamfers. A countersunk through hole at the center of the strip provides the mounting point.

family_pilot__Z_00117_1.desc: A same-family tag could use an oval pad with two small side ears and one central mounting hole; its handle leaves along the long axis, carries a rounded tip, and ends in a keyhole slot for hanging.

family_scale1__Z_00212_2.desc: Deep funnel-well variant: an open-top square box whose tall tapered cross-ribs form a four-by-four set of inverted-pyramid wells converging into small ports in a thick base rather than a flat pierced floor. Those ports feed a common shallow perimeter sump cast beneath the wells; the outside has vertical stiffening ribs on two opposing walls, a rolled top bead, integral corner stacking feet and a molded snap-latch ledge along one side.

family_scale1__Z_00341_1.desc: A same-family grille with a coarser lattice: fewer and larger square cells set within a heavier perimeter frame, interrupted by an off-centre solid island. Corner mounting holes pass through the skin, several oblong slots break one edge row, and all ribs keep a uniform modest height with moulding draft.

family_scale1__Z_00011_0.desc: One thin constant-thickness metal strip forms an elongated pointer. The heel is rolled into a closed circular eye that serves as the pivot bore, with a short counterbalance tail leading to a small transverse rectangular hub collar swaged across the strip; two short across-flats crimped zones sit at the eye side and at the collar. From the collar a long straight flat blade runs to a symmetric faceted spear tip made by opposing shallow chamfers that meet in a fine point, with several tiny edge-breaking radii along the point edges and no other holes or ribs.

family_scale1__Z_00310_1.desc: A deeper U-channel mounting rail of similar thin-gauge construction, but with outward flanged feet that are the only drilled faces: an even single row of round fixing holes on each foot, two elongated end-adjustment slots in the deep web, an embossed grounding boss near mid-span, notched open ends and generally larger corner radii, with no cross piercings.

family_scale1__Z_00311_0.desc: A constant-thickness machined star plate has a central boss with a large through bore and a hexagonal web ring; six radial spokes join the ring to six outer ear blocks, with scalloped filleted cutouts between spokes. The hub carries a patterned set of small through and blind holes around the bore, while the ear blocks and side faces include through holes, narrow oriented slots, edge notches, radiused recesses and lightening openings.

family_scale1__Z_00210_0.part_family: thin flat rectangular windowed spacer frame
family_scale1__Z_00210_0.desc: A thin, constant-thickness elongated rectangular frame whose long top and bottom rails are tied by short end rails and a single central cross-rib, creating two side-by-side rounded-rectangular through windows. The window corners use a generous uniform fillet while the outer perimeter corners are sharper, and small end bosses with a narrow edge section stiffen the thin rails.

family_scale1__Z_00509_0.desc: A thin rectangular front plate is set into a shallow U-channel perimeter frame with small folded end flanges, forming one thin shell-like cover. The front face carries a regular three-by-eleven array of identical round recessed bores, and the back side has a narrow central recess bounded by the side walls.

family_scale1__Z_00508_2.desc: A comb-style grille insert has a rectangular outer rim with many closely spaced transverse ribs between solid end blocks, plus a few round drain holes and one taller locating tab projecting from an end rail.

family_scale1__Z_00429_0.part_family: slender thin-gauge metal reed/probe with formed end(s)
family_scale1__Z_00429_0.desc: One long, essentially straight thin-walled rectangular hollow section of uniform wall; a short length at one end is flattened into a thin solid tang that continues past the bore and is set at a slight single angle to the main axis, while the opposite end remains the open rectangular mouth. No through-holes, ribs, or bosses; external corners are crisp and the only cavity is the small rectangular bore visible at the open end.

family_scale1__Z_00255_2.desc: Another same-family plate is a flat breadboard-style adapter with a dense rectangular array of plain through holes, periodic counterbored fastener holes, two central obround cable slots, paired dowel holes near opposite corners, and small raised bosses around the primary mounts on the underside.

family_scale1__Z_00278_1.desc: A shorter, symmetric version of the same flat link family with a large through pivot bore at each rounded end and only one interior bay between them. That bay is lightened by an X-brace: two diagonal through-cut triangles meeting at a small central circular hole for a pin or tie, framed by slightly wider edge rails adjacent to the bores. Constant plate thickness throughout with small fillets on all external and internal corners, no formed features or raised pads.

family_scale1__Z_00687_2.desc: A one-piece toothed flange hub whose outer rim carries molded gear teeth while the web is thinned and stiffened by short radial ribs. It uses blind tapped holes on two concentric bolt circles instead of through holes, includes a recessed locating counterbore on the back face, a cross-drilled set-screw hole into the keyed bore, and a snap-ring groove near the rim.

family_scale1__Z_00647_0.desc: One long uniform-thickness flat blade with a wide butt end carrying two through pin holes in small raised round bosses with filleted edges; a shallow embossed chevron-and-falcon emblem panel sits mid-face, the spine end has a hooked guard notch and a rectangular tab, and the opposite end tapers to an acute point, with a curled multi-radius scroll formed at the butt.

family_scale1__Z_00659_2.part_family: extruded personalized word fob (script name plate)
family_scale1__Z_00659_2.desc: A non-cursive variant with individual raised sans-serif characters seated on a separate rounded-corner backplate; the plate is a thin shell with an embossed perimeter rib, the letters are discrete bosses evenly spaced on a shallow pedestal strip, one end carries a keyhole-style lanyard slot and the back face holds a single shallow counterbored recess.

family_scale1__Z_00278_0.desc: A single constant-thickness plate with an obround outline: two semicircular end caps blended into parallel straight edge rails. One rounded end carries a single large through pivot bore, while the bay between the rails is cut through with an alternating row of triangular and small quadrilateral lightening openings that leave a Warren-truss web of diagonal struts; the opposite end is left as a solid rounded pad. All outer corners and every cutout corner are softened with small uniform fillets, and there are no bosses, counterbores, threads, bends, or raised ribs—just a clean machined skeletonized plate.

family_pilot__Z_00005_0.desc: A thin, flat, single-thickness plate with four identical arms radiating at right angles from a round central hub. The hub carries one smooth cylindrical through-hole and is framed by four small scalloped lobes; each arm narrows to a waisted neck and ends in a closed hexagonal ring. All outer and inner edges are broken with the same small radius, so the part reads as one continuous rounded-edge shell rather than an assembly.

family_pilot__Z_00079_2.desc: A short three-lobe asymmetric profile with unequal radial webs, a keyed central bore, two opposed full-length bolt holes and one service slot. Outer fins are sparse and stepped, with generous root fillets and small gusset ribs tying the lobes to the core.

family_scale1__Z_00089_2.desc: Narrow elongated connector plate with a single row of fine contact slots flanked by two raised guide rails and no full perimeter rim; one end carries a spring latch tab and a keying cutout, the opposite end has clearance slots, and several larger rectangular tooling openings plus underside standoff bosses replace the dense second bank.

family_scale1__Z_00613_2.desc: D-shaped backing plate: one straight edge opposite a bowed edge, a central oblong through-slot with a short keyway notch instead of a round port, fixing holes only along the two long edges, and a few oval lightening cutouts in between. Same single-thickness construction with rounded external corners and no formed or raised features.

family_scale1__Z_00652_1.desc: A shorter Z-folded sheet-metal clip rail with an offset web and two opposed flanges. The wide web has two parallel rows of plain round holes interrupted by an obround adjustment slot near each end, plus a single embossed stiffening bead down the middle; both flanges are plain with simple bend radii.

family_scale1__Z_00518_1.part_family: thin-walled molded plastic bezel / instrument tray
family_scale1__Z_00518_1.desc: Elongated rounded-rectangle enclosure bezel formed as a thin shell with a raised sealing lip; it has one large circular boss near one end, a row of three square through-openings for switches, four corner mounting posts with counterbores, and a sparse cross-rib pattern on the back face for stiffness.

family_scale1__Z_00427_0.desc: A quarter-arc track segment made from a thin, uniform-thickness curved strip, with several concentric through-slots running the full arc length and opening at both square-cut end faces; small holes and edge notches near the ends serve as fastening features, and the inner and outer faces are smooth concentric radii.

family_scale1__Z_00175_0.desc: Thin flat rectangular grille panel with four clipped corners. A continuous outer border frames an orthogonal lattice of uniform narrow ribs forming many rectangular through-slots, with the edge slots slightly narrower than the interior square cells. The panel has constant wall thickness, a shallow stepped perimeter, and small chamfers on the outside edge.

family_scale1__Z_00127_0.desc: A straight, slender rail formed from thin sheet into a constant open U-profile with a flat web and two full-length flanges joined by sharp bends. Two small round through-holes are punched in the web close to one end and spaced along the rail; the opposite end carries a small formed end notch, with no ribs, bosses, or slots elsewhere.

family_scale1__Z_00705_0.desc: A straight slender rail cut from thin flat stock: one long edge carries a regular comb of short, evenly pitched slots grouped toward both ends, while the cross-section is a low open channel with a central rectangular recess between two side walls, stepped outer shoulders and small hooked lips; all transverse edges are broken with many small chamfers plus two larger corner chamfers.

family_pilot__Z_00096_0.part_family: slender rectangular hollow-section tube (straight RHS post/spacer)
family_pilot__Z_00096_0.desc: One straight extruded thin-wall rectangular tube with a constant hollow rectangular core, four flat outer walls, sharp longitudinal corner edges, and open square-cut ends. It has no holes, slots, ribs, bosses, fillets, or tapers; the wall and corner lines run straight and parallel for the full length.

family_scale1__Z_00259_0.desc: A single monolithic flat rectangular plate of uniform thickness with four rounded outer corners and small chamfers on the edge arrises. The working face carries a regular ten-by-seven matrix of identical plain cylindrical through holes on an even rectangular pitch, leaving a solid solid perimeter rim all around; there are no bosses, ribs or counterbores.

family_scale1__Z_00273_2.part_family: stamped and bent strip-metal hook / flat spring latch
family_scale1__Z_00273_2.desc: A wider latch strip with a row of three evenly spaced through-holes along the shank, a spring finger slit and bent up out of the strip plane near the middle, and two opposing side notches for snap retention. One tip terminates in a single large-radius hooked tang, the rear edge is left square and unchamfered, and small raised dimples sit beside two of the holes instead of a swaged collar.

family_scale1__Z_00577_0.desc: Low-profile injection-molded open chassis strip: a thin longitudinal spine ties two edge rails to a dense mounting-ear cluster at one end and a rounded rectangular loop at the other. The web is mostly open with scalloped cutouts, cross ribs and gussets; small through-holes form patterned groups around chamfered or countersunk bosses, while several raised posts and standoffs of mixed heights carry additional holes. Edges use generous fillets/radii and chamfered lead-ins rather than sharp corners.

family_scale1__Z_00676_1.part_family: long drilled-perforated flat bar / multi-hole mounting strip
family_scale1__Z_00676_1.desc: A flat perforated strap punched from thin sheet, similar in spirit but built around a single centered row of larger round holes along its full length. Each end carries a keyhole (round-plus-slot) feature for a fastener, and the short ends are semicircular rather than square; edges are sheared and deburred with no other machining.

family_scale1__Z_00182_1.part_family: pierced and formed sheet-metal rosette ornament
family_scale1__Z_00182_1.desc: Same family but an eight-lobed, gently domed rosette: rounded overlapping petals are drawn upward around a raised central boss instead of a spike, the boss carrying a small cluster of tapped holes plus one keyway for mounting. Piercing is limited to two concentric rings of round and teardrop holes, the outer edge is turned into a continuous fastening flange, and shallow embossed ribs run from the boss into each petal for stiffness.

family_scale1__Z_00010_0.part_family: ribbed thin rectangular bezel panel with recessed windows
family_scale1__Z_00010_0.desc: This part is a thin rectangular base skin carrying a raised perimeter rim and one central cross rib, together dividing the face into four equal rectangular recessed windows in a two-by-two grid. Short edge rails stiffen the border, small corner reliefs and repeated matching internal fillets break every pocket, and one long edge carries a small clearance notch with a shallow stepped edge detail.

family_scale1__Z_00560_0.desc: Thin circular grille bezel with an annular outer rim and a shallow stepped rear shell. The face is openwork: concentric arc ribs joined by radial spokes around a central boss, leaving sector-shaped vents; the hub has a through bore with a large rear counterbore, and the rim carries several small mounting ears plus a few tiny pin holes with rounded fillets throughout.

family_scale1__Z_00213_1.part_family: tri-lobed hand spinner body with recessed bearing pockets
family_scale1__Z_00213_1.desc: Four-arm spinner body in a cruciform layout: four teardrop bearing cups sit at the cardinal points and are carried on straight tapered spokes from a larger central finger-bearing boss. The spokes include longitudinal lightening slots, small counterbored tie holes near the hub, and short gusset ribs at each spoke root, with a continuous raised lip around each cup and generous fillets throughout.

family_pilot__Z_00083_1.part_family: pigeonhole shelving frame of thin panels
family_pilot__Z_00083_1.desc: Tall single-column shelf carcass of the same thin-panel family: two full-height side panels are tied by a fixed top, bottom and mid shelves, with further shelves adjustable on rows of pin holes. One side carries hinge bosses and a latch tab for a door, a shallow toe recess is cut at the base, no internal vertical dividers are used, and a separate thin back panel closes the rear.

family_scale1__Z_00069_2.desc: A thin circular perforated plate with concentric rings of through holes surrounding a central raised boss. Three equally spaced rim tabs carry clearance holes for fasteners, the back face has shallow lightening pockets between rings, and the hole field mixes plain through holes with a few countersunk positions for screwed connections.

family_scale1__Z_00571_1.desc: An elongated studded rail of the same family: a single row of top studs sits on a narrow rectangular spine, with two counterbored mounting holes through the end lugs and one wide longitudinal slot replacing the individual vertical bores. Shallow ribs run along the underside between the stud bays, the stud rims carry a small top recess, and all outer corners are chamfered.

family_scale1__Z_00201_0.desc: Monolithic thin-wall molded frame: a low rectangular base channel surrounds a large central opening and carries taller end and side rails with filleted corners; five small rectangular teeth and matching edge slots run along one rail, short ribs line the opposite inner edge, a raised obround latch boss sits inside, and four external ear bosses with through holes are stiffened by small gussets.

family_scale1__Z_00112_2.desc: A shallow cap-like variant that swaps the fine crown serrations for broad castellated lugs and slots around the open rim; the closed end is gently domed with a central raised boss pierced by one cross hole, two slotted ears serve as a clip interface, and short internal ribs gusset the boss back to the thin shell.

family_scale1__Z_00447_1.part_family: shallow rectangular sheet cover panel with edge flange
family_scale1__Z_00447_1.desc: Pressed shallow rectangular tray with a continuous turned-up rim on all four sides, small corner radii, one corner drain notch, and a single central stiffening bead across the floor. Two mounting holes sit along one rim and the opposite rim is rolled into a smooth grip edge.

family_scale1__Z_00568_2.part_family: long dual-row edge-card / mezzanine connector with combed contact field
family_scale1__Z_00568_2.desc: Closed-shroud press-fit receptacle: an enclosed five-sided insulator carries two slightly staggered contact rows with compliant eye-of-needle tails instead of solder surface; both ends grow molded alignment funnels and guide posts, one long side has a spring detent, the shroud wall is pierced by a short run of square inspection windows, and selected cavities receive removable keying plugs while the internal comb uses wider barred ribs at the ends and finer ribs in the middle.

family_scale1__Z_00695_0.desc: Shallow open-top molded tray with a flat rectangular deck and a perimeter wall that is tall at the rear and ramps down to a thin sloped leading edge at the front, giving a wedge side profile. The deck is penetrated by a dense field of short narrow through-slots arranged in two column banks separated by a central longitudinal rib, with extra small slot groups near the side walls; the underside carries shallow stiffening ribs and small pads, and the outer edges have small corner fillets.

family_scale1__Z_00606_1.desc: Alternative: stamped pump/fan impeller with a solid back disk and partial front shroud ring, joined by eight backward-curved blades and rivets. It adds a raised hub with a keyed bore, set-screw flat, lightening slots in the back disk, and generous root radii.

family_scale1__Z_00118_0.desc: A constant-thickness flat plate is cut as one radial rosette: a small annular center with a single through bore joins eight narrow arms into a scalloped outer rim. The arms are separated by rounded U-shaped slots, the rim repeats small rectangular tabs and notches with four larger rounded features and sixteen smaller rounds, and there are no raised bosses, ribs, or formed flanges.

family_scale1__Z_00402_1.part_family: curved solid guide-rail segment (arcuate rectangular block)
family_scale1__Z_00402_1.desc: A shorter arc block in the same family with the same swept rectangular section, but with two counterbored through-holes on the top face along the centerline for fasteners and a shallow rectangular pocket milled into the underside between them for weight relief. The radial end faces carry small chamfers, and one end adds a single locating dowel hole.

family_scale1__Z_00296_2.desc: Same family in an L-shaped bracket form: one upright leg is densely slotted with vertical rounded-end fins grouped into three unequal banks by two thicker webs, while the perpendicular mounting foot carries three clearance holes and a small locating boss. Two triangular gusset ribs join the legs at the bend line, the outer corners are chamfered, and the slot field is omitted near the bend to keep a solid fillet region.

family_scale1__Z_00492_0.desc: A thin flat circular carrier disk with one central through bore and six larger through bores equally spaced on a common bolt circle around it. Each outer bore is surrounded by a raised annular collar, and curved radial spokes with an open lattice join the collars to a reinforced central hub and a thin outer rim, leaving triangular lightening pockets in between. The plate is essentially constant thickness with machined hole rims and small fillets where the ribs meet the bosses.

family_scale1__Z_00068_0.desc: A circular injection-moulded spoked wheel built from a central cylindrical hub with a through bore, joined by several straight radial spokes to a concentric outer rim, leaving open sector windows between the spokes. The outer rim carries a dense skirt of short vertical ribs around its circumference and is tied to a thin larger-diameter base flange at the bottom; all hub, spoke, rim and flange junctions are softly filleted.

family_scale1__Z_00329_2.part_family: small single-column pedestal stand with splayed foot base
family_scale1__Z_00329_2.desc: Low wide pedestal riser of bent sheet construction: a rectangular top panel with a down-turned perimeter lip sits on four short corner legs tied by an underframe cross, over a flat rectangular floor plate with slotted mounting holes. Stiffening comes from hemmed edges and pressed darts instead of a center tube, with gusset plates only at two opposite corners.

family_scale1__Z_00131_2.desc: Eight-bore variant in which the even pattern alternates one plain through-hole and one blind threaded boss, all tied to a scalloped outer edge rather than a smooth rim. One face carries a shallow recess between the center hub and the bores, elongated radial lightening slots sit between alternate holes, and the perimeter uses a fine castellated wrenching edge instead of separate lugs.

family_scale1__Z_00039_0.part_family: ribbed plastic linear guide rail with integral end mounting brackets
family_scale1__Z_00039_0.desc: A long, slender molded rail of constant rectangular hollow cross-section with a closed square bore, one thin internal webbed wall, four filleted outer corners, and a dense repeated pattern of small through-holes running along its length; a transverse reinforcing bridge interrupts the span at mid-length, and both ends terminate in raised solid end blocks with rectangular loop openings and chamfered upper edges that act as mounting brackets.

family_pilot__Z_00064_2.desc: A shallow bezel member of the family: a flat rectangular frame with a large central window and no skirt, edged by a continuous mating lip on one face; one edge carries a row of cantilever spring fingers and a single obround contact slot, while the inner face is studded with circular boss towers, some plain and some cored for inserts, plus two molded locating pins; fixing is through opposing side flanges with slotted holes, with generous fillets, ejector-witness pads and small lightening pockets in the corners.

family_scale1__Z_00233_2.desc: A stamped sheet-metal variant: a rounded-rectangle retaining band with a hemmed outer edge and inward spring tabs. Three pierced slots run along each long side, one central locating notch interrupts an end rail, corner embosses replace countersunk holes, and a symmetric set of coined dimples adds stiffness.

family_scale1__Z_00526_2.desc: Short quadrant segment using a T-shaped radial section, a central rib flanked by flanges on both sides, carrying a finer higher-count tooth row along its lower concave edge and a continuous V-guide groove along the top for a mating roller. Three molded bosses with through bores stand proud of the back face for fastening, with blend radii on all tooth roots.

family_scale1__Z_00302_2.desc: Compact right-angle member of the family in which a single horizontal foot with two elongated mounting slots supports one rounded-top vertical ear braced by a triangular rear rib. The ear is drilled with a two-by-three grid of plain through holes without counterbores, a single lightening window is cut in the rib, external edges are chamfered, and two small tapped boss pads sit on the foot for accessories.

family_scale1__Z_00728_2.part_family: stamped lanced sheet-metal encoder tone ring
family_scale1__Z_00728_2.desc: A press-fit reluctor variant that is lightly dished for stiffness with a short rolled axial flange at the outer rim; the sensing features are punched external castellations flared outward on a uniform pitch around the full circumference except for one double-width keying gap. The bore has a small keyway, a bolt circle of round fixing holes and an embossed alignment dimple lie inside the rim, and tooth roots are coined with alternating full- and half-width teeth to give a coarse/fine quadrature pattern.

family_scale1__Z_00133_1.part_family: flat profile-cut plate with a toothed dorsal edge
family_scale1__Z_00133_1.desc: A constant-wall profile plate cut as a seated cat side-silhouette resting on two doubled paw pads; the face, chest and belly edges are smooth while the spine is shaped into a coarser row of widely spaced scallops rather than teeth. Two countersunk mounting holes pierce the chest and rump and a short keyhole slot opens at the tail root, with all exterior corners generously filleted and no added ribs or bosses.

family_scale1__Z_00258_1.desc: A photo-etched flat spring of the same class but with a circular closed anchor ring, an S-shaped serpentine neck for added compliance, and a short terminal comb carrying a few wide tines with full-radius tips. The outer edge carries a shallow stiffening fold, and a single small tooling hole sits beside the ring.

family_scale1__Z_00670_1.desc: Straight ladder-style variant of the same family: two parallel flat side rails are tied by evenly spaced cross rungs and a continuous top flange rather than an A-frame apex. One rail carries eight rectangular clip slots and the other is left plain, the end flanges are pierced with clearance holes, and small triangular gussets reinforce the rung joints.

family_scale1__Z_00537_1.desc: A hollow rectangular box extrusion with T-slots on all four outer faces and two internal webs that tie opposite walls together. One face carries a row of countersunk mounting holes along the slot, both ends have tapped holes in the corners, and the inner walls use generous fillets where they meet the outer skin.

family_scale1__Z_00410_2.desc: Symmetric scissor-link plate built as two parallel thin straps sharing common end eyes, each strap pierced by elongated slots and several round lightening holes; the pivot eyes have raised annular bushing bosses on both faces, and the small fastener holes are laid out as two mirrored pairs rather than a single scattered set.

family_scale1__Z_00129_1.part_family: hubbed toothed drive sprocket / timing pulley
family_scale1__Z_00129_1.desc: Double-strand sibling: two parallel toothed rings separated by a plain relief groove sit on one wide centered hub, giving a symmetric front-to-back outline instead of an offset one. The through-bore is keyed, the hub carries a pair of radial set-screw holes, and a ring of circular lightening holes pierces the web; all tooth tips are chamfered on both edges and the strand divider groove is filleted at its roots.

family_scale1__Z_00049_1.desc: Wider hat-section sheet-metal vent cover with a flat crown pierced by two parallel banks of obround slots and downturned side flanges left plain except for round mounting holes. Both long edges are closed hems for stiffness, the bend corners are generously radiused, and there is no end foot.

family_pilot__Z_00034_2.desc: Six-pad ring spacer plate with circular lobes around an open center; alternating pads carry counterbored holes, two opposed pads include radial slots, and short gusset-like thickenings appear only in the connecting webs.

family_pilot__Z_00052_0.desc: A single constant-thickness metal strip is straight in plan and formed across its narrow width as a shallow circular-arch shell for the full length. It has plain cut ends, two long side edges, and no holes, slots, ribs, bosses, or patterned features; only small edge breaks are implied.

family_scale1__Z_00409_2.part_family: cut length of thin-wall square hollow tube
family_scale1__Z_00409_2.desc: A long square-tube strut that is straight-cut at one end and angle-cut at the other to mate with an inclined bracket. Along one face it has a single longitudinal adjustment slot, while the two adjacent faces carry a repeating pattern of small round fixing holes; the interior stays an unobstructed thin-wall bore open through both ends.

family_scale1__Z_00622_1.part_family: thin-walled trihedral box corner with a concave three-way cove (inside cube corner)
family_scale1__Z_00622_1.desc: Closed rectangular enclosure shell of the same thin-panel family: a base plus two adjacent side walls meet in a coved inside corner, but the blend is a single-axis cylindrical fillet run along just one edge rather than a three-way patch. The open rim is flanged outward with a row of mounting holes, the exterior carries several pressed stiffening ribs and one small round locating boss, and the corner opposite the cove is left square with a drainage notch.

family_scale1__Z_00379_2.desc: Offset tubular link made from the same hollow round stock: a short inlet leg, two opposing right-angle bends, and a longer outlet leg that is parallel but displaced. The ends are plain, while the middle straight section has a flattened mounting pad with one through hole.

family_scale1__Z_00458_2.desc: An eight-point indexing star plate with alternating long and short rounded teeth carried on a thin web. Scalloped lightening pockets are cut between the teeth, the through bore is flanked by two dowel holes, and the outer tooth tips are chamfered rather than fully radiused.

family_scale1__Z_00531_2.desc: A coiled spiral spring pin built as a thin hollow cylinder wrapped a little over two turns, giving several helical edge lines and a self-closing seam rather than one straight slot. It has chamfered entry at both ends, a slightly reduced nose for starting the bore, and one small radial lock-wire hole near the head end; there are no grooves, threads, ribs, or external bosses.

family_scale1__Z_00001_0.part_family: castellated cylindrical bezel with coaxial sleeve
family_scale1__Z_00001_0.desc: One concentric machined part: a wide flat face ring carries thirty equally spaced chamfered rectangular castellations around its outer edge, while a short cylindrical skirt drops from the ring into an open underside pocket and ends in a reduced lower seat. A straight coaxial through-bore runs the full height, so the toothed rim, skirt walls and lower collar all share one centreline.

family_scale1__Z_00323_0.part_family: curved plastic emblem nameplate with raised lettering
family_scale1__Z_00323_0.desc: Thin gently arched badge plate with the raised word UPTAKE spanning the front face as integral drafted characters. The base is a shallow shell with small through-holes beside the lettering, short rear mounting studs and locating posts, and small fillets at the stud roots and letter bases.

family_scale1__Z_00398_1.part_family: round-bar spacer with axial bores and a longitudinal milled flat
family_scale1__Z_00398_1.desc: A longer wrenching spacer of constant round outside diameter with two opposed longitudinal flats for gripping. It carries one large central axial through-bore flanked by several smaller satellite bores on a common pitch circle, every hole lightly chamfered at both faces; the body remains a single turned-and-milled piece with no external ribs.

family_scale1__Z_00182_2.part_family: pierced and formed sheet-metal rosette ornament
family_scale1__Z_00182_2.desc: A fully flat, unformed twelve-point star plate of the same pierced-sheet family used as a grille/spacer: one large central round bore, a single radial locating tab and matching notch on the outside, alternating long obround slots and round lightening holes between the points, short pressed stiffening beads on the spokes, and several countersunk mounting holes near the rim; no petals are bent and the part stays in one plane.

family_scale1__Z_00304_1.desc: A narrower spring-connector variant of the same folded-chevron family: two flat end lugs carry oblong slots rather than a diamond flange, joined by a longer accordion web of more numerous shallow V-folds. A small central boss and staggered lightening cutouts sit between bends, with no separate top plate.

family_scale1__Z_00476_1.part_family: arcuate molded grille/bezel segment with windows
family_scale1__Z_00476_1.desc: Annular-sector grille strip subtending a wider sweep, fitted with many closely spaced narrow louver slots instead of a few large windows; the slots sit flush with the convex face and are divided by thin radial webs. Integral mounting lugs with round holes project from both ends, a single cylindrical locating boss stands on the concave side near mid-arc, and the inner edge is a smooth continuous flange with no notches.

family_scale1__Z_00585_2.part_family: T-slot structural aluminium extrusion cut to length
family_scale1__Z_00585_2.desc: Asymmetric slotted rail extrusion with several parallel T-grooves across one wide face only, a closed slightly crowned back face, one offset longitudinal service bore beneath the grooves, and flanged lip edges on the long sides in place of side slots; cut to length with a drilled and tapped connector pattern at one end and edge radii rather than chamfers throughout.

family_scale1__Z_00464_2.desc: A lighter perforated rectangular tube in which the openings are punched obround slots rather than round holes: two staggered rows of slots run along one broad face with a mirrored single row on the opposite broad face. The narrow faces stay plain, one end is square and open, and the other end is closed by an integral pressed cap pierced by a small center hole.

family_scale1__Z_00431_0.desc: One-piece thin plate whose outline is a large round lobe at one end blending through two straight tangent sides into a small rounded nose; the nose carries a single small through hole. The face has a shallow coined recess or border groove following just inside the perimeter, a slightly reinforced land around the nose hole, and uniform sheet thickness elsewhere, with the lobe-to-arm transitions generously filleted and no slots or ribs.

family_scale1__Z_00563_2.part_family: slender precision-punched metal mounting strip / perforated rail
family_scale1__Z_00563_2.desc: A same-family rail formed as a shallow folded channel: a punched web with a regular hole pattern, short turned-up side flanges carrying a few oval slots, hemmed outer edges for stiffness, and small end tabs with single round fixing holes instead of a dense end pattern.

family_scale1__Z_00439_2.desc: A shallow Z-shaped folded strip stamped from thin sheet, using two bends to offset one end flange from the opposite mounting flange; it adds a single central emboss, two pierced tabs, and one notched end for location.

family_scale1__Z_00695_1.desc: A flat rectangular vent-grille insert of the same family with a uniform low bezel on all sides and straight, non-sloped edges. One repeated pattern of long parallel slots spans the deck in a single zone with no central divider, the corners each take a round mounting hole, the long sides add snap-fit tabs, and the back face uses a grid of ribs for stiffness with a smooth top and rounded outer corners.

family_scale1__Z_00272_0.part_family: stamped spring clip with slotted collar
family_scale1__Z_00272_0.desc: Make this as one thin spring-metal stamping: a small rolled cylindrical collar/crown carries many axial fingers separated by round-ended slots and a short locking tab, while the flat blank fans out from the collar into unequal radial tongues, two long tapered straps and one broad triangular web ending at a pierced lug. Keep all features continuous with formed bend radii and slot-root reliefs rather than separate bosses.

family_scale1__Z_00399_1.part_family: slender bent sheet-metal retaining channel/edge rail
family_scale1__Z_00399_1.desc: Straight spring clip-strip of the same family but with a symmetric U-channel cross-section, the web pierced by a single row of evenly spaced rectangular slots and one pressed detent dimple near mid-length. Each end is flared into opposed fish-mouth spring tabs, all edges hemmed for stiffness and safety.

family_scale1__Z_00246_0.desc: A thin flat plate with a stepped, nearly rectangular outline and generous edge fillets carries a row of three large circular through-holes, one elongated rectangular slot, and a single tiny pin hole in the web. Small rounded lugs project from both long edges, each lug pierced with a mounting hole, while low formed saddles and lanced stiffening details rise from the sheet and every internal corner is radiused.

family_scale1__Z_00812_1.desc: A spring-steel flat link of the same pierced-strip family but with an open forked clevis at one end instead of a closed eye; its straight backbone carries a single line of round perforations between two pressed stiffening ribs. The far end is a solid rectangular pad with twin mounting holes, a small locating dimple, and a simple bent lug rather than stacked leaves.

family_scale1__Z_00011_2.desc: A fork-tipped flat spring pointer of uniform sheet thickness with an oblong slotted mounting eye at the base for positional adjustment.
