A pair of opposed side notches midway along the shank accepts a retaining clip, one embossed longitudinal stiffening rib runs down the centre and stops before the head, and the distal end splits into two close parallel tines whose outer edges are chamfered to twin fine points.

family_scale1__Z_00023_2.desc: A wider asymmetric variant pairs a tall hinge barrel with a broad triangular gusset on one side and a two-hole mounting ear on the opposite end. The flat leg carries only a few elongated adjustment slots near the barrel plus larger counterbored holes toward the ear, and a rolled stiffening bead runs along the free edge instead of dense slot patterning.

family_scale1__Z_00342_2.part_family: bent sheet-metal angle bracket with machined mounting lugs
family_scale1__Z_00342_2.desc: Open-top U-channel bracket bent from one blank, with a base web and two upright side walls that each terminate in a rounded lug carrying one pivot bore and a square pattern of four tapped holes. The base provides one obround cable slot, two countersunk mounting holes, and three small alignment holes on a common bolt circle, while triangular gusset ribs are formed at the wall-to-base bends to resist racking.

family_pilot__Z_00118_2.desc: A compact two-bay fan adapter: narrower plate with only two large triangular cutouts, threaded corner bosses instead of rails, one slotted adjustable hole row along an edge, snap-fit tabs on the short sides, and a deeper surrounding flange.

family_scale1__Z_00800_0.desc: A slim flat plate of uniform sheet thickness with a wide rectangular head at one end, a stepped shoulder that narrows into a long straight shank, and a J-curved hook catch at the far end with a small angled latch tab beside the throat. The head carries a large rounded nose corner, the shank edges show several small rounded edge breaks, and all bends are gentle so the strip acts as a flexing spring latch.

family_scale1__Z_00664_2.part_family: trussed open frame of thin punched rails
family_scale1__Z_00664_2.desc: Shallow wall-mount pivot frame of similar thin punched construction: a rectangular back frame has hinge barrels along one edge and a latch boss on the opposite edge. Internal horizontal rails use slotted mounting holes, several stamped ribs stiffen the thin panel zones, and the rear is left open for cable entry.

family_scale1__Z_00185_1.desc: A circular variant of the same panel family would be a thin lightened bulkhead plate with a rolled or raised outer edge, a central boss with a bore, and a ring of kidney-shaped pockets separated by radial ribs. A larger set of perimeter through-holes would mount it to a flange, while all pocket mouths stay filleted and the back face remains one smooth sheet.

family_scale1__Z_00240_0.part_family: flat multi-pocket bearing cage / retainer ring
family_scale1__Z_00240_0.desc: A thin constant-thickness annular carrier whose outer edge is a cluster of identical overlapping circular lobes fused around a central hub, giving a flower-like silhouette. It has a central through bore, a set of large round rolling-element pockets evenly spaced on one pitch circle, additional through holes on the same bolt circle, stepped recessed seats in thickness, and a small uniform chamfer breaking all outer and pocket edges.

family_scale1__Z_00650_0.desc: A flat uniform-thickness plate whose plan outline is a single closed composite of tangent circular arcs, forming an asymmetric teardrop: a full rounded lower lobe sweeping up into a pinched neck and ending in a sharp multi-corner cusp at the top. One closed teardrop through-cutout sits inside, offset toward the neck, leaving a thick lower web and a narrow bridge near the cusp. All outer and inner edges are smooth cut faces with generous fillet radii except for several intended sharp zero-radius corners at the cusp; there are no bosses, ribs, or secondary holes.

family_scale1__Z_00673_1.desc: A short, heavy equal-leg angle bracket cut from thick plate rather than formed thin stock. One vertical leg has two countersunk bolt holes, the horizontal leg has a single large central opening flanked by two round holes, and a small triangular gusset is welded into the inside corner at mid-length to stiffen the joint.

family_scale1__Z_00114_1.part_family: open skeletal frame junction node (rounded hollow cube block)
family_scale1__Z_00114_1.desc: A three-way corner hub for square-tube framing: a compact rounded cube with three mutually perpendicular open socket mouths, internal triangular gusset ribs stiffening each inside corner, a blind threaded boss on the top face, and cross-bolt holes passing through two opposing faces. The exterior is fully radiused and the lowest edges carry small drainage notches.

family_scale1__Z_00574_1.desc: Similar flat profiled tool plate but laid out as an open-jaw wrench: a straight center bar has two different-sized open hex notches along one edge and a smooth D-shaped finger loop at one end. The opposite end terminates in a single fixed hook, the body uses three short lightening slots instead of one long slot, and the grip zone carries a stamped dimple pattern rather than a toothed sector; there is no pivot pin.

family_scale1__Z_00552_1.desc: A shorter housing of the same rounded-strip family but with a single recessed face containing two large round through-holes flanking one wide keying slot, plus only two staggered rows of small pin apertures. The top boss is omitted in favor of a side latch ramp, the underside is closed by a thin cover with two internal stiffening ribs, and mounting is by four corner ears rather than end tabs.

family_scale1__Z_00810_1.desc: A similar formed strap uses an offset S layout: a half-round saddle at one end transitions into a flat mounting tab at the other. The tab carries two round holes and one oblong slot, while the saddle has a shallow embossed center rib and small stamped locating dimples.

family_pilot__Z_00036_1.desc: A shorter member of the family is a closed-back socket rail: two parallel side walls are tied by end bridges and a central keying web, with paired blind cavities and spring tongues in the channel. It uses four board-lock posts and an offset polarizing boss, with coarser grouped ribs and larger end radii.

family_scale1__Z_00105_0.part_family: machined round flanged housing and end-cap adapters
family_scale1__Z_00105_0.desc: A monolithic turned cylindrical end cap with a thick round shell, stepped outside diameter, shallow top counterbore, central through bore, and an internal annular groove near the rim. The lower skirt is chamfered into a smaller diameter, a short coaxial outlet boss projects from the underside, and the top face carries eight equally spaced through holes on one bolt circle.

family_scale1__Z_00123_1.desc: A flat lightened handwheel variant with a keyed central bore and a ring of circular lightening holes rather than hexagons, joined by broad curved spokes to a smooth plain outer rim. One face has a raised hub boss with a cross-drilled set-screw hole, and the back face is recessed around the rim.

family_scale1__Z_00271_1.desc: Asymmetric flat forked retainer with one broad solid finger and one narrow slotted finger extending from a three-hole ear. An embossed stiffening bead runs along the spine, and the base mixes one keyhole slot, two plain round holes, a lanced locating tab, and fully radiused outside corners.

family_pilot__Z_00076_0.desc: This part is a long, low, uniform-thickness sheet-metal frame: two edge rails are tied into a ladder-like spine by repeated transverse webs, forming open rectangular bays. A regular pattern of round holes, short rectangular slots, and three small square slots runs along the spine, while stepped notches, short end lugs, and shallow bent returns provide location and stiffness; corners are sharp-bent with only small relief fillets.

family_scale1__Z_00465_0.part_family: perforated slotted miniature metal rail strip
family_scale1__Z_00465_0.desc: A long straight strip of constant narrow cross-section with softly radiused corners, formed with two full-length parallel slots that leave twin side webs tied by an inner web. Two straight columns of small through-holes run the length at close, slightly uneven pitch, the punched edges are broken by tiny fillets, and both ends are cut square.

family_scale1__Z_00330_0.desc: Thin constant-thickness plate cut to a symmetric bat-like outline: a narrow central body with two upright ear tabs and a small center notch is flanked by left and right wing webs. Each wing has a convex outer edge, concave scalloped trailing cutouts and a pointed lower tip; the contour is through-cut in one plane with straight edge walls and small filleted transitions, with no formed bends or raised bosses.

family_scale1__Z_00617_0.desc: A long, low rectangular shell of thin formed sheet metal with rounded outer corners and a stepped side wall, split along its length into two equal bays. Both short ends are packed with many stamped thin fins seen edge-on, giving scalloped vertical borders: a row of small half-rounds along the top flange, several larger scallops down each side, a few medium rounds low down, and a dense field of tiny edge fillets. Dark clamping straps bridge the fin packs, a flat base ties the bays together, and fixing is by a small group of through-holes plus a separate pair, with two generous internal corner radii and a pair of sharp internal corners.

family_scale1__Z_00552_0.desc: A long, low-profile molded plastic strip with a rounded-rectangle outer wall, a shallow open underside channel, small end tabs, and one small rectangular boss on the top edge. The broad face is divided into two recessed bays: the left bay has three short horizontal slots over a dense grid of small round through-holes arranged in four rows of five, while the right bay carries three square slots and three larger round through-holes. The panel edges and ends are heavily filleted, with a raised peripheral lip and several mixed corner radii.

family_scale1__Z_00375_2.desc: A shallow dished member of the same family: the spoke and slot pattern is pressed slightly out of plane so the outer rolled rim sits offset from the hub. It uses alternating long and short radial slots, a central bore with a single keyway, a circumferential row of small round perforations just inside the rim, and no peripheral teeth, with generous fillets at the hub transition and crisp edges elsewhere.

family_scale1__Z_00568_1.part_family: long dual-row edge-card / mezzanine connector with combed contact field
family_scale1__Z_00568_1.desc: Right-angle surface-mount mate: the same slim backbone and twin contact rows, but the tails dog-leg out through the belly for reflow while stamped metal hold-down claws sit at both ends; a centered polarization key runs inside the slot, the separator ribs are taller and scalloped with funneled lead-ins, a flat pick-and-place cap lands on top, and a few round locating pegs and a side latch boss project from the lower face.

family_pilot__Z_00068_2.part_family: bent spring-steel strip clip with rolled clamping eyes and punched features
family_pilot__Z_00068_2.desc: A variant retaining clip made from the same kind of punched spring strip but bent into an open U rather than an arch: both legs end in small rolled eyes, a stamped round boss is coined into the base of the U as a locating dimple, and a row of round holes replaces the rectangular slots. One outer leg has one lanced barb near its tip so the clip can be pushed into a panel slot and lock by spring-back, with generous fillets at every bend to protect the spring strip.

family_scale1__Z_00122_1.part_family: bent sheet-metal spring strip with serrated edge
family_scale1__Z_00122_1.desc: Straight unbent flat spring strip of the same thin section, with matching semicircular teeth cut along both long edges so the serrations oppose each other. A central elongated mounting slot is flanked by two round through holes, and both ends are cropped square with small corner breaks rather than formed tabs.

family_scale1__Z_00786_1.part_family: thin multi-rail ladder guide frame with end plates
family_scale1__Z_00786_1.desc: A similar family part formed as a single folded sheet-metal carrier in which the two end uprights and two rails are one bent channel and the remaining rail is resistance-welded across. The uprights use keyhole slots and dimpled stiffening ribs instead of projecting lugs, only the entry rail ends are chamfered, and the cross holes are gathered on one outer upright rather than on a rail.

family_scale1__Z_00202_0.desc: A low rectangular molded carrier made from a thin flat base panel with integral raised edge rails and cross-ribs on one face. The ribs create repeated rectangular and triangular lightening pockets, tie into small posts and bosses, and are filleted into the panel; fastening is by assorted through holes with local chamfered or countersunk mounting points and narrow rib slots.

family_scale1__Z_00000_2.desc: Narrow two-row strip variant intended as an inline separator, with one long edge carrying alternating hinge knuckles and a single latch loop while the opposite edge is scalloped between apertures. The aperture set mixes plain through-holes with a few counterbored seats and several blind cups, and alternating rings are raised to different heights to add out-of-plane stiffness.

family_scale1__Z_00134_2.desc: Rectangular snap-in version: a low-profile four-sided trim frame with a wide central window and the bead/roller cord pressed into a groove on three sides only, the fourth side replaced by an integral latching spring tab. The back of the web carries shallow stiffening ribs and a pair of small boss posts, while the two closed corners blend the rollers into molded corner radiuses.

family_scale1__Z_00720_2.desc: Larger square multi-cell framing extrusion whose internal ribs divide the section into four longitudinal chambers; every face has a pair of panel slots, the corners carry small mounting holes, and a row of evenly spaced counterbored holes is drilled across one web with the tube ends reamed for fasteners.

family_scale1__Z_00140_0.desc: A thin square peripheral frame carries an integral orthogonal eggcrate of narrow intersecting ribs, forming a regular field of open square cells; the ribs and rim are one molded shell with small filleted junctions and slightly reinforced crossings.

family_scale1__Z_00312_0.desc: Thin flat plate cut to a symmetric four-arm cross profile with radiused arm tips, the arms merging into a raised central hub. The hub carries a central through bore, ringed by four small countersunk holes on an inner bolt circle, while each arm end carries a larger counterbored through hole on an outer bolt circle; smooth fillets blend the arms into the hub.

family_pilot__Z_00098_0.desc: Single flat strip of uniform width and gauge, press-brake folded along several crease lines that run straight across the band. A long central leg is joined through two angled bends to an inclined top tab, while the lower end is folded out into a short foot whose tip is turned down as a small end flange; no holes, slots, ribs or bosses, with inside bend radii and crisp outside corners.

family_scale1__Z_00238_0.desc: A thin-walled shallow rectangular tray with a flat floor surrounded by a low continuous perimeter rim on all four sides and small radii at the outer corners. The floor is pierced by a regular grid of equal square through-slots arranged in several rows, with the slot count differing between certain rows, and local fillets dress the slot and rim junctions; wall and floor thickness are essentially uniform.

family_scale1__Z_00154_2.part_family: spinner-style multi-arm plate with hex nut-capture bosses
family_scale1__Z_00154_2.desc: A star-shaped six-arm variant: six short tapered arms surround a central boss with a keyed through-bore, with raised hexagonal captive-nut sockets on three alternating arm tips while the remaining tips carry plain round lightening holes. The plate thickness is uniform between the bosses, and the back face has a recessed pocket around the hub to save weight.

family_scale1__Z_00535_2.part_family: four-channel T-slot structural extrusion cut to length
family_scale1__Z_00535_2.desc: A heavier closed-box member of the same T-slot framing family: a wide rectangular extrusion with slots on three faces, an offset central bore, and a fourth face closed by a solid wall carrying an integral side flange with two connector holes. Internal diagonal braces tie the slot lips back to the core, and both ends are machined with a small pattern of tapped fastener holes.

family_scale1__Z_00490_1.part_family: inverted-U support frame of thin flat bar
family_scale1__Z_00490_1.desc: Same-family variant as a low carry handle: two short upright legs rise from flared feet to a gently curved top grip instead of a straight rail, with generous fillets at both bends rather than block corners. Add one central hanging hole in the grip, two elongated lightening slots in each leg, and a small locating tab projecting from each foot.

family_scale1__Z_00281_1.part_family: flat rectangular open-grid tube frame panel
family_scale1__Z_00281_1.desc: A ladder-style variant of the same family: two parallel side rails tied together only by evenly spaced transverse rungs, leaving long open slots and no intermediate longitudinal member. Each rung end is filleted into the rail, and a pair of small mounting tabs with through holes projects from one long edge.

family_scale1__Z_00582_1.part_family: flat profile-cut miniature rifle replica plate
family_scale1__Z_00582_1.desc: Same flat-profile replica idea arranged as a bolt-action precision rifle, with a much longer plain barrel, a skeletonized buttstock opened by several triangular lightening cutouts, and a smooth scope rail that has only two ring notches instead of a full cross-slot track. The fore-end uses a few long oval cooling slots rather than round holes, adds a small bipod lug near the muzzle, and finishes with a single lanyard hole through the butt.

family_scale1__Z_00087_1.desc: Different variant: a symmetric four-arm star mount in thin plate, with a central counterbored bearing seat, four equal radial arms ending in single tapped boss pads, and a square bolt pattern around the hub. Lightening teardrop pockets sit between the arms, the back face is pocketed to leave a shallow ribbed shell, and every arm root uses a large blend radius.

family_scale1__Z_00322_2.desc: A radial finned cooling-sleeve extrusion built around one central through-bore, with many straight outer fins over most of the length and plain clamping lands left at both ends; a pair of opposed side ears break through the fin outer diameter, each with tapped holes and a small dowel boss, and the bore adds an internal keyway with a chamfered entry.

family_scale1__Z_00456_2.desc: An oblong perforated strainer panel split into two screen zones by a central solid rib, each zone using a radial fan of small holes rather than a rectangular grid. It has a rolled perimeter edge instead of a raised rim, countersunk corner holes for flat-head fasteners, and one small central boss that doubles as a handle and stiffener.

family_scale1__Z_00690_2.desc: Flat four-way cross node: a square central boss sprouts four coplanar extrusion arms as two opposite pairs, acting as an in-plane intersection rather than a corner. The top face carries a dense threaded-hole grid and two dowel bosses for a deck panel, the arms use keyslot grooves instead of cross holes, and the bottom of the hub is pocketed with radial ribs to save weight.

family_scale1__Z_00258_2.desc: A wider planar flexure built around a central spine that throws mirror-image combs of short fingers from both side edges, ending in an oblong slotted mounting tab pierced by two holes. The spine uses staged reduced-width hinge necks and a row of small square perforations, with plain filleted corners throughout.

family_pilot__Z_00092_2.desc: Scalloped-rim internal ring gear plate with fewer, coarser teeth, three coined radial stiffening ribs on one face, and elongated alignment slots through the web. Lead-in chamfers suit a mating pinion, and the opposite face remains flat for stacking.

family_scale1__Z_00153_0.part_family: ribbed molded enclosure cover with hinge lug
family_scale1__Z_00153_0.desc: Shallow rectangular molded shell built as a raised outer rim framing a recessed central panel, with rounded outer corners, a flat mounting face, and a regular row of short internal ribs along the rim. One short edge carries a transverse hinge barrel formed as paired rounded cheeks with a pin bore, plus a small through-boss on the adjacent deck, while the opposite side has a single fastener hole; walls blend into the rim with smooth fillets.

family_scale1__Z_00423_1.part_family: right-angle flat-strap crank link with a bored eye hub
family_scale1__Z_00423_1.desc: Straight in-line version of the same flat-strap link family: one obround constant-thickness connecting bar with a semicircular lug and transverse bore at each end (two eyes total), a plain parallel shank between them, an elongated lightening slot centered in the shank, and small chamfers on all outer edges. No perpendicular leg and no corner hub.

family_scale1__Z_00785_1.desc: A uniform-thickness flat plate whose outline is a soft-cornered square rather than triangular; four identical teardrop windows form a four-fold rosette around a small solid central disc, and the narrow bridges between windows each carry one clearance hole in line. The perimeter is smooth with no edge notching, two opposite sides have oblong mounting slots, every interior corner is broken with a small fillet, and the whole part is a flat laser-cut pattern with through features only.

family_scale1__Z_00055_1.desc: A slim single-line rack in which a straight spine carries six identical open square bays all projecting to the same side, each bay having a closed back, a chamfered lead-in and a molded retention dimple. Pierced mounting ears stand off both ends, and small triangular gussets tie the bays to the spine instead of a full perimeter flange.

family_scale1__Z_00504_1.desc: Straight cut-to-length member of the same extrusion family: an opposed-hook channel with matching serrated grip faces on both sidewalls, a pair of through holes near each end, and dense cooling fins on the outer web only. Fin roots are filleted, the end faces are square cut, and one sidewall is left smooth and unnotched for flat mounting.

family_pilot__Z_00023_1.desc: Two-lobe bar-style spinner plate of uniform thickness: a central finger-bearing hub with one large ring boss at each opposite end, giving a smooth dumbbell outline. Replace the scalloped rims with fine straight knurling around the two end rings, add shallow counterbores on both faces of each large bore, and put one small radial set-screw hole into each ring to retain the inserted bearings.

family_scale1__Z_00789_2.part_family: lightweight toothed rail with trussed web bracket
family_scale1__Z_00789_2.desc: A twin-web variant in which two parallel thin webs hang from a top toothed bar and are tied by evenly spaced transverse ribs, leaving a repeating row of closed rectangular windows between ribs. The lower edges join a continuous narrow sole bar interrupted midway by a cylindrical clamping boss; fastening uses a symmetric pattern of countersunk through-holes in the sole and a keyway slot in the boss, with the tooth track relieved at both ends.

family_scale1__Z_00365_0.desc: A thin, flat machined plate whose working end is three fused annular lobes in a straight row; each lobe is a coaxial stepped bore with a through hole and a larger shallow counterbore from one face, producing annular seats, and the lobe outer walls blend together with generous fillets. The opposite face carries a dense transverse band of short parallel ribs between solid edge rails, while separate plain through holes at the ends provide fastening.

family_scale1__Z_00615_1.desc: A similar flat star/index plate with six evenly spaced arms around a small central through bore. Alternate roots use deep and shallow notches, two opposite arms carry elongated mounting slots, and the remaining outer corners use a mixed chamfer-and-fillet edge treatment while staying a constant-thickness cut profile.

family_scale1__Z_00211_0.desc: A uniform-thickness flat plate with a triangular three-lobed outline: a top apex tab and two lower side flanges tied together by a webbed center. It has four circular through bores, three equally spaced on a common bolt circle around a central bore, plus small edge notches and rectangular connector-like cutouts between lobes; all external corners and plate edges are broken with small rounds.

family_pilot__Z_00044_1.desc: A flat profiled mounting plate in an open L layout: a broad horizontal base flange meets a taller vertical ear through a large outside radius. The base carries a row of round through holes plus one long obround adjustment slot, the ear carries a single keyhole slot near its tip and two small semicircular edge notches, and the perimeter mixes generous fillets on the inner corner with chamfers on the exposed outer corners.

family_scale1__Z_00192_2.desc: A stepped fluted collar with a narrow upper locating sleeve and a broad lower paddle ring; alternating tall and short radial paddles rise from the ring, while the through bore has a single keyway and opposing small set-screw bosses, and the underside is pocketed for weight reduction.

family_scale1__Z_00284_0.desc: A shallow open-top rectangular shell molded in one piece, with a thin base, perimeter wall and small corner fillets. A transverse inner wall forms one large side compartment, while the other side is split by parallel ribs into five long slot openings, with an end rail carrying six small round holes and a narrow auxiliary pocket.

family_scale1__Z_00596_2.desc: A curved heat sink built on a thick arc-shaped backbone with concentric arcuate fins rising from its convex side, spaced wider near the ends and densely packed at mid-arc with scalloped tips. The concave mounting face carries three cast bosses, one blind and two threaded, and two through slots pierce the backbone for airflow; fin roots are generously radiused.

family_scale1__Z_00654_1.part_family: flat machined annular spacer ring with a pointed star outer edge
family_scale1__Z_00654_1.desc: A flat annular spacer ring of constant thickness with a smooth circular outer edge instead of points. It has a central through-bore with a shallow counterbore on one face, an evenly spaced bolt circle of plain through-holes around the bore, one radial keyway slot cut from the bore into the ring, and a small uniform chamfer on both faces of the outer rim and bore.

family_scale1__Z_00773_2.desc: An elongated ladder-style lattice strip with two edge rails tied by frequent square cross-nodes; alternating pads are solid or carry hexagonal clearance holes, short diagonal ribs triangulate every other bay, and one end finishes in forked mounting ears while the opposite end is a closed rectangular tab.

family_scale1__Z_00135_1.desc: Flat connecting plate of the same thin machined family but using round through bores only: a large pivot bore at one end and a smaller pin bore at the other, with two closed lightening slots between them and a shallow raised pad around the large bore. The outline keeps radiused ends, while the long edges carry a single continuous chamfer on one face and a filleted edge on the opposite face.

family_pilot__Z_00043_1.desc: A same-family lanyard medallion plate with a teardrop outer profile and no window: two small round through-holes at the top for a ring, one centered blind recess on the front for an insert, and three short ribs on the back around a low circular boss. All edges are rounded, with the back otherwise flat.

family_scale1__Z_00519_1.desc: A boxier sliding-track extrusion built as a rectangular tube with an open top channel: two facing C-slots run the full length to capture rollers or bolts, three square internal cells add stiffness, and a pair of star screw bosses sit in opposite corners for end-plate fasteners. One side is extended into a flat mounting flange with elongated fixing holes, while a thin snap groove along the opposite edge takes a clip-on cover; wall junctions use small fillets and the outer faces are plain.

family_scale1__Z_00760_1.part_family: thin radial rosette plate with looped petals
family_scale1__Z_00760_1.desc: Six-spoke spider plate of the same sheet family: a raised hexagonal hub with a keyed through-bore carries six tapered straight spokes out to a segmented outer rim. The sectors between adjacent spokes are open, the hub face holds a small equally spaced bolt-hole circle, and every spoke root and rim break is filleted while thickness stays constant.

family_pilot__Z_00107_2.desc: Similar family part: a flat three-spoke crank plate with a central splined hub boss and three small clevis ears radiating outward; each ear carries a through pin hole, one ear is made adjustable with a short radial slot, and a stamped reinforcing rib runs along one spoke.

family_scale1__Z_00183_2.desc: Snap-in variant made as a low three-sided retainer frame, open on one short side for slide-over assembly. Its inner seating lip is interrupted by evenly spaced rectangular relief slots, and the back face carries several integral spring clips plus two locating pins.

family_scale1__Z_00593_2.desc: Right-angle hooded member of the family: the cavity field faces horizontally out of a short shrouded plug nose, while the body lies flat on the panel and rises into a rear cable hood with a half-round strain-relief mouth. Spring latches sit on both flanks, one triangular polarizing key projects from the mating face, mounting uses two metal solder-tail hold-downs plus panel holes, and the interior uses a stepped partition plate instead of stacked ledges.

family_scale1__Z_00141_1.desc: A wider pressed-metal grille panel in the same family uses several parallel columns of short punched louvers separated by solid lands, with a formed perimeter flange on all sides and corner mounting holes; the louvers are grouped in two banks with a central stiffening rib.

family_scale1__Z_00596_0.desc: An elongated cooling body on a thin swept base whose section is airfoil-like: a rounded thick leading edge tapering to a sharp trailing edge. Two finned zones stand on the base and are joined by a narrow central bridge, one zone densely packed with parallel transverse plate fins and the other more coarsely ribbed, with fin heights following the curved top so the stack steps down toward the tail. Two small integral upright lugs are pierced with through holes near the thick edge, and external corners carry light chamfers.

family_pilot__Z_00069_2.part_family: ribbed plastic enclosure half with molded honeycomb grille
family_pilot__Z_00069_2.desc: Shallow enclosure base shell in the same family, kept mostly flat with a low drafted wall around the edge. A segmented honeycomb vent band occupies only one end portion of the floor, the rest being a solid mounting plate with four corner standoffs; snap tabs are molded along two opposite side walls and a cable entry slot is cut through one end wall.

family_scale1__Z_00653_1.desc: A rectangular version of the same lattice family uses a thicker perimeter rim and a coarser 4x6 set of deep square wells whose walls are all one uniform height; the base of selected wells is pierced with round through-holes for fasteners and drainage, and the four corners carry blind mounting bosses with generous fillets.

family_scale1__Z_00293_0.desc: One-piece thin-wall molding with four open cylindrical barrels standing in a straight row on a shared rectangular base channel, the barrel heights stepping upward from one end to the other. Each barrel carries several evenly spaced circumferential ribs and a beaded lip at the mouth, and inside the base every barrel drains through an inverted conical seat. Two short serrated outlet studs project from the underside between the middle barrels, each with a cross-drive recess, and the row ends are closed by rounded caps.

family_scale1__Z_00706_2.desc: Stepped thin-wall stiffened panel formed as two rectangular fields offset by a molded jog; the larger field is a smooth skin with one row of horizontal slot-pockets, while the smaller field is an open egg-crate of crossing ribs reinforced by triangular gussets at the inner corner. Slotted mounting ears project from two outer edges, and rib-to-rim junctions are filleted with molded draft throughout.

family_scale1__Z_00731_1.desc: A compact radial heat-spreader with eight tapered fins cast into a thicker annular hub; the hub carries a central bore and keyseat, while each thin plate fin has a generous root fillet and a slightly upturned tip.

family_scale1__Z_00209_0.desc: A single constant-thickness machined plate with a slightly tapered, fanned outline bounded by large corner arcs and chamfered outer edges. The flat central field is pierced by a mixed hole pattern: one large central through-bore ringed by several medium bores, plus repeated groups of small countersunk screw holes; there are no ribs, bosses, or formed walls—everything is through-cut in one slender panel.

family_scale1__Z_00320_0.part_family: perforated flat mounting strip / drilled bar rail
family_scale1__Z_00320_0.desc: A thin, elongated flat bar with a narrow, low cross-section; the long edges are softened with small fillets and the end profile blends several radii. A single row of small through-holes is evenly pitched along the bar centerline, passing through the thin face, while both flat faces are otherwise plain with no ribs, bosses, or cutouts.

family_pilot__Z_00116_0.desc: A constant-thickness sheet-metal plate is profiled so a continuous lower band folds at a right angle into a horizontal mounting foot, while the standing web above the fold is cut into two upright rectangular ears spaced along the foot. The outboard ear is taller than the inboard ear, the two are separated by an open rectangular notch, and there are no holes, ribs, or bosses—only square-cut edges and a single bend radius at the foot.

family_scale1__Z_00331_0.part_family: thin open-center rectangular plastic bezel frame
family_scale1__Z_00331_0.desc: One-piece flat rectangular rim forming a closed ring around an open window; four outer corners and four inner window corners are rounded for eight matched edge fillets. A shallow rectangular pocket is recessed into the top face inside the rim to seat a panel or gasket, the thin uniform wall has a small step at the lower edge, and four small drafted locating features sit on the rim.

family_scale1__Z_00625_0.desc: A thin circular rim drum carries an evenly spaced ring of open rectangular pockets around its periphery and a small central hub bore; a short side bracket ties the hub to a vertical support post. The post drops to a flat multi-foot base with splayed feet and bracing legs, with filleted joints throughout; the rim reads as a hollow slotted shell rather than a solid disc.

family_scale1__Z_00280_1.desc: Flat rectangular filter-grille panel formed as a single thin shell with a turned-up edge flange for stiffness. A field of parallel angled louvers spans the middle, countersunk mounting holes sit near the short ends, and a small raised rectangular pad in one corner is left for an embossed mark.

family_scale1__Z_00372_2.desc: Shallow retaining frame with softly rounded rectangular outline and a narrow uniform rim rather than a stepped rabbet; it fastens by four molded snap hooks on the back plus two metal threaded inserts on one short side. The front lip is slightly crowned, the inner opening is drafted, and two small locating pins rise from the seat near diagonal corners.

family_scale1__Z_00723_0.desc: Long straight injection-molded rail built as two parallel side rails tied together by many evenly spaced cross-rungs, leaving a regular line of rectangular through-windows. Walls are thin and uniform, with a shallow channel cross-section, a low longitudinal lip standing slightly proud along one edge, a short solid mounting head with small round holes at one end, and a stepped latch edge at the other.

family_scale1__Z_00712_1.desc: A dished handwheel variant with a solid unpierced grip rim that has scalloped finger notches, joined to an offset hub by a shallow conical web and a few curved tapered spokes. The hub has a plain through bore plus one radial set-screw boss, and the back face is stiffened by concentric ribs rather than by pierced rim windows.

family_scale1__Z_00010_1.part_family: ribbed thin rectangular bezel panel with recessed windows
family_scale1__Z_00010_1.desc: A same-family variant is an oblong thin cover plate whose single raised border rib and two parallel interior ribs form three in-line rectangular apertures. One end adds two cylindrical mounting bosses with counterbored holes beside a narrow wiring slot, while the opposite edge is opened by a long finger notch and each pocket gets a small drain slot.

family_scale1__Z_00439_0.desc: A straight folded sheet-metal angle strip with one long web and one shorter flange joined by a single continuous bend, forming an open obtuse profile in a uniform thin wall. The two ends are plain sheared with small corner miters; there are no holes, slots, ribs, or bosses.

family_scale1__Z_00471_2.part_family: bent sheet-metal channel bracket with end mounting flanges
family_scale1__Z_00471_2.desc: A compact formed sheet-metal support clip in this family, bent into a Z-shaped offset profile with a hemmed, near-closed box section rather than an open trough. One end terminates in a flat lug with a single pressed-thread insert boss, the opposite end in a curled catch hook, and the side wall carries a short row of pierced louvres plus a few locating dimples, with no cable-finger row.

family_scale1__Z_00255_0.desc: One-piece shallow rectangular carrier plate with a raised perimeter rim and a recessed working field; the field carries a regular grid of counterbored circular through pockets, several small pin or screw holes, and rounded clearance slots near the short ends, with filleted internal corners and an underside stiffening skirt.

family_scale1__Z_00129_0.part_family: hubbed toothed drive sprocket / timing pulley
family_scale1__Z_00129_0.desc: One-piece machined sprocket: a thin constant-thickness rim carries a single circumferential row of identical outward teeth, and a longer cylindrical hub barrel is fused coaxially to one face so the part is stepped and asymmetric front-to-back. A smooth central bore passes clean through hub and rim, the web is solid, and the bore entry, hub-to-rim shoulder, and every tooth crest edge are broken by small fillets or chamfers. Each tooth repeats the same pair of flank radii with an angled root.

family_pilot__Z_00092_1.desc: Stepped internal helical ring gear with a plain outer flange and a recessed web; the toothed bore is interrupted by two timing notches. Four countersunk mounting holes sit on a bolt circle, with small chamfers at both tooth ends.

family_pilot__Z_00051_1.desc: A bent sheet-metal mounting bracket formed from one blank into a flat base flange, an upright web, and a short return lip. The base carries two round holes, the web has one slotted hole plus a single pressed stiffening rib, and the bend corners are filleted.

family_scale1__Z_00802_0.desc: Thin flat annular ring gear: a short cylindrical band with parallel end faces, a smooth outer rim, and a central through bore whose wall carries one continuous row of internal spur teeth around the full circumference. Tooth roots blend into the bore with small fillets; there are no bolt holes, keyways, ribs or bosses, only the uniform internal tooth ring with light edge chamfers.

family_scale1__Z_00073_1.desc: Eight-petal molded rosette with a taller central hub carrying a blind threaded bore and a single keyway; petals are solid teardrop shells without the underside lattice, each pierced by a circular hole near its tip, with alternating long and short petals. Stiffening is by radial underside gussets and a snap groove around the boss rather than a rib mesh.

family_scale1__Z_00818_1.desc: A flat decorative snowflake disc built on eightfold symmetry: a solid round center plate sprouts eight tapered spokes, each spoke edged with a single run of triangular teeth and opened by one short radial slot near the rim. A scalloped outer band ties the spoke tips together, the spoke roots are gusseted into the hub with shallow ribs, and a small heart-shaped pierced opening beside one spoke replaces a protruding lug as the hanger.

family_pilot__Z_00065_2.desc: A straight metal gear-rack segment uses a thicker rectangular bar with machined teeth along the top edge and two counterbored mounting holes through the end zones. A central adjustment slot, broad chamfers on the long edges, and a shallow underside weight-relief pocket differentiate it from a plain tie strip.

family_scale1__Z_00039_1.part_family: ribbed plastic linear guide rail with integral end mounting brackets
family_scale1__Z_00039_1.desc: An open-top C-channel variant of the same rail family: a shallow extruded trough with a snap-on flat cover, a single staggered row of slotted fixing holes plus two molded locating bosses along the base, low ribbing on the outer underside, plain flat end feet with countersunk holes, and no mid-span bridge.

family_scale1__Z_00396_0.desc: Thin circular web with a narrow raised rim around the outer edge. Two short solid cylindrical studs sit on the centreline at equal offsets above and below the disc centre; the upper stud projects from the front face and the lower stud from the back face, so the pair is diametrically opposed but on opposite sides. The plate is closed with no through bore, carrying only the two eccentric pins.

family_scale1__Z_00102_2.desc: Alternate same-family part: a hexagonal snowflake plate with six long primary spokes alternating with six shorter barbed tines, all branching from a raised hexagonal boss with a polygonal through hole and three small mounting holes. The faces use shallow V-grooves and pierced slots instead of full jewel facets, and the tines end in blunt chamfers with mixed fillet radii for a stamped or machined metal version.

family_pilot__Z_00118_0.desc: Thin one-piece molded rectangular plate with a shallow perimeter flange; the top face is a symmetric open truss of triangular ribs/apertures—four large central triangles around a pair of through-holes plus smaller diagonal-webbed pockets at the ends—tied together by two raised longitudinal rails densely patterned with small countersunk holes and end fastener bores, with short cylindrical standoffs on the underside.

family_scale1__Z_00295_0.desc: A shallow open-top rectangular electronics enclosure base molded as one shell, with a flat floor, continuous perimeter sidewalls and radiused external corners. The interior carries raised corner screw bosses and board standoffs, cross ribs and small reinforcing gussets, while the rim and sidewalls include multiple round through holes, radiused edge holes, elongated slots and recessed connector pockets; all sharp transitions are filleted.

family_scale1__Z_00597_1.part_family: thin injection-molded plastic ring grille with spokes
family_scale1__Z_00597_1.desc: A molded elliptical fan-guard ring: a single outer rim carries eight short radial spokes to a central hub with a through bore and keyway, plus two opposing snap tabs on the rim. One inner concentric rib is perforated instead of solid, and a small molded label pad and a drain notch sit at the low point.

family_scale1__Z_00826_1.desc: A flat locating strip in the same thin-plate style, but pierced with two round mounting holes near the ends and one central obround adjustment slot; the perimeter has light corner bevels and one end is relieved as a short tongue.

family_scale1__Z_00043_2.part_family: machined flat connecting link with end eyes
family_scale1__Z_00043_2.desc: An offset flat control link with one round closed eye and one elongated slotted eye set at an angle to the main arm. The connecting web is swept and tapered with local raised boss pads around the bore and the slot, several round lightening holes along the arm, and a continuous edge chamfer around the perimeter.

family_scale1__Z_00616_2.desc: A long narrow variant of the family: one central row of oval deep pockets flanked by two solid edge rails that hold several through mounting holes and small locating bosses. Short transverse gusset ribs tie the pocket wall to the rails underneath instead of a full fin field, the rim ends have molded lead-in chamfers, and one end rail carries an integral finger-pull slot for removal from a mating frame.

family_scale1__Z_00230_2.part_family: folded thin-gauge sheet-metal multi-bay divider/organizer tray
family_scale1__Z_00230_2.desc: A one-row, six-narrow-pocket version wrapped from a single strip with a continuous base and wrap-over end walls; each pocket floor has one obround finger-relief cutout, the short dividers are stiffened by coined ribs rather than return hems, and the two end walls extend into keyed mounting ears with round holes, using only minimal edge breaks throughout.

family_pilot__Z_00008_2.desc: A long rectangular return-air grille in the same family: a molded frame with rounded ends encloses one set of closely spaced straight blades crossed by a coarser set of ribs, producing elongated rectangular cells. Mounting is concentrated at the ends as keyhole slots plus countersunk holes, and the back side carries a few short standoff bosses that lift the lattice off the mounting surface.

family_scale1__Z_00136_2.part_family: one-piece miniature dagger with integral guard and grip
family_scale1__Z_00136_2.desc: A symmetrical letter-opener dagger variant uses a spear-point blade with a molded fuller on both faces, a flared two-arm crossguard capped by round finial bosses, an integrally molded grip with three circumferential grooves, and a ring pommel without a lanyard hole.

family_scale1__Z_00315_1.part_family: vented flat faceplate panel with end mounting tab
family_scale1__Z_00315_1.desc: A straight thin bezel panel from the same family with no bent ear: one half carries two side-by-side rounded rectangular cutouts while the other half holds a smaller bank of vertical vent slots, and countersunk mounting holes run along the long edges instead of an end tab; the slot edges are chamfered and all cutout corners are filleted.

family_scale1__Z_00630_2.desc: A half-round crossing file with one flat double-cut face and one convex single-cut face; the body is parallel for most of its length then sweeps into a blunt rounded nose. Coarse teeth cover the curved side while the flat side is finer, a slim edge is left uncut, and the heel carries a wide rectangular tang sized for a press-fit wooden handle.

family_scale1__Z_00244_1.part_family: machined cheese-plate mounting plate with four corner bosses
family_scale1__Z_00244_1.desc: A wider rectangular mounting plate uses only two raised clamp bosses on diagonally opposite corners, formed as open semicircular rod seats rather than closed rings and linked to the deck by straight ribs. Its field mixes staggered round clearance holes, countersunk tapped holes, two keyhole slots and a central grip opening, all inside a low peripheral stiffening rib.

family_scale1__Z_00372_1.desc: Deeper rectangular frame of the same bezel type but with the rim widened on two opposite sides into mounting ears; six clearance holes run along those ears instead of corner fasteners. The window has a recessed ledge on three sides and a through connector slot on the fourth, with small triangular gusset ribs tying the ear pads back to the outer wall and chamfered, not filleted, outer corners.

family_scale1__Z_00554_2.part_family: pigeonhole storage cabinet of thin panels
family_scale1__Z_00554_2.desc: Tall narrow bin-column organizer: one half is a fixed grid of small uniform cubbies while the other half holds two deep pull-out tray bins sliding on folded sheet rails. It adds a raised toe plinth at the base, a lipped top cap, rear ventilation slots, and bent label-holder tabs on the bin fronts in place of the plain header rail.

family_scale1__Z_00485_0.desc: Thin flat rectangular grille panel with a shallow perimeter rim and slightly raised edge rails forming a low tray. The face carries a dense uniform array of narrow parallel through-slots split into an upper bank of long slots and a lower bank of short slots by a solid transverse web; the back is mostly open with smooth walls and small corner fillets.

family_scale1__Z_00652_0.desc: A long, slender uniform-gauge strip folded into a shallow stepped channel: a wide slotted web joined by a bend radii to a narrower turned edge that runs the full length as a stiffening hem. The web carries one continuous, evenly pitched row of identical square through-slots; there are no ribs, bosses or welds, only clean press-brake bends and square-cropped ends.

family_scale1__Z_00498_2.part_family: square-cell honeycomb cartridge in cylindrical shell
family_scale1__Z_00498_2.desc: A shorter lattice canister uses a coarse square mesh only at the inlet as a removable screen, backed by radial support ribs inside the shell. Three equally spaced external tabs clamp the body into a housing, while the rear stays open against an internal shoulder.

family_scale1__Z_00431_1.desc: Flat dog-bone link plate with two equal circular lobes joined by a straight narrow waist, each lobe carrying a through hole, plus one elongated closed slot centered in the waist. A coined stiffening border runs around the whole outline and around the slot, all exterior corners are radiused, and the sheet keeps one constant thickness with no formed tabs.

family_scale1__Z_00186_0.desc: One-piece turned hub with a coaxial through-bore cut by a single keyway. Around the lower half the outside is slotted axially into an integral ring of straight radial teeth (18) with rounded crests and chamfered free ends, the teeth stopping at a circumferential shoulder; above the shoulder the same outside diameter continues as a plain smooth barrel. The web between the keyed bore and the tooth roots stays solid, with no inserts or fasteners.

family_scale1__Z_00648_2.desc: 紧紧抓住 A compact square adapter plate with clipped corners and a single large keyed cutout at its center, ringed by download a bolt circle of tapped holes. The back is relieved with milled lightening pockets, and two opposing edges carry elongated alignment slots insteadestival of a hole grid.

family_scale1__Z_00520_1.desc: A heavier open-web girder of the same family: a closed rectangular thin-wall tube whose two opposite side faces are Pratt trusses with verticals and diagonals meeting at gusseted nodes, while the top and bottom faces remain solid sheet. It adds welded end mounting plates with a bolt-hole pattern, triangular node gussets, lightening holes in the internal diaphragms, and one solid face swaps the obround slots for a single row of round access holes.

family_scale1__Z_00677_1.part_family: panel-built decorative surround with lattice grilles
family_scale1__Z_00677_1.desc: A single flat cover panel of the same thin-stock family: one rectangular sheet with a plain perimeter border, its lower two-thirds punched with one dense field of identical vertical slots rather than a square lattice. Two small cylindrical mounting bosses stand off the rear face, the front outer edge carries a continuous chamfer, and a pair of keyhole slots near the top provide hanging points.

family_scale1__Z_00517_1.desc: A similar annular web insert with a thicker outer ring and six tapered radial spokes around a central through-hole hub. Alternate sectors carry small perforated vent fields, and the rim has three equally spaced locating notches.

family_scale1__Z_00218_2.desc: Same family, different feature mix: a shorter, wider paddle-style contact strip with a central boss hole flanked by two side fixing slots in the head, then a tapered shank ending in a small radiused pull tab. Instead of through-slots it has one row of fewer, larger closed-bottom rectangular pockets, and only the leading corners are chamfered.

family_pilot__Z_00029_0.part_family: bent flat metal strip hook / clip
family_pilot__Z_00029_0.desc: A uniform flat strip of constant rectangular cross-section is bent through one large smooth radius into an open C-shaped hook, the curved spine closing one side while two straight, roughly parallel legs form the open side. Each free leg terminates in a small rectangular end lug at the tip; there are no through-holes, with only small edge chamfers and a generous inside fillet at the bend.

family_pilot__Z_00017_0.desc: A constant-thickness sheet chassis in one primary plane, built as a central polygonal hub/deck integral with several slender radial arms. Some arms end in elongated slotted motor-mount tabs, others in short skid or accessory tabs and hexagonal ring pads; the plate is opened up by many through-holes and lightening slots, tied together by narrow integral bridges, with small fillets at re-entrant corners and a uniform chamfer around the outside edges.

family_scale1__Z_00070_2.desc: Taller bent sheet-metal chassis half of the same family, built as an L-shaped bracket that closes the back and one side of the enclosure. It uses pressed standoff bosses and threaded insert locations on the interior floor, with a row of mixed circular and D-shaped connector openings on the rear flange. The open edges are hemmed for stiffness, gusseted triangular tabs brace the corner, and a pair of keyhole slots replaces the plain mounting ears.

family_scale1__Z_00675_0.desc: A short straight miniature extruded aluminum rail of compact rectangular cross-section. Multiple longitudinal T-slot channels run the full length on the outer faces, the section also contains two small internal through-bores with many tiny corner fillets, and one zone is pierced by a single evenly spaced row of ten cross-drilled through-holes; both ends are plain saw-cut faces.

family_scale1__Z_00450_1.part_family: thin flat closed frame ring (delta bezel/spacer)
family_scale1__Z_00450_1.desc: Closed rectangular frame ring of the same uniform thin section, built from four straight walls joined by generously radiused outer corners around a centered rectangular window. A regular row of through mounting holes runs along two opposite walls while the other two walls are left plain, with all surfaces coplanar and no stiffening features.

family_scale1__Z_00207_1.part_family: flat toothed rotary ring (sprocket / reluctor wheel)
family_scale1__Z_00207_1.desc: A thicker machined timing-belt pulley of the same rotary-toothed family: a solid stepped hub with a keywayed central bore and one radial set screw, an integral belt toothed band around the mid-width, and a flange on each side of the teeth. Several milled lightening pockets penetrate the web between hub and toothed band instead of a bolt circle.

family_scale1__Z_00298_0.part_family: slotted multi-bay divider rack of thin upright panels
family_scale1__Z_00298_0.desc: A low rectangular base plate carries several thin vertical divider walls standing on edge and tied together along a continuous rear spine, forming a row of open-topped compartments. The panels are pierced by multiple obround slot windows in a repeating pattern, all slot corners and outer corners are filleted, exposed edges are broken with small chamfers, and one end of the base is stepped/notched for clearance.

family_scale1__Z_00678_0.desc: A straight, slender prismatic rail of uniform narrow rectangular cross-section. One broad face carries two parallel longitudinal rows of many small close-pitched through-holes, while the ends add a few larger through mounting holes plus a small cluster of shallow blind holes; edges are square with no ribs, slots, or bosses.

family_scale1__Z_00826_2.desc: A spring-steel strip from the same family with a straight midsection, three punched holes along the spine, a narrow cross slot near one end, and a small latch tab formed from the opposite end; edges are deburred, with bevels only around the tab and slot mouths.

family_scale1__Z_00614_1.desc: Rectangular open bezel of the same thin-frame family with six perimeter bosses—four corners plus one centered on each long side—joined by a continuous outer rail and a full-height inner lip. Instead of a diagonal strut it uses an X-shaped pair of cross ribs over the central opening, mixes countersunk and plain through holes, and has small snap-latch grooves along two opposite rails.

family_scale1__Z_00565_1.desc: Heavier rectangular machine-frame extrusion, much wider than it is tall, with T-slots on both wide faces and one narrow face while the other narrow face is left closed and smooth. A horizontal mid-web splits the interior into two cells, each with its own central screw bore and corner bosses sized for end tapping, and the outside corners are chamfered rather than rounded.

family_pilot__Z_00064_1.desc: Same family but as a three-sided cage rather than a full ring: a deep U-shaped trough whose open side forms the card mouth; two staggered rows of contact slots run along the back wall split by an internal ribbed divider, the side walls carry molded cantilever latch arms with snap hooks instead of pierced ears, and attachment is by four corner standoffs with press-fit pegs plus a pair of board-lock barbs; the floor is ribbed in a cross pattern and the outer corners are chamfered rather than radiused.

family_scale1__Z_00291_1.desc: L-shaped bent sheet bracket: a rectangular vertical leg with an uncurled straight top edge and a trapezoidal horizontal web joined across the full width by a generous inside bend. The vertical leg carries two stacked clearance holes while the web mixes one elongated adjustment slot with a pair of countersunk fixing holes; the outer tip is clipped and rounded, and a small pressed dimple stiffens the bend.

family_pilot__Z_00030_0.part_family: thin-strip open frame bracket with upright leg
family_pilot__Z_00030_0.desc: A flat open rectangular ring made from uniform thin strip forms a picture-frame base with a clear central window and square, essentially sharp corners. From one side of the ring a single straight narrow blade rises perpendicular to the frame plane as an integral mounting leg. The frame rail and leg share the same constant thin-wall section with a small stepped edge detail at the section break, and there are no holes, slots, ribs, or bosses.

family_scale1__Z_00217_1.desc: A same-family plate laid out as a triangular three-lobed spring: three taller plain collars sit uniformly about a large central bore on rounded arms, with tear-drop lightening slots cut in each web between collars and a smooth, slightly rolled outer rim instead of edge teeth. A single small index notch on one lobe provides orientation.

family_pilot__Z_00099_2.part_family: thin flat machined linkage plate (instrument lever/bracket)
family_pilot__Z_00099_2.desc: Wider symmetrical flat link: two parallel clevis ears at one end share a common cross-bore flanked by counterbored fastener seats, the central web is opened by one elongated lightening pocket and two relief slots, and the body tapers to a rounded tail pierced by a short diagonal pattern of plain thru-holes, with no fork or spring arms used.

family_scale1__Z_00454_0.part_family: pocketed annular component-carrier ring with standoff legs
family_scale1__Z_00454_0.desc: A thin-walled annular ring has a continuous outer rim and a central bore linked by radial ribs, creating twelve evenly spaced rectangular through-pockets around the face. A low rectangular module nests in each pocket and stands just proud of the ring, while several short cylindrical legs project from the underside and small fixing holes sit on an internal bolt circle; rib roots are filleted and each leg ends in a flat mounting land.

family_scale1__Z_00452_0.desc: A flat rectangular grille: two long side rails and two short end caps form a thin perimeter frame one wall thick, and the opening is filled by a single coplanar random Voronoi, cracked-mud web whose struts tie directly into the rails. The front face is flush and the back is open like a shallow tray; outer edges carry small chamfered lead-ins and short snap lips at the ends, with no separate bosses, holes, slots, or rear ribs beyond the organic lattice pattern.

family_pilot__Z_00020_1.desc: A constant-thickness four-lobed square flange uses one solid plate with scooped sides and filleted outside corners. The centre has a counterbored main hole, four equally spaced mounting holes surround it, and one opposed pair is replaced by short radial slots for adjustment.

family_pilot__Z_00059_0.desc: A thin uniform-thickness plate cut into a symmetric X-shape: a compact central hub merges into four equal radial arms as a single sheet. The hub carries several hexagonal lightening pockets and clusters of small through-holes for a flight controller stack, each arm tip has a small group of through-holes, and four mounting holes are equally spaced on a large bolt circle. Outer and inner edges are eased by many small rounds plus a few chamfers, with the outline mirrored about both centerlines.

family_pilot__Z_00113_2.desc: A compact square grille insert with a flat perimeter flange for screw fastening. A coarse diagonal cross-hatch rib lattice replaces the parallel vanes, four corner holes sit on molded bosses, the lower rail has drain notches, and a recessed center pad is left for a label.

family_scale1__Z_00599_2.desc: Another variant could use three broad swept arms between the toothed rim and a raised coaxial clutch boss, with one elongated adjustment slot in an arm, a hexagonal through bore, two dowel bosses on the hub face, and small triangular gussets at selected tooth roots.

family_scale1__Z_00515_2.desc: Hubbed helical gear-rim variant: an outer ring with angled helical teeth joined by a thin radial web to a central hub. The hub has a keyed bore and a single set-screw boss, the web is lightened by several round pockets, and a generous fillet blends the hub into the rim.

family_scale1__Z_00379_1.desc: Thin-wall tube formed as a U with two parallel straight legs joined by a single return bend; the same axial bore runs end to end and both cut ends are open. One leg carries a single transverse pin hole near the tip.

family_scale1__Z_00245_0.part_family: open polygonal bar-cage drum on a central hub
family_scale1__Z_00245_0.desc: Two concentric polygonal end rings are linked by evenly spaced longitudinal flat slats to make a short open drum; taller round tie posts at the corners project past the top ring and are cross-braced by diagonal rods back to the lower ring and hub. A central flanged hub carries a through bore, an across-flats hex drive feature and several clocked circles of through and tapped mounting holes, with small gusset ribs and radiused junctions at the ring-to-slat connections.

family_scale1__Z_00795_1.desc: Externally scalloped spacer ring in the same collar family, using twelve broader lobes around a plain bored hub. Add three equally spaced axial through holes on one face and a single internal keyway; keep the outer lugs integral with rounded roots and a recessed opposite face.

family_scale1__Z_00674_2.desc: Organizer-divider variant: a similar thin slotted panel but with mixed features, combining a row of large rectangular pockets at one end, arrays of small round holes elsewhere, diagonal reinforcing ribs on the back face, and two cylindrical locating bosses for registration into a mating tray.

family_scale1__Z_00544_2.desc: A shallow tray-style variant in the same family with a raised perimeter wall around a central rectangular cutout. One rail uses a dense waffle of blind square pockets, the opposite rail carries evenly spaced through holes and long narrow slots, and the corners are reinforced with filleted gussets rather than pocketed features.

family_scale1__Z_00449_0.desc: Thin-walled molded half-round vent grille with a semicircular face frame joined to a shallow curved hood and a flat rear mounting flange. The face is an open fanlight lattice: a small bottom-center semicircular hub feeds a fan of radial spokes crossed by concentric arc ribs, while the rim, end cheeks and rear lip add stiffness and carry a perforated screen/rib band.

family_scale1__Z_00502_2.part_family: thin flat annular ring with knurled inner bore
family_scale1__Z_00502_2.desc: A stepped bezel ring with an L-shaped cross-section: a thin flat annulus plus a short axial lip on one face forming a shallow locating seat. Four evenly spaced radial notches break the outer edge for orientation, the inner edge has a fine smooth knurl band, and the flange face holds three countersunk mounting holes.

family_scale1__Z_00002_1.part_family: slotted sleeve collets and expanding mandrels
family_scale1__Z_00002_1.desc: A longer slotted collet sleeve with a hexagonal drive head rather than a round flanged head: the open end is split by six axial slots, the bore is a single through hole that changes to an internal taper toward the head, and an external circumferential groove near the head takes a retaining ring; there is no side lug and the head is fixed by four screws.

family_scale1__Z_00527_1.desc: A slender ladder-style mounting strip in the same family: a narrow rectangular web with short flanges bent down along both long edges and open coped ends. Holes are arranged as repeating triads along the centerline with larger clearance holes near each end, and one flange is interrupted by a single oblong wiring slot rather than being fully perforated.

family_scale1__Z_00297_0.desc: This part is a wide molded thermoplastic through-board header: a flat base flange carries many straight solder pins in staggered rows, and a raised shrouded deck above adds one large central rectangular socket, a smaller side socket, and edge rows of square contact openings; a taller end block and the enlarged detail show an integral locking latch, with thin outer walls, internal septa, alignment ribs and chamfered pin lead-ins.

family_scale1__Z_00586_2.desc: Same pierced-plate family but elongated and asymmetric: a laser-cut flat plate with a capsule/oval outline, an off-center double-D pivot hole, a staggered field of mixed triangular and round lightening cutouts denser on the heavier side, three tapped boss holes on one half for a mating bracket, and a fully deburred/rolled perimeter with no scalloped drive edge.

family_scale1__Z_00558_0.desc: Short square-profile T-slot extrusion segment with one longitudinal slot centered on each of the four faces; the slot mouths are chamfered, the slot roots are radiused, and the corners carry small fillets. Its solid core has a central axial through-hole plus four equally spaced axial through-holes arranged on a bolt circle for end fastening.

family_scale1__Z_00575_1.desc: An oval moulded cover grille built around a central circular boss, with a sunburst of numerous narrow teardrop through-slots and a thicker beaded outer edge. The back side carries a shallow sealing groove, a few short locator standoffs, and several small mounting holes on a perimeter flange, while the face keeps one smooth show surface with a recessed emblem pad at the hub.

family_scale1__Z_00696_0.desc: One-piece open frame molded as a cluster of rectangular bays sharing thin vertical walls, arranged in an L-shaped, height-stepped footprint with one low platform feeding into a taller bank of compartments; the bays are open-topped shells with near-uniform wall stock, tied by common divider walls and short bridging webs. Selected outer and divider walls carry rectangular window/slot cutouts and small latch/access holes, with reinforcing ribs at T-junctions, small locating ledges inside some bays, and modest fillets on vertical edges; there is no continuous top or bottom cover.

family_scale1__Z_00728_1.part_family: stamped lanced sheet-metal encoder tone ring
family_scale1__Z_00728_1.desc: A flat, unbent stainless code washer of the same family: an annular disc with a pilot bore carrying two concentric slotted tracks, an outer track of many equal narrow radial windows and an inner track of fewer wider windows plus one wider index slot for an optical sensor. A small integral orientation ear with a single fixing hole breaks the outer edge, several round lightening holes sit between the tracks, and all edges are coined and deburred with no formed height.

family_scale1__Z_00343_0.part_family: thin slotted grille panel with mounting bosses
family_scale1__Z_00343_0.desc: A flat rectangular lattice plate of uniform thin wall framed by a peripheral rail that widens into corner and mid-edge mounting bosses with through holes. Between the rails the field is pierced by rows of rectangular through-slots grouped in repeating long and short sets, with several small square blind pockets on one face and the slot edges lightly chamfered.

family_scale1__Z_00183_1.desc: Closed rounded-rectangle bezel of the same thin-plate construction, but with a centered oblong window and a continuous inner gasket groove. Four countersunk mounting holes sit at the corners and a shallow rear adhesive recess runs just inside the rim.

family_scale1__Z_00560_1.desc: Pressed sheet-metal finger guard for a small axial fan: a rolled outer ring with welded concentric wire hoops and evenly spaced radial wires, a flat center mounting disc with four clearance holes, and two spring clip tabs opposite two fixed tabs; no counterbore and no molded bosses.

family_scale1__Z_00365_2.desc: A compact square flange spacer with four counterbored through-ports in a two-by-two array, each port ringed by a raised concentric boss on one face and opening into a recessed central web on the other. Cross ribs stiffen the web, the corners carry countersunk mounting holes, and a closed perimeter seal groove plus short intersecting back-face channels tie the ports together.

family_scale1__Z_00468_2.desc: A low lid variant is built from four nested square plates as a shallow pyramid rather than a bowl, with a continuous perimeter flange, short radial ribs under the largest plate, two elongated vent slots between selected layers, and a small rounded rectangular boss on the top face.

family_scale1__Z_00241_1.part_family: flat multi-arm hand knob / spider plate
family_scale1__Z_00241_1.desc: Four-arm cruciform plate knob with a square hub and central insert bore; two opposed arms are longer and end in oval pads with plain round through holes while the short arms end in closed rounded caps, and the back face adds a thin rib along each arm with chamfered rather than fully rounded edges.

family_scale1__Z_00098_1.desc: A three-lobe version of the same family: an equilateral triangular spring plate with a central boss, three radial beam arms and three corner eyelets. Put paired elongated relief slots in each arm, add small lightening holes in the webs, scallop the outer edge between eyelets, and countersink the three mounting holes.

family_scale1__Z_00700_0.part_family: thin flat polygonal aperture retainer plate
family_scale1__Z_00700_0.desc: A thin, uniform-thickness flat plate whose outer edge is a regular hexagonal ring with small rectangular lugs and notched ears at several vertices plus a short centered tab at one flat. A large circular through-hole is concentric with the plate, and one face carries several concentric annular steps and shallow grooves forming a stepped seat around the bore; edges are sharp with only small fillets and there are no deep walls.

family_scale1__Z_00042_2.part_family: thin flat radial spider hub plate
family_scale1__Z_00042_2.desc: A five-pointed star member of the same family with slim evenly spaced arms around a small central ring. The bore is splined rather than plain, every star tip has one countersunk through hole plus an obround lightening slot mid-arm, and the back face is relieved by shallow radial pockets that leave thin webs between the hub and the tips.

family_scale1__Z_00697_1.part_family: flat rectangular multi-opening frame of thin profiles
family_scale1__Z_00697_1.desc: A wider three-bay variant uses the same thin box profiles but sets two full-height centre mullions to make three equal vertical openings, with a continuous perforated top rail and a plain uninterrupted sill rail. The inner sub-frames are omitted; instead the inner corners are stiffened by small triangular gussets and the centre mullions carry pairs of rectangular through-slots for routing.

family_scale1__Z_00026_1.part_family: thin molded rectangular electronics cover plate
family_scale1__Z_00026_1.desc: Shallow rectangular shell whose base panel is walled on three sides and left open on the fourth for a connector. Inside are two long lengthwise ribs, a cluster of threaded-insert bosses toward one end, a single large off-center rectangular cutout through the panel, a row of small vent slots, and several cantilever snap tabs along the open edge.

family_scale1__Z_00326_1.desc: Straight extruded chassis rail from the same family, but asymmetric: a hollow rectangular core is flanked by three longitudinal mounting slots and one smooth reference face, with two transverse fastener holes near each end. Lightening pockets repeat along the inner web, slot mouths are chamfered, and the outer corners are sharp except for small edge breaks.

family_scale1__Z_00140_2.desc: Circular lattice insert using concentric rings tied by radial spokes, with a solid center boss, alternating closed and open cells around the outer band, and three rear locating bosses for orientation in a housing.

family_scale1__Z_00596_1.desc: A straight rectangular heat sink formed from a flat base plate with one row of uniform-height longitudinal fins on its top face. A continuous transverse groove cuts across the fins at mid-length to seat a heat pipe, and the base has four corner counterbored mounting holes plus one elongated clip slot, with small fillets at the base-to-fin roots.

family_scale1__Z_00587_1.part_family: flat perforated vent/grille panel with a clear rectangular window
family_scale1__Z_00587_1.desc: A flat perforated cover plate of the same sheet type, but with the screen split into two rectangular grille banks of square through-slots separated by a solid central spine. A round connector cutout sits near one edge, four countersunk mounting holes mark the corners, and the far edge carries a short row of obround cable slots; the panel stays planar with square outer corners.

family_scale1__Z_00740_2.desc: A wider contoured sheet panel lightly dished across its width, with a free edge scalloped into three shallow waves and the opposite edge folded into a shallow stiffening hem. Four through holes sit in a rectangular pattern beside the hem, and two short stamped ribs run from the hem toward the scalloped edge to control oil-canning.

family_scale1__Z_00133_2.part_family: flat profile-cut plate with a toothed dorsal edge
family_scale1__Z_00133_2.desc: A long low profile plate outlining a running animal on a fused straight base edge instead of individual feet, made as a single even-thickness blank. Its back carries two separated banks of fine straight serrations with square roots (over the shoulders and along the tail) while the mid-back stays smooth, the front paw is replaced by a narrow oblong hanging slot, the nose takes one small through-hole, and the base corners use simple relief notches.

family_scale1__Z_00743_0.desc: A single flat annular plate of uniform thin wall with a smooth round outer rim and one large central through-hole; the bore edge carries a continuous closed band of inward-pointing gear teeth cut through the full thickness, evenly spaced around the circle, with only small tooth fillets and no other holes, slots, ribs or bosses.

family_scale1__Z_00700_1.part_family: thin flat polygonal aperture retainer plate
family_scale1__Z_00700_1.desc: A thin washer-like circular retaining plate of constant thickness with a central round through port and a single shallow counterbore on one face. A ring of small equally spaced mounting holes sits on a bolt circle near the rim, the outer edge has three radial alignment notches, and the opposite face is plain with a narrow recessed gasket groove.

family_scale1__Z_00191_0.desc: A single co-planar thin plate with a solid perimeter frame and an integrated window-style insert: a rectangular lower field of small lights formed by crossing muntin bars, topped by a semicircular fanlight with radial spokes and concentric arcs. The panel is a uniform shell with cut through-openings, repeated short slots and tiny pin holes along the edges, small fillets at bar intersections, and a slightly raised rim tying the grille to the outer frame.

family_pilot__Z_00023_2.desc: Four-arm star spinner plate: central through-bored hub with four equal bearing bosses on the same bolt circle at ninety-degree spacing, connected by a pierced web that leaves four curved lightening windows. Mix features by giving two opposite bosses plain smooth rims and the other two scalloped rims, counterbore every bearing seat from one face only, and thread one extra small radial hole in a single boss for an adjustable balance weight.

family_scale1__Z_00737_0.desc: One-piece flat rectangular frame of constant thin wall: an outer rim and three transverse webs are integrally connected in the same plane to create four rectangular through-slots in a single row. The exterior corners are square, the web-to-rim junctions have small fillets, and there are no mounting holes, bosses, or fasteners.

family_scale1__Z_00786_2.part_family: thin multi-rail ladder guide frame with end plates
family_scale1__Z_00786_2.desc: A heavier variant with three spaced vertical plates—two end blocks plus a central web—tied together by four shouldered round rods that are threaded into the blocks. The plates are machined rather than sheet, use tapped holes instead of pierced lugs, omit the edge-slot row, and replace the lowest rod with a solid slotted base rail for support.

family_scale1__Z_00323_2.part_family: curved plastic emblem nameplate with raised lettering
family_scale1__Z_00323_2.desc: Flat adhesive-backed badge tile with a compact logo on the left and a lowercase script mark to the right, all standing proud of a fine textured recess field. It has no through-holes; instead the rear carries foam pads and a single orientation boss, and the rim is a narrow drafted edge with corner radii.

family_scale1__Z_00350_2.part_family: elongated toothed rail with integral clips
family_scale1__Z_00350_2.desc: A gently curved carrier built as a chain of short rigid pads joined by thin flexible necks so the strip can follow an arc. Every pad bears a snap-latch hook and a small locating boss on the top face and coarse gripper ribs underneath, while the two ends finish in keyed mounting feet with closed slots instead of open holes.

family_scale1__Z_00489_0.desc: A one-piece open ladder frame: two long parallel flat rails of thin rectangular section are tied together by solid transverse end blocks into a rigid U-shaped carrier. The facing edges of both rails carry dense straight rack teeth with a steep multi-angle tooth profile, while the end blocks form plain rectangular mounting bosses with short toothed stub links between them.
