family_scale1__Z_00350_0.part_family: elongated toothed rail with integral clips
family_scale1__Z_00350_0.desc: A long thin-walled strip set at a fixed shallow incline: the lower long edge is a straight spine while the opposite edge is castellated with a regular row of deep rectangular notches and carries a fine band of many small rounded teeth. Short upright ears are spaced along the toothed edge, each pierced by a small round hole, and both ends are formed into hooked tabs. The section is a narrow rectangular wall lightened by several through-slots, with small fillets at the tooth tips and notch roots.

family_scale1__Z_00503_2.part_family: open rectangular frame of thin channel rails
family_scale1__Z_00503_2.desc: A heavier picture-frame variant with mitered rails, an outer stepped profile and an inner retaining rabbet, joined by concealed corner brackets with threaded inserts. The back flange carries a regular pattern of small clip slots and one access notch on a short side, one rail is detachable for panel insertion, and the rail section is deeper on the long sides.

family_scale1__Z_00223_2.desc: Stretched-X quadcopter main plate in thin rigid laminate with a rectangular mid-body and four arms split into front and rear pairs at different spreads for a long-body layout. It adds front camera/VTX mounting tabs, generous lightening cutouts, pressed threaded inserts for a separate top deck, and grommet holes for a soft-mounted flight controller.

family_scale1__Z_00211_1.desc: A constant-thickness oblong plate with a rounded-rectangle perimeter and two large through bores at the ends joined by a narrower waist. Add a central longitudinal slot, several small clearance holes along the midline, and two countersunk mounting holes; use generous corner fillets, two locating flats on the waist, and a few small edge notches.

family_scale1__Z_00541_1.desc: Three-arm bellcrank of the same billet-truss family: a central pivot boss with one bushed bore branches into three radiating arms, two ending in clevis ears and one in a stud boss. The arms are I-beam in section with oval lightening slots instead of triangular pockets, the pivot is counterbored for a pressed bushing, and attachment is by tapped holes in a rear pad rather than through counterbores.

family_scale1__Z_00176_2.desc: Two mirrored scroll-flame half-panels are tied by a narrow top bridge and bolted to a flanged flat base through four holes. Leave an open center window, cut small scallop notches in one edge only, add locating tabs beneath the bridge, and make one half a lattice-backed shell while the opposite half remains solid.

family_pilot__Z_00066_1.desc: A flat constant-thickness plate cut to the outline of a script letter "S", formed as one continuous serpentine stroke with flared wedge-shaped terminals and no internal openings. Both faces are plain, the edge is smooth and unribbed, and a small through-hole is drilled near each terminal for mounting the emblem to a carrier panel.

family_scale1__Z_00174_1.part_family: thin-wall frame of channel-profile rails (sign/display frame)
family_scale1__Z_00174_1.desc: Ladder-style frame of the same thin channel stock: two parallel vertical rails tied together by three horizontal crossbars, forming two stacked open rectangular bays; molded snap hooks project from the back of one rail and the bar ends are closed with small rounded caps.

family_scale1__Z_00264_2.desc: Asymmetric dual-beam variant in which two parallel slender rails are tied together by several cross ribs and terminate in taller end towers, each tower holding a pair of threaded or counterbored bores with adjacent dowel-pin holes. One end closes into an L-shaped side flange with a clearance slot, while a regular line of small tapped holes and one long through slot run along the main beam, with generous fillets blending towers and ribs into the webs.

family_pilot__Z_00041_2.desc: A thin flat bracket plate symmetric about its longitudinal centerline, with matching concave semicircular notches in both side edges that form a narrow waist. A central row of three round holes passes through the waist, both ends are blunt rectangular tabs, and each external corner carries a small fillet.

family_pilot__Z_00009_0.desc: One-piece turned disc with a plain cylindrical outer rim and a shallow raised central land forming a slightly dished, stepped face. The land is densely perforated by small through-holes arranged as several concentric equally spaced rings around a central patterned array of three lettered hole types; the back is essentially flat with a small annular step and there are no ribs, bosses or threads.

family_scale1__Z_00296_0.desc: Thin rectangular flat plate whose face is filled edge to edge with dense, identical straight vertical slots; each slot has a small equal semicircular end radius, leaving uniform narrow fins across the width. One slightly thicker central web splits the slot field into two banks, the thickness is a plain slab, and the side view shows a single hidden centered web line. All slot ends share the same fillet radius and there are no holes or bosses.

family_scale1__Z_00602_1.desc: A thin sheet ornament of the same cut-plate family but with eightfold radial symmetry and a small closed circular eyelet at the hub for a hanging cord. Branch tips are scalloped and generously filleted, the inter-branch gaps are narrow rounded slots, and one arm ends in a short keyhole slot rather than a side tab.

family_scale1__Z_00649_0.part_family: flat serrated ratchet wheel with hex hub
family_scale1__Z_00649_0.desc: A constant-thickness circular plate with a solid central hub and a continuous toothed outer rim. The hub carries a centered hexagonal through-hole for a hex shaft plus a shallow raised annular boss, and four curved spokes tie the hub to the rim, leaving four symmetric rounded kidney-shaped lightening slots. The rim bears a dense uniform ring of sharp triangular saw-teeth all the way around, with small root fillets and crisp radial flanks.

family_scale1__Z_00445_1.desc: Cruciform variant: a single thin plate with one central through-hub and four matching annular rings on the diagonals, linked by gently S-curved arms that place the rings at the corners of a square. Each arm carries a narrow lightening slot, the bores are chamfered on both faces, and a shallow raised rib rings every bore on one face only.

family_scale1__Z_00785_2.desc: A flat sheet-metal plate of elongated stadium outline with asymmetric openwork: one large off-center kidney-shaped window plus a parallel bank of thin ventilation slots on the same side, so there is no rotational symmetry and no central bolt circle. Fastening is by countersunk holes near the two ends and three aligned pierced holes along the long axis, the outer edge is fully filleted with a scalloped grip section on one long side, and all cutouts share a consistent small corner radius with any edge notches omitted.

family_scale1__Z_00094_1.desc: A same-thickness flat rocker plate with two pivot eyes at the ends of a shallow S-curved arm and a single reinforced boss at the main pivot. It uses a kidney-shaped adjustment slot, a bolt-circle pattern of equal small holes around one eye, two dowel holes, and counterbored fasteners along only one edge, with chamfer applied to the outer face only and plain as-cut edges elsewhere.

family_scale1__Z_00591_2.desc: A same-family rail made from a thicker solid rectangular bar instead of a hollow tube. It mixes a field of many small drilled holes in clustered groups with a few larger counterbored holes on the centerline, adds two milled alignment notches on one long edge, taps both ends for end caps, and breaks the long edges with a small radius.

family_scale1__Z_00627_1.desc: A clip-on member of the same family replaces the flat spine with a folded narrow channel that grips a panel edge; fewer and wider spring leaves project from one side of the channel, the opposite side carries small retention barbs and two end notches, and only the working leaf tips are crowned.

family_scale1__Z_00693_2.desc: Staggered cluster holder plate: a thicker perforated plate uses a honeycomb array of circular through holes, each counterbored from the face and ringed on the underside by short triangular ribs; the outline is a rounded polygon with three slotted mounting tabs and raised locating pads.

family_scale1__Z_00525_2.part_family: bent and pierced sheet-metal slide rail
family_scale1__Z_00525_2.desc: A branched bracket-rail variant: a straight run joined to a perpendicular leg, with one slotted oval hole and two round tooling holes in the web. The outer edge is hemmed for stiffness, two stamped dimples retain a spring, and the free end finishes in a curled hook instead of a downturned foot, using a rolled radius lead-in rather than chamfers.

family_pilot__Z_00092_0.desc: Thin annular blank made as a straight-tooth internal spur ring gear: a concentric circular through-opening carries one continuous row of evenly spaced teeth, while the outer rim remains plain and cylindrical. Tooth roots blend into a constant-thickness plate with small fillets and no external bosses.

family_scale1__Z_00177_2.part_family: spoked wheel with treaded outer band
family_scale1__Z_00177_2.desc: Solid-web wheel variant with no open spoke windows, using two concentric rows of lightening holes through the web and backside radial ribs for stiffness. A knurled outer contact ring surrounds the rim, while the hub is flanged on both faces and has a keywayed bore for a driven shaft.

family_scale1__Z_00675_2.desc: A linear-stage variant of the same slotted-extrusion family arranged as a guided carrier rail. It has two parallel internal cable channels, a top row of cross-drilled countersunk mounting holes plus a second offset row on a side face, several short milled relief slots along one flank, and reamed locating bores at the ends.

family_scale1__Z_00056_1.desc: Heavier flanged variant of the same ring: the annulus grows an external bolt-circle flange pierced by several through holes, the bore keeps only a handful of tall internal splines plus a single keyway, and two rectangular connector ports sit opposite each other, each tied back to the ring with triangular gusset ribs.

family_scale1__Z_00049_0.desc: Thin press-brake-formed sheet-metal angle bracket with two principal legs joined at a right-angle bend and a short mounting foot at one end. The wider face carries a row of through obround ventilation slots and the adjoining end face carries a smaller group of similar slots, with tight bend radii, narrow returned side flanges and short stiffening hems along the edges.

family_scale1__Z_00599_0.desc: A thin flat wheel has an outer ring cut with a regular pattern of rectangular peripheral teeth, joined by four curved spokes to a stepped central hub. Four large teardrop lightening windows separate the spokes; the hub carries a central through bore and a small circular pattern of through mounting holes, with smooth filleted transitions.

family_scale1__Z_00797_1.desc: A nearly closed external snap ring of the same bent-strip family with a narrow gap and two opposed radial lug ears; each ear has one round plier hole and is filleted into the ring, while the inner edge has three shallow locating dimples.

family_scale1__Z_00566_0.part_family: thin webbed mounting plate with bolt-ring head
family_scale1__Z_00566_0.desc: A flat, constant-thickness plate whose main body is a regular polygonal ring head with six equally spaced through holes on a bolt circle around a central holed hub; radial ribs tie hub to rim and leave several polygonal lightening openings, and the rim edge is chamfered. A narrow rectangular tang extends from one side of the ring, carries an X-cross rib pattern on its face, and ends in a pair of through holes.

family_scale1__Z_00482_0.desc: A long straight prismatic shaft of small constant square cross-section with numerous continuous axial grooves and lands running the full length on all faces, like a miniature spline or profile rail. A small central through-bore runs end to end; at the end face the groove edges are broken with small chamfers and the outer corners with small round radii. Walls between the outer lands and the bore are thin and uniform, with no steps, threads, or cross-holes along the length.

family_scale1__Z_00279_0.desc: Low-profile rectangular plate with a raised perimeter rim forming a shallow open tray; the recessed floor carries a mirror-symmetric serpentine track that narrows into a wishbone junction mid-length and terminates in two rounded loop pockets at one short edge. Hexagonal across-flats features sit at both corners of the opposite short edge and within the rounded loop ends, short posts and small round bosses rise from the floor, a transverse hole is drilled through the thin edge near one end with an additional border hole, and the outer and inner edges are broken by numerous uniform chamfers.

family_scale1__Z_00163_0.desc: One-piece thin circular index wheel with a plain central web and an integral outer toothed crown. The rim carries thirty-six identical, equally spaced radial scalloped teeth with rounded roots, while three small blind holes are equally spaced on a tiny central bolt circle; there are no separate ribs or bosses beyond the tooth band.

family_scale1__Z_00061_2.desc: A thicker closed locating ring of the same family with a stepped L-shaped section: a full-height outer band and a thinner inner lip form a shoulder on one side of the bore. Three equally spaced counterbored through-holes accept cap screws, two opposed milled flats plus a small orientation notch mark the outer diameter, and both bore edges are chamfered.

family_scale1__Z_00516_1.desc: A taller faceted mast of the same family in which six thin panels are folded and riveted into a hollow hexagonal tube, stiffened by diagonal shear webs that step from bay to bay and by internal gusset ribs at every seam; alternate panels carry staggered fields of small fastener holes, one end is closed by a flange plate with a central bore and a surrounding ring of tapped holes, and the open end has two opposed orientation slots with no end bolt circle.

family_scale1__Z_00290_1.desc: Thin radial plate with four arms at right angles from a central plain bore; two opposite arms end in closed circular counterbored bosses for press-in inserts while the other two end in open hexagonal through-pockets, straight gusset webs connect adjacent arms and each web is opened by an elongated lightening slot, with the perimeter chamfered rather than filleted.

family_scale1__Z_00492_2.desc: A heavier indexing hub of the same family with only four large off-axis through bores plus several smaller tapped holes interleaved between them. Weight is removed by blind pockets milled into one face instead of through openings, the central bore carries a keyway, and a short protruding hub on the back face provides the shaft interface in place of individual hole collars.

family_scale1__Z_00570_1.part_family: additively manufactured strut-lattice block (octet-truss cellular solid)
family_scale1__Z_00570_1.desc: Flat rectangular sandwich-core lattice panel, only a couple of unit cells thick, with larger square face openings for airflow or resin escape and heavier edge struts forming a continuous perimeter frame. Corner pads are thickened into solid bosses with countersunk fixing holes so the core can be bolted or bonded between outer face sheets.

family_scale1__Z_00613_0.desc: A single uniform-thickness plate with an irregular multi-lobed outer contour made of rounded ears and concave filleted transitions. It has one large central through-opening with a small contour notch on one side and a scattered set of small through-holes, some on the outer tabs and others clustered around the opening. It is a purely prismatic profiled sheet part: no bends, ribs, bosses or pockets, with all plan-view corners filleted.

family_scale1__Z_00519_2.desc: A half-round enclosure heat-sink extrusion whose convex outside is covered in many thin cooling fins while the concave inside is a smooth bore. Opposed internal card grooves accept a PCB, two corner screw bosses receive end-cap screws, and a longitudinal keyway plus a short hinge-lug pair are formed integrally with a separate snap-fit lid; the profile is asymmetric, with one foot thickened for mounting and the fin field interrupted by a cable channel.

family_scale1__Z_00187_1.part_family: flat radial multi-spoke spider hub plate
family_scale1__Z_00187_1.desc: A five-spoke radial impeller plate of one thickness, with tapered arms that are widest at the central boss and narrow toward rounded tips. The hub has a blind bore with a single keyway and a radial tapped set-screw hole, crescent lightening pockets cut through the web between adjacent spokes, and a small raised clamping pad on one face only.

family_scale1__Z_00120_0.desc: Constant-thickness cloverleaf foil with fourfold symmetry: four identical lobes radiate from a small central hub that carries one round through opening, and each lobe is capped by a short raised faceted rim forming a hexagonal pocket around its port. Narrow waist bridges tie the four rings into the hub, small through holes sit beside the hub, the straight base edges carry fine rounded drive serrations, and every outer corner, bridge root and pocket edge is softly filleted.

family_scale1__Z_00117_1.desc: A circular thin-gauge grille disc with a shallow domed profile and a turned outer flange. Concentric ring slots are cut between three annular bands, linked by eight evenly spaced radial ribs to a solid center boss with a countersunk bore; four equidistant mounting tabs with obround slots extend from the flange, and all cutout edges carry a small rolled radius.

family_scale1__Z_00708_1.desc: A similar obround vent grille made from thin sheet, using a flat mounting flange and low rolled edge instead of a deep rim. It has two offset banks of larger round perforations, four countersunk screw holes outside the vent field, and one side notch for a cable or latch.

family_scale1__Z_00070_1.desc: Flat sheet-metal cover plate for the same enclosure family, with a shallow downturned peripheral lip and four small corner bends instead of a deep pocket. A broad embossed stiffening rib crosses the panel, with a regular pattern of ventilation slots and two elongated connector knockouts along one edge. Integral spring latch fingers are sheared and folded from the sides, and the corners carry simple mounting holes rather than countersunk flanges.

family_scale1__Z_00455_0.desc: A thin flat rectangular sheet-metal deck with a downturned lip along one long edge and short return hems at the two ends with unequal small bend radii. The top face carries a spaced line of raised rectangular standoff pads, several with centre holes, plus a row of tiny pin holes near the lip, a few larger through holes, and a pair of narrow parallel slots at one end; corners are square with small edge breaks.

family_scale1__Z_00626_1.part_family: slender precision-profiled metal extrusion bar (miniature toothed/splined rack) with axial bores
family_scale1__Z_00626_1.desc: A symmetrical, unstepped bar of the same family: a thicker oval core carrying four equally spaced axial bores, with the external rounded fins given a continuous slow helical twist so the teeth wrap around the bar like a screw; both ends are faced square and one end is lightly chamfered for tool or driver engagement.

family_scale1__Z_00486_0.desc: Flat rectangular plate of uniform thickness with a rounded-corner outer frame. A central square recess is ringed by a radial array of trapezoidal and triangular through-pockets separated by spoke-like ribs, mixed with hex across-flats features, several round through-holes toward the corners and edges, and small fillets on essentially every internal corner; the back face is plain and flat.

family_scale1__Z_00626_0.part_family: slender precision-profiled metal extrusion bar (miniature toothed/splined rack) with axial bores
family_scale1__Z_00626_0.desc: A long, small-section metal extrusion whose constant cross-section is a compact core ringed by dense rounded gear-like teeth built from three repeated crest/root radii in differing counts, and pierced by three through bores that run the full length; most of the bar keeps this toothed profile, then one end steps down to a shorter, narrower multi-tier shank. Edges are broken with small radii rather than sharp corners and the tooth field is uniform along the straight portion.

family_scale1__Z_00615_0.desc: Single uniform-thickness prismatic plate with a four-armed cruciform front profile. Opposing arms are separated by deep open perimeter notches around a narrow central waist, and the outline is made from orthogonal runs linked by a repeated pattern of matching chamfered corners; no bosses, ribs, or enclosed holes are shown.

family_scale1__Z_00222_2.desc: A planar four-finger indexing star built from identical constant-thickness spokes welded to a cylindrical hub that has one cross-drilled pin hole and a square drive recess; the spokes lie in a single plane, end in paired rounded tips rather than tabs, and one spoke is shortened into a plain stop nub.

family_scale1__Z_00266_0.desc: Open-top rectangular thin-wall plastic basket with a flat base panel joined continuously to low perimeter walls and rounded outside corners. The base is pierced by two parallel rows of eight elongated through-slots (sixteen total) for drainage/ventilation, while the slotted wall faces each carry a row of eight short vertical slots; one edge rises into an upstanding comb of evenly spaced divider tangs. Small uniform fillets run at the wall-to-base junctions and at every external corner.

family_scale1__Z_00826_0.desc: A single solid strip of constant thin rectangular section with square-cut ends and a flat top face; there are no holes, slots, ribs or bosses, and the exposed long edges and end corners are finished with six small bevels.

family_scale1__Z_00190_1.part_family: radially slotted thin rotor disc with central drive hub
family_scale1__Z_00190_1.desc: A thin flat rotor disc of the same family but with a taller, two-step central boss (a smaller diameter stacked on a larger flange) joined to the disc with a small fillet. The bore is round with a single keyway, the outer band carries a ring of swept, arc-shaped slots instead of straight ones, and a bolt circle of small through-holes in the inner solid ring allows coupling to a mating hub.

family_scale1__Z_00576_2.desc: A wider rectangular controller board with a notched rear edge and one oblong milled slot; right-angle pin headers run along opposite long sides, six standoff holes with small internal corner reliefs are unevenly distributed, and several tall cylindrical capacitor and relay bodies cluster near the slot while a D-sub cutout breaks one end. Component height varies strongly, with the tallest cans beside the connectors.

family_scale1__Z_00361_1.desc: A flat rectangular manifold plate of the same perforated-plate family uses a staggered grid of plain through bores with no raised collars; each bore is counterbored from the back face to seat a sealing insert, two elongated mounting slots are cut near the short ends, and one larger threaded port sits at the center of the grid.

family_scale1__Z_00722_2.part_family: thin flat openwork lattice grille panel with bolt-circle mounting ears
family_scale1__Z_00722_2.desc: A rectangular equipment fascia in the same family: a flat perimeter frame surrounds a field of diamond lattice ribs, broken by an oblong cable cutout on one long edge and a row of three vent slots on the opposite edge. Instead of corner eyes it uses four raised bosses on the back face for standoff mounting, plus two keyhole slots on the top rail for quick hanging, with chamfered outer corners and no left-right symmetry.

family_scale1__Z_00744_1.part_family: slender molded flat tongue blade (insertion/pry strip)
family_scale1__Z_00744_1.desc: Symmetrical spear-shaped variant of the same strip family: the body tapers gently in width to a semicircular radius at both ends, with both wide faces carrying four short transverse grip ribs grouped near mid-length and a tiny fillet at every rib root. A single oblong tether slot and one round hanging hole pierce the central web, the narrow edges run straight with no draft, and one edge adds a small outward side-hook notch between the two rib groups.

family_scale1__Z_00521_1.part_family: shallow molded plastic electronics chassis tray
family_scale1__Z_00521_1.desc: A wider near-symmetrical enclosure base uses a continuous snap-fit outer lip and a central raised pedestal joined by radiused ribs, with four corner boss holes and a single large connector cutout on one short edge; instead of pin-block fields it uses banks of long ventilation slots and a scatter of cylindrical standoffs tied to the deck by thin webs.

family_scale1__Z_00754_0.desc: Short open cylindrical cage: a lower rim ring and an upper rim ring are joined by evenly spaced vertical bars around the circumference, while the top face is bridged by a central hub and eight straight radial spokes to the rim. Small rectangular tabs and notches repeat around the outer edge, the spokes stand slightly proud of the rim, and a central through bore with hub detail provides the mount; walls are thin and uniform with light draft and small fillets at the spoke roots.

family_scale1__Z_00451_1.desc: A flat cantilever contact spring consisting of a straight rectangular base tab pierced by two round mounting holes and one central clearance slot, running through a single gentle arc into a forked free end with two rounded contact tines. A narrow embossed bead along the strip centerline stiffens the beam, and the tine tips are slightly curled out of plane to form contact crowns while the body otherwise stays flat.

family_scale1__Z_00387_2.desc: Make a mate as a stiffened equipment guard: a deeper semi-cylindrical shell with one end closed by a domed cap and the opposite end open. Add two opposed pairs of longitudinal slots near the open end and three external circumferential ribs spaced along the body.

family_scale1__Z_00135_2.desc: Longer multi-station plate with three co-linear holes, a closed rounded end at one side and an open clevis slot at the other. A row of small countersunk mounting holes sits across the web between the main bores, both long edges are relieved by evenly spaced scallops, and the perimeter uses a deeper chamfer on the top face with only a light edge break underneath.

family_scale1__Z_00210_2.part_family: thin flat rectangular windowed spacer frame
family_scale1__Z_00210_2.desc: A closed rectangular frame of the same thin-wall family built from four mitred rail segments snapped together with three equal rounded windows separated by two internal ribs; a continuous raised sealing bead runs around the outer edge, several integral locating bosses sit on one face, and outward mounting ears project at the corners.

family_scale1__Z_00753_0.desc: Straight slender closed rectangular hollow metal profile with a constant thin wall and clear rectangular bore over its full length; both ends are clean cut and left open, with sharp external corners and no holes, slots, ribs, bosses, flanges, or end fittings—essentially a precision tube segment used as a spacer or micro-strut.

family_scale1__Z_00628_2.desc: A narrower symmetrical flat plate split by a solid center spine; each side field holds a vertical column of identical short horizontal louver through-slots, the spine carries a straight row of small round holes plus one elongated access slot near mid-height, and a single centered bottom tab with one obround hole projects below large clipped-and-radiused lower corners.

family_scale1__Z_00392_1.desc: A flat laser-cut member of the same family: an outer rim and a coaxial solid hub are linked by six straight spokes, with a concentric intermediate ring tying the spokes at mid-radius for stiffness. The hub is bored with a single keyway and a set-screw boss, the rim is broken by three equally spaced finger notches, and each spoke root is generously filleted.

family_scale1__Z_00201_2.desc: Low rectangular carrier frame built as a flanged ring with one tall latch wall and one short stop wall; it swaps round ear holes for two elongated side slots, adds eight vent/slot apertures and an internal cross-rib lattice, and uses generous base fillets without top teeth.

family_scale1__Z_00226_0.part_family: rectangular open-grid frame with connector bosses
family_scale1__Z_00226_0.desc: Single thin-walled rectangular frame formed as an open lattice: a continuous outer rim with one mid horizontal rail and several vertical mullions meeting in small filleted junctions to create a two-row grid of square through-slots. Round mounting bosses with small chamfered holes sit at the corners and at selected rail intersections, while short cylindrical connector blocks project rearward from the corner posts. A shallow return flange along the back ties the rim into a stiff channel.

family_scale1__Z_00235_0.desc: Open rectangular cage folded from thin sheet metal into a hollow four-walled shell with edge flanges; the side walls carry repeated rows of long rounded-end vertical slots, the end face is pierced by three horizontal slots, and many small round holes are patterned across the walls for mounting and ventilation, while narrow internal plates stiffen the frame and split the interior into longitudinal bays.

family_scale1__Z_00680_1.desc: A low, wide cold-plate extrusion: a thin solid base with one broad face left flat as the mounting side and the opposite face populated by a single dense row of tall straight longitudinal fins with small root fillets and slightly rounded tips. Inside the base are two large axial coolant galleries joined by short cross-ports at the ends, plus a few through mounting slots and a pair of small bosses on the flat side.

family_scale1__Z_00178_0.desc: A flat cylindrical spur-gear rim carries straight external teeth around its full perimeter, with an integral concentric hub projecting from one face only and joined to the web by a small root fillet. The hub has a central through bore for a shaft, a shallow keyseat at the bore, and a tiny cross/set-screw feature on the boss; the tooth ends and rim edges are lightly chamfered.

family_scale1__Z_00015_0.part_family: miniature drilled hollow rectangular profile (slender micro-tube rail)
family_scale1__Z_00015_0.desc: A very slim constant-section hollow rectangular micro-tube, many times longer than it is wide, with thin uniform walls and small external corner radii. Along the body are two distinct hole sets: a group of eight tiny blind holes and four smaller through-holes, clustered toward the ends and around a short stepped relief on one side, with micro paired features at the end faces.

family_scale1__Z_00261_1.desc: Open-face centrifugal blower wheel: a shallow dished backplate carries one ring of backward-curved blades to a flat inlet shroud, with a tall splined hub boss, oval lightening windows in the backplate, and short radial stiffening ribs concentrated near the hub rather than a ported outer band.

family_scale1__Z_00422_1.part_family: solid rectangular-section straight bars and spacer blocks
family_scale1__Z_00422_1.desc: A same-family stepped rectangular bar in which a long prismatic body transitions to a narrower end through a single square shoulder; one transverse through-hole crosses the wider portion and the outer edges carry a small uniform chamfer, with no ribs or bosses.

family_scale1__Z_00662_0.part_family: thin cruciform spider plate with hex end openings
family_scale1__Z_00662_0.desc: Uniform-thickness flat plate with a compact central hub, a round through hole, and four arms in a cross pattern. Each arm necks from the hub and widens into a hexagonal end pad with a concentric hexagonal cut-through, using small fillets at the arm roots and a repeated fourfold pad pattern.

family_pilot__Z_00104_1.desc: Stamped and bent flat-strip tool built from a single solid spring tang that widens into a serrated thumb tab pierced by three holes. Past the tab the strip is folded in two offset bends to raise a blunt twin-prong fork tip, with full edge radii and no terminal hook.

family_scale1__Z_00777_1.desc: Flanged timing pulley with a shallow cupped disc, eight straight radial ribs, and a solid central boss with a keywayed bore. Oval lightening slots alternate with the ribs, two set-screw flats are provided, and the toothed rim has an integral retaining flange on one side.

family_scale1__Z_00603_0.desc: Open rectangular bezel: two long parallel rails are bridged by short plain end rails into a thin flat ring with a large clear center opening. Both long rails carry a single even row of small rectangular through-slots like a comb, and each rail has a low stepped outer lip in cross-section; the shell is thin and uniform with no bosses, holes, ribs, or gussets.

family_scale1__Z_00760_2.part_family: thin radial rosette plate with looped petals
family_scale1__Z_00760_2.desc: Four-lobe clover variant mixing solid and open features: two opposite lobes are solid rounded pads while the other two are open loops with almond-shaped windows. The centre has a countersunk through-hole crossed by one relieving slot, a single lobe is drawn out into a flat mounting ear with a slotted hole, and narrow stiffening beads run along the ear-to-hub transitions.

family_scale1__Z_00008_1.part_family: flat ribbed annular ring (fan/spacer) with radial vanes and mounting lugs
family_scale1__Z_00008_1.desc: Same-family annular spacer but with an enclosed solid web between six thick radial spokes instead of open windows. It uses only three mounting ears, adds obround lightening slots in the web near the hub, and has a raised cylindrical boss on one face sized to seat a bearing, with small gussets tying the spokes to the outer rim.

family_scale1__Z_00388_1.desc: A different bracket in this family is folded into a staggered Z shape with two mounting flanges on opposite sides of a central web. One flange carries a row of round holes, the other has a single slotted hole, and a small triangular gusset is welded across the tightest inside bend.

family_scale1__Z_00305_1.part_family: molded connector housing: rectangular conduit transitioning to a round splined-collar head
family_scale1__Z_00305_1.desc: A compact right-angle adaptor of the same family: a short square duct inlet turns into a single round outlet boss on the side wall rather than in line, with the boss wrapped by an external knurled grip band and a smooth through-bore that ends in an internal snap-ring groove. Two slotted mounting ears flank the duct, the shell is uniform thin wall with small corner ribs and edge chamfers, and there is no loose ring.

family_scale1__Z_00164_2.part_family: open-cell egg-crate grille of thin intersecting ribs
family_scale1__Z_00164_2.desc: A structural diffuser lattice with fewer, larger square cells, a thicker outer bezel that overhangs the rib field as a mounting flange, and countersunk fastener holes along that flange; the blades are fully slotted rather than half-lapped, cell corners are radiused for molding, and one small solid identification pad interrupts a crossing rib.

family_scale1__Z_00677_0.part_family: panel-built decorative surround with lattice grilles
family_scale1__Z_00677_0.desc: A built-up frame of thin flat panels forming a wide, shallow surround: a tall central back panel is capped by a horizontal header rail and has a broad arch cut into its lower edge, while a shorter pedestal panel on each side stands slightly forward of it. The lower half of each pedestal is pierced by a regular square lattice of many small through-openings separated by thin mullions; panels meet in square edge-to-edge butt joints with sharp corners and effectively no fillets.

family_scale1__Z_00479_1.desc: Similar flanged barrel housing, but with a circular six-bolt flange, a smooth central bore with a single keyway instead of internal teeth, two opposed side lugs carrying slotted holes, and three evenly spaced external gusset ribs along the barrel. A shallow counterbore and a face groove provide piloting and sealing at the mounting end.

family_scale1__Z_00241_2.part_family: flat multi-arm hand knob / spider plate
family_scale1__Z_00241_2.desc: Two-arm offset lever plate with an eccentric raised hub and blind bore; the longer arm terminates in a slotted keyway pad and the shorter arm in a countersunk single hole with molded finger scallops, tied together by a narrow spine rib and a perimeter chamfer.

family_scale1__Z_00809_2.desc: A wide open-box clip formed from a rectangular sheet-metal strip folded into three joined panels. The back panel holds a pair of keyhole slots plus four clearance holes in a rectangular pattern, each return leg carries one pressed threaded boss and a hemmed outer edge, and all bends use small inside radii with constant material thickness.

family_scale1__Z_00397_2.desc: A long, mild-steel half-pipe guard formed with rolled hem lips along both longitudinal edges instead of open cut rims. Two parallel shallow stiffening beads run the full length on the convex side, and a single oblong through-slot window is punched near one end for cable access. The end faces are hemmed closed by bent end caps spot-welded inside the shell.

family_scale1__Z_00215_1.desc: Compact molded terminal insulator with a solid rectangular base and one row of large through-sockets along a straight top edge; tall end caps have scalloped finger grips, the internal divider ribs are thicker with no lower bank of openings, and blind mounting bosses sit on the underside instead of a through rail.

family_scale1__Z_00509_1.desc: A bent sheet-metal version of the same grille family has a wider flange frame with hemmed outer edges and two oblong mounting slots at the short ends. Its face uses a four-by-six array of larger round through-vent holes with a generous corner fillet around the perforated field.

family_scale1__Z_00104_0.desc: A thin machined plate centered on a cylindrical hub with a through bore and a concentric seat, from which three radial arms run out to raised hexagonal pads. The pads carry a six-off pattern of small drilled holes with shallow spotfaces, and the slim webs blend into the hub and pads with fillets while the face steps between a thin web and thicker boss lands.

family_scale1__Z_00818_0.desc: Uniform-thickness flat pendant cut as a six-point snowflake: a central annular hub merges smoothly into six radial arms, and each arm carries staggered rectangular ice-crystal blocks along both edges before ending in a forked crystalline tip. Long narrow oblong slots are broached along the spines of selected arms while the others keep crossing diagonal ribs near the hub, and one arm tip extends into a small round eyelet boss pierced by a through-hole for hanging; the outer profile is crisp with small corner notches and fine relief linework.

family_scale1__Z_00361_0.desc: A thin constant-thickness round disc carries a close cluster of short hollow cylindrical bosses that pass through it: one central nozzle ringed by eight identical nozzles equally spaced on a bolt circle. Each boss stands slightly proud of the plate faces and is blended to the disc, every bore is a clean through hole, and the many bore rims and outer edges are broken with small uniform rounds while the outer rim stays plain.

family_scale1__Z_00075_2.desc: A low-profile panel with a continuous perimeter lip and a uniform egg-crate grid of identical intersecting ribs spread over the whole face; four taller corner bosses provide fastener holes above the grid, the rib upper edges are scalloped, and a single latch tab with a lead-in chamfer projects from one short side.

family_scale1__Z_00017_2.desc: An elongated near-cylindrical variant with two opposed flattened faces replacing the full hexagon. Deep axial bores enter from one end only, arranged in a triangular group beside an offset threaded boss, while the outer grip is formed by a pair of interrupted helical grooves and two through slots for a retaining clip; a full-length molded keyway spine replaces the top tab and the flute columns.

family_scale1__Z_00337_1.part_family: slotted burner caps and flame-spreader plates
family_scale1__Z_00337_1.desc: A shallow domed burner cap with a downturned cylindrical skirt and a rolled outer lip rather than a flat disk. Straight radial flame slots ring the side wall, an arched bridge handle spans the crown, and a threaded central boss is flanked by a pair of small through holes for an electrode and a fastener.

family_scale1__Z_00027_1.desc: Heavier folded sheet-metal cradle shaped as a deep U-channel with a flat web, two tall parallel sidewalls, one closed bent-up end plate, and outward mounting feet at the open end. Sidewalls use repeated obround adjustment slots and paired standoff holes, the web has a rectangular connector cutout ringed by a four-hole bolt circle, and embossed stiffening ribs run along the wall-to-web bend lines.

family_scale1__Z_00367_2.desc: A symmetrical pointed-oval connector plate rather than a stadium shape, with two perforation rows following both curved sides and a central longitudinal lacing slot. Four countersunk holes sit toward the corners, both rounded ends carry small formed-up ears, and a shallow stiffening bead runs the midline so the part remains a single sheet with no welds.

family_scale1__Z_00485_2.desc: Long narrow grille strip with several separated slot fields along its length, mixing short and long parallel slots and a few wider keyhole openings. It uses snap-fit tabs and locating posts on the back rather than a full rim, with transverse ribs between fields and a smooth bezel edge on the visible face.

family_scale1__Z_00491_2.part_family: knurled slender shaft with drilled tip
family_scale1__Z_00491_2.desc: A hollow thin-wall relative: a straight tube with a helical-groove knurled outer surface over most of its length and a continuous internal bore. One end is formed into an enlarged round flange pierced by two radial set-screw holes, while the opposite end has a short longitudinal slot and a chamfered nose, replacing the stepped solid boss and axial hole pattern.

family_scale1__Z_00251_1.part_family: thin cruciform hub with end sockets
family_scale1__Z_00251_1.desc: A three-lobed member of the same carrier family uses a through-bored center collar with three equally spaced webs ending in closed cylindrical cups; one web is widened into a slotted mounting ear and the triangular gaps remain open with fully radiused corners.

family_scale1__Z_00721_1.part_family: bent sheet-metal ventilated channel / perforated folded enclosure rail
family_scale1__Z_00721_1.desc: A shallow bent sheet-metal mounting bracket with a flat base flange and an upright face. The upright has two staggered horizontal rows of round connector holes, and the base flange has several keyhole slots for adjustable fastening; both outer edges are hemmed, with small triangular bend gussets at the corner.

family_scale1__Z_00044_1.part_family: radial leaf-scale crown finial on pedestal stem
family_scale1__Z_00044_1.desc: A flat rosette member of the same family uses a circular back plate with a single central screw boss and one radial ring of broad solid petals lying nearly in plane. The petal undersides carry short reinforcing ribs, the rim has evenly spaced mounting holes, and the outer tips are rounded rather than boxed open shells.

family_scale1__Z_00797_2.desc: An annular wave-spring retaining clip formed from flat strip into a closed ring with three equal crests and three troughs; the butted ends include one short bent anti-rotation tang and the working faces are otherwise smooth and unpierced.

family_pilot__Z_00105_1.part_family: bowed thin-gauge sheet-metal spring strip with serrated edges and lug teeth
family_pilot__Z_00105_1.desc: A similar family part: an open C-shaped flat band spring rolled on one constant radius, serrated with evenly spaced punched teeth along the outer edge only and left smooth on the inner edge. The broad face is pierced with two oblong mounting slots near the plain, slightly flared ends, and a narrow coined stiffening bead runs along the inner edge.

family_scale1__Z_00164_0.part_family: open-cell egg-crate grille of thin intersecting ribs
family_scale1__Z_00164_0.desc: A shallow rectangular egg-crate grille built from two orthogonal sets of thin straight ribs half-lapped into a regular square-cell matrix and enclosed by a continuous perimeter frame of the same depth; every cell is an open through-void, rib intersections and exposed arrises carry small chamfers, and there are no bosses, holes, or skins beyond the uniform thin-wall lattice.

family_pilot__Z_00090_2.desc: Different layout in the same family: a shallow framed lattice insert with elongated rectangular cells running one way, solid end dams, and one central divider that splits the grille into two bays. Two underside snap bosses and short locating ribs are added, while the perimeter rail remains thin and largely free of holes.

family_scale1__Z_00609_2.desc: Narrow elongated panel plate with its single large rectangular window offset toward one end and a staggered cluster of small through-holes toward the other. Two obround adjustment slots replace fixed round mounting holes, the back face has several shallow blind lightening pockets plus an L-shaped clearance notch on one edge, and the layout is deliberately asymmetric with a plain unstepped perimeter.

family_scale1__Z_00118_2.desc: Different member: a three-pad pierced spacer strip in which small rosette pads sit on a narrow waisted spine, mixing hexagonal center holes, radial keyhole slots, oval lightening openings, and sawtooth edge notches. The layout uses fewer arms per pad and adds connecting webs, but keeps the same uniform plate, rounded corners, and absence of bosses or formed walls.

family_scale1__Z_00238_2.desc: An elongated narrow vent-tray variant whose long shallow shell carries a dense uniform field of square perforations across the entire floor. A central longitudinal reinforcing rib runs beneath the floor, the short end walls are closed while the long sidewalls use intermittent snap tabs instead of a full rim, and the corner radii are noticeably larger for a softer molded edge.

family_scale1__Z_00219_2.desc: A flat round adapter flange that bridges two different mounting standards: a keyed central through bore with an internal keyway and a radial set-screw boss, an inner group of three tapped holes on a small bolt circle, and an outer group of four equidistant open-ended radial slots at the rim for adjustable clearance. The back face has a short recessed pilot counterbore, the outer edge is turned with a lead-in chamfer, and two opposed wrenching flats are milled into the rim.

family_scale1__Z_00030_0.desc: One-piece thin-walled slotted guide bracket with a flat rectangular base and an integral mounting ear pierced by two through holes. Parallel upright ribs with rounded crests stand between a taller rail and a lower rail, forming repeated open slots; all ribs are fused to the base with small root fillets and the outer corners are radiused, with no added bosses.

family_scale1__Z_00399_0.part_family: slender bent sheet-metal retaining channel/edge rail
family_scale1__Z_00399_0.desc: Elongated thin-gauge sheet-metal rail formed as an open asymmetric channel: a long flat web with one longitudinal edge folded up into a low fence and the opposite edge returned as a short hook/lip. Both ends carry small stepped ears and a shallow notch for snap retention, with a tiny tongue at one end; uniform wall thickness, no perforations, and only small bend radii at the folds.

family_scale1__Z_00543_0.desc: Open-top rectangular enclosure shell: a thin flat base panel carries two opposed long side walls built as comb-like rows of narrow vertical fins separated by through slots, thirteen per wall, that stop above a continuous solid lower rail, while two solid end panels close the cavity; one end panel carries a dense rectangular field of small pin or vent holes, all walls are thin and uniform with sharp corner joints, and the slatted walls are tied together only at the base and end caps.

family_scale1__Z_00612_2.desc: A machined steel indexing sprocket with five broad asymmetric lobes separated by deep rounded gullets and a single-sided stepped hub. The hub has a hexagonal through bore, the back face is circumferentially relieved, and three drilled-and-tapped holes sit on a bolt circle in the web next to a shallow radial grease groove.

family_pilot__Z_00090_0.desc: Thin-walled rectangular grille panel with a continuous perimeter rim co-molded to an orthogonal eggcrate of intersecting ribs. The ribs make a regular field of square through-cells over most of the face, while one side is left as a plain framed bay; walls and ribs share a uniform thickness, sit flush at the faces, and meet with small molded fillets rather than fasteners or bosses.

family_scale1__Z_00311_2.desc: An eight-position carousel plate is a scalloped ring with bolt-on pad bosses and a raised central hub using cross-drilled pin holes and a blind locating bore. Alternating arms hold rectangular sensor windows and round lightening pockets, with an outer timing notch and a continuous face groove instead of tip through holes.

family_scale1__Z_00401_2.desc: Low stiffened flanged cup: a short central boss with a countersunk through-hole sits on a broad thin flange and is tied to it by four radial gusset ribs. Put a ring of small vent holes around the flange and give the bore two opposing flats for orientation, keeping the same coaxial barrel-on-flange construction.

family_scale1__Z_00522_1.desc: Single-arm hooked clip from the same molded-bracket family: a flat rectangular mounting pad pierced by a pattern of four screw holes anchors a curved spring arm that sweeps up into a hook. The arm is stiffened underneath by longitudinal ribs, its tip carries an integral snap-fit latch, and a row of elongated vent slots follows the curve.

family_scale1__Z_00136_1.part_family: one-piece miniature dagger with integral guard and grip
family_scale1__Z_00136_1.desc: A single-bevel craft-knife variant has a clip-point blade with one sharpened edge, an offset oval guard, two straight spine ribs, and a flat tang-style grip pierced by two fastener holes plus a closed lanyard slot.

family_scale1__Z_00539_2.part_family: flat profile-cut sheet blank (thin silhouette plate)
family_scale1__Z_00539_2.desc: An elongated flat profile plate cut from thin sheet with a mostly rectangular body, a serrated/wavy edge along one long side, and a straight edge opposite; it carries an obround mounting slot near each end plus a short row of small circular lightening holes through the face. Corners are lightly radiused and the part remains entirely unformed, with no ribs, countersinks or folded flanges.

family_pilot__Z_00095_2.desc: A short cranked double open spanner carries two equal C-jaws opening to opposite sides, the shank bent in a shallow S so each head sits offset from the handle centreline. Three lightening holes are spaced across the gripped middle, small raised dimples ring the jaw roots, and both heads remain in the shank plane for tight flat spaces.

family_scale1__Z_00408_2.desc: Angled guide-rail variant: an L-section extrusion with a tall vertical leg, a short foot and a continuous longitudinal T-slot in the foot. Evenly spaced counterbored fixing holes run along the leg, two triangular reinforcing ribs sit in the corner, and the ends are coped with a small locating notch.

family_pilot__Z_00108_2.part_family: stamped and bent sheet-metal spring contact strip
family_pilot__Z_00108_2.desc: Another variant: a straight carrier rail in the same thin spring sheet with a repeated row of identical U-shaped fingers stamped and curled upward along one edge, each finger separated by a rectangular slot and finished with a rolled contact bead; the opposite edge has spaced mounting holes, a hemmed safety edge, and short stiffening ribs between fingers.

family_pilot__Z_00014_0.desc: A low one-piece ring with a regular twelve-sided outer perimeter and a matching faceted through opening, forming a constant-thickness annular band. Planar inner and outer facets are joined at chamfered vertices, with flat top and bottom faces, narrow vertical seams at the facet breaks, and small edge fillets; there are no radial holes, ears, or bosses.

family_scale1__Z_00128_1.part_family: thin molded spoke-and-ring protective grille (fan/vent guard)
family_scale1__Z_00128_1.desc: Rectangular snap-in vent grille of the same family: a shallow perimeter frame holds a bank of parallel horizontal louvers with two cross-brace ribs on the back for stiffness. Four corner bosses take screws, while short spring clips along both long edges let it push into a panel cutout; there is no central hub.

family_scale1__Z_00376_2.desc: Six-arm star variant: one central hub with a single through bearing bore sends six short radial arms out to small counterweight rings on a common circle, with alternating arms left solid and the others pierced by round lightening holes. Blind bearing pockets instead of through-seats, a scalloped outer edge, a short rib along each arm, and larger root fillets set it apart from the cup-style spinner.

family_scale1__Z_00011_1.desc: A balanced gauge pointer built from a single thin flat blank, but with a pressed-in cylindrical mounting boss near one end carrying a straight through bore instead of a rolled eye. A short weighted counter-tail extends behind the boss and carries one small adjustment hole, while the long arm steps down in width once and ends in one long bevelled needle point; the tip edges are plain ground without an eyelet, and a shallow stamped dimple marks the balance side.

family_scale1__Z_00719_1.part_family: thin toothed wheel on a spindle
family_scale1__Z_00719_1.desc: A stamped same-family sprocket uses a slightly dished web between a toothed outer ring and an integral splined hub on one face. Add several round lightening holes around the web and a single set-screw flat on the hub, leaving the opposite face plain.

family_scale1__Z_00019_1.desc: A wider member of the same family built as a shallow folded tray: flat front panel with one large central rectangular cutout, a ninety-degree perimeter flange returning toward the rear, four pressed standoff bosses near the corners, and a row of obround connector slots along the lower edge. Short pressed ribs cross the side webs for stiffness and the outer rim is hemmed, with no angled display hood and only a few clearance holes.

family_scale1__Z_00210_1.part_family: thin flat rectangular windowed spacer frame
family_scale1__Z_00210_1.desc: A similar planar spacer frame but with one long obround window instead of two, using only end cross-ribs and no central web; the rails have a lipped edge for stiffness, carry a pair of small mounting holes near each end, and repeat short lightening slots along the lower rail.

family_scale1__Z_00002_0.part_family: slotted sleeve collets and expanding mandrels
family_scale1__Z_00002_0.desc: A turned thin-wall cylindrical cup closed at one end by a smaller raised head. The head carries three equally spaced through holes on a bolt circle around a central bore and two small wrench flats, while the open end is a straight thin shell with an internal stepped counterbore and several axial slots that leave spring fingers; a small side ear projects from the shell and the edges are lightly chamfered.

family_pilot__Z_00049_0.part_family: flat paddle link plate with a bolted circular eye flange
family_pilot__Z_00049_0.desc: Thin constant-thickness plate shaped like a paddle: a round flanged eye at one end blends through generous side fillets into a tapering straight shank with a flat-cut tip. The eye carries one large central through-bore ringed by a single bolt circle of small through-holes, and several small raised rectangular pads stand off one face of the flange as locating/standoff features; the shank is a plain web with no secondary cutouts.

family_scale1__Z_00182_0.part_family: pierced and formed sheet-metal rosette ornament
family_scale1__Z_00182_0.desc: A single-thickness sheet is pierced into a sixfold star/flower: a small central hexagonal opening is ringed by alternating arrowhead, teardrop and lozenge cutouts that leave narrow radial webs and six pointed outer petals separated by scalloped notches. The flat pattern is then dished so successive petal rings sit at different heights, producing a cupped, layered blossom; a coaxial slender spike, pointed at both ends with a corrugated grip band mid-length, closes the centre as the stem, with small radiused pierce corners throughout rather than machined fillets.

family_scale1__Z_00078_0.desc: A thin flat rectangular plate whose outer edge is a solid perimeter rim with clamped corner chamfers, giving a clipped-corner outline. The working face is an open orthogonal egg-crate lattice: two intersecting sets of narrow webs form a regular array of rectangular through-cells, split by a central spine rib, while the side views show the same webs edge-on as evenly spaced thin walls of constant pitch and uniform low height.

family_scale1__Z_00152_1.desc: A narrow manifold strip in which a flat plate carries one straight row of identical through-ports along its centreline, each with a low sealing boss on the top face and a plain exit on the bottom. One long edge is extended into an integral mounting flange with slotted holes, and closed end blocks hold threaded side ports instead of protruding tube stubs.

family_scale1__Z_00703_1.desc: A shorter three-chord triangular lattice segment using round tubes joined by zig-zag web members and a single collar ring at each bay. It swaps the chord slots for welded gusset plates with two-bolt end flanges, adds a lifting lug near mid-height, and uses a wider four-hole anchor pad at the base.

family_pilot__Z_00117_2.desc: Another variant is a rounded-rectangle paddle head joined to a cranked strap through a narrow waist; the head has three lightening holes in a triangular pattern and two pressed stiffening ribs on the back, while the grip adds a single hang hole.

family_pilot__Z_00080_0.desc: A small open-top rectangular molded tray with a thin base and low perimeter wall. Integral transverse and longitudinal divider ribs split the interior into a mixed layout: a row of larger rectangular pockets on one side and a denser bank of narrow compartments on the other, with two repeating patterns of slender rectangular through-slots piercing the floor for drainage and weight reduction. Outer corners carry small radii, every internal wall junction has tiny edge fillets, and the upright walls are drafted with short stiffening ribs along the base and sides.

family_scale1__Z_00747_2.desc: Open-ended rectangular sleeve folded from sheet with a single longitudinal lap seam and one end formed into an outward mounting flange carrying two round fastener holes. Each wide face has one shallow embossed stiffening rib, while the opposite end remains a plain cut edge.

family_scale1__Z_00773_0.desc: A flat rectangular open-lattice plate made from slender straight ribs joined into enlarged square node pads at the intersections, leaving open bays between the ribs. Several node pads carry small square through-holes while others remain solid, and the whole part keeps one uniform thickness with crisp square outer corners.

family_scale1__Z_00477_2.desc: A rectangular plaque variant with a continuous outer border, a small star in one corner, alternating long and short comb teeth along the bottom edge, and several oblong mounting slots across the upper field; internal cutouts are bridged by tie bars so the part remains a single sheet.

family_scale1__Z_00162_2.desc: Stamped metal spacer frame with an off-center rectangular cutout, two elongated cable slots along one side, a folded stiffening lip on the outer edge, and eight spring fingers around the aperture. Mounting combines three clinch nuts on one edge with two keyhole tabs near the opposite corners.

family_scale1__Z_00468_0.desc: A shallow faceted bowl is formed from many concentric hexagonal plate rings of similar thickness, stacked with progressive radial offset and joined into one laminated shell. The stepped rings make sixfold symmetric inner and outer walls, end at a thin outer lip, and close around a central hexagonal across-flats seat with sharp layer corners and no separate through holes, slots, or ribs.

family_scale1__Z_00302_0.desc: One-piece machined bracket whose shallow horizontal base is drawn into four diagonal arms ending in drilled feet, while two parallel upright plates with semicircular tombstone tops rise from the base to form an open clevis channel joined by a bottom web. The upright outer faces carry a dense symmetric cluster of through holes with shallow spotfaces, the floor between the plates holds a line of plain vertical holes plus a central four-hole bolt circle, and the splayed arms are lightened by triangular cutouts with a fastener hole at each foot and small fillets at the junctions.

family_scale1__Z_00415_0.desc: A constant-thickness metal leaf: one straight rectangular web is joined along a long edge to a small curled cylindrical eye with a through bore, formed tangentially so the web extends from the barrel; the ends are square and the web is otherwise plain.

family_scale1__Z_00808_2.desc: A stamped, lightly formed sheet-metal member of the same slide family built as a flat elongated ladder frame: two parallel rails joined by several narrow cross-bridges, pierced with oblong adjustment slots and lance-formed retention dimples, one end curled up into a pull tab and the opposite end notched with symmetrical entry chamfers, with all edges deburred instead of generously radiused.

family_scale1__Z_00803_1.desc: A similar flat gear web using eight arched window slots around a splined center bore, with short radial ribs between windows and a shallow recessed mounting face at the hub. Use a full perimeter of spur teeth plus a few small locating holes in the web away from the spokes.

family_scale1__Z_00626_2.part_family: slender precision-profiled metal extrusion bar (miniature toothed/splined rack) with axial bores
family_scale1__Z_00626_2.desc: A flatter heat-rail variant: a wide, low ribbon extrusion with a dense row of thin rounded-top fins standing on one broad face and a smooth opposite face, two longitudinal gland channels inside the web, and several crosswise half-notches for pass-throughs; the fins stop short of both ends, leaving plain lands for clamping or brazing.

family_scale1__Z_00503_0.part_family: open rectangular frame of thin channel rails
family_scale1__Z_00503_0.desc: Flat open rectangular bezel made from four narrow constant-section channel rails joined end to end at square corners by small external corner blocks or ears. A continuous longitudinal groove runs along the inner edge of the rails, the wall is thin and uniform with a fully open center and square corners, and short paired locating tabs project outward at the corners and at spaced points along the rails.

family_scale1__Z_00820_1.desc: A similar annular rotor but thicker, with a raised cylindrical hub around a keyed central bore and a separate bolt circle of countersunk mounting holes. The web mixes short straight radial through slots near the rim with solid spokes, while the outer edge is scalloped between slots and the hub face carries shallow lightening pockets, so fasteners, slots and pockets share the annulus rather than one uniform swirl.

family_scale1__Z_00786_0.part_family: thin multi-rail ladder guide frame with end plates
family_scale1__Z_00786_0.desc: A flat open ladder frame built from two identical thin vertical end plates rigidly joined by three parallel horizontal tie bars seated into the plates. Each end plate carries a vertical row of short rectangular edge slots on its inner side and small pierced mounting lugs projecting outward at the top and bottom; the bar ends have angled lead-in chamfers, and a middle bar is cross-drilled with a pair of small through holes, with only small edge breaks throughout.

family_scale1__Z_00823_0.desc: Straight square hollow aluminum extrusion cut to a fixed length with square unfinished ends. Four longitudinal T-slot grooves run the full length, one centered on each outer face, each with a narrow opening, recessed side walls and retaining lips, and small fillets at the slot mouth; inside, a thin cross-shaped web ties the walls to a single central axial through-hole, with small longitudinal corner passages and rounded outside corners.

family_scale1__Z_00584_1.part_family: thin stamped annular retainer ring with perimeter tabs and notches
family_scale1__Z_00584_1.desc: A closed flat lock ring of the same annular thin-plate type but with an asymmetric lug set: four external tabs arranged as two longer screw-clearance ears opposite two short pilot ears, a single radial anti-rotation keyway on the bore, and one slotted mounting hole plus one round tooling hole. A shallow coined stiffening bead runs just inside the outer edge, with three small lightening piercings spaced unevenly to clear mating fasteners.

family_scale1__Z_00045_2.desc: Short straight spacer version of the same thin-wall rectangular section having only two window openings, a doubled central web for stiffness, countersunk screw holes in place of bolt-circle clusters, a single longitudinal keyway slot in the back wall, closed end caps with threaded inserts, and no edge scalloping.

family_scale1__Z_00681_1.desc: Shallow channel variant: twin side rails are joined by a thin web to make a long U-section strip, with one cross bore in the web and a four-notch keying pattern at each end. Inner rail roots are filleted, outer mouth edges are chamfered, and only a short run of teeth is provided near one end.

family_scale1__Z_00794_1.desc: A single-ended version of the same stamped flat-tool family: one open multi-point ring jaw on the end of a long straight tang, with a wider entrance gap and an external gripping flat on the jaw back. The tang carries a circular hanging hole near the tail, a short pry claw at the grip end, and a narrow embossed stiffening bead running most of its length. It remains a planar gauge plate with filleted transitions, differing from the reference by having only one working head, an added through-hole, a claw, and a pressed bead.

family_scale1__Z_00058_1.part_family: molded plastic fir-tree wire-harness routing clips
family_scale1__Z_00058_1.desc: Wider push-mount harness retainer with two mirrored Y-heads sharing one center stem, giving four upright posts in a row tied together by a thin bridging web. The common shank uses fewer, deeper fir-tree fins and adds a round locating boss and an anti-rotation rib under the head; cradle mouths get lead-in chamfers and small retaining lips, and triangular gussets stiffen the post bases in place of some edge chamfers.

family_scale1__Z_00638_2.part_family: finned hollow extrusion with gabled profile
family_scale1__Z_00638_2.desc: Open-bottom ribbed channel rather than a closed tube: a flat base with smooth inner walls rises into a curved arch whose outer surface alone is finned like a half-round heat sink. Two internal screw-boss ducts run the full length to take end-cap fasteners, and side lips form a snap seat for a separate flat cover, leaving the underside open for gear or wiring.

family_scale1__Z_00699_0.desc: A short sawn length of constant-section T-slot framing extrusion, with a tall narrow rectangular profile carried through a small thickness. Four plain through-bores sit in one central column, internal ribs divide the section into four chambers, and the perimeter has repeated T-slot lips, side notches, many chamfered slot edges, and small corner radii.

family_scale1__Z_00394_2.desc: Bent clevis-style bracket of the same lug family: two parallel cheeks joined by a back web, each cheek holding an aligned boss on a common cross-pin axis; the back web has one lightening window, a reinforcing rib along the bend line, and countersunk mounting holes.

family_scale1__Z_00066_1.desc: A compact two-by-two version of the same family: four equal ring bodies fused into a rounded clover-shaped plate, plus a raised central boss with one through-hole and one small mounting hole in each outer lobe. The outer profile is rolled smooth rather than chamfered, and shallow pockets are cut in the webs between adjacent rings.

family_scale1__Z_00324_0.desc: A thin flat spur-gear disc with straight external teeth (twenty) cut around the outer edge and a short cylindrical hub raised on one side of the annular web. The hub is concentric with a through bore that combines an internal hex drive seat with a round pilot bore, and the tooth roots and tips carry small radii. The boss is cross-drilled for a transverse pin and also has several small angled set-screw holes plus a larger stepped through hole with a shallow counterbore.

family_scale1__Z_00465_1.part_family: perforated slotted miniature metal rail strip
family_scale1__Z_00465_1.desc: A wider flat mounting strip of the same stamped-profile family carrying one central full-length slot flanked by three staggered hole rows. One end is notched for indexing while the opposite end has an obround take-up slot, and periodic countersunk holes plus a shallow pressed stiffening rib interrupt the plain perforation pattern.

family_scale1__Z_00030_2.desc: Heavier enclosed variant built as an L-shaped base-and-cheek shell with one high wall, one low return and divider webs on one side only. Counterbored fixing holes, a reinforced end boss, intermittent relief cutouts between webs and large edge radii give a different feature mix.

family_scale1__Z_00434_1.desc: Four-arm version of the same thin perforated-plate family, with four equal bearing bores arranged around a small central web; each arm carries a teardrop lightening slot and the rim is scalloped rather than continuously circular.

family_scale1__Z_00364_2.desc: A related short removable rail panel: two horizontal rails and four posts make a ladder-like fence, but the base channel is replaced by end lugs with clearance holes and a spring-latch boss; one bay is filled with a perforated sheet while the others stay open.

family_scale1__Z_00299_2.desc: A symmetrical spring-retainer variant bent from the same rounded strap stock, with opposed closed loops at both ends, a central latch tongue carrying one elongated slot and a small coined dimple, plus a folded safety catch that overlaps the tongue.

family_scale1__Z_00740_1.desc: A narrow spring-steel shim bent to a single constant-radius arc rather than an S-curve, with both long edges straight and parallel. A centered obround slot replaces the round holes, one short end is turned up into a small mounting ear with its own hole, and the opposite end is left as a plain tapered tongue.

family_scale1__Z_00344_1.desc: A flat right-triangular cover panel of constant thickness carrying one large centered rounded-rectangle window and a short oblong slot near the base. Three small round mounting holes sit one at each corner beside raised cylindrical bosses, the two legs carry a sparse row of pinholes, and the outer rim is a simple filleted edge with no perimeter recess.

family_scale1__Z_00052_1.part_family: open cage frame of hollow profile rails
family_scale1__Z_00052_1.desc: A flat rectangular chassis ring from the same hollow slotted profile, with four outer edge rails and two internal cross-rails splitting it into three bays. Only the outer rails use four-hole through patterns, while the cross-rails take blind holes; each corner is a butt joint backed by a single diagonal gusset, and the rail ends carry small cylindrical stacking bosses instead of upright pockets.

family_scale1__Z_00704_0.part_family: extruded linear rail with a pocketed end block
family_scale1__Z_00704_0.desc: A long, straight, thin-walled multi-chamber extrusion forms the spine, with internal webs, a central screw boss and small corner cavities visible in cross-section. One end carries a compact, heavily pocketed block/cage with several rectangular openings, counterbored mounting holes and one deep rectangular recess; the top web is drilled with a repeated pattern of cross holes and short slots at mostly even pitch, plus one angled edge cut, all with crisp machined breaks rather than cast fillets.

family_scale1__Z_00221_1.desc: An eight-arm starburst mounting plate of the same general family: solid tapered ribs radiate from a thickened central boss with a counterbored bore to a continuous scalloped outer rim, with round lightening holes in the web between ribs instead of open frames or perforations. All ribs share one plate thickness and blend into the hub with generous fillets.

family_scale1__Z_00355_2.desc: Bonded-fin radiator variant: a thin spreader plate with a corrugated serpentine fin strip brazed across its top to make many narrow front-to-back air channels, flanked by two side flanges with slotted mounting ears and hemmed outer edges instead of discrete machined fins.

family_pilot__Z_00007_2.desc: Compact manifold version with a thick rectangular base, two mounting ears, and a low fin pack pressed around a central insert. A cartridge-heater pocket and a threaded sensor port sit on perpendicular faces, the output boss is angled from the base, and the nose uses a snap-ring groove instead of a stepped coupling.

family_pilot__Z_00113_0.desc: A thin elongated rectangular grille with a raised perimeter bezel and rounded outer corners. Many closely spaced vertical vanes span between the long rails to form narrow slots, with small fillets at the vane roots; a shallow rectangular pocket is recessed into the face and short mounting tabs project from the short ends.

family_scale1__Z_00754_2.desc: A flatter axial-flow member of the same family: a wide outer mounting flange with several screw ears, a ring of numerous curved blades angled to the axis, and a cupped central hub with a metal insert; there is no peripheral cage, and a thin shroud ring ties the blade tips on one side only.

family_pilot__Z_00031_2.part_family: ribbed molded control tray with thumbwheel
family_pilot__Z_00031_2.desc: Another same-family variant is a deeper curved cover with an end roller pocket and stub shaft, using three transverse floor ribs, local gussets and two insert bosses. It leaves out the full tray rim and adds a latch tongue plus a closed outer wall.

family_scale1__Z_00239_2.desc: Another variant is an elongated two-prong clevis-like plate: a wide filleted spine joins two parallel fingers, the finger tips carry slotted holes for adjustable fastening, the spine adds a single hexagonal recess, a few round standoff bosses and lightening scallops, and three edges are chamfered while one long edge is left as a flat datum.

family_scale1__Z_00383_1.desc: Same constant-thickness plate family but laid out as a triangular bell-crank rocker: three round eye lugs at the corners each carry a through bore, one larger bore at the apex and two matched smaller bores at the base corners, joined by a web whose edges are relieved with deep concave scallops between the lugs. Add one short integral standoff on a single face of the apex eye, keep every outer corner filleted, and omit feet and the lower arch.

family_scale1__Z_00364_1.desc: A related corner guard-rail module: the same open picket construction is bent into a shallow L, with fewer wider bays, a thicker mounting foot under the lower stringer, and triangular gussets tying the end posts to the foot.

family_scale1__Z_00338_2.desc: Machined cylindrical-roller cage for a larger bearing: two thicker cheek rings joined by a reduced count of heavier bridges that make fewer deep roller pockets, each bridge carrying a central lubrication groove and generous fillets where it meets the rims, with one rim stepped into a locating shoulder for axial seating.

family_pilot__Z_00061_1.desc: A closed elliptical ring of the same ribbed molded profile, with the decorative section following the curve and small crest bosses at the ends of the long axis. The back has a continuous retaining rabbet plus several equally spaced keyhole mounting slots, and the inner lip is a smooth rounded bead rather than a sharp rectangular reveal.

family_scale1__Z_00558_1.desc: Rectangular single-slot framing extrusion with an open T-slot on the top face only and three closed faces; the body is a thin-walled hollow shell stiffened by two internal web ribs. Each end carries integral corner bosses sized for thread-forming screws, and the outer edges are softly radiused rather than chamfered.

family_scale1__Z_00661_1.part_family: long bent sheet-metal angle rail with punched square slots
family_scale1__Z_00661_1.desc: A shorter cold-formed Z-section sheet rail: a central vertical web holds one staggered row of obround slots mixed with a few round tooling holes, while the two opposed edge flanges are plain except for several round mounting holes near the ends. Small pressed dimples sit between slots for stiffness, both ends are notched, and all folds use a single inside bend radius.

family_pilot__Z_00004_0.part_family: flat multirotor frame plate (X-arm drone plate)
family_pilot__Z_00004_0.desc: Thin uniform-thickness flat plate profiled as a four-armed X/cross radiating from a compact central hub. Each arm is a narrow truss-like strip ending in an enlarged circular pad drilled with motor-mount through holes, while the hub carries several concentric bolt-circle patterns of small through holes for stacked electronics and arm hardware; arm roots blend into the hub with generous fillets and there are no vertical walls or formed features.

family_scale1__Z_00641_0.desc: A thin stamped and gently dished lotus rosette built from constant-width open petal outlines rather than solid petals. Multiple pointed inner petals and broader outer petals radiate from a short central cylindrical collar; the collar is a concentric boss with a plain through bore and sits on a small neck having two opposing across-flat wrench faces plus a short lower mounting tab, with generous fillets at every petal root.

family_scale1__Z_00209_1.desc: A rectangular flat aluminum cover plate of the same thin perforated family, but with a true grid of identical threaded holes, one large rectangular window at the center, and a row of short connector slots along one long edge. The back face carries a few small raised standoff pads and one edge is folded into a right-angle mounting flange, with the outer perimeter deburred rather than heavily chamfered.

family_scale1__Z_00097_2.desc: Stepped circular baffle plate that is thin at the rim and thickens through a filleted transition into a central hub. Eight small through-holes surround one oversized central through-bore on a single bolt circle, alternating plain holes with two slotted clearance holes clocked off the pattern. The back face carries shallow lightening pockets between the holes and an external timing notch, with generous fillets at the hub-to-web step and a chamfer only on the central bore.

family_scale1__Z_00540_1.desc: Single-port variant: one C-shaped folded body hangs from a flat mounting ear, with one slotted contact window, three round mounting holes, an open rear, and embossed ribs across the rails instead of a second end plate.
