family_scale1__Z_00066_0.desc: A thin flat disc built from several short annular ring bodies standing normal to the face, tangent to one another and fused into a single cluster with a scalloped outer rim. It has one small central through-hole, three large through-holes equally spaced on an inner pattern, and three smaller through-holes equally spaced on an outer pattern, with small chamfers broken on the hole edges and the outside edge.

family_scale1__Z_00580_2.desc: A flat skeleton spacer plate built as a rectangular perimeter ring with two crossing diagonal braces, lightened by a repeated row of teardrop cutouts along each side and by elongated adjustment slots in the braces. Four integral cylindrical standoff bosses project from the inner corners on one face only, the opposite face remains flat, outer corners are chamfered, inner junctions are radiused, and a symmetric set of small countersunk holes completes the pattern.

family_scale1__Z_00426_2.part_family: formed thin-gauge sheet-metal sloped edging strip
family_scale1__Z_00426_2.desc: Stepped cover strip: the sheet breaks from an inclined entry land onto a flat central plateau and then drops into a single down-turned mounting flange, giving a Z-shaped section; three pressed longitudinal beads stiffen the plateau, the flange holds two obround holes, and each bend corner is relieved with a small notch. Bevelled edges are omitted in favour of square sheared edges.

family_scale1__Z_00496_0.desc: One-piece shallow cylindrical wheel with a narrow outer tread band carrying evenly spaced rectangular lugs around its circumference; a small central hub with a bore is tied to the band by eight curved, slightly twisted radial spokes, and concentric rim rings with short tie segments stiffen the tread edge. Spoke roots blend into the hub and rim with small fillets, giving a thin flat disc with the same spoke pattern readable on the front face.

family_scale1__Z_00057_0.desc: Thin constant-thickness plate blanked to a long spear outline: a narrow triangular head with a center ridge line rises from a short neck, passes through a grip section carrying several evenly spaced shallow rounded-rectangular embossed pads on one face, and terminates in a flared faceted mounting foot. All profile and pad edges carry one small uniform edge round; there are no through-holes, slots, ribs or separate bosses, just the single embossed-pad pattern and the integral foot.

family_scale1__Z_00756_0.desc: Thin flat annular plate whose outer edge is cut as a continuous ring of sprocket/gear teeth. The center is a plain through bore with a nearby larger circular feature, and a single ring of many small through holes is equally spaced on one mid-radius bolt circle. The body is one uniform sheet with a small edge bevel on the rim and holes; there are no ribs, spokes, or raised bosses.

family_scale1__Z_00677_2.part_family: panel-built decorative surround with lattice grilles
family_scale1__Z_00677_2.desc: A symmetrical bridge variant of the same panel family in which two tall side towers are joined only by a top rail, leaving the bottom center fully open. Each tower face mixes feature types: an upper band of circular through-holes over a lower bank of square lattice, a scalloped apron rail along the bottom, and plugged dowel joints at the corners instead of plain butt seams.

family_scale1__Z_00223_1.desc: Low-profile hexacopter centre chassis made from two parallel flat plates, an upper deck and a lower deck, tied together by short standoff bosses. Six radial arms leave a polygonal hub and end in three-hole motor pads; the plates include a central battery opening, long lightening slots along the arms, and scattered wiring and cable-tie holes.

family_scale1__Z_00550_1.desc: One-piece ring-gear rotor with internal teeth in the center bore and a smooth outer rim. A raised stepped hub on one face carries countersunk mounting holes, while curved lightening slots and short radial ribs break up the web between hub and rim.

family_scale1__Z_00632_0.desc: Straight constant-profile metal extrusion, far longer than its slim rectangular cross-section. Both broad faces carry dense longitudinal fins/flutes with thin perimeter walls, while three tiny through-bores and two longitudinal channels run the full length; every flute root, fin edge and corner is softened with small fillets, and the ends are plain cut-offs.

family_scale1__Z_00598_2.part_family: toothed/serrated flanged ring on a cylindrical hub with through bore
family_scale1__Z_00598_2.desc: A hubbed serrated ring laid out for adjustment: straight tooth-like ridges only around the outer circumference, an internal hexagonal drive instead of a plain round hole, and the hub split into two lengths by an external groove with two diametrically opposed radial threaded holes for locking screws. One face has a chamfered lead-in and a shallow counterbore, and the serrations run over only part of the flange thickness.

family_scale1__Z_00388_0.desc: One uniform sheet is folded into an open tapered support with a broad top flange, a downturned side leg, and an irregular pointed web profile with a concave underside. The planar faces meet at crisp bend lines, and the part has no through holes, slots, ribs, bosses, or repeated features.

family_scale1__Z_00507_0.desc: Thick-walled cylindrical ring with a smooth outer barrel integrally joined to an internal toothed bore. The bore carries a dense circumferential pattern of straight internal teeth with relieved plain bands at the ends, while four equally spaced through holes pierce the annular wall on a bolt circle and the tooth and hole edges are rounded.

family_scale1__Z_00528_0.part_family: flat serpentine flexure plate (labyrinth-slotted thin panel)
family_scale1__Z_00528_0.desc: Thin flat rectangular plate of uniform thickness carrying a dense through-cut labyrinth: nested rectangular meanders spiral in toward a small solid central island, with several long straight parallel slots in the outer field. The cuts leave a network of slender ligaments that tie the island and inner loops to a solid outer rim, so the plate acts as a planar serpentine spring; slot ends are relieved with small fillets and there are no other bosses or mounting holes.

family_scale1__Z_00391_2.part_family: thin embossed round cover/dial plate with a curved dividing rib and bored bosses
family_scale1__Z_00391_2.desc: A low oval lid using the same embossed-rib language: a serpentine rib snakes from end to end to form three lanes, switching the bosses to four counterbored corner pads and adding one oblong sight window near the middle. A continuous raised gasket bead follows the perimeter, and short cross-ribs bridge the lanes instead of a scroll divider.

family_scale1__Z_00513_2.part_family: thin punched sheet-metal vent grille panel
family_scale1__Z_00513_2.desc: A rectangular ventilation cover is punched with two banks of short parallel louver slots that angle toward a central solid spine rather than forming concentric rings. Its perimeter is bent up into a narrow stiffening flange, the midpoints of the sides carry elongated keyhole mounting slots, and several small dimpled standoffs raise the sheet slightly from the mating surface.

family_scale1__Z_00242_1.desc: A same-family circular cover whose face is a single wagon-wheel field of radial spokes running from a solid central hub to the rim, tied together by two concentric reinforcing rings. The hub has a central through-hole and a shallow logo recess, and the back of the rim carries three equally spaced snap-fit tongues for clipping into a round opening.

family_scale1__Z_00540_0.desc: Open sheet-metal cage with two upright end plates tied by folded rails and a central web into a rectangular through-frame. The perforated end plate carries patterned columns of round through holes and small edge radii, while the inner rails hold two side-by-side banks filled with regular rows of narrow slots; short bent flanges stiffen the panel edges.

family_scale1__Z_00562_2.desc: A low-profile louvered vent frame with a sturdy outer rim and one bank of closely spaced angled blades running horizontally across the opening for airflow deflection. The end stiles are reinforced with small integral gussets, the outer corners are rounded, and the back edge has a continuous retention lip and snap tabs for holding a mesh insert.

family_scale1__Z_00649_2.part_family: flat serrated ratchet wheel with hex hub
family_scale1__Z_00649_2.desc: A serrated gear-sector segment from the same flat toothed-plate family: only a partial arc of the rim carries the triangular teeth, terminating in two radial end faces with an integral stop lug near one end. The solid inner pad has a hexagonal through-bore and three straight radial relief slots, and a narrow raised rib runs along the untoothed back edge for stiffness.

family_scale1__Z_00531_0.desc: This part is a single very slender hollow pin rolled into a round tube from spring strip, with one straight axial slot running uninterrupted from end to end so the wall forms an open C-section. The outside is smooth and unthreaded with no head, flange, cross holes, ribs, or bosses, and both ends carry a small lead-in chamfer; the seam edges read as fine axial lines along the barrel.

family_scale1__Z_00277_0.desc: Constant-thickness metal strip bent into a shallow arc, with straight gear teeth cut along the inner concave edge so they point radially inward and span the strip width. A wider rectangular end boss caps each tip; one boss carries a rectangular through-pocket on its top face while the opposite end has a small notched pad. The toothed band and plain back rail are one continuous piece, the teeth formed as a dense repeated pattern along the arc.

family_scale1__Z_00501_0.desc: Elongated low-profile molded-plastic frame with a row of long parallel contact slots running along its top face, divided by a central keying web; the underside carries several hexagonal across-flats bosses of differing sizes, two large semicircular relief cutouts, and a pair of partially drilled mounting holes; tiny through-holes pierce the side walls and diagonal reinforcing ribs brace the interior near each end.

family_scale1__Z_00261_2.desc: Closed double-shroud pump impeller: opposed convex cover disks enclose alternating full and splitter vanes around a flanged hub, using a small through bore, crescent balance holes near the outer band, and a machined pilot face; the rim is smooth with a few locating notches instead of scallops and side ports.

family_scale1__Z_00036_0.desc: One-piece crankshaft built around a straight line of coaxial main-bearing journals with several offset crank-pin throws between them. Each pin is carried by a pair of profiled crank cheeks whose outer edges form rounded counterweight lobes, and every journal-to-cheek transition is blended with a generous fillet. At the rear the mains end in an integral circular mounting flange whose face holds a bolt-hole circle, a central pilot bore with a cross/key detail, and a dense pattern of lightening scallops and small blend radii; at the front the shaft continues as a plain cylindrical output snout.

family_scale1__Z_00528_2.part_family: flat serpentine flexure plate (labyrinth-slotted thin panel)
family_scale1__Z_00528_2.desc: Rectangular planar spring panel arranged as two mirrored serpentine banks separated by a solid central mounting strip that carries a row of clearance holes. Each bank is a repeated back-and-forth meander of even pitch ending in rounded slot terminations within a solid perimeter frame; one short edge adds an alignment notch and a pair of tooling holes, with a few narrow tie tabs bridging frame to meander.

family_pilot__Z_00015_2.desc: Eight-lobe handwheel knob with a thin outer ring on short spokes around a solid hub that has a D-shaped bore and a top index recess. The periphery alternates large thumb scallops with fine axial flutes, and one lobe is extended into a pointer for an asymmetric operating position.

family_scale1__Z_00796_0.desc: Single-piece open C-ring of nearly square rectangular cross-section, formed as one continuous concentric band with a smooth inner through bore and matching outer cylindrical face. A narrow gap interrupts the lower arc, finishing in two slightly splayed angled end faces; the part has no holes, ribs, bosses, or slots, only small edge chamfers at the cut ends.

family_scale1__Z_00263_1.desc: A closed four-sided version of the same stamped bezel family: a continuous thin rectangular ring surrounds a single central window, with one small clearance hole near each corner and a pair of elongated alignment slots on one side. Two opposite inner edges are lanced into a row of inward spring fingers for electrical/contact grounding, while the other edges stay plain and one outer corner has a small lead-in chamfer.

family_scale1__Z_00129_2.part_family: hubbed toothed drive sprocket / timing pulley
family_scale1__Z_00129_2.desc: Flanged clamp-hub sibling: a narrow curvilinear-tooth belt pulley captive between two thin guide flanges, mounted on a split hub closed by one transverse pinch bolt. The bore is smooth with a short locating counterbore on the back face, the front face has a shallow recess and a small pattern of tapped holes for an adapter, tooth roots are generously filleted, and the outer corners of both flanges are rounded.

family_pilot__Z_00004_1.part_family: flat multirotor frame plate (X-arm drone plate)
family_pilot__Z_00004_1.desc: Unibody quadcopter base plate cut from a single flat sheet: a rectangular central deck with two opposing arms in a stretched H layout rather than an X. Feature mix differs, with countersunk motor holes at the arm tips, long battery-strap slots across the deck, and large lightening cutouts in each arm, and only a sparse set of mounting holes around the deck perimeter.

family_scale1__Z_00438_0.desc: One constant-width, uniform-thickness strip is swept into a half-arch with continuous inner and outer curved edges and a plain rectangular cross-section. Three rectangular through-openings pierce the band: a wider opening at the crown and narrower openings toward both feet, with square-cut ends and only small edge reliefs.

family_scale1__Z_00265_1.part_family: thin radial spider plate with peripheral sockets
family_scale1__Z_00265_1.desc: A same-family flat spider plate but arranged as a four-way cross: a compact square hub with a keyed round bore blends into four straight tapered arms that end in circular pads, each pad holding a single counterbored round through-hole rather than a hex socket, and low raised ribs run between adjacent arms on one face only.

family_scale1__Z_00769_0.desc: An open, roughly rounded-rectangular loop formed in-plane from one constant-thickness flat metal strip whose six long edge corners are rolled. The band runs from a free lower end up an outward-flaring angled leg, over a long gently crowned top joined by generous bend fillets to a short downturned right leg with large corner radii, and back along a flat base leg to the other free end, leaving a gap; there are no holes, ribs, or bosses.

family_scale1__Z_00678_2.desc: A stepped narrow terminal rail whose thin perforated web, densely drilled with small holes, is flanked by a thicker spine containing only a few tapped holes. An elongated central slot interrupts the hole field, and one end is angle-cut with a single cross-drilled pin hole.

family_scale1__Z_00578_0.desc: A thin uniform-gage plate cut to a symmetric double-chevron stylized-W silhouette. A short narrow flange is turned up continuously around the outer perimeter and around each internal V-notch, leaving a flat recessed field inside the offset inner edge; the rear face carries small stiffening ribs and standoff pads, and there are no through-holes. Outer corners use many equal generous fillets, with a few smaller fillets at the notch roots and pointed base.

family_scale1__Z_00508_1.desc: A louvered vent cover in the same family uses a perimeter mounting flange instead of a deep channel, with several staggered rows of short pressed louvers, two fastening ears, and a small central reinforcing boss.

family_scale1__Z_00500_0.part_family: radial plate-vane rotor with drive hub
family_scale1__Z_00500_0.desc: A low-profile radial-plate rotor: a short solid hub with a central hexagonal through-bore for a mating shaft carries a complete ring of many thin, straight, flat fins whose planes radiate from the common axis, so the end view reads as dense spokes while the axial profile stays a narrow disc. The fins are formed integrally with the hub, are open at their outer tips with no surrounding shroud, and are arranged around the circumference in several repeating groups that mix different fin widths and spacings; the hub face carries a small centering mark and the outer rim edges are left sharp.

family_scale1__Z_00615_2.desc: A three-lobed locator plate of the same flat-profile family: three unequal arms radiate from an offset hub, one arm includes a closed keyway slot, another has a single round mounting hole, and the perimeter combines several bevelled teeth with a few radiused re-entrant corners; the part remains one solid plate extruded straight through its thickness.

family_scale1__Z_00383_2.desc: Same flat linkage-plate family as a slender symmetric dogbone: uniform-thickness plate with a through-bored eye at each end, one oversized eye and one small pin eye, connected by a narrowed waist. Pierce the waist with one long closed lightening slot plus two round tooling holes, use generous fillets at the eye-to-waist blends, and provide no forked legs, arch cutout, or mounting feet.

family_pilot__Z_00064_0.desc: Thin-walled open rectangular molded frame: a rim ring open top and bottom, with one long edge built up into a slotted header carrying a single row of evenly spaced rectangular apertures separated by narrow ribs with small root radii; the adjacent sides fold down into an L-section skirt ending in out-turned feet with through mounting holes, while short side ears project at mid height, each pierced with a through hole; inside are small standoff bosses, an obround slot, rounded outer corners and uniform fillets at every wall junction, plus a low raised step running along the rim.

family_scale1__Z_00462_0.part_family: snowflake/gear hub plate with radial hex sockets
family_scale1__Z_00462_0.desc: Thin flat plate of nearly uniform thickness with a six-lobed snowflake outline. A raised central annular boss carries a smooth through bore; six identical raised hexagonal cups, each an outer hex boss with an inner hex recess, sit on a common pitch around the ring and are tied to it by short radial webs plus small bridges between neighbors. Rim edges and pocket mouths are chamfered, the web junctions are filleted, and the thin edge face carries a fine ribbed texture with a split witness line.

family_scale1__Z_00454_1.part_family: pocketed annular component-carrier ring with standoff legs
family_scale1__Z_00454_1.desc: A similar carrier is a shallower full ring with eight deeper, blind snap-in bays rather than through-windows, bounded by thicker radial webs and a raised locating key on the inner edge. Instead of legs it uses three molded screw bosses under the rim plus an elastic latch skirt around the outer diameter, with a continuous cable channel recessed into the back face.

family_scale1__Z_00718_0.desc: Straight constant-section prismatic metal extrusion, much longer than its cross-size, cut square at both ends. The end profile packs several round axial through-bores into clustered thick webs, with thin dense longitudinal ribs/fins running the full length on the outer faces; bore mouths and long outer edges carry small chamfers and re-entrant rib roots carry small fillets, the same hole pattern appearing at each end.

family_scale1__Z_00658_1.desc: A similar profiled metal rail, but with a symmetric oval-rectangular section, four axial bores around a central web, and one deep side keyway. The faces are mostly smooth with two rows of coarse longitudinal flutes and chamfered ends rather than a full transverse tooth pattern.

family_pilot__Z_00008_1.desc: A round member of the same grille family: a solid outer ring and small central hub are tied together by radial spokes crossed by concentric ribs, making wedge-shaped open cells instead of square ones. The rim has evenly spaced plain through-holes and a few integral rear snap tabs for retention, with no counterbores and smoothly rounded rather than chamfered edges.

family_scale1__Z_00146_1.desc: Similar bezel laid out for a display: an off-center wide cutout sits in a closed front face with a perimeter sealing groove, while three mounting bosses on one edge and opposing cantilever snap tabs replace the four-hole ear pattern. The back is mostly closed with one cable slot, and radial ribs around the bosses stiffen the corners.

family_scale1__Z_00387_1.desc: A related wiring cover uses the same half-round thin shell but adds two outward mounting flanges along the springing edges. Put a single row of round clearance holes in each flange and one shallow pressed bead along the crown, leaving both ends open.

family_scale1__Z_00007_1.desc: An eight-point star spacer ring with broader, slightly asymmetric points and a thicker wall. Every other inner valley carries a counterbored through-hole for fasteners, one face is relieved by a shallow concentric groove, and the outer star tips are chamfered for safe handling.

family_scale1__Z_00775_2.desc: A denser twelve-arm openwork coaster/trivet cut from one flat sheet: twelve evenly spaced spokes each branch into three pairs of rounded side twigs, and instead of one center hole the hub is an annular ring tied to the spokes by narrow ligaments with several pierced openings. A single obround hanging slot is added near one rim; thickness is constant and all edges are profile-cut with generous tip fillets.

family_scale1__Z_00464_0.desc: A straight, open-ended rectangular hollow shell of constant thin wall and small oblong cross-section, with plain square-cut ends and no ribs, bosses, flanges or fillets. Along evenly pitched stations it carries many small round through-holes: a two-across array repeated down the broad face and a matching single line of cross holes on the adjoining narrow face, all piercing the shell.

family_scale1__Z_00130_2.desc: A compact single-row grounding-bar variant: a short solid block with only four large hex-socket clamping terminals aligned over four big round wire bores, keyhole-style mounting slots at each end, fully radiused corners, and a shallow milled pocket on the underside sized to accept a rail clip.

family_scale1__Z_00532_0.desc: One continuous slender strip of constant open U cross-section: a flat thin web joined along both long edges to two short parallel side flanges by tight bends, so the whole part is a single thin-walled channel rather than assembled bodies; both ends are plain square-cut and open, with no holes, slots, ribs, bosses or added pads, only the continuous inner bend lines showing as hidden edges and essentially sharp corners.

family_scale1__Z_00338_0.desc: One-piece thin cylindrical cage ring: two concentric side rims are tied together by many evenly spaced radial crossbars, forming a continuous circle of open rectangular roller pockets around the central bore; the pocket bridges repeat in a pattern of two slightly different across-flats widths, the outer rim carries small regular tabs, and all edges are crisp with shell-like thin walls and no other holes.

family_scale1__Z_00431_2.desc: Stamped cam-lever plate in the same family: a wide pivot lobe with a large bore and an embossed concentric boss ring, tapering into an offset arm that ends in a closed keyhole slot rather than a plain hole. Two small mounting holes pierce the arm, an integral locating tab is bent up near the pivot, and shallow lightening pockets are coined into the face with smooth fillets at every junction.

family_scale1__Z_00406_2.part_family: thin slatted rectangular grille / vent cover panel
family_scale1__Z_00406_2.desc: Louvered cover strip in the same family: a shallow rectangular frame carries one row of angled louvers open on a single face, with a solid center spine for stiffness, pierced mounting holes at the two ends, and a small formed latch tab midway along one edge.

family_scale1__Z_00106_1.part_family: perforated sheet-metal grille with angled gusset bracket
family_scale1__Z_00106_1.desc: A longer, narrower perforated panel whose obround slot field is split into two banks by a solid central spine, with a row of larger mounting holes near one short edge replacing the sunburst boss. The upturned support is a shallow trapezoidal bracket with a single rolled hinge barrel and lightening cutouts, meeting the panel close to a right angle rather than on an acute set.

family_scale1__Z_00475_2.part_family: stepped compound spur gear (coaxial cluster gear)
family_scale1__Z_00475_2.desc: Flanged internal-external gear: a ring with teeth on its inner diameter at one face and spur teeth around its outer rim at the opposite face, joined by a thin web. A pilot bore with a single keyway plus an evenly spaced circle of tapped holes in the flange provide the mounting.

family_scale1__Z_00593_1.desc: Low-profile dual-in-line socket variant of the same family: a shallow rectangular insulator whose contact field is reduced to two straight rows of round cavities along the long edges, separated by a full-length central web. Each end wall gets a single round latch hole instead of hex windows, the bottom is closed except for two integral interference-fit board pegs, and one sidewall carries an external polarization rib rather than a flex tail.

family_scale1__Z_00144_2.desc: Twin-collar molded guide lever: two tube sockets sit side by side on a shared bridge with a central hinge boss and opposed latch hooks. The bridge is an open rib tray with four mounting holes, cable slots and alternating gussets, using a compact rectangular layout instead of a single arm.

family_scale1__Z_00174_0.part_family: thin-wall frame of channel-profile rails (sign/display frame)
family_scale1__Z_00174_0.desc: One-piece frame consisting of a single long straight vertical post of narrow closed rectangular channel section, joined at its lower end to an open rectangular loop frame lying perpendicular to it. The loop is built from the same thin channel stock, contains a small internal mounting tab with a notch at one corner, and all outer edges carry small uniform rounds along the entire part.

family_scale1__Z_00239_1.desc: A same-family plate is laid out as a symmetric four-arm cross rather than a fork: each arm end has a round counterbored mounting hole, the hub has a large keyed cutout surrounded by a regular ring of small holes, and the back face is pocketed into a thin web with stiffening ribs while the perimeter keeps a uniform chamfer and two opposing alignment notches.

family_scale1__Z_00468_1.desc: A deeper same-family part uses concentric octagonal rings with alternate rings rotated half a pitch, giving a star-like stepped cavity; the outer flange carries three small through holes and the bottom has a raised circular boss for location.

family_scale1__Z_00337_2.part_family: slotted burner caps and flame-spreader plates
family_scale1__Z_00337_2.desc: An annular cast diffuser ring with an open center instead of a solid disk, pierced by a spiral of rounded polygonal vents. Two diametrically opposed mounting ears with slotted holes replace the single tang, the underside carries radial stiffening ribs and a blind recessed well, and the outer edge is scalloped between the ears.

family_scale1__Z_00794_0.desc: A single constant-thickness flat metal blank forming a narrow straight handle set on a diagonal between two open ring jaws, one at each end. Each jaw is a punched hexagonal loop interrupted by a narrow entrance slot so it can slip sideways over a nut, with the inner flats broached to grip and the mouth blended into the handle with generous fillets. The part is entirely planar with deburred edges and has no ribs, bosses, shell walls, or mounting holes; the two heads are rotated relative to each other about the plate normal.

family_pilot__Z_00043_2.desc: A symmetrical badge blank of the same family built as a thin rounded-rectangle frame with two stacked oblong through slots and one off-center hanging hole. The front has a continuous perimeter groove for an adhesive inlay, while the rear stays flat except for several small locating dimples and lightly drafted vertical walls.

family_scale1__Z_00413_0.part_family: extruded circular-segment wedge blocks and curved shell segments
family_scale1__Z_00413_0.desc: Solid wedge machined so that its cross-section is a circular segment: one face is a convex cylindrical surface and the opposing face is a flat chord plane, with the segment profile extruded uniformly between two identical flat end faces. No holes, bosses, or ribs; all geometry is a single prismatic body with plain machined edges.

family_scale1__Z_00501_2.desc: Right-angle connector housing formed as an L-shaped body: one leg holds a dense field of short contact slots with an off-center polarization key, while the perpendicular leg forms a mounting flange with several hex standoffs, snap-fit locking clips, and triangular gusset ribs tying the two legs together.

family_scale1__Z_00115_0.part_family: slatted chair frame of thin rectangular panels
family_scale1__Z_00115_0.desc: L-profile side chair frame assembled entirely from thin rectangular-section members: two mirrored L-shaped side frames merge a front leg, seat rail and tall rear post, tied together by front and rear seat rails, a low stretcher and an inset seat panel. The backrest is a ladder of top and mid rails bridged by several evenly spaced vertical slats, leaving open rectangular bays; edges carry numerous small uniform break fillets and hidden lines mark the panel/tenon joints.

family_scale1__Z_00705_2.desc: A short double-rail segment: two parallel channel webs tied by a central spine into an H-like profile, with mirrored tooth groups on both outer edges, fully rounded closed ends, and a sparse pattern of blind counterbored holes down the spine instead of any through-window.

family_scale1__Z_00127_1.desc: A lipped C-channel variant in which the free flange edges have short inward return lips for stiffness. The web carries one row of three evenly spaced obround mounting slots, one flange has a pressed longitudinal stiffening bead, and both ends are cropped square with a locating notch cut in a single flange.

family_pilot__Z_00030_1.part_family: thin-strip open frame bracket with upright leg
family_pilot__Z_00030_1.desc: A closed rectangular bezel of the same thin-strip construction is carried on two upright legs that rise from diagonally opposite corners, so the ring is held clear of the mounting surface. Each leg carries one round through hole and one short slotted hole for adjustment, the outer corners are lightly filleted, and a small triangular gusset braces each leg-to-frame junction.

family_scale1__Z_00717_1.part_family: stamped and formed slotted thin-metal carrier strip
family_scale1__Z_00717_1.desc: A shorter, lighter member of the same punched-strip family, made as an open shallow channel rather than a near-closed profile, with one edge turned up as a stiffening lip and the opposite edge left flat for mounting. It carries a single row of round holes on a constant pitch, a pressed longitudinal rib beside the holes, only a few obround access slots clustered near one end, and two formed mounting ears with small corner radii.

family_scale1__Z_00645_0.part_family: thin toothed annular indexing ring (encoder/timing disc)
family_scale1__Z_00645_0.desc: A single flat circular plate forming an annulus: a band of evenly spaced external castellated teeth with rounded roots runs around the full outer rim, cut by radial notches, and the solid inner web rises to a compact central hub with a through bore. Three small equally spaced pin holes sit on a tight bolt circle in the hub, and the whole part is one machined shell of nearly uniform thickness with no side ribs.

family_scale1__Z_00515_1.desc: Internal ring gear variant: a thicker annular ring with spur teeth cut on the inner cylindrical surface and a smooth turned outer cylinder. One flat face carries six equally spaced tapped axial holes for bolting to a housing, with a small chamfer on the outer corner and an oil groove around the tooth roots.

family_scale1__Z_00563_0.part_family: slender precision-punched metal mounting strip / perforated rail
family_scale1__Z_00563_0.desc: A straight, slim bar of small rectangular cross-section whose broad face carries one dense, evenly spaced row of tiny through-holes running nearly the full length. One short end is a small machined pad with a miniature bolt-circle pattern of through-holes, and all outer edges are broken with very small mixed fillets and chamfers rather than sharp corners.

family_scale1__Z_00589_1.part_family: Decorative ribbed grille panel with a flat figural silhouette overlay
family_scale1__Z_00589_1.desc: A perimeter-framed rectangular louver uses identical full-height slats captured between top and bottom rails, with one horizontal stiffener across mid-span and punched fixing holes in two turned side flanges. The applied overlay is an interlocking leaf-and-vine silhouette sheet confined to the central bay, leaving a clear border of exposed slats around all four edges.

family_pilot__Z_00020_0.desc: A constant-thickness solid plate forms a three-lobed triangular flange with concave curved sides and generously rounded outer corners. A central through bore sits in the middle web, three equally spaced clearance holes lie on a shared bolt circle at the lobes, and three hexagonal through features cluster around the bore; all exposed edges carry small rounds.

family_scale1__Z_00216_2.desc: Compact single-sided flat utility key with a shortened blade and a triangular bow containing two keyring holes. Only one edge carries a short set of bitting steps, one face has a single deep longitudinal milled channel while the opposite face stays smooth, and the blade end is blunt with a small chamfer rather than a pointed tip.

family_scale1__Z_00147_2.desc: A folded thin-shell guide channel with sharp zigzag corrugations instead of smooth waves, wrapped into a closed box cross-section joined by one lapped longitudinal seam; one face is pierced with a regular row of fastener holes and both ends are sealed with pressed-in flat caps.

family_scale1__Z_00003_1.part_family: thin flat multi-window carrier frame / bezel strip with edge latch notches
family_scale1__Z_00003_1.desc: A wider flat bezel frame of the same pressed/molded family, but with two staggered rows of three smaller rounded-square apertures split by a central longitudinal rib. Instead of edge notches it uses a continuous raised rim with four corner mounting ears, oblong clearance slots near the ears, and a pair of alignment-pin bosses projecting from one face; the aperture corners are radiused and the rim underside has short gusset ribs at each web.

family_scale1__Z_00222_0.desc: A small rectangular pivot boss with two adjacent through bores anchors a spray of constant-thickness flat-strip arms leaving the hub at different compound angles; each arm is a stamped and bent strap whose long edge is finished as a run of equal semicircular scallops, several arms ending in small rectangular paddles bent out of plane and one arm dropping to a narrower finger, all fused at the boss with no added ribs or gussets.

family_scale1__Z_00637_1.part_family: flat sheet four-arm X-frame plate bracket
family_scale1__Z_00637_1.desc: A flat star plate with an open hexagonal centre ring and six radial spokes; alternating spoke tips end either in a raised circular boss with a countersunk hole or in a round pad with a pair of mounting holes. Triangular lightening cutouts sit between the spokes, and the central bore is keyed to locate a mating hub.

family_scale1__Z_00397_1.desc: A short half-round cradle shell of similar arc profile but with a thicker wall and flat mounting flanges extending outward from both long edges. Each flange carries two countersunk through-holes, and three small triangular gusset ribs tie the flanges to the convex outer surface. The concave face is smooth except for a central molded locating boss.

family_scale1__Z_00769_2.desc: An open C-shaped spring clip bent from the same rolled-edge flat strip, deeper on one side than the other so it hugs a flange. One straight leg carries four evenly spaced punched slots, the opposite leg ends in an inward rolled eye, and the free tip is flared outward as a lead-in tang.

family_pilot__Z_00094_1.desc: A compact flat spring strip formed into a shallow S-curve, with a stamped contact dimple near its rounded free tip and two spaced round mounting holes at the opposite end, its edges straight and parallel with no taper.

family_scale1__Z_00621_1.part_family: vented extruded electronics enclosure with front I/O panel
family_scale1__Z_00621_1.desc: A shorter two-piece vented electronics housing: an extruded base channel with full-length PCB card guides and a separate rear end cap, sandwiched by a front panel fastened at the corners. The front panel has two horizontal louver rows, one round power-connector hole and one D-sub cutout, while the rear cap carries a circular fan grille and four threaded standoff bosses; the top closes with a snap-on cover rather than leaving the end open.

family_scale1__Z_00355_1.desc: Tall straight-fin extrusion heatsink: a thick rectangular base with evenly spaced full-height fins running the length of the part, no transverse fin cuts, a flat back face with a central raised boss and two through mounting holes for a fan clamp, and gently radiused fin tips.

family_scale1__Z_00125_2.desc: A shallow square waffle tray variant with fewer, larger blind cells and a mixed feature set: some cells are replaced by narrow vent slots, the rim has a snap-fit lip, and small corner standoffs/bosses project from the flat back while the pocket entries remain softly chamfered.

family_scale1__Z_00023_1.desc: A symmetric link in the same family uses matching circular eyes at both ends with a gentle waist between them rather than one oversized barrel. A single centerline row of round holes replaces the grouped oblong slots, two small lightening pockets sit in the web, and a pressed longitudinal rib stiffens the middle with all corners filleted.

family_scale1__Z_00051_2.part_family: ring-shaped spring washer with circumferential teeth
family_scale1__Z_00051_2.desc: A corrugated lock washer with a wavy circumferential profile, incorporating intermittent radial slots that divide the toothed section into discrete segments for controlled flexibility.

family_scale1__Z_00539_0.part_family: flat profile-cut sheet blank (thin silhouette plate)
family_scale1__Z_00539_0.desc: A single constant-thickness flat plate profile-cut to an irregular dart/bird-like silhouette: several sharp triangular prongs cluster at one end, a notched neck leads to a long tapered tail, and all outline corners are straight and unfilleted. There are no through-holes, bosses, ribs or formed bends; only shallow dashed crease/etch markings lie on the faces, seen edge-on as segmented vertex lines along the thin side view.

family_scale1__Z_00173_1.desc: Single-column variant: one angled connector head rises from an offset mounting base, carrying two larger circular ports and one oblong keyed opening on its sloped face. The cap is smooth rather than knurled, and the base uses one spring latch foot opposite a plain screw boss instead of paired hooked feet.

family_scale1__Z_00538_1.part_family: spur gear with integral central hub
family_scale1__Z_00538_1.desc: A molded plastic spur gear in which the toothed rim is tied to a central hub by four curved spokes separated by open windows and a thin connecting web. The hub has a D-shaped through bore on one face and a hexagonal nut recess on the other, with a shallow annular reinforcing rib at the tooth root and a small gate pad on one spoke.

family_scale1__Z_00718_1.desc: Wide, low, flat microchannel extrusion cut to a moderate length: two smooth outer skins joined by many thin internal webs that form a single row of parallel rectangular axial passages from end to end. The four long edges get small chamfers, there are no external fins and no cross-holes, so the part reads as a slim hollow heat-exchange strip rather than a ribbed bar.

family_scale1__Z_00075_1.desc: A shallow plastic tray whose base carries two facing banks of parallel divider walls separated by a central spine, forming mirrored columns of pockets; the spine carries round mounting bosses with through-holes instead of slots, the divider tops are castellated to two heights, and small drainage notches are cut at the foot of every channel.

family_pilot__Z_00049_1.part_family: flat paddle link plate with a bolted circular eye flange
family_pilot__Z_00049_1.desc: Double-ended flat link plate of the same family: a narrow web joins a bossed circular eye at each end, the two eyes using different bolt-circle counts and one eye having a slotted central opening for adjustment. The web is lightened by a long oblong slot and stiffened by an embossed longitudinal rib, with small dowel holes added beside only one flange.

family_scale1__Z_00099_1.desc: A wider shallow-tray vent cover of the same family: a planar grille field of vertical obround louvers split by two solid longitudinal stiffening ribs and surrounded by a low drafted skirt rather than a raised rim. Four threaded screw bosses sit at the corners, snap-fit tabs line the long sides, a single central boss carries a label or ground point, and the louver root ends are filleted while the outside lip is lightly chamfered.

family_scale1__Z_00495_1.desc: A seated-cat variant uses the same mirrored silhouette side plates but reserves slats for only a short run of wide, widely spaced seat and backrest slats. Both haunch plates are left solid and pierced with a regular pattern of round lightening holes, the tail is a single solid scrolled plate rather than a slatted block, and the two sides are tied by one flat lower stretcher instead of legs. Joints are countersunk fasteners in plain holes rather than the slotted slat-in-plate arrangement.

family_scale1__Z_00517_2.desc: A low-profile round carrier with an outer ring, an inner concentric ring, and three Y-shaped spokes tying both rings to a domed center boss. The open bays are unequal, with one bay closed by a thin membrane for a label or emblem.

family_scale1__Z_00308_1.part_family: toothed annulus on a pedestal mount
family_scale1__Z_00308_1.desc: A flat encoder-style disc of the same family uses a raised cylindrical hub instead of a box: a centered bore with a single keyway, a small bolt circle on the hub flange, and an outer track mixing long radial slots with shorter timing slots. One face is plain while the other has a shallow raised washer land around the hub and a chamfered outer rim.

family_scale1__Z_00593_0.desc: Tall square-section molded thermoplastic receptacle. The open top face is rimmed by a perimeter array of small circular contact cavities (six along one edge, eight along the adjacent edge, six along the opposite edge) surrounding a deeper central recessed well, and four thin walls drop straight to the board interface with several internal ledges. Two opposite walls each carry a pair of vertically stacked regular-hexagon latch windows backed by molded spring arms, while the base adds a central trapezoidal tool/cable notch, two outward-splayed board-lock feet and one central downward retention tail.

family_scale1__Z_00447_2.part_family: shallow rectangular sheet cover panel with edge flange
family_scale1__Z_00447_2.desc: Flat stepped access cover with a raised central rectangular pad holding four countersunk fastener holes, a down-turned flange on three sides, and the fourth side left open as a short hinge tongue with two slots. Add two small locator bosses and one oblong wiring slot, with gently drafted vertical walls for release.

family_scale1__Z_00269_0.desc: One-piece annular metal collar with a centered through bore and a short cylindrical shell. The outside is a scalloped/lobed ring with dense axial ribs and forty-two repeated small edge chamfers; a lateral ear/clevis projects from one side with twin prongs, a cross-hole and a small hex boss, while another round radial boss pierces the rim.

family_scale1__Z_00384_0.desc: A single thin sheet-metal blank folded along its full length into an open unequal-leg angle cross-section, with a taller flat leg and a shorter leg meeting at a small bend radius. The rail is straight with uniform thin walls, plain square-cut ends, and no holes, slots, ribs or bosses.

family_scale1__Z_00734_1.desc: A similar one-piece flat metal link but laid out as a straight slender arm with a rounded fork tip and two through-holes, one at each end. A closed longitudinal slot lightens the arm, one side carries a single V-notch instead of a hook, and all outline corners are rounded while the part remains planar with uniform thickness.

family_scale1__Z_00648_0.desc: A constant-thickness flat plate with a rounded-rectangle outline, lightly chamfered edges and a shallow relieved notch along the lower edge. Its face is dominated by a dense regular grid of small through holes, several additional grouped through-hole patterns and four countersunk mounting holes, while a central meandering cluster of rectangular through-slots plus short rectangular perimeter openings provide connector and latch clearance.

family_scale1__Z_00327_2.desc: A different arcuate bracket plate built as a narrow curved web between two thicker end pads. Each pad has a raised boss around a countersunk through-hole, the mid-span carries two lightening slots, and all web-to-pad junctions use generous fillets.

family_scale1__Z_00743_1.desc: A flanged internal gear in which the same inward-toothed ring is joined on one face to a thicker axial hub; the hub has a smaller keyed central bore, an outer bolt-circle flange carries several evenly spaced through-holes plus a locating recess, and generous fillets blend the rim into the hub.

family_scale1__Z_00565_0.desc: Straight anodized-aluminum extrusion of nearly square cross-section, cut to a fixed length with square ends. A continuous T-slot runs the full length on each of the four faces; the outer walls tie into a cruciform internal web surrounding one central tubular boss with a small through bore, with rounded external corners, small radiused slot lips, and fine longitudinal extrusion lines on every surface.

family_scale1__Z_00746_0.part_family: curved flat linkage arm with bolted end pads
family_scale1__Z_00746_0.desc: A single constant-thickness plate swept into one long gentle arc, with an integral enlarged round pad blended in at each end by generous fillets and no ribs or slots. The larger lower pad carries a main counterbored through pivot hole ringed by two concentric equally spaced seven-hole bolt circles plus a few small blind holes, while the smaller upper pad has a counterbored through hole with adjacent small drilled holes; the outer profile is smooth throughout.

family_scale1__Z_00776_0.desc: This part is a thin constant-thickness circular spoked guard: an outer rim and an intermediate annular ring are joined to a small central boss by two staggered tiers of radial ribs, leaving open tapered windows all around; the boss carries a centered through bore, the faces are flush, and the rib-to-ring junctions are softly filleted.

family_scale1__Z_00564_2.part_family: low extruded constant-wall cam-track link plate
family_scale1__Z_00564_2.desc: An open C-shaped variant rather than a closed band: two end eyes with through-bores and raised boss rings are tied by an arcuate constant-thickness spine, the inner edge carries one short straight guide groove and one elongated oval slot mid-length, with reinforcing gusset fillets at each eye and a thin flange lip along the top perimeter; the gap between the eyes remains open for clip-in assembly.

family_scale1__Z_00479_0.desc: One-piece rigid housing joining a square four-hole mounting flange to a short round barrel; the barrel has a large central through-bore ringed by evenly spaced internal teeth/notches with two rounded reliefs, internal radial ribs, and an exterior lug/pad with a cross-drilled hole. The square end is thick-walled with four through holes on a bolt circle and a stepped recessed face around the bore.

family_scale1__Z_00613_1.desc: Three-ear adapter plate of the same flat-sheet family: a centered round bore is surrounded by three equispaced mounting tabs, each tab carrying one radial clearance slot for adjustment plus one plain hole, with two small dowel holes close to the bore. Constant thickness throughout, generous fillets at every tab root, and a single-face counterbore on the central bore.

family_pilot__Z_00091_1.part_family: openwork flat cut-plate star wheel / sheet-metal flange
family_pilot__Z_00091_1.desc: Similar thin cut plate but arranged with five broader arms around a larger plain center hole with no keyway; each arm is pierced by one elongated oval lightening slot, and three small bolt holes sit on an inner bolt circle for face mounting. The arm tips tie into a gentle scalloped outer rim rather than remaining separated points.

family_scale1__Z_00061_0.desc: A single thin flat annular spacer ring with a large concentric through-bore and a low, nearly uniform rectangular cross-section; one face is stepped by a shallow concentric recess/land, while the outer rim is interrupted by a few short chordal flats and a small rounded edge break. Two tiny blind holes are sunk partway into the ring for location, with no through-fastener pattern, ribs or bosses.

family_pilot__Z_00102_0.desc: A single thin metal strip of uniform wall is roll-formed into an open C-shaped circular arc, leaving two flat square-cut free ends facing each other across a gap. A dense row of identical rectangular through-slots is punched across the strip width along the full developed length, giving a ladder-like perforated band with smooth plain inner and outer edges, no ribs, and no bosses.

family_scale1__Z_00571_2.desc: A compact square flanged variant: a two-by-two stud pad is raised on a thicker central pedestal with a main through bore and one side port, while four corner lugs take clearance fasteners. Fan-shaped gusset ribs tie the pedestal down to an open base frame on the underside, and the stud grid sits inboard of the flange rather than spanning the whole top face.

family_pilot__Z_00011_0.desc: Open-topped molded cradle on a flat rectangular base plate: two side walls and a taller rear wall rise from the base and are tied together by an inclined header frame, with the wall faces densely ribbed in a uniform honeycomb of hexagonal cells and short peripheral stiffening ribs along the panel edges and base underside. A pair of hexagonal insert bosses and several smaller raised bosses stand on the inner floor, two through holes pierce the inclined header near a small chamfered top edge, and a chamfered U-shaped notch is cut into the upper rear wall; intersections carry small fillets.

family_scale1__Z_00353_1.desc: A shallow circular heat spreader uses concentric annular fins broken by radial spoke ribs, with a raised central boss and four equally spaced mounting counterbores in the outer rim; the underside is a flat face with a perimeter locating groove.

family_scale1__Z_00333_2.desc: A compact two-slot variant is built from one bent sheet that forms a shallow U base, with two upstanding wing panels spot-welded to a pair of side tie rods. The wings have hemmed edges and an oval thumb hole near the top rather than lower arches, and small elastomer-pad bosses sit under the base for gripping a shelf.

family_scale1__Z_00435_1.part_family: slender round shaft with an attached flat flag/paddle blade
family_scale1__Z_00435_1.desc: A stepped round shaft carrying two identical flat paddle blades spaced apart along the same side, each blade a rounded-corner rectangle with one central lightening hole and brazed into a shallow flat milled on the shaft. The far end has a turned-down pilot tip, and a small cross-hole for a retaining pin sits just behind the second blade.

family_scale1__Z_00459_2.desc: Hollow double-width aluminum extrusion rail whose upper face combines two parallel T-track channels over a closed rectangular cavity. The cavity has corner screw bosses for end caps, the underside carries a central longitudinal slot and a small pattern of tapped holes, the outer corners are rounded instead of hooked, and one end is mitered while the other is square.

family_scale1__Z_00236_2.desc: An elongated flat link plate from the same family having two round bearing bores in raised end lugs and three staggered open hex cells chained between them by narrow straight ligaments; one middle cell is blind, triangular gussets reinforce only the top face at the ligament joints, and the cell rims use small fillets while the end lugs use larger chamfers.

family_scale1__Z_00823_1.desc: Straight rectangular aluminum framing extrusion with T-slot grooves on the two wide faces only and smooth closed narrow sides. The hollow section is split by two longitudinal webs into three chambers and carries two central screw bores rather than one, with radiused outer corners and plain saw-cut ends.

family_pilot__Z_00019_0.part_family: thin-panel workstation desk with pigeonhole hutch
family_pilot__Z_00019_0.desc: An L-shaped workstation built from thin rectangular panels: a left pedestal frames two stacked drawer openings within a side modesty panel, joined by a flat desktop and a lower shelf to a tall right hutch panel. The hutch carries a repeated grid of small square pigeonhole cubbies set above a larger rectangular recess and an open knee bay, with edge-joined panels, small corner radii, and dense rows of evenly spaced small holes along the panel edges.

family_scale1__Z_00564_1.part_family: low extruded constant-wall cam-track link plate
family_scale1__Z_00564_1.desc: A longer same-family cam-track plate with three rounded lobes in line, each with a through-bore and boss ring, routed by a closed figure-eight groove between the bores instead of one serpentine slot; add two counterbored mounting holes along the outer spine, a shallow relief pocket on the underside, and scalloped lightening cutouts on the long outer edge while keeping one constant wall thickness.

family_scale1__Z_00291_2.desc: Wider corner-gusset brace folded from a single blank with two perpendicular rectangular flanges tied by an integral diagonal rib. The upright flange is pierced with four holes in a square pattern plus a central keyhole slot, the base flange carries three clearance holes in a line near the free edge, both outer corners are rounded, reinforcing beads run parallel to the bend, and the gusset edge is flanged for stiffness.

family_scale1__Z_00723_1.desc: Open C-channel guide rail of the same family: a single backbone carries transverse ribs on one face only, with oval lightening windows between ribs and integrated snap-fit cantilever clips spaced irregularly along the length. Both ends are closed solid caps, one keyed with a slot and the other forked for alignment, and there are no full-width rungs.

family_scale1__Z_00279_2.desc: An elongated stepped variant: one leg carries a straight through-slot while the wider leg holds a single large circular bearing bore and a row of countersunk mounting holes, the back face is stiffened by thin ribs instead of an open tray rim, and small blind weight-relief pockets replace the looped track; edge treatment is limited to lead-in chamfers at the two entry corners plus one cross-drilled locking hole in the stepped shoulder.

family_scale1__Z_00074_1.desc: Same family but a compact two-pole variant: a short rectangular insulating block with two side-by-side upright contact barrels on a flat base and no long blades, replaced on the mating face by a row of forked spring contacts and stamped retention barbs. It adds a central polarizing keyway, perimeter snap-fit latches, one slotted mounting ear, and a honeycomb rib field under the base rather than a long finned tail.

family_scale1__Z_00027_2.desc: Low-profile single-blank sheet-metal pan bracket with a broad top plate, one downturned edge flange, two short side skirts, and gusseted corner bends rather than fully closed ends. Features are sparse: keyhole mounting slots on the flange, a row of small ventilation piercings across the plate, one large D-shaped connector opening near a skirt, and hemmed skirt edges instead of raw cut edges.

family_scale1__Z_00514_2.desc: Wide multi-lane extrusion batten made from several parallel T-slot tracks joined by thin deck webs, mixing through holes, blind boss pads and one continuous locating rib; the ends are square-cut with small notches for cover plates and lane-dividing walls run uninterrupted along the part.

family_pilot__Z_00019_2.part_family: thin-panel workstation desk with pigeonhole hutch
family_pilot__Z_00019_2.desc: A compact wall-hung sorting cabinet in the same family, with no legs: a shallow panel carcass divided into many columns of small cubbies with removable dividers and front label holders. A fold-down writing flap on side stays covers the lower cubbies when closed, and the rear panel carries mounting cleats with keyhole slots plus a row of ventilation slots near the top.

family_scale1__Z_00771_1.desc: A similar thin rectangular timepiece dial but with a flat, unrecessed face: twelve separate raised baton indices sit directly on the surface, a central arbor hole is flanked by two small countersunk mounting holes near one edge, and the only rim feature is a narrow rolled outer lip. Four short standoff bosses on the back provide mounting clearance instead of a deep dished pocket.

family_scale1__Z_00738_2.part_family: stamped and bent sheet-metal spring clip bracket
family_scale1__Z_00738_2.desc: Offset hanger bracket of thin sheet metal in a Z-profile: a top horizontal tab holds a row of pierced fastener holes, the vertical web is lightened by two triangular cutouts and strengthened with two embossed longitudinal ribs, and the bottom terminates in a return hook flange. A keyhole slot is punched in the web for quick release and a shallow dimpled boss surrounds the main mounting hole.

family_scale1__Z_00755_1.part_family: thin annular retaining/mounting ring with an integral clip tab
family_scale1__Z_00755_1.desc: A same-family flat circular retaining washer for a similar bore, but with a plain continuous outer edge rather than lobes and no formed clip: it mounts through four equally spaced clearance holes plus two elongated adjustment slots on one bolt circle, carries a low stamped concentric stiffening rib around the bore on one face, and has a single small locating notch breaking the inner edge. All corners are softened with modest fillets and the part remains one uniform thin sheet.

family_scale1__Z_00233_1.desc: A molded variant of the same family: a wider open rectangular frame with a recessed inner shelf for a glass or gasket and a raised outer lip. Six clearance holes cluster on one long rail, two keyhole slots sit on the opposite rail, short transverse ribs stiffen the shelf, and the lightening openings mix round and capsule shapes.

family_scale1__Z_00320_2.part_family: perforated flat mounting strip / drilled bar rail
family_scale1__Z_00320_2.desc: A short, compact connection strip with enlarged circular eye holes at each end and a small cluster of evenly spaced clearance holes between them; the body is thicker over the midspan with shallow lightening pockets on one face and generous fillets blending into both end eyes.

family_scale1__Z_00282_0.part_family: hubbed radially slotted circular cutter disc
family_scale1__Z_00282_0.desc: Thin annular metal disc with a dense uniform pattern of radial gullets around the outer edge; the slots leave short tooth-like lands on the rim. At the center an integral raised cylindrical hub carries a square drive through-hole, surrounded by a concentric circular recess, with a smooth fillet blend from the hub down to the blade face.

family_scale1__Z_00257_1.part_family: open-top machined enclosure with holed mounting deck
family_scale1__Z_00257_1.desc: Low cast enclosure base for a controller: a flat mounting plate with four corner feet and a single central row of three tall stud bosses, each with a tapped hole, set among a sparse field of small clearance holes and two oblong cable slots cut through the deck. A perimeter wall stands on only three sides leaving the fourth open for a mating panel, with triangular gusset ribs at the inner wall-to-floor corners, filleted internal corners and a chamfered top edge.

family_scale1__Z_00395_2.desc: A narrow snap-ring variant formed as a nearly closed rectangular-section ring with a small circumferential gap and two free ends that curl slightly outward; each end is pierced by one round tooling hole for pliers. One flat face carries a shallow annular recess, and the inner wall has two short axial key slots positioned opposite the gap.

family_scale1__Z_00276_2.desc: Low-profile cam lever made as one molded shell: a paddle handle drives a serrated side rail through paired torsion flexures. The rail adds three bayonet slots, a blind alignment boss, and an angled release finger rather than a through cylindrical tip.

family_scale1__Z_00521_2.part_family: shallow molded plastic electronics chassis tray
family_scale1__Z_00521_2.desc: A mostly open frame-style chassis pan keeps only a perimeter wall and one cross-divider forming two bays, adding stamped adjustability via oval slots, a row of threaded inserts along one side, gusseted inside corners and one grounding boss; solid walls replace any perforation pattern and the rim carries small formed earthing tabs.

family_scale1__Z_00654_2.part_family: flat machined annular spacer ring with a pointed star outer edge
family_scale1__Z_00654_2.desc: A thin stamped retaining ring with a scalloped outer edge made of many small rounded lobes rather than sharp points. Around the central hole the metal is drawn up into a short continuous collar, three equally spaced mounting ears project outward with slotted holes, and several pressed stiffening dimples sit in the web between the collar and the lobed rim, so the part mixes one formed bend with through-cut edge and ear features.

family_scale1__Z_00262_2.part_family: thin machined carrier plate with clustered ring bosses
family_scale1__Z_00262_2.desc: A radial variant of the same plate family: one central annular hub with a large through-bore feeds four evenly spaced thin arms out to four smaller perimeter lug bosses. Alternate arms carry blind counterbores, the rim is scalloped with unequal radii, and the back face has a shallow recessed pocket while the plate thickness stays constant.

family_pilot__Z_00081_2.desc: An elongated shallow variant replaces closed cells with a serpentine row of thin low fins that form a zigzag airflow channel, the fins interrupted at regular gaps rather than tied into boxes. The base between fins is pierced with a regular pattern of round lightening and vent holes, while three threaded-insert bosses stand on raised pedestal pads along the centerline. End walls step up taller than the side fins and extend into two external mounting ears with slotted holes, and the whole strip is bounded by a low continuous edge track.

family_pilot__Z_00118_1.desc: A larger single-spine variant: one central perforated rail instead of two edge rails, a hexagonal/honeycomb vent field rather than triangles, four corner standoffs and an offset cable slot, intended as a side-panel radiator bracket.

family_scale1__Z_00567_0.desc: A single flat thin-walled panel molded as an open rectangular lattice: vertical stiles and horizontal rails form several rows of through-openings, while a row of tall narrow posts of differing heights projects from the top edge. The section is a uniform thin wall with small fillets at the rail intersections and a short ribbed boss detail along one edge.

family_scale1__Z_00047_0.part_family: stamped toothed sensor reluctor ring (tone wheel)
family_scale1__Z_00047_0.desc: A thin flat annular plate with a large central through bore; the narrow outer web is castellated into eighteen equal rectangular teeth separated by rounded root fillets, while three small equally spaced holes on a concentric bolt circle provide the mounting/index pattern. The section is essentially one stamped plate thickness with a short raised land at the bore and the teeth sheared from the same blank, so there are no tall bosses, ribs, or enclosing walls.

family_scale1__Z_00312_2.desc: Flat X-shaped adapter plate blanked from heavier stock, its four tapered arms joined at a square central pad. Each arm tip carries a pair of inline through holes, the pad features a countersunk central bore, and short pressed ribs run along each arm for stiffness.

family_scale1__Z_00389_1.desc: A stepped retaining spacer of the same thin-ring family built on a through bore, but with only one deep counterbore on the front face and a flat rear face; the outer cylinder is interrupted by a single circumferential O-ring groove and the bore entry has one chamfer rather than a stepped rim.

family_scale1__Z_00007_0.desc: A flat, closed annular band whose outer and inner edges both follow the same regular twelve-point star, leaving a narrow uniform radial wall all around. Axial thickness is thin and constant with all corners sharp; there are no holes, bosses, ribs, or chamfers, as if the ring were sliced from a prismatic star extrusion.

family_scale1__Z_00290_0.desc: Flat constant-thickness plate with three identical arms radiating at equal angles from a central round through-bore; each arm widens into an end lobe pierced by a hexagonal through-pocket for capturing a nut, neighboring lobes are joined by curved webs that leave three open windows around the hub, and the faceted outer outline plus all pocket corners carry many small equal fillets with flat top and bottom faces.

family_scale1__Z_00460_1.desc: Same family, but with a flat arched end panel instead of a gable: a single wide window grid of six panes above one large recessed panel, no lamp boss, and a plain lintel. Its base carries one row of three deep square wells with inner snap-fit ribs, four corner screw bosses with through mounting holes, smooth unfluted outer walls, and a line of hinge knuckles molded along the rear edge.

family_scale1__Z_00790_1.desc: Narrow spur-gear ring with straight external teeth on a thin rim and an integral offset hub on one face. The hub has a single round bore with a transverse pin hole, while several radial lightening slots separate the hub from the toothed rim and all tooth tips are chamfered.

family_scale1__Z_00771_0.desc: A thin rectangular single-piece dial plate whose perimeter is a raised, multi-step picture-frame rim surrounding a shallow recessed reading field. The field carries a ring of short raised radial index bars around an implied ellipse, a small central through-hole for a hand arbor and a few slender raised spokes from the centre, with tiny raised pads and chamfered flats; the underside is essentially a flat thin panel matching the rim outline.

family_scale1__Z_00001_1.part_family: castellated cylindrical bezel with coaxial sleeve
family_scale1__Z_00001_1.desc: A moulded rotary adjustment ring in the same style: a low annular dial with a fine external tooth band for grip, a plain top face with a single index pip, and an inner coaxial sleeve that take a shaft. Four small screw bosses stand off the back and are tied to the rim by thin radial ribs, leaving open windows between the spokes.

family_scale1__Z_00086_1.desc: Moulded elastomer drive star with eight rounded lobes radiating from a solid annular web and a keyed central bore. Shallow radial ribs bridge the web between lobes, every arm root uses a generous moulded radius, and the tooth flanks are slightly tapered for release with no machined chamfers.

family_scale1__Z_00251_0.part_family: thin cruciform hub with end sockets
family_scale1__Z_00251_0.desc: A thin constant-wall cruciform carrier has a central through-bored collar joined by four radial webs to four open rounded socket bosses at the ends. Four contoured relief windows sit between the webs, all transitions are filleted, exposed edges are chamfered in a repeated pattern, and shallow raised rims surround the bore and sockets.

family_pilot__Z_00051_2.desc: A narrow sheet-metal channel clip folded into a three-sided C profile with two unequal side flanges and a small closing tab. A row of three pierced holes runs along the back, one flange carries an embossed dimple and a lanced retention tab, and the open end is hemmed.

family_scale1__Z_00524_0.part_family: thin machined bezel frame with rectangular window pockets
family_scale1__Z_00524_0.desc: Flat, thin rectangular machined frame opened into two side-by-side rectangular window pockets split by a single central transverse rib. A continuous perimeter rail and shallow marginal ledges surround the bays, the pockets are cut to more than one depth, and small through-holes sit near the short ends; the outer edge is stepped, giving a low bezel-like profile rather than a thick block.

family_scale1__Z_00507_2.desc: Split clamp-type internal-gear ring made as a thin outer shell with a longitudinal slit, two clamp-bolt ears, and an interrupted internal tooth pattern. Three lightening windows break up the toothed band, and one end face adds a timing notch and small alignment boss.

family_scale1__Z_00718_2.desc: Star-section extruded transfer spine with four thick radial fin plates spaced evenly around a central tubular core that contains one axial through-bore. Fin tips are rounded, core-to-fin junctions are generously filleted, and each end face has a shallow countersink at the bore; contrasted with the reference it uses few large external fins and a single central hole instead of many small bores and dense fine ribs.

family_scale1__Z_00570_0.part_family: additively manufactured strut-lattice block (octet-truss cellular solid)
family_scale1__Z_00570_0.desc: Monolithic cubic lattice block built from repeating octet-truss unit cells, where diagonal struts meet at filleted nodes to form interlocking tetrahedral and octahedral voids. All six outer faces display the same triangulated diamond grid, with stepped half-cell projections along the edges where the bounding envelope slices through the cell pattern; there are no skins, ribs, or drilled holes, only the open strut network.

family_scale1__Z_00735_0.desc: A thin, essentially planar plate forms an X-shaped cross: a small central ring hub with a clear through bore sends four narrow arms diagonally outward to identical rounded mounting feet that carry through holes at the corners. The hub mixes feature types on one face: a compact bolt-circle of four equally spaced small through holes, plus counterbored holes from the same side, leaving the opposite face flat; arm-to-hub and arm-to-foot junctions are filleted, the four outer feet have generous corner radii, and the re-entrant notches between arms are softened with small rounds.

family_scale1__Z_00549_1.desc: Six straight tapered spokes radiate from a slightly thicker central washer and are tied together at their outer ends by a continuous annular rim, leaving six open pie-shaped windows in what is still one uniform flat sheet. The centre is a plain through hole with a single keyway, each spoke carries one round lightening hole near the rim, and fillets appear only at the spoke-to-rim junctions rather than as forked fingers.

family_scale1__Z_00509_2.desc: A molded plastic sibling keeps the shallow tray outline but replaces the uniform grid with staggered rows of counterbored holes and small locating bosses between them. The back carries crossing reinforcing ribs and integral snap tabs on the long sides instead of folded metal flanges.

family_scale1__Z_00429_2.part_family: slender thin-gauge metal reed/probe with formed end(s)
family_scale1__Z_00429_2.desc: A straight thin-walled rectangular hollow section open at both ends, with two opposed rectangular windows cut through the wide faces near mid-length and four small locating dimples, two on each narrow face. One end is swaged down to a smaller rectangular outlet while the other is slightly flared, two tiny cross-holes take a retaining pin, and the section corners are lightly radiused with no projecting tang.

family_scale1__Z_00658_0.desc: A single straight slender metal strip with a constant narrow rectangular section and fully radiused edges. Fine longitudinal ribs/grooves run the length, one broad face carries a dense regular transverse tooth or graduation pattern, and three small through-holes pierce the compact end profile; both ends are cut square.

family_scale1__Z_00051_1.part_family: ring-shaped spring washer with circumferential teeth
family_scale1__Z_00051_1.desc: A thicker annular retaining ring with a single row of rectangular serrations machined only along its outer edge, featuring two concentric reference diameters and a smooth inner bore.

family_scale1__Z_00000_0.desc: Thin rectangular lattice plate formed as a four-by-five array of circular through-apertures. Every aperture is edged with a raised rounded bead; adjacent beads are bridged by short ties and framed by an outer rectangular rail, giving a continuous egg-crate shell of nearly uniform thickness. A few small closed loop tabs project from two opposite edges as lift/location features, with all junctions filleted and no separate bosses or ribs.

family_scale1__Z_00427_1.desc: A semicircular guide segment of the same thin curved-strip construction, but using a single wide centre channel instead of multiple full-length slots, with a row of small punched holes along the neutral axis and a countersunk mounting hole at each end.

family_scale1__Z_00579_2.desc: A short rounded-square tubular spacer built from the same thin-wall rounded-corner section but cut to standoff length with both ends open. One face carries a row of several small through-holes, the opposite face has two long longitudinal slots that form flexible tines, and all four external corners keep a uniform round with matching internal fillets.

family_scale1__Z_00366_1.part_family: profiled flat sheet-metal hand lever bracket
family_scale1__Z_00366_1.desc: A flat stamped link plate of uniform thickness formed as a compact two-ear yoke, where a shallow arched bridge joins left and right mounting ears and each ear carries a single raised bore boss. An oblong adjustment slot crosses the bridge, the outside uses large tangent radii rather than finger lobes, and one countersunk pilot hole sits between the ears.

family_scale1__Z_00497_1.desc: A symmetrical version of the track built as two equal deep channels mirrored about a central T-shaped rib, with outward mounting flanges on both sides instead of a drilled base; clamping is by a continuous undercut dovetail groove beneath, each channel mouth has a chamfered lead-in rather than hooked lips, and only two large filleted junctions are used at the rib roots.

family_scale1__Z_00256_1.desc: Flat gasket-grooved faceplate of the same enclosure family using a two-across layout of large circular connector cutouts beside one rectangular data-connector slot and a short row of indicator pinholes. The recessed dish is omitted in favour of a plain front with an O-ring channel, the rear carries a few shallow standoff bosses, and edge fixings are four corner clearance holes rather than per-port bolt circles.

family_scale1__Z_00817_1.part_family: thin flat profiled sheet-metal plate with through-cut slots and holes
family_scale1__Z_00817_1.desc: A thin uniform-thickness profile plate formed as a symmetrical two-end link: an elongated body with semicircular ends, a round through-hole at each end, and one central obround slot. A small indexing notch is cut into one long edge and a shallow concave clearance radius into the opposite edge; every transition is filleted and the part remains a single flat sheet with no formed features.

family_scale1__Z_00151_0.desc: One constant-thickness circular plate built as a central hub, inner annular boss, outer ring, and evenly spaced radial spokes; the spokes leave through windows, the center has a through shaft hole with a larger coaxial counterbore, and the rim carries repeated short rectangular lugs with small rounded roots and cutout corners.

family_scale1__Z_00496_1.desc: Compact wheel built from a solid center hub with a hexagonal drive bore, joined by five straight tapered spokes to a smooth continuous outer rim with no tread blocks. Circular lightening holes sit between the spokes, and a raised boss on one side offsets the hub from the rim plane.

family_scale1__Z_00490_2.part_family: inverted-U support frame of thin flat bar
family_scale1__Z_00490_2.desc: Same-family variant as a wide three-leg gantry: two parallel thin top rails are tied by short rungs into a ladder-like beam supported on three splayed legs, the middle leg centered under the span. Punch rectangular windows through the top rails, add a row of small round tooling holes, form snap-fit tabs at the feet, and use triangular gusset plates at every leg-to-rail joint.

family_scale1__Z_00754_1.desc: A same-family wheel with a solid, slightly dished web between hub and outer ring instead of an open spoke face; the side wall is closed except for a handful of oblong louvers, six thick underside spokes stiffen the web, and the hub uses a splined bore with two snap-fit tangs rather than a keyed plain bore.

family_scale1__Z_00367_1.desc: A longer, narrower rounded-end strap in the same gauge carrying one centered row of evenly spaced eyelets plus two obround adjustment slots near mid-length. One end is a plain semicircular tip; the other swells into a teardrop lug with a single large mounting hole flanked by two small anti-rotation holes, with all external corners generously radiused.

family_pilot__Z_00108_1.part_family: stamped and bent sheet-metal spring contact strip
family_pilot__Z_00108_1.desc: A different member of the same family: a compact cantilever spring clip with a flat mounting base carrying one round hole and a pair of side locating notches; a narrowed beam leaves the base through a single smooth S-bend and ends in a crowned contact tip with a small coined dimple, using fewer folds, no long slots, and generous root fillets.

family_scale1__Z_00266_1.desc: Deeper rectangular utility crate of the same molded thin-wall type, but with tall open-rib side walls formed from vertical格栅 ribs rather than punched slots. The solid floor carries only a sparse pattern of round drain holes, the short ends have molded-in hand-grip cutouts, and stacking lugs project from the top rim with small feet under the bottom corners.

family_scale1__Z_00687_0.desc: A round metal coupling flange made as a thin annular plate with a wider toothed/knurled band around its outer rim that stands proud of both side faces. The front face carries concentric stepped recesses and shoulders, and the centre is a through bore opened by a larger counterbore from one side.
