Sixteen small through holes sit equally spaced on one bolt circle between the inner hub and the rim, with an across-flats wrenching feature on a boss and small edge chamfers.

family_scale1__Z_00027_0.desc: Thin-gauge folded sheet-metal part forming a shallow open tray: one flat rectangular base with two opposite edges bent up into short side walls and the ends finished with small flanged ears/tabs, all from a single blank with rounded outer corners. The base carries a mixed hole pattern—one large central through bore, a four-hole counterbored group equally spaced on a bolt circle, plus several clusters of small clearance holes—while the side walls have rows of tiny through holes and small rectangular access cutouts.

family_scale1__Z_00351_0.desc: Flat six-point snowflake medallion cast as a thin uniform shell. A small central ring boss with a through-hole anchors six radial arms in hexagonal symmetry; each arm ends in a faceted lance tip and carries mirrored side barbs plus a short inner spike, with pierced gaps between spokes and low-relief vein ridges on the front. The rear face is essentially flat with crisp edges and small corner fillets.

family_scale1__Z_00216_1.desc: Double-bitted flat key with a symmetrical blade so it inserts either way, having identical rows of edge cuts on both long edges and smooth ungrooved faces. An oval bow is pierced by one round hole plus a small stamped logo recess, and the blade ends in a centered spear point with a generous neck fillet.

family_scale1__Z_00803_0.desc: A single constant-thickness spur-gear plate with teeth around the full outside rim. Five evenly spaced teardrop lightening windows connect a small hub region to the toothed rim with rounded spoke roots and filleted corners; a small through bore sits on the axis and the section remains essentially the plate thickness.

family_scale1__Z_00751_0.desc: A one-piece flat metal link of uniform thin wall: a round annular eye boss with a single centered through bore blends through a small fillet into a straight rectangular tang that leaves the ring side and ends in a semicircular tip. Ring and arm lie in the same plane; there are no ribs, slots, extra bosses, or secondary holes.

family_scale1__Z_00275_0.part_family: thin-walled vented square sleeve enclosure with chamfered corners
family_scale1__Z_00275_0.desc: A hollow open-ended square duct formed by four thin flat wall panels joined at four chamfered corner posts, giving a clipped-corner plan with a continuous rounded top lip. Opposite faces carry a central vertical column of short horizontal through-louvers between stiffening ribs, while the lower edge is a base rail with small recessed pockets and tiny rounded feet; most edges are broken with small chamfers and corner radii.

family_scale1__Z_00216_0.desc: Flat metal pin-tumbler key: an enlarged rounded ring bow with one circular through-hole blends through a short filleted neck into a thin straight blade of uniform thickness. Both blade faces carry matched longitudinal milled warding grooves along the shank; one edge is cut with a row of depth-varying bitting notches ending at an angled lead-in tip, with radiused bow and shoulder transitions.

family_scale1__Z_00744_0.part_family: slender molded flat tongue blade (insertion/pry strip)
family_scale1__Z_00744_0.desc: One-piece thin-wall molded blade: an elongated flat strip whose wider faces are split by a shallow central longitudinal arris/channel that fades out before the tip, with one side edge straight and the opposite edge on a slight draft. The leading end is closed by a full semicircular radius, while the trailing end is capped by a small faceted pentagonal chisel face; a short rectangular shoulder steps one narrow edge just above the round tip, and there are no holes, bosses or ribs.

family_pilot__Z_00106_1.part_family: flat circular lugged flange cover with annular seal groove
family_pilot__Z_00106_1.desc: A flat circular flange cap of the same family built as one thin annular panel with six evenly spaced perimeter lugs and matching drilled holes. It has a single central large through bore surrounded by a raised sealing boss and one concentric groove, plus three kidney-shaped lightening openings spaced around the port; the rim carries a small locating notch and rounded edges.

family_scale1__Z_00356_2.desc: A lighter ribbed coupling hub built from a flat annular plate with three large sector cut-outs for weight reduction, a central hub with a keyed through-bore and a concentric blind pilot recess on the reverse side, and six short top-face gussets that do not reach the outer rim. It uses three tapped standoff bosses rather than full-height posts, two opposing flats on the outside for a wrench, and four countersunk mounting holes on one bolt circle; the perimeter is otherwise plain with no slots.

family_pilot__Z_00059_1.desc: An H-ladder chassis plate of the same sheet family: two parallel side rails are tied by three cross braces into one flat web. Lightening is done with long oval slots along the rails and round avionics holes near the middle, while the rail ends use slotted motor tabs instead of a round bolt-circle pattern. The perimeter has fewer but larger corner radii, no chamfers, and a front-to-back offset pair of battery-strap slots makes the layout asymmetric.

family_scale1__Z_00264_0.desc: Single long machined-metal carrier: a thin flat web links two low mounting end feet, and a raised pad near one end carries a side-by-side pair of counterbored through-bores. The raised section is studded with small through-holes and pin bores plus a dense row of tiny edge grooves/radii, with filleted step transitions between the feet, web and pad.

family_pilot__Z_00100_0.desc: A flat, thin one-piece plate of irregular outline with a tall hook-shaped upright ear at the top that carries a dense cluster of small through-holes, several additional groups of small through-holes along the right edge and lower tab, and one large rounded-rectangular central window. Outer corners and the junction of the ear to the plate use generous fillets, and a row of integral stiffening ribs runs along the left edge. One face is essentially flat with raised bosses around the holes.

family_scale1__Z_00290_2.desc: Shallow dished radial plate with six short lobes around a stepped central through-hub; alternating lobes carry a round through-hole and a radial slot, the underside has a recessed circular seat with three ribs tying the hub to a continuous outer rim, and the rim is interrupted by a few locating notches with only selective edge rounds.

family_scale1__Z_00206_0.desc: One-piece metal bracket formed as a C-channel in side section: a tall flat rear mounting web carries two parallel cantilever ears, upper and lower, each ending in a rounded lug. The web face is densely patterned with small through and tapped holes, countersunk holes and several raised rectangular boss pads; each lug has a large central cross bore ringed by an equally spaced bolt circle on its end face. The gap between the ears is open, the ear-to-web roots use generous fillets, outer edges are chamfered and the walls are thin and uniform.

family_pilot__Z_00099_1.part_family: thin flat machined linkage plate (instrument lever/bracket)
family_pilot__Z_00099_1.desc: Compact flat L-bracket of the same plate family: one leg carries a single large circular eye sized for a pressed bearing and ringed by a bolt circle of counterbored holes, while the other leg is a narrower mounting tab laid out with an inline row of slotted adjustment holes; a small triangular gusset is coined at the inside corner and the perimeter is fully filleted.

family_scale1__Z_00221_2.desc: A four-point star ornament plate with an openwork lattice of diamond-shaped openings between a small ring hub and the pointed outer tips. The blanked edge is scalloped rather than spiked, the central bore carries a single keyway slot, and a small raised boss with a through hole sits at each star tip for fastening.

family_scale1__Z_00515_0.desc: One-piece flat metal ring gear: a thin circular annulus with a continuous band of straight spur teeth around its outer rim and a large concentric plain through-bore. The two side faces are flat and parallel, the axial face width is small versus the diameter, and there is no hub, web, keyway, or fastener hole—only the toothed rim and the smooth bore.

family_scale1__Z_00753_1.desc: Same family but with end preparation and fastening: a constant-section thin-wall rectangular hollow strut having one square-cut open end and one coped/mitred end, plus a drilled cross-hole near each end for a pin or bolt; still a plain closed-tube spar with no ribs or bosses.

family_pilot__Z_00046_2.part_family: thin triangular spacer plate with raised circular pad
family_pilot__Z_00046_2.desc: Rounded-corner triangular shallow-shell variant: the panel is a low drawn dish whose off-center circular feature is an open hollow sleeve, flanked by two parallel oblong slots toward the base edge. A raised annular sealing bead rings the sleeve on the outer face, and a single locating notch breaks one side edge.

family_scale1__Z_00428_1.desc: A flat spring-steel pull with an elongated closed finger loop at one end and a forked two-prong tang at the other; the prongs carry small pierced holes and a shallow central slot, and a single embossed stiffening rib runs along the shank between loop and fork.

family_scale1__Z_00722_1.part_family: thin flat openwork lattice grille panel with bolt-circle mounting ears
family_scale1__Z_00722_1.desc: A circular vent-guard member of the same family: a flat ring of two concentric hoops joined by evenly spaced radial spokes, with a solid central boss pierced by a single countersunk hole. Six short mounting tabs project from the outer hoop and use open-ended slots rather than drilled holes, and the spoke roots are generously filleted while the whole grille keeps one constant wall thickness.

family_scale1__Z_00371_0.desc: A uniform-thickness folded sheet-metal bracket shaped as a shallow U-channel: a flat rectangular deck with two opposing edge flanges bent down at right angles plus small end tabs. The deck carries one large central circular through-hole ringed by an equally spaced bolt-circle of small holes, an additional row of clearance holes, several countersunk holes, and a few obround slots; the side flanges repeat smaller round holes for side mounting. All folds are small radiused bends with corner reliefs and notched flange ends, with no separate ribs or bosses.

family_scale1__Z_00051_0.part_family: ring-shaped spring washer with circumferential teeth
family_scale1__Z_00051_0.desc: A thin annular metal washer with a flat base and a series of radial teeth formed around its entire inner circumference, creating a continuous toothed edge that projects from the central bore.

family_scale1__Z_00674_1.desc: Ventilation grille variant of the same family: a larger rectangular panel laid out as three columns of square through-openings, with a thickened outer flange, countersunk mounting holes near the four corners, and snap-fit clips molded along one long edge for tool-free installation.

family_scale1__Z_00421_2.part_family: thin flat multi-eyelet plate (spinner-style bossed flange)
family_scale1__Z_00421_2.desc: Compact square-pattern flange: one larger central annular hub with a keyed through bore, ringed by four smaller plain eyelets on a concentric bolt circle and bridged by four broad curved in-plane spokes. The outer edge is scalloped between eyelets to cut mass, every feature is pierced straight through a constant-thickness blank, and the finished part remains flat with no formed flanges.

family_pilot__Z_00055_2.desc: A diamond-oriented thin medallion plate whose four vertices are generously radiused and whose edge is turned into a shallow downturned flange. The front shows an embossed labyrinth glyph of straight bars around a small central pad, while the rear carries a regular grid of small square standoff pads, three blind insert bosses, and a continuous perimeter groove for an adhesive seal.

family_scale1__Z_00520_0.desc: A straight, prismatic thin-wall rectangular tube is folded into a closed hollow box on three faces with crisp bend corners and open ends; the fourth longitudinal face is replaced by an in-plane Warren zig-zag of short diagonal struts spanning between two edge chords, using mixed strut lengths and mirrored half-bays at the extremities. Internal transverse bulkhead ribs stiffen the box at intervals, and one solid face carries a small group of identical obround slots plus paired locating positions.

family_scale1__Z_00044_2.part_family: radial leaf-scale crown finial on pedestal stem
family_scale1__Z_00044_2.desc: A post-top variant starts with an octagonal socket base having an internal bore to slip over a rail post, then a short fluted neck and many staggered rings of narrow pointed blades that alternate long and short around the axis. Adjacent blades leave small vent gaps, the lowest ring blades hook outward over the neck, and a small cap closes the crown while the socket adds an internal keyway and cross-hole for a locking pin.

family_pilot__Z_00073_0.part_family: handled single-edged pointed blade (fixed utility knife)
family_pilot__Z_00073_0.desc: Thin single-edged blade integrally joined to a round grip through a short perpendicular crossguard. The blade is a flat uniform-thickness plate with a symmetric spear-point tip, a flat unsharpened spine on one side, and a ground cutting edge on the other that is plain near the tip and changes to a serrated saw segment toward the guard; both bevels meet at a shallow included angle. A small ricasso sits ahead of the guard, with filleted transitions into the guard and grip, and the handle is a plain cylindrical bar closed by a rounded pommel.

family_scale1__Z_00276_1.desc: Compact over-center retainer with a wide C-shaped spring base, an offset living hinge, and a short hook that closes into one rectangular catch. It has a slotted side ear, a single cross-pin boss, and straight stiffening ribs, with no barrel end.

family_scale1__Z_00006_1.desc: Compact two-port variant: a shallow open-bottom housing with only two square top windows and one central dividing rib, smooth even-height side walls, integral snap-latch hooks on the long faces in place of mounting feet, and a simple perimeter chamfer with no large corner chamfers or internal slot pattern.

family_scale1__Z_00341_2.desc: A half-covered variant in which only part of the rectangle bears the square-cell rib lattice while the remainder stays a solid thin mounting skin. The gridded area mixes bands of square cells with rows of elongated slots, and the back side adds two edge snap tabs and a small central locating boss.

family_scale1__Z_00491_0.part_family: knurled slender shaft with drilled tip
family_scale1__Z_00491_0.desc: One long straight cylindrical solid shank whose full length carries a fine repeating texture of many small rounded grooves (a knurl). At one end the shank steps through short coaxial shoulders into a compact drill pad holding a central axial through-hole plus four small through-holes equally spaced on a bolt circle; the far end is a plain cut face. Everything is axisymmetric and coaxial, with no tabs, slots, ribs or side bosses.

family_scale1__Z_00415_1.desc: A wider hinge-leaf variant with two separated curled barrels along the same edge, a short plain gap between them, and a flat mounting tongue carrying two round holes near the free corners.

family_scale1__Z_00316_1.part_family: ratcheting cam-lever band clamp for a round tube
family_scale1__Z_00316_1.desc: A two-piece hose-size clamp of the same family: a smooth-bore molded saddle carries a separate toothed strap whose tail threads through a buckle block, while a stamped bail handle pivots on a rivet to over-center and lock the tail. Instead of a full ribbed band it uses a short run of ratchet teeth, a spring-pawl release tab, gusset ribs at the buckle, and an extra mounting boss off to one side.

family_scale1__Z_00808_0.desc: A very slim, low-profile rectangular open frame molded as one thin shell: two long side rails are tied together by short end walls around a large central through-window, leaving a continuous narrow rim rather than a solid deck. The rim carries four small rounded standoff bumps on the top and bottom edges, two opposed raised pads partway along the long sides, matching large concave finger reliefs at both ends, a shallow height step in the cross-section, and numerous tiny edge chamfers around the perimeter.

family_scale1__Z_00635_2.part_family: slender multi-slot extruded aluminium profile rail
family_scale1__Z_00635_2.desc: A heavier symmetric member of the same family built around a closed rectangular core with internal webs, carrying fine longitudinal ribs on two opposite faces only. Several full-length small channels route wiring, both ends are countersunk for fasteners, and the profile roots use generous fillets rather than chamfered end edges.

family_pilot__Z_00097_0.part_family: long thin flat strip / spacer bar
family_pilot__Z_00097_0.desc: A single elongated solid strip of constant thin rectangular cross-section running its full length, much longer than it is wide. Both short ends carry a slightly enlarged rectangular pad or tab standing proud of the main face. There are no holes, slots, ribs, or cutouts; edges are crisp with negligible fillets, giving a plain flat-bar form.

family_pilot__Z_00083_2.part_family: pigeonhole shelving frame of thin panels
family_pilot__Z_00083_2.desc: Low, wide two-bay bin shelf: a central vertical divider and two shelf levels create four open compartments under a continuous top panel, while a diagonal cross brace between the rear uprights replaces a solid back. The shelf front edges have upturned retaining lips with punched label-holder slots, and the bottom panel extends into mounting feet with anchor holes.

family_scale1__Z_00262_1.part_family: thin machined carrier plate with clustered ring bosses
family_scale1__Z_00262_1.desc: Same family but rearranged in line: three annular ring bosses sit in a row along a flat spine plate, joined by straight side rails instead of triangular webs. Two end mounting through-holes, elongated lightening slots between rings, and unlike end radii give it an asymmetric oblong outline.

family_scale1__Z_00148_2.desc: Two-lobe bar variant: an elongated symmetrical plate with the bearing bore at mid-span and a large round weighted head at each end. Each head carries a removable ring weight retained by a small radial set screw, a row of small through holes lightens the connecting bar, one face has a shallow recessed finger pad around the hub, and generous fillets blend the bar into both heads.

family_pilot__Z_00107_1.desc: Similar family part: an offset double-end flat link with a circular pivot boss at each end, one boss open to the edge by a clamp slot and cross pinch hole while the other stays closed; the connecting web is laterally offset and lightened by one oblong window.

family_scale1__Z_00077_1.desc: An oblong version of the same tray family uses two side-by-side rectangular recessed cells split by a central spine, each cell holding a dense staggered array of small through holes and covered by a straight (edge-parallel) egg-crate rib grid rather than diagonal bracing. The perimeter wall is stepped to form a clamping ledge, four corner counterbored mounting holes sit outside the recessed field, and two long lifting slots are cut through the end walls; the back face adds short transverse stiffening ribs between the cells.

family_scale1__Z_00003_0.part_family: thin flat multi-window carrier frame / bezel strip with edge latch notches
family_scale1__Z_00003_0.desc: A slim, flat rectangular frame of uniform thin stock holding a single row of three identical rounded-rectangle through-windows separated by straight transverse webs. The window corners are generously filleted, both long edges carry a repeating pattern of small latch notches and short locating tabs, and the short ends are stepped with little tabs; a shallow recessed floor with a slightly raised perimeter lip gives the strip a shallow tray section.

family_scale1__Z_00119_2.desc: Taller multi-bay grille having three louver banks separated by two vertical ribs, mixing horizontal slot rows with a short column of round breather holes near one end. A flanged rear edge, four blind boss pads, and intermittent side clip slots create a different mounting scheme from the flat rectangular pattern.

family_scale1__Z_00207_2.part_family: flat toothed rotary ring (sprocket / reluctor wheel)
family_scale1__Z_00207_2.desc: A very thin press-fit encoder/reluctor ring for the same family: a plain inner bore sized for an interference fit on a shaft with no hub and no screws, and a large count of fine rectangular teeth cut on the inner edge rather than the outside. A few stamped index apertures break the web, the tooth edges are left sharp without chamfers, and retention relies on the press fit plus adhesive rather than a three-hole bolt pattern.

family_pilot__Z_00015_1.desc: Four-arm clamping knob with a more square star outline and a blind threaded insert in the hub rather than a through bore. Deep concave scallops separate the arms, the underside is lightened by a shallow pocket, and the rim uses coarse knurling with only a few reinforcing ribs.

family_scale1__Z_00770_0.part_family: tapered flat sheet-metal spring strip (wedge clip)
family_scale1__Z_00770_0.desc: A single narrow flat strip of constant width, rectangular in plan, with one straight longitudinal edge and an opposing sloped face that feathers the thickness down to a thin toe. The wide heel end is bent up into a tight curled hook that reads as a stacked multi-layer rectangle in the end view, and just inboard of the hook the lower edge is interrupted by one small rectangular catch notch; a hidden line running lengthwise marks a shallow underside groove starting near mid-length. There are no through holes, and the only radii are the small bend of the hook and the rounded toe.

family_scale1__Z_00737_1.desc: Similar family part with a two-by-two array of larger rectangular windows: a heavier outer rim carries one vertical and one horizontal cross web, plus small locator tabs on one edge and two round tooling holes in the rim. Corners are more rounded and the rear face has a shallow sealing groove.

family_scale1__Z_00606_2.desc: Alternative: low-profile blower wheel folded from one annular sheet, with sixteen forward-inclined tabs and an open inner ring rather than a shroud. Three oblong mounting slots surround the center hole, and small rim notches are provided for balancing.

family_scale1__Z_00759_2.part_family: short molded optical light-guide rod (light pipe)
family_scale1__Z_00759_2.desc: A hub-and-spoke light guide: one thick central button takes a lamp on its flat polished rear face and feeds three thin curved arms that radiate outward in a single plane. Each arm terminates in a domed, lightly frosted exit tip, while the underside carries small alignment pins and a shallow stiffening rib ring, with no through-holes.

family_scale1__Z_00223_0.desc: Single thin flat plate cut as a symmetric X, with a small central hub joined to four equal arms by necked, filleted roots. The hub has one large centre through-hole ringed by four small equally spaced fixing holes, and each arm tip widens into a motor pad drilled with a small hole cluster; the whole part is uniform thickness with rounded outer corners.

family_scale1__Z_00728_0.part_family: stamped lanced sheet-metal encoder tone ring
family_scale1__Z_00728_0.desc: This part is a thin flat annular steel web with a large concentric through bore; around the band a single row of identical rectangular tabs is lanced from the web and bent up to one side to a uniform axial height, forming a crenellated rail above the ring. The tabs repeat on a constant pitch with a few evenly spaced missing-tooth gaps and several flat land pads left in the plane of the ring; bend roots carry small fillets, the inner and outer edges are sheared, and the pattern is rotationally symmetric about the bore.

family_pilot__Z_00041_0.desc: A constant-thickness flat plate cut to a tapered triangular outline that ends in a sharp nose on one side. The wide end is opened by a single large concave semicircular notch, leaving short rectangular ears above and below it; the remaining perimeter is one straight edge and one diagonal edge, with no holes, ribs, bends, or bosses.

family_scale1__Z_00673_0.desc: A long, unequal-leg L-shaped angle rail of constant thin wall thickness, plain-cut at both ends. The narrower leg carries a row of three small round through-holes along its centerline, while the wider leg carries three oblong stadium-shaped slots on its own centerline, the two patterns interleaved along the length; the inside corner is a sharp or lightly radiused bend with no other ribs or bosses.

family_scale1__Z_00405_2.part_family: thin slotted contact plate with integral tang
family_scale1__Z_00405_2.desc: Another member of the family with two unequal tangs projecting from opposite corners of a slotted flat body. It carries one row of larger eyelets, each with a small raised boss, a central rectangular window, and shallow embossed ribs between the holes instead of full through-slots.

family_scale1__Z_00524_1.part_family: thin machined bezel frame with rectangular window pockets
family_scale1__Z_00524_1.desc: Slim single-bay bezel of the same thin machined-plate family: one centered rectangular recess with a uniform shallow seating ledge on all four sides, four raised corner bosses each drilled once for fasteners, a cable notch on one long edge, and rounded outer corners instead of a stepped lip.

family_scale1__Z_00726_2.desc: An elongated variant of the same family with staggered circular vents plus a few oblong slots near the ends. One long edge is a continuous bead for locating, the opposite edge has spaced snap hooks, and selected transverse ribs cross the back while leaving the hole field clear.

family_scale1__Z_00085_1.desc: A wider two-lane member of the same thin-wall carrier family: the base is split by a single central spine rib, while two opposite perimeter walls are extended upward into flat mounting flanges drilled with a row of clearance holes. The closed end wall is pierced by two large circular connector cutouts instead of slots, the corners are reinforced with small gusset bosses, and the base carries only a sparse pattern of counterbored fasteners.

family_scale1__Z_00526_0.desc: Single annular-sector rail with a stepped L-shaped radial section: a thicker concave band carries one continuous row of evenly pitched trapezoidal teeth, while an integral taller thin rim runs along the convex edge as a smooth guide lip, the two joined by a central web. The radial end faces are plain square cuts, hidden concentric shoulders beneath the rim form a recessed seat, and there are no through-holes.

family_scale1__Z_00394_0.desc: Single-piece bracket made of one short hollow cylindrical boss with a single coaxial through-bore, fused along one side to a flat rectangular blade; an inclined planar gusset web bridges from the boss wall down to the far edge of the blade, leaving an open triangular pocket, and the blade is a plain uniform plate with no holes, slots, ribs, counterbores or edge relief.

family_scale1__Z_00688_1.part_family: open cubic structural frame node / six-face connector hub
family_scale1__Z_00688_1.desc: A trihedral corner variant of the same node family: three thick-walled square tubes converge into one solid corner block, leaving the three outer mating faces open to receive rails and using blind tapped holes instead of through bores. Triangular gusset ribs brace the inner corner, one face carries a slotted adjustment hole, and only the external corner edges are radiused.

family_scale1__Z_00321_2.desc: Stamped rotor disc variant: a flat annular plate with evenly spaced rim-open radial slots forming teeth around the edge and an inner ring of round vent holes. A low raised center boss carries a splined round bore with one locating notch, and a few dimpled standoffs stiffen the plate-to-hub transition.

family_scale1__Z_00809_1.desc: A flat sheet-metal gusset bracket punched as a triangular plate with one central lightening bore and three equal clearance holes along the base edge. Two adjacent sides are folded upward to form stiffening flanges, each flange ending in an obround adjustment slot, and every external corner is closed with a small fillet.

family_scale1__Z_00512_0.desc: Open rectangular molded tray with a continuous perimeter wall, a stepped cover rim and generously radiused outer corners. Two opposite inner walls carry dense straight fin/rib stacks separated by narrow grooves, the floor holds a mix of tiny blind screw bosses, taller standoffs, small rectangular connector shrouds and clearance holes, and short ears with through-holes project from two opposite edges for mounting.

family_scale1__Z_00642_1.desc: Rectangular version of the same tray family, elongated in one direction with a four-by-two rib grid and a slightly taller outer wall. A continuous lowered channel replaces one transverse rib, four corner mounting bosses with through holes sit on the base, and the rim uses short vent slots rather than full castellations.

family_scale1__Z_00550_0.desc: One-piece flat annular plate with a continuous external tooth band around the rim and a plain constant-thickness web. The center has a through bore with a shallow counterbore from one face, and the web is pierced by sixteen equally spaced through holes on a single bolt circle; there are no separate bosses, only lightly broken tooth roots and hole edges.

family_scale1__Z_00709_0.part_family: profiled flat metal linkage/clevis plate bracket
family_scale1__Z_00709_0.desc: A single solid plate of uniform thickness is profiled to an irregular podal outline: a tall land carries two concave half-round saddle notches and a stepped toothed edge, then a diagonal web runs down into a small rectangular clevis lug. The face is pierced through the thickness by one large bore in a wide land, one medium bore, and several small cross-centred pin holes, with square exterior edges and small fillets/internal radii at the notches and steps. There are no bends or shells; the lug ends in a transverse pin hole and the stepped edge forms a little two-step foot.

family_scale1__Z_00602_0.desc: A constant-thickness flat plate profiled as a sixfold dendritic snowflake: six radial arms each carry mirrored side twigs, with open V-notches between branches running to the outer edge. A short straight attachment tab projects from one side; all edges are through-cut perpendicular to the faces, with sharp external corners and no ribs, bosses, or enclosed holes.

family_scale1__Z_00408_1.desc: Snap-on edge seal in the same profile family: a C-channel that grips a panel edge is co-extruded with a hollow cushioning bulb on the outer side and a row of short internal barb fins on the channel legs. One end is mitred and the web carries a pair of small moulded mounting holes plus a flexible sealing lip.

family_scale1__Z_00315_0.part_family: vented flat faceplate panel with end mounting tab
family_scale1__Z_00315_0.desc: A thin rigid rectangular cover plate formed as one piece, with a rounded-corner rectangular through window near one end, a dense central field of many parallel horizontal through-slots acting as a vent grille, and the opposite end stepped into a short right-angle ear pierced by a vertical obround slot; the window corners are filleted, the many slot edges carry small chamfers, and the outside perimeter has a shallow edge break.

family_scale1__Z_00117_2.desc: A rectangular louvered guard panel stamped from thin sheet with a bent-down edge channel on all four sides for stiffness. A dense field of parallel horizontal slots forms the venting area, framed by a solid border that holds two keyhole mounting slots at the top corners and two plain holes at the bottom; a pressed rib runs down the middle of the border, and the panel corners are notched and hemmed.

family_scale1__Z_00585_1.part_family: T-slot structural aluminium extrusion cut to length
family_scale1__Z_00585_1.desc: Square modular framing extrusion built around one central tap bore with four internal spokes, a single T-groove centred on each outside face and small radiused outer corners; supplied as a straight cut with one end square, the opposite end mitred, and a transverse clearance hole near the mitred end.

family_scale1__Z_00582_2.part_family: flat profile-cut miniature rifle replica plate
family_scale1__Z_00582_2.desc: Compact submachine-gun silhouette in the same thin profile-plate family, with a short receiver, a curved magazine, and a folding stock suggested by a hinged outline rather than a fixed stock. Only a short run of cross-slots is cut at the front of the handguard, the grip and fore-end use wide rectangular lightening slots, several small assembly pin holes are spread through the body, and the muzzle end is stepped to imply a barrel nut.

family_pilot__Z_00056_0.part_family: thin flat slat with obliquely cut ends
family_pilot__Z_00056_0.desc: A single monolithic flat strip of constant thin rectangular cross-section, much longer than it is wide, with plain parallel faces and no holes, slots, ribs or bosses; both short ends are sheared on the same matching skew angle so the two long edges finish at different stations, leaving sharp cut faces with only a light edge break.

family_scale1__Z_00201_1.desc: Open U-shaped card-guide shell in the same family, with the fourth side left open for insertion; six narrow latch slots in the rear rail, two blind threaded-insert bosses under the base, continuous corner fillets, and no external mounting ears.

family_scale1__Z_00197_0.desc: A flat steel drive sprocket built as a thin annular rim carrying many rounded external teeth around its full perimeter, joined through a pierced web to a smaller-diameter stepped hub that projects from one face. The web holds a central pilot bore plus an evenly spaced ring of round through-holes on a bolt circle, with generous fillets at the tooth roots and at the rim-to-hub transition.

family_scale1__Z_00638_1.part_family: finned hollow extrusion with gabled profile
family_scale1__Z_00638_1.desc: Hollow rectangular extruded enclosure of the same finned family, with cooling ribs across the top and down both side walls but a smooth mounting face underneath. A continuous internal web splits the cavity into two longitudinal chambers, and open T-slots run along the base for sliding nuts or brackets; the ends are machined square and one end carries a short row of tapped holes for an end plate.

family_scale1__Z_00645_1.part_family: thin toothed annular indexing ring (encoder/timing disc)
family_scale1__Z_00645_1.desc: A thicker annular indexing ring with far fewer, wider external castellations separated by deep rectangular slots, a large central through bore instead of a raised hub, and four tapped mounting holes on a mid-radius bolt circle. One face carries a short axial locating boss and the rim teeth are chamfered on their leading edges, while the opposite face is plain.

family_scale1__Z_00215_0.desc: Elongated one-piece molded insulator on a thin full-length base rail, with two parallel upstanding walls forming a long channel; the taller rear wall has a concave saddle cut across its top edge. Both walls carry repeated rectangular through-slots arranged in two horizontal tiers, separated by thin integral ribs, and the ends are closed by low cheek walls with rounded finger notches and generous corner fillets over a continuous mounting foot.

family_scale1__Z_00215_2.desc: Barrier-style insulator whose base extends into side mounting ears, with an upstanding wall carrying many small cavities grouped into stacks split by a central solid web; cavity depths alternate, entry mouths are chamfered rather than filleted, one side has a raised polarizing rib, and the end walls are open U-notches for wire entry.

family_scale1__Z_00630_1.desc: A straight three-square needle file with an equilateral triangular cross-section, kept essentially parallel in width and tapered only slightly in thickness toward the tip. All three faces are single-cut with sharp arrises, one narrow edge is left safe, and the heel ends in a short round tang behind a flared shoulder.

family_scale1__Z_00296_1.desc: Same finned-plate family but arranged as a horizontal-louver vent: a flat rectangular panel with a raised perimeter flange and four corner counterbored mounting holes, carrying two stacked fields of short horizontal rounded-end slots separated by a solid crossbar. The slots are blind, stopping before the edges to leave a continuous solid border, and the back face has a shallow recessed pocket clearing the louver area.

family_scale1__Z_00366_0.part_family: profiled flat sheet-metal hand lever bracket
family_scale1__Z_00366_0.desc: A thin constant-thickness profiled metal lever with a wide contoured grip head carrying lobe-like finger projections and one closed elongated slot, blended through a waisted neck into a narrower straight tang. The head has several through holes of differing sizes and the tang ends in a rounded tab pierced by a close pair of matching through holes, with small fillets around the perimeter and chamfered edges at selected holes.

family_scale1__Z_00430_0.desc: A solid turned metal pin with one long slender round shank coaxially joined to a shorter, larger-diameter grip. The grip carries dense straight longitudinal knurl ribs, while the free end of the shank reduces to a short conical point blended with small rounded fillets; there are no holes, slots, threads, cavities, or added bosses.

family_scale1__Z_00673_2.desc: A long roll-formed slotted angle rail of light gauge with equal legs, perforated over its full length. Both legs carry a uniform pitch pattern of round holes repeated many times, with a single long oblong adjustment slot near each end of one leg; the ends are square-cut and the length contains evenly spaced stamped holes rather than drilled features.

family_scale1__Z_00131_1.desc: Similar thin carrier disc but with four larger clearance bores on a single pitch circle and no full outer rim—four straight spokes connect the bossed holes directly to a stepped center hub that has a D-shaped bore and a single keyway. The hole bosses are counterbored from one face for captive fastener heads, the opposite face is flat, and two opposed spring tabs replace the full ring of lugs.

family_scale1__Z_00697_0.part_family: flat rectangular multi-opening frame of thin profiles
family_scale1__Z_00697_0.desc: A shallow rectangular perimeter frame is joined from thin constant-wall rectangular profiles into outer stiles, a centre mullion and top and bottom rails, forming two tall side-by-side bays. Each bay holds a recessed inner sub-frame with a short upper transom pierced by a pair of small rectangular slots, one large central opening, and a lower sill zone interrupted by two small rectangular ports. The rails carry evenly repeated small perforations along their length and the section depth stays slim from front to back.

family_scale1__Z_00239_0.desc: One constant-thickness plate is cut to a branching three-lobed outline whose arms meet in filleted junctions; the whole outer edge is chamfered. One arm tip carries a small hexagonal through feature next to an elongated closed slot with a hexagonal seat, the center and the opposite arm carry several hexagonal holes and raised hexagonal pads of mixed size, and one side is formed into a stepped edge with short chamfered tabs, angled lead-ins and small notches.

family_scale1__Z_00766_0.part_family: splined coupling collar with radial torque lugs
family_scale1__Z_00766_0.desc: A thick-walled annular collar whose bore carries an internal involute spline along only part of its length, the remaining barrel being plain cylinder. One end face is opened into a one-piece external star of eight equally spaced radial lugs around the rim, concentric to the splined bore; the spline band shows as a short toothed section in the axial view, joined to the barrel by small steps and blend fillets.

family_scale1__Z_00766_1.part_family: splined coupling collar with radial torque lugs
family_scale1__Z_00766_1.desc: A flat lock-ring variant of the same family: a thin annular plate with a full-face internal involute spline, six rounded external torque tabs projecting in the plane of the ring, and a short rectangular locking slot between two adjacent tabs. The bore edge is chamfered on one side and the outer tab roots are filleted, with no extended barrel.

family_scale1__Z_00640_2.part_family: cut-to-length T-slot sigma aluminum structural framing extrusion
family_scale1__Z_00640_2.desc: Wide deck-style framing extrusion built from three closed rectangular cells in a row tied by short transverse webs, still a uniform thin-wall no-draft profile. Put T-slots only on the broad faces with two slots across the top and one continuous slot on the bottom, add diagonal braces inside the outer cells, countersunk end-connector hole patterns at both square-cut ends, and small chamfers along the long outside edges.

family_scale1__Z_00489_1.desc: A single straight gear rack: one solid flat bar with a continuous row of rack teeth along one longitudinal edge and a thicker rectangular backing spine on the opposite edge. Two clearance holes pass through the spine near the ends, a small locating boss stands at one end, and the tooth roots are filleted into the web.

family_pilot__Z_00051_0.desc: A constant-width thin sheet strip folded along several parallel transverse creases into an open lightning-bolt (Z) profile: four flat rectangular panels linked edge-to-edge by sharp alternating bends and meeting in pointed outer corners. Uniform wall throughout with no holes, slots, ribs, bosses, or fillets—only planar flanges and bend edges.

family_scale1__Z_00132_1.desc: Flat bar-style link of the same family: an elongated plate with two circular end lobes connected by a narrow waisted arm, each lobe holding a hexagonal nut-capture socket, with one lobe extended into a small mounting tab pierced by a round hole and all perimeter edges filleted.

family_pilot__Z_00116_2.desc: Another variant is a narrow U-cradle bent from flat bar: two equal-height uprights rise from a short base and one upright ends in an out-turned fastening flange. Each upright carries a single weld-nut boss, the base has one locating notch, and all bends use generous radii rather than sharp folds.

family_scale1__Z_00414_0.part_family: thin stamped sheet-metal plate / flat shim bracket with stepped outline
family_scale1__Z_00414_0.desc: This part is a single thin flat metal plate of uniform thickness with a stepped L-shaped plan outline: a full-width body transitions through one internal rectangular step into a narrower elongated leg, with a small edge relief at one end. All edges are straight sheared cuts meeting at right angles; there are no holes, slots, bends, ribs, or surface features—just a plain flat profiled blank.

family_scale1__Z_00019_2.desc: A compact L-shaped bent sheet-metal bezel/bracket: a narrow base leg carrying two slotted mounting holes joins a taller vertical leg at a right-angle fold reinforced by a small gusset. The vertical leg has one circular port, two obround slots, and several punched dimples forming locating bosses, while the exposed outer edge is curled and the bend uses generous fillets rather than perforated fastener patterns.

family_scale1__Z_00809_0.desc: A thin-gauge sheet-metal plate laser-cut to an irregular multi-sided outline with radiused outer corners and one broadly rounded lower edge. The flat web carries two large circular through-openings, a short obround slot, and a cluster of small counterbored mounting holes grouped around the openings; the blank is brake-formed with a single obtuse bend that turns one edge into a narrow mounting flange while keeping uniform wall thickness.

family_scale1__Z_00234_1.desc: A shallow rectangular louvered vent panel of bent sheet metal: a flat perimeter mounting flange carries one bank of angled stamped louvers across a gently domed center, with punched corner holes, a hemmed outer edge, and small embossed stiffening beads between slots; the layout is symmetric and the louvers stop short of the flange.

family_pilot__Z_00076_2.desc: Another variant is a wider perforated chassis rail built as a shallow tray with flanged long sides and several cross ties; alternating circular connector holes, square knockout windows, and ventilation slots march along the center web. Reinforcing gussets at the bends and turned-up end ears make a stiffer, more enclosed frame while keeping the same cut-and-folded construction.

family_scale1__Z_00047_1.part_family: stamped toothed sensor reluctor ring (tone wheel)
family_scale1__Z_00047_1.desc: A dished pressed-steel impulse ring whose wide inner mounting band is joined by an axial step to an outer sensing track; instead of external castellations the track is a row of punched rectangular windows, and the inner band carries six clearance holes plus two locating notches, with a rolled stiffening bead circling the step between band and track.

family_scale1__Z_00514_0.desc: Straight segment of slotted aluminium framing extrusion with a symmetrical multi-cavity profile: two mirrored outer rails are tied by a central web, the web carries three inline through bores, and the perimeter repeats open T-slots, small grooves and radiused corners along the full extruded length.

family_pilot__Z_00109_0.desc: Open-ended monolithic thick-walled regular-hex tube with a coaxial hexagonal through-bore and chamfered end rims. One flat carries a centered axial column of identical hexagonal through-pockets, while adjacent flats mix long closed-end slots, raised guide rails, small end notches, dense triangular dimples, edge ribs, and short rectangular or hexagonal locating bosses; arrises are lightly filleted.

family_scale1__Z_00524_2.part_family: thin machined bezel frame with rectangular window pockets
family_scale1__Z_00524_2.desc: Wide three-bay carrier frame in the same family: three equal rectangular wells in a row separated by two transverse ribs, each well having a deeper center with tiny corner pads, a long slotted adjustment hole at one end and a plain clearance hole at the other, with chamfered perimeter edges and no central longitudinal rail.

family_pilot__Z_00061_2.desc: A rectangular two-light variant in which the same decorative ribbed molding forms the outer frame while an integral center mullion splits the opening into two side-by-side windows. Corners are softly radiused instead of scalloped, the back carries snap-fit clip hooks around each opening for a separate retention strip, and small drain notches are cut at the bottom of each light.

family_pilot__Z_00018_2.part_family: punched and formed sheet-metal lattice frame
family_pilot__Z_00018_2.desc: A compact radial hub variant: short formed arms project from a pressed polygonal center instead of long rails. Each arm keeps only a small regular-pitch hole group and a curled safety edge, while the hub carries one large central bore with a surrounding array of small chamfered fixing holes and stamped stiffening ribs between the arms.

family_scale1__Z_00265_0.part_family: thin radial spider plate with peripheral sockets
family_scale1__Z_00265_0.desc: A thin flat plate built as a central annular hub with one round through-bore, joined by six short curved arms to six equally spaced round end lobes; each lobe contains a hexagonal through-pocket set in a circular boss, the outer edge is one continuous scalloped star profile with generous fillets at every arm root, and both flat faces carry small chamfers and shallow edge notches around the perimeter.

family_scale1__Z_00376_1.desc: Bar-type spinner of the same family: an elongated capsule plate carrying a bearing seat at each end as counterweights plus a third seat at the balance mid-point, all joined by a narrow pinched waist. Two mirrored lightening slots pierce the waist, the faces step down between seats, and the rim uses a shallow finger groove rather than full cups.

family_scale1__Z_00784_1.part_family: thin-wall instrument tube / hypodermic-style metal cannula
family_scale1__Z_00784_1.desc: A thin-wall stainless cannula tube with a long constant-diameter body that ends in a sharpened beveled needle point at the working tip and a swaged, slightly flared collar at the hub end for attachment; a single small side port pierces the wall a short distance behind the bevel, and the lumen runs the full length.

family_pilot__Z_00068_0.part_family: bent spring-steel strip clip with rolled clamping eyes and punched features
family_pilot__Z_00068_0.desc: One piece of thin constant-thickness spring strip is punched with a row of rectangular windows and closely spaced coined stiffening ribs, then formed into a shallow arched foot that rises into a narrow neck and terminates in a single large rolled split ring; the ring has a small pinch gap at its crown for clamping around a tube or cable, and two small lanced locking barbs stick out from the sides of the neck just below the ring. The cross-section is a flat rectangular strip throughout, with the ribs and slots lying along the flat portion rather than on the curled eye.

family_scale1__Z_00053_1.desc: Straight double-ended connecting link of the same uniform plate stock, with a plain bearing eye at each end and no mid-span boss; between the eyes the web opens into a row of round lightening holes plus one long central slot, while one face also carries several shallow blind pockets. One eye is ringed by countersunk fastener holes and spot-faced, the outline uses large end fillets, and the long slot ends are left without chamfer.

family_scale1__Z_00139_1.desc: A thin triangular gusset plate with a right-triangle footprint and an open hypotenuse edge instead of a full perimeter wall. It carries one offset clearance bore plus one elongated slot, a partial hub pad, and ribs that fan from the pad toward two reinforced corner bosses with counterbored mounting holes. The remaining vertex is left as a plain locating ear with a single small hole.

family_scale1__Z_00351_1.desc: Eight-point star emblem of the same thin-cast family but with equal angular spacing and a solid, non-pierced face. Arms are shorter and broader with scalloped outer edges and a deeper domed center boss; the back carries one threaded insert and two small clearance holes for mounting instead of a front hanger hole. Relief is limited to a raised border bead and radial crease lines.

family_scale1__Z_00556_0.desc: A flat rectangular metal base plate carries two raised cooling banks on one face: a dense grid of many short vertical pin fins beside a parallel set of upright plate fins captured in a low perimeter frame. Four countersunk mounting holes sit at the plate corners, and the fin field is broken by rows of tiny through-holes, a few narrow root slots, and shallow rectangular recesses, with the close-pitched fins standing to a common height and crisp unfilleted roots.

family_pilot__Z_00105_0.part_family: bowed thin-gauge sheet-metal spring strip with serrated edges and lug teeth
family_pilot__Z_00105_0.desc: A single uniform-thickness flat sheet strip cold-formed into a shallow in-plane serpentine bow, wide in the broad face and very thin through its wall. The broad face narrows toward both tips with stepped rectangular edge notches, carries two short clusters of projecting tooth blocks near the ends, and swells to a pointed lateral tab at mid-length; notch roots and the waist blend with small fillets, and there are no pierced holes or added ribs.

family_scale1__Z_00530_2.part_family: thin rectangular bezel plate with window cutout and honeycomb grille texture
family_scale1__Z_00530_2.desc: A flat escutcheon plate with a rounded-rectangle display opening on one side and a circular through-hole on the other, separated by a single vertical column of hexagonal grille cells. A short row of oblong vent slots runs along the lower edge, and the back carries two small standoff bosses for soldering to a PCB.

family_scale1__Z_00676_0.part_family: long drilled-perforated flat bar / multi-hole mounting strip
family_scale1__Z_00676_0.desc: A straight slender bar of constant rectangular cross-section, much longer than it is wide, with flat unfinished faces and square-cut ends. Two parallel longitudinal rows of small cylindrical through-holes run the full length on the wide face: each row holds 23 evenly pitched holes (46 total), symmetric about the centerline with equal edge margins across the width and matching margins at both ends. No ribs, bosses, slots, or fillets; the holes are the only features.

family_scale1__Z_00065_0.desc: A slender thin-wall cantilever arm whose flat rectangular spine meets a taller inclined head through a short filleted knee; the head is an open triangulated lattice of diagonal ribs inside a perimeter rim, while the spine stays a slim solid-edged bar. Both ends terminate in small eye or clevis bosses with transverse pin bores, and the hinge area carries a pair of small pilot holes with matching corner fillets.

family_scale1__Z_00364_0.desc: A long straight guard-rail strip: a narrow base rail/channel carries an upstanding open fence on one edge, with regular vertical stanchions tying a lower stringer to a continuous top stringer so the bays form a repeated rectangular pattern. The end posts close the run, the underside is a simple tongue/channel rather than a hollow shell, and corners are softened with small radii rather than machined bosses or holes.

family_scale1__Z_00825_0.part_family: flat multi-arm linkage plate with truss lightening
family_scale1__Z_00825_0.desc: Thin constant-thickness plate built around a straight spine that carries a row of small through holes and castellated rectangular edge notches along one side. Two flat arms branch off the spine to the same side in a forked Y layout; each arm web is lightened by triangular truss cutouts and terminates in a rounded lug with a through pivot hole, with generous fillets throughout.

family_pilot__Z_00056_1.part_family: thin flat slat with obliquely cut ends
family_pilot__Z_00056_1.desc: A narrow flat strap of the same slat family but with square-cut ends; one end carries two spaced through holes for fasteners while the opposite end has one centred oblong adjustment slot, and all outer edges receive a small uniform radius rather than a sharp shear edge.

family_scale1__Z_00067_2.desc: A right-angle board contact pairing a smooth solid circular mating pin with a folded stamped fork set perpendicular to it. The flat fork has two tines, a rectangular window, press-fit serrations on the tail, and a gusseted folded heel; the pin gets a chamfered lead-in while each tine carries a coined wiping face.

family_scale1__Z_00651_0.desc: A slender solid rectangular bar of uniform oblong cross-section, machined only from one broad longitudinal face. The working zone near one end combines one long closed-bottom channel, a small square blind well, and two comb-like groups each of five narrow transverse blind slots; all recesses stop short of the back face so the underside and both side walls remain continuous, with sharp edges and no ribs, bosses, or through-holes.

family_scale1__Z_00778_2.desc: A flanged variant of the grooved seal ring: an L-shaped cross-section with a short axial collar on one side and a wider radial flange on the other. The flange face carries multiple concentric raised sealing lips, the inner bore is counterbored at one end, and a small relief fillet blends the collar into the flange.

family_scale1__Z_00093_0.desc: A planar square grille: a solid perimeter frame surrounds an inset field of criss-crossing ribs that intersect to leave a regular grid of small diamond/square through-slots, several across and several rows deep. Frame and ribs are one thin uniform panel with most slot edges and the outer rim broken by small chamfers; the openings sit inboard of the border with a consistent margin and the back is essentially flat.

family_scale1__Z_00380_0.part_family: slender contact pin / socket terminal on a small rectangular base block
family_scale1__Z_00380_0.desc: A long thin-walled round tube stands vertically from the top face of a compact rectangular base block and is open at its far end. The tube meets the block coaxially at a small axial bore, giving one continuous passage; the base is a plain prism with flat side faces, no shell, no ribs and no fillets.

family_scale1__Z_00132_0.desc: Flat plate of uniform thickness formed by a central circular ring with a large through hole, joined by three curved arms to three equally spaced round lobes arranged radially; each lobe carries a hexagonal through socket set within a raised annular boss, outer edges are fully rounded, and all arm-to-lobe transitions are smooth tangent blends.

family_scale1__Z_00246_1.desc: A narrow elongated bracket of the same family uses a flat spine with one edge folded into a downturned flange and the opposite edge lanced into bent-up spring fingers. It has two large round connector cutouts plus one oval cutout, clustered end mounting holes, and a repeated pattern of small stamped stiffening ribs along the spine.

family_scale1__Z_00575_0.desc: A thin flat plate with a rounded parallelogram outline and large corner radii, of essentially uniform wall thickness. Eight rounded triangular through-slots radiate from a small central diamond hub in a mirrored two-fan pattern, leaving tapered radial ribs joined to a continuous outer rim; every slot corner and rib junction is softly filleted and the opening walls are lightly drafted, with no separate bosses or fastener holes.

family_scale1__Z_00356_1.desc: A molded round end-bell style flange with a deep central bearing boss and six even radial spokes joining it to a smooth outer mounting ring; instead of upright posts it has four equally spaced perimeter mounting ears with through holes, two oblong pass-through slots, and a single keyway in the bore. The back face is a flat piloted register, the outer diameter is a plain turned flange with no wrench flats, and the rib-to-hub junctions use generous fillets for stiffness.

family_scale1__Z_00282_2.part_family: hubbed radially slotted circular cutter disc
family_scale1__Z_00282_2.desc: Shallow dished cutting disc with sparse deep scalloped gullets and rounded tooth roots; a central hexagonal through-bore is framed by an embossed annular rib, with three lightening holes and several staggered perforations in the web.

family_scale1__Z_00461_0.desc: Flat open lattice panel made of thin, uniform walls forming a repeating array of through hexagonal cells, arranged in offset rows with a stepped, rounded-outline perimeter that follows the cell pattern; the panel has constant thickness with straight side edges, no fasteners or bosses, only the open cell apertures.

family_pilot__Z_00015_0.desc: Solid low-profile six-lobe knob built around a raised central hub with a straight through bore. A thick annular rim flows into six rounded finger lobes through curved webs, the grip band carries twenty-eight uniform radial ribs/scallops, and the top has concentric steps and small lobe pads with generous fillets throughout.

family_scale1__Z_00823_2.desc: Compact square T-slot profile used as a corner post, with grooves on two adjacent faces, the other two faces closed, and one large central cavity stiffened by four diagonal corner ribs. A transverse through-hole and a pair of tapped end holes are added near one end for a connector, and the long outer edges are chamfered instead of rounded.

family_pilot__Z_00010_1.part_family: ribbed injection-molded carrier plate with through-boss array
family_pilot__Z_00010_1.desc: Same family as a closed ribbed plate but with a three-by-two array of deeper socket collars and no comb/contact edge. The rib lattice is orthogonal rather than diagonal, the long slots are replaced by round lightening holes, the back is pocketed between ribs for stiffness-to-weight, and two opposite sides are thickened into snap latch rails with integral lead-in chamfers while corner screw bosses remain.

family_pilot__Z_00086_1.desc: Constant-thickness dogbone link plate with large pivot bores at both rounded ends and a short middle lug; the connecting web adds a longitudinal obround adjustment slot, a pair of small clearance holes, and one asymmetric mounting ear, with chamfered edges.

family_pilot__Z_00062_0.desc: A thin sheet-metal carrier strip with integral upright open-channel letters spelling one short word in a straight row. Curved characters are rolled to smooth outlines while the straight characters are folded from flat returns, all sharing one constant wall thickness and standing on the same narrow base flange; small notches, tabs and pierced slots break up the rail, and the letter backs are left open.

family_scale1__Z_00160_2.desc: A long open channel rail bent from one sheet: a flat base web has two upturned side flanges for stiffness, one flange pierced with a repeated row of rectangular adjustment slots and the base carrying several round holes. The strip ends are closed with short hems and the free edge of one flange is broken by a single notch; all folds are small-radius bends.

family_scale1__Z_00004_0.desc: A single solid decorative tower on a square chamfered-edge plinth, fourfold-symmetric about the vertical axis: four stepped buttress wings rise in tiered setbacks around a cruciform core and converge to a slender central spire. Faces carry shallow recessed arched/lancet panels with vertical corner ribs and fins; outer plan corners get four chamfers, the inner crossing gets four smaller chamfers, and the base step gets four chamfers. There are no through-holes; the underside is a flat mounting face and the gaps between wings form the X void seen in plan.

family_scale1__Z_00589_0.part_family: Decorative ribbed grille panel with a flat figural silhouette overlay
family_scale1__Z_00589_0.desc: A shallow cassette of many evenly pitched parallel ribs spans a rectangular face, with the rib crests trimmed to five graduated heights so the top edge climbs in steps toward one end; the ribs share a common bottom datum edge and a thin side depth. A separate cut plate shaped as an open hand with spread fingers overlays the rib faces, the fingertips riding on the stepped crests and terminating in small faceted points produced by two short angled cuts.

family_scale1__Z_00483_0.part_family: ribbed plastic enclosure half / molded electronics chassis tray
family_scale1__Z_00483_0.desc: A shallow open-top rectangular molded enclosure base with thin peripheral walls and a flanged rim. Its flat floor mixes small through-holes with deeper counterbored mounting holes, carries several cylindrical standoffs of differing heights including one tall post boss, contains two rectangular floor cutouts, and has corner mounting pads reinforced by triangular gussets plus a short internal step forming a recessed component bay.

family_scale1__Z_00297_1.desc: A same-family alternative is a low-profile single-cavity board receptacle with two symmetric contact rows, one polarizing key and snap-in plastic board locks instead of the tall latch; the shell is a simple rectangular box with smooth end walls, a single mating throat and short right-angle solder tails.

family_scale1__Z_00214_0.desc: One-piece shallow rectangular tray: a flat base plate carries an integral perimeter mounting flange, and several open-top pockets stand on the base separated by thin vertical partition walls. Two large matching bays sit beside smaller cells; short rectangular notches break some wall tops, and the flange is patterned with through holes plus round standoff bosses, with small edge and corner radii throughout and a flat underside.

family_scale1__Z_00731_0.desc: A flat radial rotor made from twelve identical rectangular-section spokes emanating from a small star-shaped central hub; the straight spokes are evenly spaced with open gaps between them and merge only at the hub, with no separate bosses, holes, slots, or added ribs evident.

family_scale1__Z_00433_2.desc: A two-bay formed cover with unequal rectangular openings, a pressed stiffening rib down the web between bays, a short row of lanced louvers beside one opening, and several self-clinching standoffs on the rear face for board mounting.

family_scale1__Z_00162_0.desc: One-piece flat rectangular plate-frame with a large centered rectangular through-window and a narrow uniform border. Four small round mounting holes sit just outside the window corners in square raised pads, with tiny rear standoffs and small chamfered seats; the rest of the panel is low-profile with straight clean edges.

family_scale1__Z_00365_1.desc: An elongated inline manifold spacer with five identical stepped ports in a single row, each through-bored and counterbored from the top for a sealing ring, linked on the back face by shallow milled flow slots. Two dowel bores locate the plate, a continuous perimeter groove takes an O-ring, and all port edges are lightly chamfered with a smooth, rib-free bottom face.

family_scale1__Z_00469_1.part_family: tapered open-lattice spire with perforated crown
family_scale1__Z_00469_1.desc: A four-legged tapering obelisk rising from a square cast plinth that has a mounting flange and corner bolt pads; the straight rails are joined by spaced horizontal ring bands and zig-zag diagonal braces rather than a diamond skin, and it ends in a closed pyramidal cap. Lightening is by a few large teardrop openings with cast gusset fillets, with no cross-drilled pinning holes along the legs.

family_scale1__Z_00536_2.part_family: slender solid rectangular strip (flat precision bar)
family_scale1__Z_00536_2.desc: A longer adjustment and wear strip of the same prismatic family, with a centered longitudinal through-slot and several evenly spaced small through-holes along the web for sliding fastener positions; one end is formed as a full-radius round while the opposite end is cut square, and both long edges remain straight and sharp.

family_scale1__Z_00443_2.part_family: open rectangular bezel frame of thin rails
family_scale1__Z_00443_2.desc: Near-square frame from the same family with radiused outer corners and an asymmetric channel cross-section that is deeper on two opposite rails. It drops the inner panel rebate, adds vent slots along the lower rail, and uses rear snap-fit tabs with locating bosses instead of corner fasteners.

family_scale1__Z_00237_2.part_family: T-slot structural aluminum extrusion cut length
family_scale1__Z_00237_2.desc: Single-sided slotted rail extrusion with one long T-groove on the working face and the remaining faces closed into a shallow C-section. An integral mounting flange runs along the back edge with a row of slotted clearance holes for panel bolts, and staggered triangular gusset ribs connect the flange to the grooved web. A single off-center fastener bore runs the full length, the groove lips are slightly thickened, and the part is a short deburred offcut with square ends.
